import { itemData } from "./index/item_index";

/**
 * 悪魔の実データ
 * num: 実番号
 * langId: 言語ファイルid
 * tags: 能力者tag(複数)
 * itemId: 実id、テクスチャフォルダ名
 */
const akumanomiData = itemData.filter(item => item.ability).map(item => item.ability);
/**
 * データから情報を取得
 * @param {{ num: Number; langId: String; tags: String[]; itemId: String; }} [info={num,langId,tags,itemId}] 
 * @returns 
 */
export function getAkumanomiData(info={num,langId,tags,itemId}){
    if(info.num!=null){
        return akumanomiData.filter(item => item.num === info.num)[0];
    }
    else if(info.langId!=null){
        return akumanomiData.filter(item => item.langId === info.langId)[0];
    }
    else if(info.tags!=null){
        return akumanomiData.filter(item => item.tags.every((tag) => info.tags.includes(tag)))[0];
    }
    else if(info.itemId!=null){
        return akumanomiData.filter(item => item.itemId === info.itemId)[0];
    }
}
/**
 * ロギア系かどうか(9:yamiは除く)
 * @param {Number} akuma 
 */
export function isLogia(akuma) {
    return logiaList.includes(akuma);
}
const logiaList = [
    1,2,3,4,8,10,29,36
]

import { Entity, Player } from "@minecraft/server";
import { replaceItemInInventoryCombine, } from "../function";
import { spawnTamedEntity } from "../function/entityFunction";
import { shootProjectile } from "../function/combatFunction";
import { isBuso } from "../haki";



/**
 * 飛行開始
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function barabara_fly_start(player){

    const akuma = player.getProperty("op_asa:akumanomi");
    const akumaType = player.getProperty("op_asa:akumanomi_type");

    if(akuma==28 && akumaType==0){
        player.setProperty("op_asa:akumanomi_type",1);

        spawnTamedEntity("op_asa:barabara_fly_e",player.location,player);
        
        // クールダウン
        player.startItemCooldown("akumanomi2",20);
        // "飛行"を"終了"に変える
        replaceItemInInventoryCombine(player,"op_asa:barabara_fly","op_asa:barabara_fly_end");
    }
}
/**
 * 飛行終了
 * @param {Player} player 
 * @param {Number} num 
 */
export function barabara_fly_end(player,num){

    function exe(){
        // player.sendMessage("§b[bara.js]§f終了");
        // 酔い解除
		player.removeEffect("nausea");
        // 
        player.setProperty("op_asa:akumanomi_type",0);
        // クールダウン
        player.startItemCooldown("akumanomi2",20);
        // "終了"を"飛行"に変える
        replaceItemInInventoryCombine(player,"op_asa:barabara_fly_end","op_asa:barabara_fly");
    }

    // 足が存在しないまたは自分の足が存在しないから終了
    if(num==0){
        exe();
    }
    // 自分の足が存在するが64以上離れてるから終了、自分の足が64以内に存在する(右クリの場合はこれ)
    else{
        const myFeet = getMyFeet(player);
        player.teleport(myFeet.location);
        getMyFeet(player).remove();
        exe();
    }

}
/**
 * 自分の足を取得
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function getMyFeet(player){
    // 全足を取得
    const allFeet = player.dimension.getEntities({type:"op_asa:barabara_fly_e"});

    // 足が存在しない
    if(allFeet.length==0){
        return undefined;
    }
    // 足が存在する
    else{
        // 自分の足を取得
        for(const feet of allFeet){
            if(feet.getComponent("tameable").tamedToPlayer==player){
                return feet;
            }
        }

    }

}
/**
 * バラバラ砲
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function barabara_cannon(player){
    const effect = player.getEffect("strength");
    /**@type {import("../function/combatFunction").ShootProjectileOptions} */
    const options = {
        offset: [0,0,1],
        properties: {
            "op_asa:is_buso": isBuso(player)
        }
    };
    if (effect != null) {
        const level = effect.amplifier + 1;
        options.spawnEvent = `op_asa:lv${Math.min(5, level)}`;
    }
    shootProjectile(player,"op_asa:barabara_cannon_p",options);

    // クールダウン
    player.startItemCooldown("akumanomi",20);
}
/**
 * バラバラ回避
 * @param {Entity} entity 
 */
export function onDamagedBaraBara(entity){
    if(Math.random()<=0.33){
        entity.playAnimation("animation.player.barabara_dodge_1",{stopExpression:"q.any_animation_finished",nextState:"none",blendOutTime:0});
    }
    else if(Math.random()<=0.66){
        entity.playAnimation("animation.player.barabara_dodge_2",{stopExpression:"q.any_animation_finished",nextState:"none",blendOutTime:0});
    }
    else if(true){
        entity.playAnimation("animation.player.barabara_dodge_5",{stopExpression:"q.any_animation_finished",nextState:"none",blendOutTime:0});
    }
}

import { Player, system } from "@minecraft/server";
import { shiftLocation } from "../function";
import { getEntitiesInRange, spawnRiderEntity } from "../function/entityFunction";
import { applySelfKnockback, damageByEffectStrength, shootProjectile } from "../function/combatFunction";



/**
 * 
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function barrierbility(player){
    shootProjectile(player,"op_asa:barrierbility_p",{offset:[0,0,0.5]});
    shootProjectile(player,"op_asa:barrierbility_p",{offset:[1,0,0.5]});
    shootProjectile(player,"op_asa:barrierbility_p",{offset:[-1,0,0.5]});
}
/**
 * 
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function bari_pistol(player){
    applySelfKnockback(player,4,0.5);

    system.runTimeout(()=>{
        if(player.getComponent("equippable").getEquipment("Mainhand")!=undefined && player.getComponent("equippable").getEquipment("Mainhand").typeId=="op_asa:bari_pistol"){
            for(const target of getEntitiesInRange(player,shiftLocation(player.location,-2,-1,-2),{x:3,y:2,z:3},true)){
                target.applyDamage(damageByEffectStrength(player,27,1.1),{cause:"entityAttack",damagingEntity:player});
            }
            player.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:bari_pistol_particle",shiftLocation(player.location,0,-0.5,0));
        }
    },10);
}
/**
 * 
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function barrier_crush(player){
    player.addTag("barrier_crush");
    shootProjectile(player,"op_asa:barrier_crush_p",{offset:[0,0,1]});
    player.startItemCooldown("akumanomi",40);
}
/**
 * 
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function barrier_ball(player){
    if(player.getProperty("op_asa:akumanomi_type")==0){
        const targetEntityRaycastHit = player.getEntitiesFromViewDirection({maxDistance:16})[0];
        // ターゲットがいるならターゲットに発動
        if(targetEntityRaycastHit!=undefined){
            const targetEntity = targetEntityRaycastHit.entity;
            if(targetEntity.matches({excludeFamilies:["waza"],excludeTypes:["item","xp_orb"]})){
                const targetLocation = targetEntity.location;
                targetEntity.teleport({x:targetLocation.x,y:targetLocation.y+1,z:targetLocation.z})
                targetEntity.dimension.spawnEntity("op_asa:barrier_ball_e",{x:targetLocation.x,y:targetLocation.y+6,z:targetLocation.z});
                player.setProperty("op_asa:akumanomi_type",1);
            }
        }
        // ターゲットがいないなら自分に発動
        else{
            spawnRiderEntity(player,"op_asa:barrier_ball_self",player.location);
            player.setProperty("op_asa:akumanomi_type",2);
        }
    }
}

import { Entity, Player, ItemStack } from "@minecraft/server";
import { getScoreUtility, setScoreUtility } from "../scoreboard";
import { caret } from "../function";
import { applySelfKnockback, shootProjectile } from "../function/combatFunction";
import { SCOREBOARD } from "../index/scoreboard_index";

/**
 * 
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function bomu_ex_arm_max_on_use(player){
	player.addEffect("slow_falling",20,{amplifier:0,showParticles:false});

	const playerRotationX = player.getRotation().x;
	const horizontalStrength = 2 * Math.cos(playerRotationX * (Math.PI/180));
	const verticalStrength = playerRotationX > 0 ? -0.5 * Math.sin(playerRotationX * (Math.PI/180)) : Math.min(0.5,-2 * Math.sin(playerRotationX * (Math.PI/180)));
	applySelfKnockback(player,horizontalStrength,verticalStrength);

	const spPower = getScoreUtility(player,SCOREBOARD.spPower);
	const bomu_ex = player.dimension.spawnEntity("op_asa:bomu_ex",caret(player.getHeadLocation(),player.getRotation(),[0,0,0]));
	bomu_ex.getComponent("projectile").owner = player;
	bomu_ex.triggerEvent(`op_asa:max.${spPower}`);
}
/**
 * 
 * @param {Player} player 
 * @param {Entity} hitEntity 
 */
export function bomu_ex_arm_max_on_hit(player,hitEntity){
	const spPower = getScoreUtility(player,SCOREBOARD.spPower);

	const bomu_ex = hitEntity.dimension.spawnEntity("op_asa:bomu_ex",{x:hitEntity.location.x,y:hitEntity.location.y+1.7,z:hitEntity.location.z});
	bomu_ex.getComponent("projectile").owner = player;
	bomu_ex.triggerEvent(`op_asa:max.${spPower}`);
}
/**
 * 
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function bomu_ex_arm_min_on_use(player){
	player.addEffect("slow_falling",20,{amplifier:0,showParticles:false});

	const playerRotationX = player.getRotation().x;
	const horizontalStrength = 2 * Math.cos(playerRotationX * (Math.PI/180));
	const verticalStrength = playerRotationX > 0 ? -0.5 * Math.sin(playerRotationX * (Math.PI/180)) : Math.min(0.5,-2 * Math.sin(playerRotationX * (Math.PI/180)));
	applySelfKnockback(player,horizontalStrength,verticalStrength);

	const spPower = getScoreUtility(player,SCOREBOARD.spPower);
	const bomu_ex = player.dimension.spawnEntity("op_asa:bomu_ex",caret(player.getHeadLocation(),player.getRotation(),[0,0,0]));
	bomu_ex.getComponent("projectile").owner = player;

/**
 * 
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function bomu_nose_fancy_cannon(player){
	const spPower = getScoreUtility(player,SCOREBOARD.spPower);
	const spcharge = getScoreUtility(player,SCOREBOARD.spCharge);

	const power = spcharge < 5 ? 0.5 : spcharge < 10 ? 1 : spcharge < 15 ? 1.5 : spcharge < 20 ? 2.0 : 2.5;


	shootProjectile(player,"op_asa:nose_fancy_cannon_p",{power,spawnEvent:`op_asa:${spPower}`});

	setScoreUtility(player,SCOREBOARD.spCharge,0);
	player.startItemCooldown("akumanomi2",60);
}
/**
 * ブリーズブレスボム
 * @param {Player} player
 */
export function breeze_breath_bomb(player){
	const spPower = getScoreUtility(player,SCOREBOARD.spPower);
    shootProjectile(player,"op_asa:nose_fancy_cannon_p",{power:2.5,spawnEvent:`op_asa:${spPower}`});
    player.dimension.playSound("ju_shoot.sound",player.location,{volume:0.4});

    const equipComp = player.getComponent("equippable");
    const mainhandItemStack = equipComp.getEquipment("Mainhand");
    const durability = mainhandItemStack.getComponent("durability");

    // 最大耐久値
    const maxDurability = durability.maxDurability;
    // 減少値
    const damagedDurability = durability.damage;
    // 残り耐久値
    const remainingDurability = maxDurability - damagedDurability;

    // 残り耐久値1以上なら耐久値減少
    if(remainingDurability > 0){

        const updateItemStack = new ItemStack(mainhandItemStack.typeId,1);
        const updateItemDurability = updateItemStack.getComponent("minecraft:durability");
        updateItemDurability.damage = damagedDurability + 1;

        equipComp.setEquipment("Mainhand",updateItemStack);
    }else{
        equipComp.setEquipment("Mainhand",undefined);
    }
}

    entity.addEffect("slowness",200,{amplifier:1});
    entity.addEffect("nausea",200,{amplifier:1});

/**
 * 
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function venomdemon_start(player){
    const akuma = player.getProperty("op_asa:akumanomi");
    const akumaType = player.getProperty("op_asa:akumanomi_type");

    if(akuma==30 && akumaType==0){
        player.setProperty("op_asa:akumanomi_type",1);
        setScoreUtility(player,"sppower_max",1000);
        setScoreUtility(player,"sppower",1000);
        // クールダウン
        player.startItemCooldown("akumanomi",20);
        // "毒竜"を"地獄の審判"に変える
        replaceItemInInventoryCombine(player,"op_asa:hydra","op_asa:jigokunoshinpan");
        // "毒の巨兵"を"終了"に変える
        replaceItemInInventoryCombine(player,"op_asa:venomdemon","op_asa:venomdemon_end");
    }
}
/**
 * 
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function venomdemon_fill(player){
    if(player.isSneaking) return;
    
    const excludeTypes = [
        "water",
        "flowing_water",
        "op_asa:venomdemon_block"
    ];
    const replaceableBLockTypes = REPLACEABLE_BLOCKS.filter(function(type){
        return !excludeTypes.includes(type);
    });
    fillCommand(player,player.location,[-2,-1,-2],[2,1,2],BlockPermutation.resolve("op_asa:venomdemon_block"),replaceableBLockTypes);
}
/**
 * 
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function venomdemon_end(player){
    player.setProperty("op_asa:akumanomi_type",0);
    setScoreUtility(player,"sppower_max",0);
    setScoreUtility(player,"sppower",0);
    // クールダウン
    player.startItemCooldown("akumanomi",300);
    // "地獄の審判"を"毒竜"に変える
    replaceItemInInventoryCombine(player,"op_asa:jigokunoshinpan","op_asa:hydra");
    // "終了"を"毒の巨兵"に変える
    replaceItemInInventoryCombine(player,"op_asa:venomdemon_end","op_asa:venomdemon");
}

/**
 * ギアN
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function gearN(player){
    const akumaType = player.getProperty("op_asa:akumanomi_type");

    // ギア５の状態なら
    if(akumaType == 5){

        // 巨人の場合巨人を終了させる
        if(player.getProperty("op_asa:gear5_gigant")!=0){
            gear5_gigant_end(player);
        }

        // アイテムクールダウン開始
        player.startItemCooldown("gear5",3600);
    }
    // ギア４状態なら
    else if (akumaType == 41 || akumaType == 43) {
        // パーティクル
        player.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:gear4_return_particle",player.location);
    }

    // プロパティ更新
    player.setProperty("op_asa:akumanomi_type",0);

    // アイテム置換
    replaceItemsInInventoryCombine(player,[
        // G2
        {from:"op_asa:jet_pistol",to:"op_asa:gom_pistol"},
        {from:"op_asa:jet_gatling",to:"op_asa:gom_gatling"},
        {from:"op_asa:jet_rocket",to:"op_asa:gom_rocket"},
        {from:"op_asa:jet_bazooka",to:"op_asa:gom_bazooka"},
        {from:"op_asa:redhawk",to:"op_asa:gom_storm"},
        {from:"op_asa:gigant_jet_shell",to:"op_asa:gear3_gatling"},
        // G41
        {from:"op_asa:kong_gun",to:"op_asa:gom_pistol"},
        {from:"op_asa:kong_gatling",to:"op_asa:gom_gatling"},
        {from:"op_asa:kong_rifle",to:"op_asa:gom_rocket"},
        {from:"op_asa:leo_bazooka",to:"op_asa:gom_bazooka"},
        {from:"op_asa:culverin",to:"op_asa:gom_rocket"},
        {from:"op_asa:double_culverin",to:"op_asa:gom_rocket"},
        {from:"op_asa:kong_organ",to:"op_asa:gom_gatling"},
        {from:"op_asa:reno_schneider",to:"op_asa:gom_rocket"},
        // G43
        {from:"op_asa:snakeman_combo",to:"op_asa:gom_pistol"},
        {from:"op_asa:jet_culverin",to:"op_asa:gom_rocket"},
        {from:"op_asa:black_mamba",to:"op_asa:gom_gatling"},
        {from:"op_asa:king_cobra",to:"op_asa:gom_bazooka"},
        // G5
        {from:"op_asa:mogura_pistol",to:"op_asa:gom_pistol"},
        {from:"op_asa:dawn_gatling",to:"op_asa:gom_gatling"},
        {from:"op_asa:gear5_gigant",to:"op_asa:gom_rocket"},
        {from:"op_asa:star_gun",to:"op_asa:gom_bazooka"},
        {from:"op_asa:gom_kaminari",to:"op_asa:gom_storm"},
        {from:"op_asa:bajrang_gun",to:"op_asa:gear3_gatling"},
    ]);

    // エフェクト解除
    player.removeEffect("speed");
    player.removeEffect("jump_boost");
}

export function gear4B(player){

    // パーティクル
    gear4exParticle(player);

    // プロパティ更新
    player.setProperty("op_asa:akumanomi_type",41);

    // パワーゲージ設定 (すでにギア４の場合は設定しない)
    if(player.getProperty("op_asa:akumanomi_type")!=43){
        // 現在の経験値
        const currentExp = player.getProperty(`op_asa:b_haki_exp`);
        // 現在のレベル
        const currentLevel = Math.floor(currentExp/10);
        
        setScoreUtility(player,"sppower",30 + 60 * currentLevel);
        setScoreUtility(player,"sppower_max",30 + 60 * currentLevel);
    }
    
    // アイテム置換
    replaceItemsInInventoryCombine(player,[
        // N
        {from:"op_asa:gom_pistol",to:"op_asa:kong_gun"},

/**
 * ギア４終了時のCT開始
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function gear4_cooltime_start(player){

    // インベントリからゴムtagのあるアイテムを消す(ゴムは装備アイテムないからインベントリだけでok)
    clearItemHasTag(player,["op_asa:gomgom"]);

    // エフェクトを消す
    player.removeEffect("speed");
    player.removeEffect("jump_boost");

    // クールタイム用スコアを設定
    setScoreUtility(player,"cooltime",120);

    // 覇気を無効化する
    player.triggerEvent("haki_off");

    // CTプロパティ設定
    player.setProperty("op_asa:akumanomi_type",40);
}
/**
 * ギア5
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function gear5(player){
    const loc = player.location;

    // プロパティ更新
    player.setProperty("op_asa:akumanomi_type",5);

    // パワー設定
    const spPower = 180 + getStatusLevel(player);
    setScoreUtility(player,"sppower",spPower);
    setScoreUtility(player,"sppower_max",spPower);

    // 演出
    player.dimension.playSound("random.totem",loc);
    player.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:gear5_transform_lightning_particle",loc);
    player.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:shanks_kamusari_particle1",loc);
    player.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:gear5_transform_particle",loc);
    
    // アイテム変換
    replaceItemsInInventoryCombine(player,[
        {from:"op_asa:gom_pistol",to:"op_asa:mogura_pistol"},
        {from:"op_asa:gom_gatling",to:"op_asa:dawn_gatling"},
        {from:"op_asa:gom_rocket",to:"op_asa:gear5_gigant"},
        {from:"op_asa:gom_bazooka",to:"op_asa:star_gun"},
        {from:"op_asa:gom_storm",to:"op_asa:gom_kaminari"},
        {from:"op_asa:gom_ufo",to:"op_asa:mogura_pistol"},
        {from:"op_asa:gear3_gatling",to:"op_asa:bajrang_gun"},
        {from:"op_asa:gear3_bazooka",to:"op_asa:star_gun"},
    ]);
    system.runTimeout(()=>{// アニメーション制御のため遅延
        replaceItemsInInventoryCombine(player,[
            {from:"op_asa:gear5",to:"op_asa:gear"},
        ]);
    },2);

    // アイテムクールダウン開始 (アニメーション制御のため)
    for(const category of COOLDOWN_CATEGORY_SKILL){
        player.startItemCooldown(category,70);
    }
    player.startItemCooldown("gear",100);

    // 移動制限 (アニメーション制御のため)
    player.inputPermissions.setPermissionCategory(2,false);
    system.runTimeout(()=>{
        player.inputPermissions.setPermissionCategory(2,true);
    },70);
}
/**
 * ギア５終了時のCT開始
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function gear5_cooltime_start(player){

    // 巨人の場合巨人を終了させる
    if(player.getProperty("op_asa:gear5_gigant")!=0){
        player.triggerEvent("gear5_gigant_end");
    }

    // インベントリからゴムtagのあるアイテムを消す(ゴムは装備アイテムないからインベントリだけでok)
    clearItemHasTag(player,["op_asa:gomgom"]);

    // エフェクトを消す
    player.removeEffect("speed");
    player.removeEffect("jump_boost");

    // クールタイム用スコアを設定
    setScoreUtility(player,"cooltime",180);

    // 覇気を無効化する
    player.triggerEvent("haki_off");

    // ホットバー8を置き換える
    setItemInInventory(player,8,"op_asa:hotbar_8_status",1,true,"slot");

    // CTプロパティ設定
    player.setProperty("op_asa:akumanomi_type",50);

    // アイテムクールダウン開始
    gear5_cooltime_ct(player);
}
/**
 * ギア５終了時のCT中のアイテムクールダウン
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function gear5_cooltime_ct(player){

    // アイテムクールダウン開始
    for(const category of COOLDOWN_CATEGORY_ALL){
        player.startItemCooldown(category,10000);
    }
}
/**
 * ギア５終了時のCT終了
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function gear5_cooltime_end(player){
    player.setProperty("op_asa:akumanomi_type",0);
    for(const category of COOLDOWN_CATEGORY_ALL){
        player.startItemCooldown(category,0);
    }
}

/**
 * バズーカ
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function bazooka(player){
    player.startItemCooldown("akumanomi",40);
    setSpCharge(player,"uncharged");
    setScoreUtility(player,"spcharge",0);

    system.runTimeout(()=>{
        rangedAttackForward({
            damaging:player,
            range:[3,3],
            distance:4,
            damage:{amount:damageByEffectStrength(player,16,1.1)},
            knockback:{horizontalStrength:5,verticalStrength:0.75}
        });
    },5);
}
/**
 * ストーム
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function storm(player){
    rangedAttackForward({
        damaging:player,
        range:[5,5],
        distance:8,
        damage:{amount:damageByEffectStrength(player,4,1.1)}
    });

    const horizontalStrength = 2 * Math.cos(player.getRotation().x * (Math.PI/180));
    const verticalStrength = (player.getRotation().x > 0 ? -0.5 : -1.5) * Math.sin(player.getRotation().x * (Math.PI/180));
    applySelfKnockback(player,horizontalStrength,verticalStrength);
}
/**
 * UFO
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function ufo(player){
    for(const target of getEntitiesInRange(player,shiftLocation(player.location,-2.5,-1,-2.5),{x:4,y:2,z:4})){
        target.applyDamage(1,{cause:"entityAttack",damagingEntity:player});
    }

    const horizontalStrength = 2 * Math.cos(player.getRotation().x * (Math.PI/180));
    const verticalStrength = Math.max(0,-1.5 * Math.sin(player.getRotation().x * (Math.PI/180)));
    applySelfKnockback(player,horizontalStrength,verticalStrength);
}
/**
 * ギア３バズーカ
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function gear3_bazooka(player){
    player.startItemCooldown("akumanomi",60);
    setSpCharge(player,"uncharged");
    setScoreUtility(player,"spcharge",0);

    system.runTimeout(()=>{
        rangedAttackForward({
            damaging:player,
            range:[7,4],
            distance:10,
            damage:{amount:damageByEffectStrength(player,32,1.1)},
            knockback:{horizontalStrength:5.5,verticalStrength:0.55}
        });

        const dim = player.dimension;
        const headLoc = player.getHeadLocation();
        const rot = player.getRotation();
        spawnExplosion(dim,caret(headLoc,rot,[0,0,4]),2.5);
        spawnExplosion(dim,caret(headLoc,rot,[0,0,7]),2.5);

    },2);
}

/**
 * レッドホーク
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function redhawk(player){
    player.startItemCooldown("akumanomi",30);

    const isRyuo = getHakiInfusion(player).includes("ryuo");

    // 流桜の時だけパーティクル
    if(isRyuo){
        player.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:redhawk_ryuo_particle",caretZ(player.getHeadLocation(),player.getRotation(),[0,0,3]));
    }

    // ダメージとノックバックと火傷
    const targets = isRyuo ? getEntitiesInFront(player,[5,5],7,true) : getEntitiesInFront(player,[3,3],4,true);
    for(const target of targets){
        applyVarious({
            target:target,
            damaging:player,
            damage:{amount:damageByEffectStrength(player,24),cause:"entityAttack"},
            knockback:{type:"front",horizontalStrength:4,verticalStrength:0.75}
        });
        target.setOnFire(7,true);
    }
}
/**
 * ギガントJETシェル
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function gigant_jet_shell(player) {
    player.startItemCooldown("akumanomi", 140);
    setSpCharge(player,"uncharged");
    setScoreUtility(player, "spcharge", 0);

    const startLocation = player.location;

    // 1tick後にノックバック
    system.runTimeout(() => {
        const rotationX = player.getRotation().x;
        const rad = rotationX * (Math.PI / 180);
        const horizontalStrength = rotationX < 0 ? 20 * Math.cos(rad) : 20;
        const verticalStrength = Math.max(1, Math.min(3, -3 * Math.min(rad, 0)));
        applySelfKnockback(player,horizontalStrength,verticalStrength);
    }, 1);

    // 2tick後から多段攻撃開始
    system.runTimeout(() => {
        multiRushAttack({
            damaging: player,
            startLocation,
            volume: { x: 5, y: 5, z: 5 },
            attacks: [
                { amount: 100, delay: 0 },
                { amount: 80 },
                { amount: 60 },
                { amount: 40 },
                { amount: 20 }
            ]
        });
    }, 2);
}
/**
 * 複数段階の RushAttack を順番に実行する
 * @param {Object} params
 * @param {Entity} params.damaging - 攻撃者
 * @param {Vector3} params.startLocation - 開始位置
 * @param {Vector3} params.volume - 範囲
 * @param {Array<{amount:number, cause?:string, delay?:number}>} params.attacks - 各段階の攻撃
 */
function multiRushAttack({ damaging, startLocation, volume, attacks }) {
    let prevLocation = startLocation;

    attacks.forEach((attack, i) => {
        system.runTimeout(() => {
            const stopLocation = damaging.location;
            rushAttack({
                damaging,
                startLocation: prevLocation,
                stopLocation,
                volume,
                damage: { amount: attack.amount, cause: attack.cause ?? "entityAttack" }
            });
            prevLocation = stopLocation;
        }, attack.delay ?? 2 * i); // delay 指定なければ 2tick 間隔
    });
}

/**
 * ギガント右クリ
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function gear5_gigant(player){
    // 何かに乗ってるなら降りる
    const ridingComp = player.getComponent("riding");
    if(ridingComp!=undefined){
        ridingComp.entityRidingOn.getComponent("rideable").ejectRider(player);
    }

    const gigantProp = player.getProperty("op_asa:gear5_gigant");

    // 未発動なら発動
    if(gigantProp==0){
        player.startItemCooldown("akumanomi3",50);
        player.startItemCooldown("status_akumanomi",50);
        applySelfKnockback(player,0,2);
        system.runTimeout(()=>{
            player.setProperty("op_asa:gear5_gigant",1);
        },2);
        system.runTimeout(()=>{
            player.triggerEvent("gear5_gigant");
        },3);
        system.runTimeout(()=>{
            // この遅延の間に死んでたりしたらまずいので一応チェック
            if(player.getProperty("op_asa:gear5_gigant")!=0){
                player.setProperty("op_asa:gear5_gigant",2);
            }
        },50);
    }
    // 発動中なら捕獲
    else{
        const rideableComp = player.getComponent("rideable");
        // 満員
        if(rideableComp.getRiders().length == 2){
            // player.sendMessage(`${rideableComp.getRiders()[0].typeId}と${rideableComp.getRiders()[1].typeId}が乗っています。`);
        }
        // 空きがある
        else{
            const target = gear5_gigant_view_target(player);
            // 乗り物に乗っていないターゲットがいるなら自分に乗せる
            if(target != undefined && target.getComponent("riding")==undefined){
                rideableComp.addRider(target);
                // player.sendMessage(`${entity.typeId}を乗せた`);
            }
        }
    }
}
/**
 * ギガント視線の先のターゲット
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function gear5_gigant_view_target(player){
    // 三人称カメラ
    const viewOffset = {
        x:player.location.x,
        y:player.location.y + 18,
        z:player.location.z
    }

    const blockRaycastHit = player.dimension.getBlockFromRay(viewOffset,player.getViewDirection(),{maxDistance:24});
    const entityRaycastHits = player.dimension.getEntitiesFromRay(viewOffset,player.getViewDirection(),{maxDistance:24,excludeNames:[player.nameTag]});
    // ブロックがある場合はそこから3ブロック以内の一番近いエンティティを対象
    if(blockRaycastHit != undefined){
        // player.sendMessage("ブロックあり");
        const viewLoc = blockRaycastHit.block.location;
        return getEntitiesInRange(player,shiftLocation(viewLoc,-3.5,-3,-3.5),{x:6,y:6,z:6})[0];
    }
    // ブロックがなくてエンティティがある場合はそのエンティティを対象
    else if(entityRaycastHits.length){
        // player.sendMessage("エンティティあり");
        return entityRaycastHits[0].entity;
    }
    // 何もない場合は18ブロック目の位置から3ブロック以内の一番近いエンティティを対象
    else if(true){
        // player.sendMessage("最大距離");
        const viewLoc = caret(viewOffset,player.getRotation(),[0,0,24]);
        return getEntitiesInRange(player,shiftLocation(viewLoc,-3.5,-3,-3.5),{x:6,y:6,z:6})[0];
    }
}
/**
 * ギガント中のクールダウン-akumanomi3(ギガント)以外のスキル
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function gear5_gigant_ct(player){
    for(const category of gear5_gigant_ct_categories){
        player.startItemCooldown(category,10000);
    }
}
const gear5_gigant_ct_categories = COOLDOWN_CATEGORY_SKILL.filter(v => v !== "akumanomi3");
/**
 * ギガントカメラループ
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function gear5_gigant_camera_loop(player){
    // 三人称前方
    if(player.getProperty("op_asa:gear5_gigant")==1){
        // 盲目、暗闇のときは強制的に三人称後方になる
        if(player.getEffect("blindness") || player.getEffect("darkness")){
            player.camera.setCamera("op_asa:gear5_gigant_third_person");
        }else{
            const playerLoc = player.location;
            const facingLoc = {
                x:playerLoc.x,
                y:playerLoc.y+20,
                z:playerLoc.z
            };
            const Loc = caret(facingLoc,player.getRotation(),[0,0,32]);
            player.camera.setCamera(
                "minecraft:free",
                {
                    location:Loc,
                    easeOptions:{easeTime:0.1,easeType:"Linear"},
                    facingLocation:facingLoc
                }
            );
        }
    }
    // 三人称後方
    else{
        player.camera.setCamera("op_asa:gear5_gigant_third_person");
    }
}
/**
 * ギガントカメラ切り替え
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function gear5_gigant_camera_switch(player){
    const gigantProp = player.getProperty("op_asa:gear5_gigant");

    if(gigantProp==1){
        player.setProperty("op_asa:gear5_gigant",2);
    }
    else if(gigantProp==2){
        player.setProperty("op_asa:gear5_gigant",1);
    }
}
/**
 * ギガント攻撃
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function gear5_gigant_attack(player){

    const damageAmount = damageByEffectStrength(player,10,1.3);
    const rideableComp = player.getComponent("rideable");

    // 誰も捕まえていない
    if(rideableComp.getRiders().length==0){
        const target = gear5_gigant_view_target(player);
        if(target != undefined){
            target.applyDamage(damageAmount,{cause:"entityAttack",damagingEntity:player});
        }
    }
}

 * ギガント落下

export function gear5_gigant_fall(player){

    const targets = getEntitiesInRange(player,shiftLocation(player.location,-5.5,-5,-5.5),{x:10,y:10,z:10});
    for(const target of targets){
        if(target != player){
            target.applyDamage(100,{cause:"entityAttack",damagingEntity:player});
        }
    }
}

/**
 * モグラ銃
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function mogura_pistol(player){
    // 発動時：プロパティとスコア設定
    setSpCharge(player,"charged_attack");
    setScoreUtility(player,"spcharge",0);
    system.runTimeout(()=>{
        setSpCharge(player,"uncharged");
    },2);

    // 発動時：クールダウン開始
    player.startItemCooldown("akumanomi",30);
    player.startItemCooldown("akumanomi2",30);
    player.startItemCooldown("akumanomi3",30);
    player.startItemCooldown("akumanomi4",30);
    player.startItemCooldown("akumanomi5",30);
    player.startItemCooldown("akumanomi6",30);

    // 地面パンチ時：低速落下削除、ノックバック、ターゲット設定とエンティティ召喚、遅延してダメージ発生
    system.runTimeout(()=>{
        player.removeEffect("slow_falling");
        applySelfKnockback(player,0,0.5);
        
        /**@param {Block} targetBlock  */
        function moguraPistol(targetBlock){
            const blockLocation = targetBlock.location;

            targetBlock.dimension.spawnEntity("op_asa:mogura_pistol_e",shiftLocation(blockLocation,0.5,0,0.5));
            
            system.runTimeout(()=>{
                for(const target of getEntitiesInRange(player,shiftLocation(blockLocation,-2,0,-2),{x:3,y:10,z:3})){
                    applyVarious({
                        target:target,
                        damaging:player,
                        damage:{amount:100,cause:"entityAttack"},
                        knockback:{type:"front",horizontalStrength:7,verticalStrength:2.5}
                    });
                }
            },1);
        }

        const entityRaycastHits = player.getEntitiesFromViewDirection({maxDistance:64,excludeFamilies:["waza"],excludeTypes:["item","xp_orb"]});
        if(entityRaycastHits.length){
            const targetEntity = entityRaycastHits[0].entity;
            const targetBlock = targetEntity.dimension.getBlockFromRay(targetEntity.location,{x:0,y:-100,z:0},{includeLiquidBlocks:false}).block;
            moguraPistol(targetBlock);
        }else{
            const blockRaycastHit = player.getBlockFromViewDirection({maxDistance:64,includeLiquidBlocks:false});
            if(blockRaycastHit==undefined) return;
            const targetBlock = blockRaycastHit.block;
            moguraPistol(targetBlock);
        }

    },10);
    
}

/**
 * 雷ヒット
 * @param {Entity} entity 
 */
export function gom_kaminari_p(entity){
    const owner = entity.getComponent("projectile").owner;
    const targets = getEntitiesInRange(owner,shiftLocation(entity.location,-6,-5.5,-6),{x:11,y:11,z:11});
    for(const target of targets){
        if(target.matches({excludeFamilies:["gomgom","gorogoro"],excludeTags:["gomgom","gorogoro"]})){
            target.applyDamage(200,{cause:"none",damagingEntity:owner});
        }
    }
    entity.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:gom_lightning_particle",entity.location);
    entity.dimension.spawnEntity("op_asa:gom_kaminari_e",entity.location);
    entity.remove(); 
}

                    {typeId:"mining_fatigue",duration:200,amplifier:5},
                    {typeId:"weakness",duration:200,amplifier:5}
                ]
            });
        }
    },10);

/**
 * バジュラングガン
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function bajrang_gun(player){
    setSpCharge(player,"charged_attack");
    setScoreUtility(player,"spcharge",0);
    system.runTimeout(()=>{
        setSpCharge(player,"uncharged");
    },2);

    player.startItemCooldown("akumanomi",70);
    player.startItemCooldown("akumanomi2",70);
    player.startItemCooldown("akumanomi3",70);
    player.startItemCooldown("akumanomi4",70);
    player.startItemCooldown("akumanomi5",1200);
    player.startItemCooldown("akumanomi6",70);
    player.startItemCooldown("status_akumanomi",70);

    // sppowerを3にする
    setScoreUtility(player,"sppower",3);

    system.runTimeout(()=>{

        const dim = player.dimension;
        const playerLoc = player.getHeadLocation();
        const playerRot = player.getRotation();

        const damageTargets1 = getEntitiesInRange(player,shiftLocation(caret(playerLoc,playerRot,[0,0,16]),-16,-16,-16),{x:32,y:32,z:32});
        const damageTargets2 = getEntitiesInRange(player,shiftLocation(caret(playerLoc,playerRot,[0,0,40]),-40,-40,-40),{x:80,y:80,z:80});
        const damageTargets3 = getEntitiesInRange(player,shiftLocation(caret(playerLoc,playerRot,[0,0,64]),-64,-64,-64),{x:128,y:128,z:128});
        const damageTargetsAll =  damageTargets1.concat(damageTargets2,damageTargets3);
        damageTargetsAll.filter((element, index) => {
            return damageTargetsAll.indexOf(element) == index;
        });
        for(const damageTarget of damageTargetsAll){
            damageTarget.applyDamage(1200,{cause:"entityAttack",damagingEntity:player});
        }

        /**@param {Number} dist  */
        function explode(dist){
            spawnExplosion(dim,caret(player.getHeadLocation(),player.getRotation(),[0,0,dist-3]),140);
            system.runTimeout(()=>{
                dim.spawnParticle("op_asa:bajrang_gun_particle",caret(player.getHeadLocation(),player.getRotation(),[0,0,dist]));
            },1);
        }

        const blockRay = player.getBlockFromViewDirection({maxDistance:80});
        if(blockRay != undefined){
            const blockLoc = blockRay.block.location;
            const blockDist = getDistance(blockLoc,player.getHeadLocation());
            explode(blockDist);
        }else{
            explode(64);
        }

    },1);
}

export function goro_tp(player){
    const targetEntityRaycastHit = player.getEntitiesFromViewDirection({maxDistance:64})[0];
    const targetBlockRaycastHit  = player.getBlockFromViewDirection({maxDistance:64});
    if(targetEntityRaycastHit != undefined){
        const targetEntity = targetEntityRaycastHit.entity;
        player.teleport(targetEntity.location,{rotation:player.getRotation()});
        player.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:goro_tp_particle",player.location);
    }
    else if(targetBlockRaycastHit != undefined){
        const targetBlock = targetBlockRaycastHit.block;
        player.teleport(
            {
                x:targetBlock.location.x + targetBlockRaycastHit.faceLocation.x,
                y:targetBlock.location.y + targetBlockRaycastHit.faceLocation.y,
                z:targetBlock.location.z + targetBlockRaycastHit.faceLocation.z
            },
            {rotation:player.getRotation()}
        );
        player.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:goro_tp_particle",player.location);
    }
    else if (true){
        player.teleport(caret(player.getHeadLocation(),player.getRotation(),[0,0,64]));
        player.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:goro_tp_particle",player.location);
    }
}

/**
 * 雷獣-発射物による範囲ダメージ
 * @param {Entity} entity 
 */
export function goro_creature_p(entity) {
    const owner = entity.getComponent("projectile")?.owner;
    if (owner == undefined) return;

    const charge = entity.getProperty("op_asa:charge");
    const loc = entity.location;
    const damageAmount = charge == 2 ? 20 : charge == 1 ? 14 : 8;

    function exe(){
        for (const target of getEntitiesInRange(entity,shiftLocation(loc,-2.5,-2,-2.5),{x:4,y:4,z:4})) {
            target.applyDamage(damageAmount,{damagingEntity:owner,cause:"none"});
        }
    }

    // 1回実行
    exe();

    // 遅延して実行(龍の長さだけあと残り)
    if (charge == 2) {
        for (let i = 1; i <= 4; i++) {
            system.runTimeout(() => {
                if (entity?.isValid) exe();
            }, i * 5);
        }
    }
    
}

/**
 * 
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function goru_restraint(player){
	const targets = player.dimension.getEntities({location:player.location,maxDistance:64,excludeTags:["gorugoru"]});
	for(const target of targets){
		const firstBlock = target.dimension.getBlock(target.location);
		const secondBlock = target.dimension.getBlock(shiftLocation(target.location,0,-1,0));
		const thirdBlock = target.dimension.getBlock(shiftLocation(target.location,0,1,0));
		if(firstBlock?.typeId=="minecraft:gold_block" || secondBlock?.typeId=="minecraft:gold_block" || thirdBlock?.typeId=="minecraft:gold_block"){
			target.addEffect("slowness",100,{amplifier:20,showParticles:false});
			fillCommandReplaceAir(target,target.location,[-1,0,-1],[1,0,1],BlockPermutation.resolve("gold_block"));
		}
	}
}

/**
 * 金ブロック生成
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function goru_generate(player){
	const excludeTypes = [
		"lava",
		"flowing_lava",
		"fire",
		"water",
		"flowing_water"
	];
	const replaceableBLockTypes = REPLACEABLE_BLOCKS.filter(function(type){
		return !excludeTypes.includes(type);
	});

	const spcharge = getScoreUtility(player,"spcharge");
	if(spcharge == 0){
		fillCommand(player,player.location,[-1,-1,-1],[1,1,1],BlockPermutation.resolve("minecraft:gold_block"),replaceableBLockTypes);
	}
	else if(spcharge == 2){
		fillCommand(player,player.location,[-4,-5,-4],[4,-1,4],BlockPermutation.resolve("minecraft:gold_block"),replaceableBLockTypes);
	}
	else if(spcharge == 4){
		fillCommand(player,player.location,[-4,0,-4],[4,5,4],BlockPermutation.resolve("minecraft:gold_block"),replaceableBLockTypes);
	}
	else if(spcharge == 6){
		fillCommand(player,player.location,[-8,-5,-8],[8,-1,8],BlockPermutation.resolve("minecraft:gold_block"),replaceableBLockTypes);
	}
	else if(spcharge == 8){
		fillCommand(player,player.location,[-8,0,-8],[8,5,8],BlockPermutation.resolve("minecraft:gold_block"),replaceableBLockTypes);
	}
	else if(spcharge == 10){
		fillCommand(player,player.location,[-16,-5,-16],[16,-1,16],BlockPermutation.resolve("minecraft:gold_block"),replaceableBLockTypes);
	}
	else if(spcharge == 12){
		fillCommand(player,player.location,[-16,0,-16],[16,5,16],BlockPermutation.resolve("minecraft:gold_block"),replaceableBLockTypes);
	}
	else if(spcharge == 14){
		fillCommand(player,player.location,[-24,-5,-24],[24,-1,24],BlockPermutation.resolve("minecraft:gold_block"),replaceableBLockTypes);
	}
	else if(spcharge == 16){
		fillCommand(player,player.location,[-24,0,-24],[24,5,24],BlockPermutation.resolve("minecraft:gold_block"),replaceableBLockTypes);
	}
	else if(spcharge == 18){
		fillCommand(player,player.location,[-32,-5,-32],[32,-1,32],BlockPermutation.resolve("minecraft:gold_block"),replaceableBLockTypes);
	}
	else if(spcharge == 20){
		fillCommand(player,player.location,[-32,0,-32],[32,5,32],BlockPermutation.resolve("minecraft:gold_block"),replaceableBLockTypes);
	}
}
/**
 * 金ブロック吸収
 * @param {Player} player 
 * @param {Number} eventNum 
 */
export function goru_absorption(player,eventNum){


	/**@param {Number} a @param {Number} z */
	const rangeArray = (a, z) => {
		const lst = [];
		for (let i = a; i <= z; i++) {
			lst.push(i)
		}
		return lst;
	};

	const rangeX = rangeArray(-eventNum,eventNum);
	const rangeZ = rangeArray(-eventNum,eventNum);

	let range = [
		{x:0,y:0,z:0}
	];

	if(eventNum!=0){
		range.shift();

		for(let y=0; y<6; y++){
			for(const x of rangeX){
				range.push({x:x,y:y-2,z:eventNum});
				range.push({x:x,y:y-2,z:-eventNum});
			}
			for(const z of rangeZ){
				range.push({x:eventNum,y:y-2,z:z});
				range.push({x:-eventNum,y:y-2,z:z});
			}
		}
	}

	for(const a of range){

		const targetBlock = player.dimension.getBlock(
			{
				x:player.location.x + a.x,
				y:player.location.y + a.y,
				z:player.location.z + a.z
			}
		);

		if(targetBlock != undefined && targetBlock.permutation.matches("minecraft:gold_block")){
			replaceAir(targetBlock);
			player.getComponent("inventory").container.addItem(new ItemStack("minecraft:gold_block",1));
		}
	}

}

import { Entity, Player, system, world } from "@minecraft/server";

/**
 * cooldown
 * 1: gura_shake, yamiyami - 一般技
 * 2: gura_right, kurouzu - 連続技
 * 3:  - 移動技
 * 4: revelation - 必殺技

/**
 * グラッシュ
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function gura_gurash(player){

    const charge = getScoreUtility(player,"spcharge");

    if(charge < 7){
        exeGurash(player,1);
    }
    else if(charge < 14){
        exeGurash(player,2);
    }
    else if(charge < 20){
        exeGurash(player,3);
    }
    else if(true){
        exeGurash(player,4);
    }
    
    setScoreUtility(player,"spcharge",0);
    setSpCharge(player,"uncharged");
    // player.startItemCooldown("akumanomi2",140);
}
/**
 * グラッシュ内容
 * @param {Entity} entity 実行者
 * @param {Numb7} stage 段階(1~4)
 */
export function exeGurash(entity,stage){
    const loc = entity.location;

    system.runTimeout(()=>{
        // ダメージ(距離で減衰)とノックバック
        for(const target of getEntitiesInFront(entity,[8,8],5)){
            applyVarious({
                target,
                damaging:entity,
                damage:{amount:damageByDistance(loc,target.location,200,40),cause:"piston"},
                knockback:{horizontalStrength:5,verticalStrength:0.5}
            });
        }

        // stage2: 爆発
        if(stage == 2){
            spawnExplosion(entity.dimension,caret(entity.getHeadLocation(),entity.getRotation(),[0,0,5]),4,false);
        }
        // stage3: 射撃(飛距離1秒)
        else if(stage == 3){
            shootProjectile(entity,"op_asa:gurash_p",{spawnEvent:"op_asa:middle"});
        }
        // stage4: 射撃(飛距離2秒)
        else if(stage == 4){
            shootProjectile(entity,"op_asa:gurash_p",{spawnEvent:"op_asa:heavy"});
        }
    },3);
}
/**
 * グラッシュ射撃エンティティのイベント
 * @param {Entity} entity 
 */
export function gura_gurash_p(entity){

    const owner = entity.getComponent("projectile").owner;
    if(owner==undefined) return;

    const loc = entity.location;
    const dim = entity.dimension;

    for(const target of getEntitiesInRange(owner,shiftLocation(loc,-4,-3.5,-4),{x:7,y:7,z:7})){
        target.applyDamage(damageByDistance(loc,target.location,50,10),{cause:"piston",damagingEntity:owner});
    }
    
    spawnExplosion(dim,loc,4);

    dim.spawnParticle("op_asa:gurash_p_particle",loc);

}
/**
 * むら雲切射撃エンティティのイベント
 * @param {Entity} entity 
 */
export function murakumokiri_p(entity){
    const owner = entity.getComponent("projectile").owner;

    if(owner==undefined) return;

    const targets = owner.typeId == "op_asa:shirohige" ? getEntitiesInRange(owner,shiftLocation(entity.location,-5.5,-5.5,-5.5),{x:10,y:10,z:10}) : getEntitiesInRange(owner,shiftLocation(entity.location,-2.5,-2,-2.5),{x:4,y:4,z:4});

    for(const targetEntity of targets){
        // バラバラの場合はグラグラダメージだけ与える
        if(targetEntity.matches({propertyOptions:[{propertyId:"op_asa:akumanomi",value:{equals:28}}]})){
            applyVarious({
                target:targetEntity,
                damaging:owner,
                damage:{amount:18,cause:"piston"}
            });
            onDamagedBaraBara(targetEntity);
        }else{
            applyVarious({
                target:targetEntity,
                damaging:owner,
                damage:{amount:damageByEffectStrength(owner,15,1.3),cause:"entityAttack"}
            });
        }
    }
}
/**
 * 地震発動時
 * @param {Entity} entity 
 */
export function gura_earthquake_charged_attack(entity){
    
    const loc = entity.location;
    let dist = 32;
    let chargeValue = 2;

    // プレイヤーの場合チャージに応じて変更
    if(isPlayer(entity)){
        const spcharge = getScoreUtility(entity,"spcharge");

        dist = spcharge < 7 ? 16 : spcharge < 14 ? 24 : spcharge < 20 ? 32 : 64;
        chargeValue = spcharge < 7 ? 0 : spcharge < 14 ? 1 : spcharge < 20 ? 2 : 3;

        setScoreUtility(entity,"spcharge",0);
        entity.startItemCooldown("akumanomi5",200);
    }

    // 爆発
    entity.dimension.spawnEntity("op_asa:gura_earthquake_e",loc).triggerEvent(`op_asa:charge.${chargeValue}`);

    // ダメージ
    for(const target of getEntitiesDistance(entity,loc,dist)){
        applyVarious({
            target,
            damaging:entity,
            damage:{amount:damageByDistance(loc,target.location,200,5),cause:"piston"},
            knockback:{type:"sphere",horizontalStrength:5,verticalStrength:1.5},
            effect:[
                {typeId:"slowness",duration:200,amplifier:2},
                {typeId:"nausea",duration:200,amplifier:2}
            ]
        });
    }
}
/**
 * 地震
 * @param {Entity} entity 
 */
export function gura_earthquake(entity){
    if(entity==undefined) return;

    const dim = entity.dimension;
    const Loc = entity.location;
    const range = entity.getComponent("variant").value;
    const randomX = Math.floor(-range + Math.random()*range*2);
    const randomZ = Math.floor(-range + Math.random()*range*2);

    const exeLoc = {
        x:Loc.x + randomX,
        y:Loc.y,
        z:Loc.z + randomZ
    }

    const targetBlock = dim.getTopmostBlock({x:exeLoc.x,z:exeLoc.z},exeLoc.y);
    const targetBLockLoc = targetBlock.location;
    
    const targetEntities = dim.getEntities({location:Loc,maxDistance:range,excludeFamilies:["waza","guragura"],excludeTypes:["item","xp_orb"],excludeTags:["guragura"]});
    for(const targetEntity of targetEntities){
        targetEntity.applyDamage(2,{cause:"void"});
    }

    // シミュレーション距離外なら実行しない
    if(dim.getPlayers({maxDistance:64,location:targetBLockLoc}).length > 0){
        spawnExplosion(dim,shiftLocation(targetBLockLoc,0,-1,0),3);
    }
}
/**
 * 白ひげ-近接グラッシュ
 * @param {Entity} entity 
 */
export function shirohige_gurash_melee(entity){
    const dim = entity.dimension;
    const loc = entity.location;

    for(const target of getEntitiesInRange(entity,shiftLocation(loc,-6,-5.5,-6),{x:11,y:11,z:11})){
        applyVarious({
            target,
            damaging:entity,
            damage:{amount:damageByDistance(loc,target.location,200,30),cause:"piston"},
            knockback:{horizontalStrength:10,verticalStrength:1.25,type:"sphere"}

}
/**
 * 白ひげ-近接
 * @param {Entity} entity 
 * @param {boolean} knockback 
 */
export function shirohige_crisis_attack(entity,knockback){

    const targets = getEntitiesInRange(entity,shiftLocation(entity.location,-6,-5.5,-6),{x:11,y:11,z:11});

    if(knockback) {
        for(const target of targets){
            applyVarious({
                target,
                damaging:entity,
                damage:{amount:damageByEffectStrength(entity,13),cause:"piston"},
                knockback:{horizontalStrength:14,verticalStrength:1}
            });
        }
    }
    else{
        for(const target of targets){
            applyVarious({
                target,
                damaging:entity,
                damage:{amount:damageByEffectStrength(entity,13),cause:"piston"}
            });
        }
    }

}

import { Player, system } from "@minecraft/server";

/**
 * スパイダーネット
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function spidernet(player){

    // エンティティがいるなら位置固定してエフェクト付与、いないなら召喚
    const loc = player.location;
    const rot = player.getRotation();
    const fixLoc = caretZ(loc,rot,[0,0,4]);
    
    const skillEntity = getTamedEntity(player,loc,32,"op_asa:spidernet_e");
    if (skillEntity) {
        skillEntity.teleport(fixLoc,{rotation:rot});
        // ネットの位置から7*3*7にエフェクト
        for (const target of getEntitiesInRange(player,shiftLocation(skillEntity.location,-4,0,-4),{x:7,y:3,z:7})) {
            target.addEffect("slow_falling",10,{amplifier:0,showParticles:false});
        }
    } else {
        spawnTamedEntity("op_asa:spidernet_e",fixLoc,player,{initialRotation:rot.y});
    }
}
/**
 * スパイダーネット-終了
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function spidernet_end(player){
    getTamedEntity(player,player.location,32,"op_asa:spidernet_e")?.remove();

    player.startItemCooldown("akumanomi",20);
}

import { BlockPermutation, Entity, Player, system, world } from "@minecraft/server";
import { caret, fillCommand, fillCommandReplaceAir, getDirectionVector3, isPlayerInCreative, removeProjectileInBLock, shiftLocation } from "../function";
import { getEntitiesInRange, getEntitiesDistance, spawnProjectileEntity } from "../function/entityFunction";
import { REPLACEABLE_BLOCKS } from "../index/block_index";
import { applySelfKnockback, applyVarious, damageByEffectStrength, shootProjectile } from "../function/combatFunction";




/**
 * cooldown ()はクールダウンなし、一応分類
 * 1: (ice_saber), ice_age - 一般技
 * 2: partisan, ice_ball - 射撃
 * 3: (ice_walk) - 移動技
 * 4: fezantbeck - 必殺技
 * 5: ice_world, - フィールド技
 * 6: ice_glove - 特殊技
 * 
 */

/**
 * アイスBALL
 * @param {Entity} entity 
 */
export function ice_ball(entity){

	applySelfKnockback(entity,3,2);
	entity.addEffect("slow_falling",30,{amplifier:0,showParticles:false});

    const startPos = entity.getHeadLocation();

    let targetPos = caret(startPos,entity.getRotation(),[0,0,32]);
    const entityHit = entity.getEntitiesFromViewDirection({maxDistance:32})[0];
    if(entityHit){
        targetPos = caret(startPos,entity.getRotation(),[0,0,entityHit.distance]);
    }else{
        const blockHit = entity.getBlockFromViewDirection({maxDistance:32});
        if(blockHit){
            targetPos = blockHit.block.location;
        }
    }

    system.runTimeout(()=>{
		entity.clearVelocity();
        
        const shootPos = entity.getHeadLocation();
        
        const projectile = spawnProjectileEntity("op_asa:ice_ball_p",shootPos,entity);
        const shootDir = getDirectionVector3(shootPos,targetPos);
        projectile.projectileComp.shoot({x:shootDir.x*2,y:shootDir.y*2,z:shootDir.z*2});
		// 始点の終点から角度決めて発射
    },9);

}
/**
 * アイスBALLヒット
 * @param {Entity} entity 
 */
export function ice_ball_p_hit(entity){
    for(const target of getEntitiesInRange(entity,shiftLocation(entity.location,-3.5,-3,-3.5),{x:6,y:6,z:6})){
        ice_ball_hit(target);
    }
}
/**
 * アイスBALLヒット
 * @param {Entity} entity 
 */
export function ice_ball_hit(entity){
    const loc = entity.location;

    // 効果範囲内にエフェクトを与える
    if(isValidHie(entity)){
        entity.addEffect("slowness",100,{amplifier:6,showParticles:false});
    }
    
    // ダメージとエフェクトを与えるためのエンティティを召喚
    entity.dimension.spawnEntity("op_asa:ice_ball_e",loc);

    // サイズ測定
    const aabb = entity.getAABB();
    const extent = aabb.extent;
    const halfSizeX = extent.x;
    const halfSizeY = extent.y;
    const halfSizeZ = extent.z;

    const inSideSizeY = halfSizeY*2;
    const outSideSizeX = halfSizeX + 1;
    const outSideSizeY = inSideSizeY + 1;
    const outSideSizeZ = halfSizeZ + 1;

    // サイズに合わせて氷設置
    fillCommandReplaceAir(entity,loc,[-outSideSizeX,-1,-outSideSizeZ],[outSideSizeX,outSideSizeY,outSideSizeX],BlockPermutation.resolve("op_asa:hiehie_block",{"op_asa:type":"ice_ball"}));
    fillCommand(entity,loc,[-halfSizeX,0,-halfSizeZ],[halfSizeX,inSideSizeY,halfSizeZ],BlockPermutation.resolve("minecraft:air"),["op_asa:hiehie_block"]);
}
/**
 * アイスBALL持続
 * @param {Entity} entity 
 */
export function ice_ball_e_tick(entity){
    for (const target of getEntitiesInRange(entity,shiftLocation(entity.location,-1.5,-1,-1.5),{x:2,y:2,z:2})){
        if(isValidHie(target)){
            target.applyDamage(4,{cause:"freezing"});
            target.addEffect("slowness",100,{amplifier:6,showParticles:false});
        }
    }
}

/**
 * 
 * @param {Entity} entity 
 */
export function fezantbeck_p(entity){
    // 存在しないなら終了
    const projectileComp = entity.getComponent("projectile");
    if(projectileComp==undefined) return;

    // パーティクル
    entity.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:fezantbeck_particle",entity.location);

    // ダメージ
    const owner = projectileComp.owner;
    const targets = entity.dimension.getEntities({excludeFamilies:["waza","hiehie"],excludeTypes:["item","xp_orb"],excludeTags:["hiehie"],location:shiftLocation(entity.location,-5,-5,-5),volume:{x:10,y:10,z:10}});
    for(const target of targets){
        target.applyDamage(40,{cause:"none",damagingEntity:owner});
    }

    // ブロック置き換え
    fillCommand(entity,entity.location,[-3,-1,-3],[3,3,3],BlockPermutation.resolve("minecraft:packed_ice"));
}
/**
 * アイスWORLD
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function ice_world(player){
    const exeLoc = player.location;
    const replaceableBLockTypes = REPLACEABLE_BLOCKS.filter(function(type){
        return type != "packed_ice" && type != "ice" && type != "water" && type != "flowing_water";
    });

    // パーティクル
    player.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:kuzan_ice_world_particle",exeLoc);
    player.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:ice_world_p_particle",exeLoc);

    // 水を氷に変換
    fillCommand(player,exeLoc,[-52,-6,-52],[52,-5,52],BlockPermutation.resolve("minecraft:ice"),["water","flowing_water"]);
    fillCommand(player,exeLoc,[-52,-4,-52],[52,-3,52],BlockPermutation.resolve("minecraft:ice"),["water","flowing_water"]);
    fillCommand(player,exeLoc,[-52,-2,-52],[52,-1,52],BlockPermutation.resolve("minecraft:ice"),["water","flowing_water"]);
    fillCommand(player,exeLoc,[-52,0,-52],[52,1,52],BlockPermutation.resolve("minecraft:ice"),["water","flowing_water"]);
    fillCommand(player,exeLoc,[-52,2,-52],[52,3,52],BlockPermutation.resolve("minecraft:ice"),["water","flowing_water"]);
    fillCommand(player,exeLoc,[-52,4,-52],[52,5,52],BlockPermutation.resolve("minecraft:ice"),["water","flowing_water"]);

    // 水と氷と氷塊以外を氷塊に変換
    fillCommand(player,exeLoc,[-52,-4,-52],[52,-3,52],BlockPermutation.resolve("minecraft:packed_ice"),replaceableBLockTypes);
    fillCommand(player,exeLoc,[-52,-2,-52],[52,-1,52],BlockPermutation.resolve("minecraft:packed_ice"),replaceableBLockTypes);
    fillCommand(player,exeLoc,[-52,0,-52],[52,1,52],BlockPermutation.resolve("minecraft:packed_ice"),replaceableBLockTypes);
    fillCommand(player,exeLoc,[-52,2,-52],[52,3,52],BlockPermutation.resolve("minecraft:packed_ice"),replaceableBLockTypes);
    fillCommand(player,exeLoc,[-52,4,-52],[52,5,52],BlockPermutation.resolve("minecraft:packed_ice"),replaceableBLockTypes);

    // 氷/氷塊の上のエンティティを凍らせる
	for(const target of getEntitiesInRange(player,shiftLocation(exeLoc,-52.5,-5,-52.5),{x:104,y:10,z:104})){
		if(target.matches({excludeTags:["hiehie"],excludeFamilies:["hiehie"]}) && !isPlayerInCreative(target)){
            ice_ball_hit(target);
		}
	}
}

/**
 * アイスグローブ-実行
 * @param {Entity} entity 
 * @param {Number} damageAmount 
 */
function exeIceGlove(entity,damageAmount){
    const exeLoc = entity.location;
    const amount = damageAmount ?? damageByEffectStrength(entity,50,1.3);


    // ヒエヒエブロック破壊
    fillCommand(entity,exeLoc,[-8,-2,-8],[8,8,8],BlockPermutation.resolve("air"),["op_asa:hiehie_block"],true);
    // ダメージとノックバック
    for(const target of entity.dimension.getEntities({location:exeLoc,maxDistance:8,excludeFamilies:["waza"],excludeTypes:["item","xp_orb"]})){
        if(target != entity){
            if(target.matches({excludeFamilies:["logia"],excludeTags:["logia"]})){
                applyVarious({
                    target:target,
                    damaging:entity,
                    damage:{amount,cause:"entityAttack"},
                    knockback:{type:"sphere",horizontalStrength:7,verticalStrength:1.25},
                    effect:{typeId:"slowness",duration:100,amplifier:2}
                });
            }else{
                applyVarious({
                    target:target,
                    damaging:entity,
                    damage:{amount,cause:"entityAttack"},
                    knockback:{type:"sphere",horizontalStrength:7,verticalStrength:1.25}
                });
            }
        }
    }
}
/**
 * ヒエヒエの能力が有効かどうか (1,8,10は無効)
 * @param {Entity} entity 
 */
function isValidHie(entity){
    const akuma = entity.getProperty("op_asa:akumanomi");
    return akuma!=1 && akuma!=8 && akuma!=10;
}

/**
 * クザン-アイスエイジ
 * @param {Entity} entity 
 */
export function kuzan_ice_age(entity){
	entity.addEffect("slowness",20,{amplifier:10,showParticles:false});
	
	const entityRaycastHit = entity.getEntitiesFromViewDirection({excludeFamilies:["waza","inanimate"],excludeTypes:["item","xp_orb"],includePassableBlocks:false})[0];
	
	if(entityRaycastHit!=undefined){

		entity.triggerEvent("op_asa:switch_to_ranged_4");

		const entityLoc = entity.getHeadLocation();
		const entityRot = entity.getRotation();
		const targetDist = entityRaycastHit.distance;

		// ブロック設置とパーティクル、速度低下付与、ダメージ
		for(let delay = 0; delay<=32; delay=delay+1){
			const minDist = delay*2;
			if(targetDist>=minDist){
				system.runTimeout(()=>{
					for(let dist=minDist; dist<=minDist+2; dist++){
						const exeLoc = caret(entityLoc,entityRot,[0,0,dist]);

						fillCommandReplaceAir(entity,exeLoc,[-1,-0.5,-1],[1,-0.5,1],BlockPermutation.resolve("op_asa:hiehie_block",{"op_asa:type":"ice_age"}));
						entity.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:cutlass_hie_p_particle",exeLoc);

						for(const target of getEntitiesInRange(entity,shiftLocation(exeLoc,-2,-1.5,-2),{x:3,y:3,z:3})){
							if(target.matches({excludeFamilies:["hiehie"],excludeTags:["hiehie"]})){
								if(target.matches({excludeFamilies:["logia"],excludeTags:["logia"]})){
									applyVarious({
										target:target,
										damaging:entity,
										damage:{amount:8,cause:"none"},
										effect:{typeId:"slowness",duration:40,amplifier:1}
									});
								}
								fillCommandReplaceAir(target,target.location,[-1,0,-1],[1,1,1],BlockPermutation.resolve("op_asa:hiehie_block",{"op_asa:type":"ice_age"}));
							}
						}
					}
				},delay);
			}
		}

		// テレポート地点 ５分割
		const hitLoc1 = caret(entity.getHeadLocation(),entityRot,[0,1,entityRaycastHit.distance*(1/5)]);
		const hitLoc2 = caret(entity.getHeadLocation(),entityRot,[0,1,entityRaycastHit.distance*(2/5)]);
		const hitLoc3 = caret(entity.getHeadLocation(),entityRot,[0,1,entityRaycastHit.distance*(3/5)]);
		const hitLoc4 = caret(entity.getHeadLocation(),entityRot,[0,1,entityRaycastHit.distance*(4/5)]);
		const hitLoc5 = caret(entity.getHeadLocation(),entityRot,[0,1,entityRaycastHit.distance]);

		// テレポートする
		system.runTimeout(()=>{
			entity.teleport(hitLoc1);
		},25);

		system.runTimeout(()=>{
			entity.teleport(hitLoc2);
		},25 + Math.floor(targetDist/12));

		system.runTimeout(()=>{
			entity.teleport(hitLoc3);
		},25 + Math.floor(targetDist/6));

		system.runTimeout(()=>{
			entity.teleport(hitLoc4);
		},25 + Math.floor(targetDist/4));
		
		system.runTimeout(()=>{
			entity.teleport(hitLoc5);
		},25 + Math.floor(targetDist/3));

	}

	



	// // 

	// if(entityRaycastHit!=undefined){

	// 	// テレポート地点 ５分割

import { Player } from "@minecraft/server";
import { caret, clearCommand, replaceItemInInventoryCombine, shiftLocation } from "../function";
import { getEntitiesDistance, getEntitiesInRange } from "../function/entityFunction";
import { applyVarious } from "../function/combatFunction";
import { getAkumaExp, getAkumaExpLevel } from "../status_akumanomi";

/**
 * 
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function hito2_hotoke_start(player){
    const akuma = player.getProperty("op_asa:akumanomi");
    const akumaType = player.getProperty("op_asa:akumanomi_type");

    if(akuma==31 && akumaType!=1){
        player.setProperty("op_asa:akumanomi_type",1);
        player.triggerEvent("hito2_hotoke_start");
        // クールダウン
        player.startItemCooldown("akumanomi",20);
        // "獣型"を"終了"に変える
        replaceItemInInventoryCombine(player,"op_asa:hito2_hotoke","op_asa:hito2_hotoke_end");
    }
}
/**
 * 
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function hito2_hotoke_end(player){
    player.setProperty("op_asa:akumanomi_type",0);
    player.triggerEvent("hito2_hotoke_end");
    // クールダウン
    player.startItemCooldown("akumanomi",20);
    // "終了"を"獣型"に変える
    replaceItemInInventoryCombine(player,"op_asa:hito2_hotoke_end","op_asa:hito2_hotoke");
}
/**
 * 衝撃波
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function hito2_hotoke_impact(player){
    const loc = caret(player.getHeadLocation(),player.getRotation(),[0,0,13]);
    player.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:hotoke_impact_particle",loc);

    const amount = 4 * (1 + getAkumaExpLevel(getAkumaExp(player,31)));

    for(const target of getEntitiesDistance(player,loc,10)) {
        applyVarious({
            target,
            damaging:player,
            damage:{amount,cause:"piston"},
            effect:{typeId:"slowness",duration:20,amplifier:1,showParticles:true}
        });
        target.clearVelocity();
    }

    player.startItemCooldown("akumanomi2",20);
}

import { Entity, Player, system } from "@minecraft/server";
import { getStatusLevel } from "../status";

/**
 * ホビホビ終了(死、リセット)
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function hobi_end(player){
    // おもちゃエンティティ変換
    const hobbyEntities = player.dimension.getEntities({type:"op_asa:hobby"});
    for(const hobbyEntity of hobbyEntities){
        hobbyEntity.triggerEvent("op_asa:toy_end");
    }
}
/**
 * おもちゃにする
 * @param {Entity} entity 
 */
export function hobihobi(entity){
    if(entity.matches({excludeFamilies:["hobihobi","boss"],excludeTags:["hobihobi"],excludeTypes:["player"]})){
        if(getStatusLevel(entity) < 40){
            const tag = entity.typeId;
            system.runTimeout(()=>{
                entity.dimension.spawnEntity("op_asa:hobby",entity.location).addTag(tag);
                entity.remove();
            },1);
        }
    }
}
/**
 * おもちゃ終了
 * @param {Entity} entity 
 */
export function toy_end(entity){
    const allTags = entity.getTags();
    if(allTags.length > 0){
        const tag = allTags.filter(
            function (value){
                return value.includes(":");
            }
        )[0];
        if(tag!=undefined){
            entity.dimension.spawnEntity(tag,entity.location);
            entity.remove();
        }
    }
}

/**
 * エバーホワイト
 * @param {Player} player 
 * @param {Number} eventNum 
 */
export function ever_white(player,eventNum){
	const excludeTypes = [
		"lava",
		"flowing_lava",
		"fire",
		"water",
		"flowing_water"
	];
	const replaceableBLockTypes = REPLACEABLE_BLOCKS.filter(function(type){
		return !excludeTypes.includes(type);
	});

	if(eventNum == 0){
		fillCommand(player,player.location,[-1,-1,-1],[1,1,1],BlockPermutation.resolve("op_asa:itoito_block"),replaceableBLockTypes);
	}
	else if(eventNum == 1){
		fillCommand(player,player.location,[-4,-5,-4],[4,-1,4],BlockPermutation.resolve("op_asa:itoito_block"),replaceableBLockTypes);
	}
	else if(eventNum == 2){
		fillCommand(player,player.location,[-4,0,-4],[4,5,4],BlockPermutation.resolve("op_asa:itoito_block"),replaceableBLockTypes);
	}
	else if(eventNum == 3){
		fillCommand(player,player.location,[-8,-5,-8],[8,-1,8],BlockPermutation.resolve("op_asa:itoito_block"),replaceableBLockTypes);
	}
	else if(eventNum == 4){
		fillCommand(player,player.location,[-8,0,-8],[8,5,8],BlockPermutation.resolve("op_asa:itoito_block"),replaceableBLockTypes);
	}
	else if(eventNum == 5){
		fillCommand(player,player.location,[-16,-5,-16],[16,-1,16],BlockPermutation.resolve("op_asa:itoito_block"),replaceableBLockTypes);
	}
	else if(eventNum == 6){
		fillCommand(player,player.location,[-16,0,-16],[16,5,16],BlockPermutation.resolve("op_asa:itoito_block"),replaceableBLockTypes);
	}
	else if(eventNum == 7){
		fillCommand(player,player.location,[-24,-5,-24],[24,-1,24],BlockPermutation.resolve("op_asa:itoito_block"),replaceableBLockTypes);
	}
	else if(eventNum == 8){
		fillCommand(player,player.location,[-24,0,-24],[24,5,24],BlockPermutation.resolve("op_asa:itoito_block"),replaceableBLockTypes);
	}
	else if(eventNum == 9){
		fillCommand(player,player.location,[-32,-5,-32],[32,-1,32],BlockPermutation.resolve("op_asa:itoito_block"),replaceableBLockTypes);
	}
	else if(eventNum == 10){
		fillCommand(player,player.location,[-32,0,-32],[32,5,32],BlockPermutation.resolve("op_asa:itoito_block"),replaceableBLockTypes);
	}
}

/**
 * フラップスレッド-仮エンティティの回転合わせる
 * @param {Entity} entity 
 */
export function flap_thread_rider(entity){
    if(entity==undefined) return;

    const riders = entity.getComponent("rideable").getRiders();

    // 乗られてないならデスポーン
    if(riders.length <= 0){
        entity.remove();
    }
    // 乗られている
    else{
        // despawn状態なら上のエンティティを終了状態に変更して0.5秒後に両方デスポーン
        if(entity.getProperty("op_asa:despawn") && riders[0].getProperty("op_asa:spcharge")!="uncharged"){
            setSpCharge(riders[0],"uncharged");
            system.runTimeout(()=>{
                entity.remove();
                riders[0].remove();
            },11);
        }

        // 乗ってるなら回転する
        const ridingComp = entity.getComponent("riding");
        if(ridingComp != undefined){
            const player = ridingComp.entityRidingOn;
            entity.setRotation(player.getRotation());
        }
    }
}

    const godThreadEntity = player.dimension.spawnEntity("op_asa:god_thread_ride",player.location);

/**
 * ゴッドスレッド-発動
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function god_thread(player){
    setScoreUtility(player,"spcharge",0);
    setSpCharge(player,"charged_attack");
    player.startItemCooldown("akumanomi4",140);

    const blockHit = player.getBlockFromViewDirection({ maxDistance: 32 });
    const baseLoc = player.getHeadLocation();
    const rotation = player.getRotation();
    const damageAmount = damageByEffectStrength(player,60,1.2);

    // 4ステップ: 8ブロックごと
    const ranges = [8, 16, 24, 32];

    ranges.forEach((dist, i) => {
        system.runTimeout(() => {
            // --- ダメージ処理（毎回実行） ---
            for (const target of getEntitiesInFront(player, [3, 3], dist)) {
                applyVarious({
                    target,
                    damaging: player,
                    damage: { amount: damageAmount }
                });
            }

            // --- 爆発処理（毎回実行） ---
            let spawnLoc;

            if (blockHit && blockHit.block && dist <= blockHit.distance) {
                const blockLoc = blockHit.block.location;
                const faceLoc = blockHit.faceLocation;
                spawnLoc = shiftLocation(blockLoc, faceLoc.x, faceLoc.y, faceLoc.z);
            } else {
                spawnLoc = caret(baseLoc, rotation, [0, 0, dist]);
            }

            spawnExplosion(player.dimension,spawnLoc,3);
        }, i + 2); // 2tick ごとに遅延
    });

    // 終了アニメーションを開始
    const godThreadEntity = player.getComponent("riding").entityRidingOn;
    setSpCharge(godThreadEntity,"charged_attack");
}
/**
 * ゴッドスレッド-終了
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function god_thread_end(player){
    setScoreUtility(player,"spcharge",0);
    setSpCharge(player,"uncharged");

    // チャージ後発動せずにキャンセルした場合
    if(player.getItemCooldown("akumanomi4")==0){
        player.startItemCooldown("akumanomi4",60);
    }

    // プレイヤーの移動制限解除
    player.inputPermissions.setPermissionCategory(2,true);

    // プレイヤーを降ろす
    if(player.getComponent("riding")){
        const godThreadEntity = player.getComponent("riding").entityRidingOn;
        godThreadEntity.getComponent("rideable").ejectRiders();
    
        // 遅延してデスポーン
        system.runTimeout(()=>{
            godThreadEntity.remove();
        },20);
    }
}

/**
 * 引き寄せ
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function jiki_attract(player){

    // 対象のプレイヤーを引き寄せる
    const targetPlayers = player.dimension.getPlayers({excludeTags:["jikijiki"]});
    for(const targetPlayer of targetPlayers){

        const equippableComp = targetPlayer.getComponent("equippable");

        let bool = false;

        for(const equipmentSlot of Object.values(EquipmentSlot)){
            const equipmentItemStack = equippableComp.getEquipment(equipmentSlot);
            if(equipmentItemStack==undefined) continue;

            const equipmentItemId = equipmentItemStack.typeId;
            if(ironItems.includes(equipmentItemId)){
                bool = true;
            }
        }

        if(bool == true){
            attract(player,targetPlayer,1);
        }
    }

    // 対象モブの右手から金属アイテムを落とす
    const targetMobs = player.dimension.getEntities({families:["mob"],maxDistance:64,location:player.location});
    for(const targetMob of targetMobs){

        const ironItemMob = [
            "op_asa:cutlass","op_asa:cutlass2","op_asa:katana","op_asa:katana2","op_asa:ju"
        ]

        for(const ironItem of ironItemMob){
            const result = targetMob.runCommand(
                `testfor @s[hasitem={item=${ironItem},location=slot.weapon.mainhand}]`
            );
            if(result.successCount>0){
                targetMob.dimension.spawnItem(
                    new ItemStack(`${ironItem}`,1),
                    {
                        x:targetMob.location.x + Math.sign(player.location.x - targetMob.location.x),
                        y:targetMob.location.y + 2,
                        z:targetMob.location.z + Math.sign(player.location.z - targetMob.location.z)
                    }
                );
                targetMob.runCommand("replaceitem entity @s slot.weapon.mainhand 0 air");
            }
        }

    }

    // 金属アイテムをプレイヤーの元へゆっくりテレポート
    const targetItemEntities = player.dimension.getEntities({type:"item",maxDistance:64,location:player.location});
    for(const targetItemEntity of targetItemEntities){
        if(targetItemEntity.getComponent("item")!= undefined){
            const targetItemId = targetItemEntity.getComponent("item").itemStack.typeId;
            if(ironItems.includes(targetItemId)){
                targetItemEntity.teleport(caret(targetItemEntity.location,targetItemEntity.getRotation(),[0,0,1]),{facingLocation:player.getHeadLocation(),dimension:player.dimension});
            }
        }
    }

    // インベントリ内の金属アイテム数に応じてスコア追加してアイテム削除
    let ironCount = getScoreUtility(player,"sppower");
    for(let slotNumber=0; slotNumber<=35; slotNumber++ ){
        const itemStack = player.getComponent("inventory").container.getItem(slotNumber);
        if(itemStack != undefined && consumablIironItems.includes(itemStack.typeId)){
            ironCount = ironCount + itemStack.amount;
            player.getComponent("inventory").container.setItem(slotNumber,undefined);

        }
    }
    setScoreUtility(player,"sppower",ironCount);

}

/**
 * ジキ腕ヒット
 * @param {Entity} entity 
 */
export function jiki_p_hit(entity){
    if (!entity || !entity.isValid) return;

    const owner = entity.getComponent("projectile").owner;
    if(owner==undefined) return;

    const loc = entity.location;
    for(const target of getEntitiesInRange(owner,shiftLocation(loc,-3,-2.5,-3),{x:5,y:5,z:5})){
        target.applyDamage(24,{cause:"entityAttack",damagingEntity:owner});
    }

    spawnExplosion(entity.dimension,loc,2);

    entity.remove();
}

import { Player } from "@minecraft/server";
import { getDistance, shiftLocation } from "../function";
import { getEntitiesInRange, spawnExplosion } from "../function/entityFunction";
import { applyVarious, damageByEffectStrength } from "../function/combatFunction";


/**
 * 
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function kiro_fall(player){
    const dim = player.dimension;
    const loc = player.location;
    
    spawnExplosion(dim,loc,"op_asa:injection_shot",false);

    dim.spawnParticle("op_asa:kiro_fall_particle",loc);
    dim.spawnParticle("op_asa:huge_explosion_emitter",shiftLocation(loc,0,-1,0));
    dim.spawnParticle("op_asa:huge_explosion_emitter",shiftLocation(loc,0,-2,0));

    // ダメージとノックバック
    for(const target of getEntitiesInRange(player,shiftLocation(loc,-3.5,-3,-3.5),{x:6,y:6,z:6})){
        const targetDist = getDistance(target.location,loc);
        const damageAmount = targetDist<1 ? 40 : targetDist<2 ? 30 : targetDist<3 ? 20 : 10;

        applyVarious({
            target,
            damaging:player,
            damage:{amount:damageByEffectStrength(player,damageAmount,1.3)},
            knockback:{type:"sphere",horizontalStrength:3,verticalStrength:1}
        });
    }
}
