/**
 * 大噴火-projetcile
 * @param {Entity} entity 
 */
export function daifunka_p(entity){
    // execute positioned ~-2~-1.5~-2 run damage @e[dx=3,dy=3,dz=3,type=!item,type=!xp_orb,family=!waza] 60 none entity @p[tag=magmag]

    const targets = entity.dimension.getEntities({excludeFamilies:["waza","magmag"],excludeTypes:["xp_orb","item"],excludeTags:["magmag"],volume:{x:4,y:4,z:4},location:{x:entity.location.x-2,y:entity.location.y-2,z:entity.location.z-2}});
    for(const target of targets){
        target.applyDamage(60,{cause:"none",damagingEntity:entity.getComponent("projectile").owner});
    }

	const excludeTypes = [
        "magma",
		"lava",
		"flowing_lava",
		"fire",
		"water",
		"flowing_water"
	];
	const replaceableBLockTypes = REPLACEABLE_BLOCKS.filter(function(type){
		return !excludeTypes.includes(type);
	}).concat("air");
    fillCommand(entity,entity.location,[-1,-1,-2],[1,1,2],BlockPermutation.resolve("minecraft:fire"),replaceableBLockTypes);
    fillCommand(entity,entity.location,[-1,-2,-1],[1,2,1],BlockPermutation.resolve("minecraft:fire"),replaceableBLockTypes);
    fillCommand(entity,entity.location,[-2,-1,-1],[2,1,1],BlockPermutation.resolve("minecraft:fire"),replaceableBLockTypes);
}
/**
 * 
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function ryuseikazan(player){
    const entityRaycastHit = player.getEntitiesFromViewDirection({maxDistance:128,excludeFamilies:["waza"],excludeTypes:["item","xp_orb"]});

    /**
     * 
     * @param {Player} player 
     * @param {import("@minecraft/server").Vector3} location 
     */
    function ryuseikazan_down(player,location){
        const projectile = player.dimension.spawnEntity(
            "op_asa:ryuseikazan_down",
            {
                x:location.x + Math.round((Math.random() - 0.5)*10),
                y:location.y + 80,
                z:location.z + Math.round((Math.random() - 0.5)*10)
            }
        );
        const projectileComp = projectile.getComponent("projectile");
        projectileComp.owner = player;
    }

    if(entityRaycastHit.length > 0){
        const targetEntity = entityRaycastHit[0].entity;
        const targetLocation = targetEntity.location;

        system.runTimeout(()=>{
            ryuseikazan_down(player,targetLocation);
        },78);
    }
    else{
        const blockRaycastHit = player.getBlockFromViewDirection({maxDistance:128,includeLiquidBlocks:false,includePassableBlocks:false});
        if(blockRaycastHit != undefined){
            const targetBlock = blockRaycastHit.block;
            const targetLocation = targetBlock.location;

            system.runTimeout(()=>{
                ryuseikazan_down(player,targetLocation);
            },78);
        }
    }
}
/**
 * 冥狗
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function mag_meigou(player){

    // 移動
    const startLocation = player.location;
    const horizontalStrength = 14 * Math.cos(player.getRotation().x * (Math.PI/180));
    const verticalStrength = Math.max(0.25,-2 * Math.sin(player.getRotation().x * (Math.PI/180)));
    if(player.isOnGround){
        applySelfKnockback(player,horizontalStrength,verticalStrength);
    }else{
        applySelfKnockback(player,horizontalStrength/1.5,verticalStrength);
    }

    // ダメージとパーティクル
    const baseDamage = getScoreUtility(player,SCOREBOARD.spCharge)>=20 ? 40 : 20;
    system.runTimeout(()=>{
        const stopLocation = player.location;
        rushAttack({
            damaging:player,
            startLocation,
            stopLocation,
            volume:{x:3,y:3,z:3},
            damage:{amount:damageByEffectStrength(player,baseDamage,1.1),cause:"void"},
            particle:{hitParticleId:"op_asa:sakazuki_meigou_particle"}
        });
    },4);

    // クールダウンとチャージ解除
    player.startItemCooldown("akumanomi6",200);
    setScoreUtility(player,"spcharge",0);
}
/**
 * マグマ生成
 * @param {Player} player 
 * @param {Number} eventNum 
 */
export function mag_field(player,eventNum){
	const excludeTypes = [
		"water",
		"flowing_water"
	];
	const replaceableBLockTypes = REPLACEABLE_BLOCKS.filter(function(type){
		return !excludeTypes.includes(type);
	});

	if(eventNum == 0){
		fillCommand(player,player.location,[-1,-1,-1],[1,1,1],BlockPermutation.resolve("magma"),replaceableBLockTypes);
	}
	else if(eventNum == 1){
		fillCommand(player,player.location,[-4,-5,-4],[4,-1,4],BlockPermutation.resolve("magma"),replaceableBLockTypes);
	}
	else if(eventNum == 2){
		fillCommand(player,player.location,[-4,0,-4],[4,5,4],BlockPermutation.resolve("magma"),replaceableBLockTypes);
	}
	else if(eventNum == 3){
		fillCommand(player,player.location,[-8,-5,-8],[8,-1,8],BlockPermutation.resolve("magma"),replaceableBLockTypes);
	}
	else if(eventNum == 4){
		fillCommand(player,player.location,[-8,0,-8],[8,5,8],BlockPermutation.resolve("magma"),replaceableBLockTypes);
	}
	else if(eventNum == 5){
		fillCommand(player,player.location,[-16,-5,-16],[16,-1,16],BlockPermutation.resolve("magma"),replaceableBLockTypes);
	}
	else if(eventNum == 6){
		fillCommand(player,player.location,[-16,0,-16],[16,5,16],BlockPermutation.resolve("magma"),replaceableBLockTypes);
	}
	else if(eventNum == 7){
		fillCommand(player,player.location,[-24,-5,-24],[24,-1,24],BlockPermutation.resolve("magma"),replaceableBLockTypes);
	}
	else if(eventNum == 8){
		fillCommand(player,player.location,[-24,0,-24],[24,5,24],BlockPermutation.resolve("magma"),replaceableBLockTypes);
	}
	else if(eventNum == 9){
		fillCommand(player,player.location,[-32,-5,-32],[32,-1,32],BlockPermutation.resolve("magma"),replaceableBLockTypes);
	}
	else if(eventNum == 10){
		fillCommand(player,player.location,[-32,0,-32],[32,5,32],BlockPermutation.resolve("magma"),replaceableBLockTypes);
	}
}

/**
 * 陽炎
 * @param {Player} player
 */
export function mera_kagerou(player){

    const playerLocation = player.location;

    const exePosX = convertRotYtoPosXZ(player).x;
    const exePosZ = convertRotYtoPosXZ(player).z;

    applySelfKnockback(player,player.isOnGround ? 14 : 5.4,0);

    system.runTimeout(()=>{
        const updateLocation = player.location;

        const moveDist = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(updateLocation.x - playerLocation.x,2) + Math.pow(updateLocation.z - playerLocation.z,2));

        player.dimension.spawnParticle(
            "op_asa:kagerou_particle",
            {
                x:updateLocation.x + exePosX,
                y:updateLocation.y + 1,
                z:updateLocation.z + exePosZ
            }
        );
        
        for(let num = 0; num <= moveDist; num++){
            const location0 = {
                x:updateLocation.x - (exePosX * num),
                y:updateLocation.y,
                z:updateLocation.z - (exePosZ * num)
            }
            const location1 = {
                x:updateLocation.x - (exePosX * num),
                y:updateLocation.y + 1,
                z:updateLocation.z - (exePosZ * num)
            }
            if(!player.dimension.getBlock(location0).isAir || !player.dimension.getBlock(location1).isAir) break;
            player.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:kagerou_particle",location1);
            const targets = player.dimension.getEntities({excludeFamilies:["waza"],excludeTypes:["item","xp_orb"],location:location1,maxDistance:3});
            for(const target of targets){
                target.applyDamage(10,{cause:"fire",damagingEntity:player});
            }
        }
    },4);
}
/**
 * 炎帝
 * @param {Player} player
 */
export function mera_entei(player){

    const entei = player.dimension.getEntities({type:"op_asa:entei_e"})[0];

    if(entei == undefined) return;

    const entityRaycastHit = player.getEntitiesFromViewDirection({maxDistance:24})[0];
    if(entityRaycastHit != undefined){
        // ターゲットエンティティがいるならそこにテレポート
        system.runTimeout(()=>{
            entei.teleport(entityRaycastHit.entity.location);
            entei.triggerEvent("op_asa:delay1");
        },5);
    }else{
        const blockRaycastHit = player.getBlockFromViewDirection({maxDistance:24});
        if(blockRaycastHit!=undefined){
            // ターゲットブロックがあるならそこにテレポート
            system.runTimeout(()=>{
                entei.teleport(
                    {
                        x:blockRaycastHit.block.location.x+0.5,
                        y:blockRaycastHit.block.location.y,
                        z:blockRaycastHit.block.location.z+0.5
                    }
                );
                entei.triggerEvent("op_asa:delay1");
            },5);
        }
        else{
            // 16ブロック先にテレポート
            system.runTimeout(()=>{
                entei.teleport(
                    {
                        x:player.location.x + player.getViewDirection().x*16,
                        y:player.location.y + player.getViewDirection().y*16,
                        z:player.location.z + player.getViewDirection().z*16
                    }
                );
                entei.triggerEvent("op_asa:delay1");
            },5);
        }
    }
    player.startItemCooldown("akumanomi4",280);
}

/**
 * 炎上網
 * @param {Entity} entity 
 */
export function enjoumou(entity){

    const isPlayerEntity = isPlayer(entity);
    
    const loc = entity.location;

    if(isPlayerEntity){
        const spcharge = getScoreUtility(entity,"spcharge");
        const charge = spcharge < 6 ? 0 : spcharge < 13 ? 1 : spcharge < 20 ? 2 : 3;

        // スコアリセット
        setScoreUtility(entity,"spcharge",0);

        // エンティティ召喚
        system.runTimeout(()=>{
            // すでに存在してる場合は削除
            getTamedEntity(entity,loc,64,"op_asa:enjoumou_e")?.triggerEvent("op_asa:despawn");
            // 生成
            const enjoumouEntity = entity.dimension.spawnEntity("op_asa:enjoumou_e",loc);
            enjoumouEntity.getComponent("tameable").tame(entity);
            enjoumouEntity.setProperty("op_asa:charge",charge);
        },5);
    }else{
        // エンティティ召喚
        const enjoumouEntity = entity.dimension.spawnEntity("op_asa:enjoumou_e",loc);
        enjoumouEntity.setProperty("op_asa:is_ace",true);
        enjoumouEntity.setProperty("op_asa:charge",3);
    }
}




/**
 * 火拳-projetcile
 * @param {Entity} entity 
 */
export function hiken_p(entity){
    const owner = entity.getComponent("projectile").owner;
    if(!owner) return;

    const loc = entity.location;

    // パーティクル
    entity.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:hiken_particle",loc);

    // ダメージ
    for(const target of getEntitiesInRange(owner,shiftLocation(loc,-3,-2.5,-3),{x:5,y:5,z:5})){
        target.applyDamage(100,{cause:"none",damagingEntity:owner});
    }

    // ブロック設置
	const excludeTypes = [
        "magma",
		"lava",
		"flowing_lava",
		"fire",
		"water",
		"flowing_water"
	];
	const replaceableBLockTypes = REPLACEABLE_BLOCKS.filter(function(type){
		return !excludeTypes.includes(type);
	}).concat("air");
    fillCommand(entity,entity.location,[-2,-2,-2],[2,2,2],BlockPermutation.resolve("minecraft:fire"),replaceableBLockTypes);
    fillCommand(entity,entity.location,[-3,-1,-1],[3,1,1],BlockPermutation.resolve("minecraft:fire"),replaceableBLockTypes);
    fillCommand(entity,entity.location,[-1,-1,-3],[1,1,3],BlockPermutation.resolve("minecraft:fire"),replaceableBLockTypes);
    fillCommand(entity,entity.location,[-1,-3,-1],[1,3,1],BlockPermutation.resolve("minecraft:fire"),replaceableBLockTypes);
}

/**
 * 炎上網-entity
 * @param {Entity} entity 
 */
export function enjoumou_e(entity){

    const owner = entity.getProperty("op_asa:is_ace")==true ? entity.dimension.getEntities({type:"op_asa:ace",maxDistance:64,location:entity.location})[0] : entity.getComponent("tameable").tamedToPlayer;
    if(!owner){
        entity.remove();
        return;
    }
    
    // チャージ値
    const charge = entity.getProperty("op_asa:charge");
    
    // ダメージ与える
    const base = entity.location;
    const stage = chargeStages.find(s => charge == s.charge);

    for (const [dx, dz] of stage.offsets) {
        const loc = { x: base.x + dx, y: base.y - 6, z: base.z + dz };
        for(const target of getEntitiesInRange(owner,shiftLocation(loc,-1,0,-1),{x:1,y:10,z:1})){
            target.applyDamage(4,{cause:"none",damagingEntity:owner});
        }
    }
    
    // パーティクル生成 0.5sごと
    if(system.currentTick%10 === 0){
        const molang = new MolangVariableMap();
        molang.setFloat("variable.radius",stage.radius);
        entity.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:enjoumou_particle_v2",shiftLocation(entity.location,0,-6,0),molang);
    }
}
const chargeStages = [

import { BlockPermutation, Entity, Player, system } from "@minecraft/server";
import { caret, caretZ, fillCommand, fillCommandDestroy, fillCommandReplaceAir, isPlayer, shiftLocation } from "../function";
import { getEntitiesInRange, spawnExplosion } from "../function/entityFunction";
import { getScoreUtility } from "../scoreboard";
import { REPLACEABLE_BLOCKS } from "../index/block_index";
import { rangedAttackForward, applySelfKnockback, damageByEffectStrength, shootProjectile, setSpCharge } from "../function/combatFunction";
import { getHakiInfusion, isBuso } from "../haki";
import { startCooldownEntries } from "../index/item_cooldown_index";



/**
 * cooldown
 * 1: mochituki, nagurimochi, musodonuts - 近~中距離
 * 2: yakimochi, mochihadan  - 射撃
 * 3:  - 移動技
 * 4: zangirimochi - 必殺技
 * 5: nagaremochi - フィールド技
 * 6: kagamimochi - 特殊技

/**
 * モチ刃弾
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function mochihadan(player){
    shootProjectile(player,"op_asa:mochihadan_p",{power:1.5,offset:[-0.1,-0.1,0.5],spawnEvent:isBuso(player) ? "op_asa:is_buso" : undefined});
}
/**
 * モチ突
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function mochituki(player){
    fillCommandDestroy(player,caret(player.getHeadLocation(),player.getRotation(),[0,0,1]),[-1,-1,-1],[1,1,1]);
    fillCommandDestroy(player,caret(player.getHeadLocation(),player.getRotation(),[0,0,3]),[-1,-1,-1],[1,1,1]);

    rangedAttackForward({
        damaging:player,
        range:[3,3],
        distance:5,
        damage:{amount:damageByEffectStrength(player,20,1.3)},
        knockback:{horizontalStrength:2,verticalStrength:0.5}
    });

    if (isPlayer(player)) player.startItemCooldown("akumanomi",60);
}

/**
 * 
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function zangirimochi(player){

    applySelfKnockback(player,2,0.5);

    player.startItemCooldown("akumanomi",20);
    player.startItemCooldown("akumanomi2",20);
    player.startItemCooldown("akumanomi3",20);
    player.startItemCooldown("akumanomi4",140);
    player.startItemCooldown("akumanomi5",20);
    player.startItemCooldown("akumanomi6",20);
    
    system.runTimeout(()=>{
        if(player.getComponent("equippable").getEquipment("Mainhand")?.typeId=="op_asa:zangirimochi"){
            exe_zangirimochi(player);
        }
    },10);
}
/**
 * 
 * @param {Entity} entity 
 */
function exe_zangirimochi(entity){
    const isKatakuri = entity.typeId === "op_asa:katakuri";
    const dim = entity.dimension;
    const dist = isKatakuri ? 7 : 3.5;
    const range = isKatakuri ? 8 : 4;
    const exeLoc = caretZ(entity.location,entity.getRotation(),[0,0,dist]);
    const damageAmount = damageByEffectStrength(entity,60,1.2);
    const particleIds = isKatakuri ? {dust:"op_asa:riki_block_dust_3",hao:"op_asa:zangirimochi_hao_particle_katakuri"} : 
                                     {dust:"op_asa:bari_pistol_particle",hao:"op_asa:zangirimochi_hao_particle_katakuri"};

    // ダメージ
    for(const target of getEntitiesInRange(entity,shiftLocation(exeLoc,-range,-range+1,-range),{x:range*2-1,y:range*2-2,z:range*2-1})){
        target.applyDamage(damageAmount,{cause:"entityAttack",damagingEntity:entity});
    }

    // 爆発
    if (isKatakuri) {
        spawnExplosion(dim,shiftLocation(exeLoc,0, 0.0,0),10);
        spawnExplosion(dim,shiftLocation(exeLoc,0,-3.0,0),10);
        spawnExplosion(dim,shiftLocation(exeLoc,0,-6.0,0),10);
    } else {
        spawnExplosion(dim,shiftLocation(exeLoc,0,-2.5,0),5);
        spawnExplosion(dim,shiftLocation(exeLoc,0,-2.0,0),5);
    }

    // パーティクル
    dim.spawnParticle(particleIds.dust,shiftLocation(exeLoc,0,-0.5,0));
    // 覇王色(纏)なら追加パーティクル
    if(isKatakuri || getHakiInfusion(entity).includes("hao")){
        dim.spawnParticle(particleIds.hao,shiftLocation(exeLoc,0,-1,0));
    }
}

/**
 * 
 * @param {Entity} entity 
 */
export function yakimochi_p(entity){
    const owner = entity.getComponent("projectile").owner;
    if (!owner) return;

    const loc = entity.location;
    const targets = getEntitiesInRange(owner,shiftLocation(loc,-3,-2.5,-3),{x:5,y:5,z:5});
    const is_buso = isBuso(owner);
    for(const target of targets){
        if(target != owner){
            target.applyDamage(is_buso ? 24 : 16,{cause:"entityAttack",damagingEntity:owner});
        }
    }
    spawnExplosion(entity.dimension,loc,"op_asa:yakimochi");
    entity.remove();
}
/**
 * 
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function kagamimochi(player){
    const blockRaycastHit = player.getBlockFromViewDirection({maxDistance:32});
    if(blockRaycastHit==undefined) return;
    const targetBlock = blockRaycastHit.block;
    fillCommandReplaceAir(player,targetBlock.location,[-3,-1,-3],[3,2,3],BlockPermutation.resolve("op_asa:mochimochi_block",{"op_asa:type":"kagamimochi"}));
    fillCommandReplaceAir(player,targetBlock.location,[-2,3,-3],[2,4,2],BlockPermutation.resolve("op_asa:mochimochi_block",{"op_asa:type":"kagamimochi"}));
    fillCommandReplaceAir(player,targetBlock.location,[-1,5,-1],[1,5,1],BlockPermutation.resolve("op_asa:mochimochi_block",{"op_asa:type":"kagamimochi"}));
    fillCommandReplaceAir(player,targetBlock.location,[0,6,0],[0,6,0],BlockPermutation.resolve("op_asa:mochimochi_block",{"op_asa:type":"kagamimochi"}));
}
/**
 * 
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function nagaremochi(player){
	const excludeTypes = [
		"lava",
		"flowing_lava",
		"fire",
		"water",
		"flowing_water"
	];
	const replaceableBLockTypes = REPLACEABLE_BLOCKS.filter(function(type){
		return !excludeTypes.includes(type);
	});

	const spcharge = getScoreUtility(player,"spcharge");
	if(spcharge == 0){
		fillCommand(player,player.location,[-1,-1,-1],[1,1,1],BlockPermutation.resolve("op_asa:mochimochi_block"),replaceableBLockTypes);
	}
	else if(spcharge == 2){
		fillCommand(player,player.location,[-4,-5,-4],[4,-1,4],BlockPermutation.resolve("op_asa:mochimochi_block"),replaceableBLockTypes);
	}
	else if(spcharge == 4){
		fillCommand(player,player.location,[-4,0,-4],[4,5,4],BlockPermutation.resolve("op_asa:mochimochi_block"),replaceableBLockTypes);
	}
	else if(spcharge == 6){
		fillCommand(player,player.location,[-8,-5,-8],[8,-1,8],BlockPermutation.resolve("op_asa:mochimochi_block"),replaceableBLockTypes);
	}
	else if(spcharge == 8){
		fillCommand(player,player.location,[-8,0,-8],[8,5,8],BlockPermutation.resolve("op_asa:mochimochi_block"),replaceableBLockTypes);
	}
	else if(spcharge == 10){
		fillCommand(player,player.location,[-16,-5,-16],[16,-1,16],BlockPermutation.resolve("op_asa:mochimochi_block"),replaceableBLockTypes);
	}
	else if(spcharge == 12){
		fillCommand(player,player.location,[-16,0,-16],[16,5,16],BlockPermutation.resolve("op_asa:mochimochi_block"),replaceableBLockTypes);
	}
	else if(spcharge == 14){
		fillCommand(player,player.location,[-24,-5,-24],[24,-1,24],BlockPermutation.resolve("op_asa:mochimochi_block"),replaceableBLockTypes);
	}
	else if(spcharge == 16){
		fillCommand(player,player.location,[-24,0,-24],[24,5,24],BlockPermutation.resolve("op_asa:mochimochi_block"),replaceableBLockTypes);
	}
	else if(spcharge == 18){
		fillCommand(player,player.location,[-32,-5,-32],[32,-1,32],BlockPermutation.resolve("op_asa:mochimochi_block"),replaceableBLockTypes);
	}
	else if(spcharge == 20){
		fillCommand(player,player.location,[-32,0,-32],[32,5,32],BlockPermutation.resolve("op_asa:mochimochi_block"),replaceableBLockTypes);
	}
}

import { Player } from "@minecraft/server";
import { caret, getDistance } from "../function";
import { applySelfKnockback, damageByEffectStrength } from "../function/combatFunction";

/**
 * 
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function whitelauncher(player){
    applySelfKnockback(player,14,1);
}
/**
 * 
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function whiteblow(player){

    // 最大距離
    let targetDist = 32;
    // 始点
    const headLocation = player.getHeadLocation();
    // 視線の先にエンティティがいるなら距離を取得
    const entityRaycastHits = player.getEntitiesFromViewDirection({maxDistance:32,excludeFamilies:["waza"],excludeTypes:["item","xp_orb"]});
    if(entityRaycastHits.length > 0){
        targetDist = Math.min(entityRaycastHits[0].distance,targetDist);
        
        const target = entityRaycastHits[0].entity;
        target.applyDamage(damageByEffectStrength(player,8),{cause:"entityAttack",damagingEntity:player});
    }
    // いないなら視線の先のブロックのヒット位置を取得
    else{
        const blockHit = player.getBlockFromViewDirection({maxDistance:32});
        if(blockHit != undefined){
            const blockLocation = blockHit.block.location;
            targetDist = Math.min(getDistance(blockLocation,headLocation),targetDist);
        }
    }
    // その距離まで0.1間隔でパーティクルを生成、最大距離(ターゲットの位置)で爆発
    for(let num = 0; num <= targetDist; num=num+0.1){
        const exeLocation = caret(headLocation,player.getRotation(),[0.25,0,num]);
        player.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:whiteblow_particle",exeLocation);
    }

    player.startItemCooldown("akumanomi",20);

}

import { Entity, Player } from "@minecraft/server";
import { shiftLocation } from "../function";
import { getEntitiesInRange, spawnExplosion } from "../function/entityFunction";
import { applySelfKnockback, shootProjectile } from "../function/combatFunction";



/**
 * 
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function nikyu_repel_self(player){
    player.extinguishFire(true);

    const horizontalStrength = 8 * Math.cos(player.getRotation().x * (Math.PI/180));
    const verticalStrength = player.getRotation().x < 0 ? (1.75 * -Math.sin(player.getRotation().x * (Math.PI/180))) : 0.25;
    applySelfKnockback(player,horizontalStrength,verticalStrength);
}
/**
 * 
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function nikyu_repel_pain(player){
    const entityRaycastHit = player.getEntitiesFromViewDirection({maxDistance:8})[0];
    if(entityRaycastHit==undefined) return;

    const targetEntity = entityRaycastHit.entity;
    const targetHealthComp = targetEntity.getComponent("health");
    const targetMaxHp = targetHealthComp.effectiveMax;
    const targetCurrentHp = targetHealthComp.currentValue;

    const painValue = Math.floor(targetMaxHp - targetCurrentHp);

    if(painValue>0 && painValue<=1000){
        // world.sendMessage(`ダメージ量 : ${painValue}`);
        targetHealthComp.setCurrentValue(targetMaxHp);
        const painEntity = targetEntity.dimension.spawnEntity("op_asa:nikyu_pain_e",{x:player.location.x + player.getViewDirection().x,y:player.location.y+1.5,z:player.location.z + player.getViewDirection().z});
        painEntity.setProperty("op_asa:pain",painValue);
        painEntity.addTag(`id${targetEntity.id}`);
        painEntity.setRotation(player.getRotation());
    }
}
/**
 * 
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function pressure_cannon(player){
    shootProjectile(player,"op_asa:pressure_cannon_p");
}
/**
 * 
 * @param {Entity} entity 
 */
export function pressure_cannon_p(entity){
    
    // 存在しないなら終了
    const projectileComp = entity.getComponent("projectile");
    if(projectileComp==undefined) return;

    // ダメージ
    const owner = projectileComp.owner;
    const targets = getEntitiesInRange(owner,shiftLocation(entity.location,-1,-0.5,-1),{x:1,y:1,z:1});
    for(const target of targets){
        target.applyDamage(18,{cause:"entityAttack",damagingEntity:owner});
    }
    
    // ブロック内なら爆発起こして消す
    const dim = entity.dimension;
    const loc = entity.location;
    if(!dim.getBlock(loc).isAir){
        spawnExplosion(dim,loc,2);
        entity.remove();
    }
}

/**
 * 近くの者にダメージを与える
 * @param {Entity} entity 
 */
export function nikyu_pain_e_damage(entity){

    const painValue = entity.getProperty("op_asa:pain");

    const targets = entity.dimension.getEntities({excludeTypes:["item","xp_orb"],excludeFamilies:["waza"],maxDistance:painValue>50 ? painValue/50 : 1,location:entity.location});

    for(const target of targets){
        // idタグが消えてないならidタグと一致する者以外にダメージを与える
        if(entity.getTags()[0] && entity.getTags()[0].split("id")[1]){
            if(target.id.toString() != entity.getTags()[0].split("id")[1]){
                target.applyDamage(1,{cause:"selfDestruct"});
                entity.setProperty("op_asa:pain",painValue-1);
            }
        }
        // idタグが消えているなら全員にダメージを与える
        else{
            target.applyDamage(1,{cause:"selfDestruct"});
            entity.setProperty("op_asa:pain",painValue-1);
        }
    }
}
/**
 * ダメージが持ち主に戻る
 * @param {Entity} entity 
 */
export function nikyu_pain_e_return(entity){
    const painValue = entity.getProperty("op_asa:pain");
    
    const allEntities = entity.dimension.getEntities();
    
    let existTarget = false;
    for(const target of allEntities){
        // idタグが消えてないならidタグと一致する者にダメージを与える
        if(entity.getTags()[0] && entity.getTags()[0].split("id")[1]){
            if(target.id.toString() == entity.getTags()[0].split("id")[1]){
                target.applyDamage(1,{cause:"selfDestruct"});
                entity.setProperty("op_asa:pain",painValue-1);
                existTarget = true;
            }
        }
        // idタグが消えているならエンティティを消す
        else{
            entity.remove();
        }
        
    }
    // 一度も実行されていない(id一致がいない)ならエンティティを消す
    if(existTarget==false) entity.remove();
}

/**

export function numa_body_start(player){
	const akuma = player.getProperty("op_asa:akumanomi");
	const akumaType = player.getProperty("op_asa:akumanomi_type");

	if(akuma==36 && akumaType==0){
		player.setProperty("op_asa:akumanomi_type",1);
		player.triggerEvent("numa_body_start");
		// クールダウン
		player.startItemCooldown("akumanomi",20);
		// "沼の体"を"終了"に変える
		replaceItemInInventoryCombine(player,"op_asa:numa_body","op_asa:numa_body_end");
	}
}

	player.triggerEvent("numa_body_end");
	// クールダウン
	player.startItemCooldown("akumanomi",20);
	// "終了"を"沼の体"に変える
	replaceItemInInventoryCombine(player,"op_asa:numa_body_end","op_asa:numa_body");
}

import { BlockPermutation, Entity, ItemStack, Player, system, world } from "@minecraft/server";
import { caret, caretZ, destroyBlock, getDistance, isPlayer, replaceItemInInventoryCombine, shiftLocation } from "../function";
import { getEntitiesInRange, getEntitiesInFront, spawnTamedEntity, spawnRideEntity, spawnRiderEntity, isTamedToPlayer, spawnExplosion, isProjectileOwner } from "../function/entityFunction";
import { getScoreUtility, operationScoreUtility, setScoreUtility } from "../scoreboard";
import { getStatusLevel } from "../status";
import { applySelfKnockback, applyVarious, setSpCharge, shootProjectile } from "../function/combatFunction";



/**
 * カウンターショック
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function counter_shock(player){

    setSpCharge(player,"charged_attack");

    player.addEffect("slow_falling",10,{amplifier:0,showParticles:false});

    // ターゲットを取得
    const entityRay = player.getEntitiesFromViewDirection({excludeTypes:["item","xp_orb"],excludeFamilies:["waza"],maxDistance:128,ignoreBlockCollision:true});

    // RROOMならその場発動
    if(player.getProperty("op_asa:akumanomi_type")==3){
        // ターゲットがいるなら発動
        if(entityRay.length>0 && isInRoom(player,entityRay[0].entity.location)){
            const target = entityRay[0].entity;
            const hitLoc = caret(player.getHeadLocation(),player.getRotation(),[0,0,entityRay[0].distance]);
            
            exe_counter_shock(player,target,shiftLocation(hitLoc,0,1,0));
        }
    }else{
        if(entityRay.length>0 && isInRoom(player,entityRay[0].entity.location)){
            // ターゲットがいるならテレポートして発動
            const target = entityRay[0].entity;
            const hitLoc = caret(player.getHeadLocation(),player.getRotation(),[0,0,entityRay[0].distance]);
            player.teleport(hitLoc);
            exe_counter_shock(player,target,shiftLocation(hitLoc,0,1,0));
        } else {
            // ターゲットがいないなら最大3ブロック先にテレポートして発動
            const target = getEntitiesInFront(player,[1,1],2,true);
            const hitLoc = getViewBLockLoc(player,3);
            player.teleport(hitLoc);
            exe_counter_shock(player,target);
        }
    }

    // クールダウン
    player.startItemCooldown("counter_shock",60);

}
/**
 * @param {Entity} user 
 * @param {Entity|Entity[]} target 
 * @param {import("@minecraft/server").Vector3} [partileLoc] 
 */
function exe_counter_shock(user,target,partileLoc=undefined){

    // 1/10でクリティカル
    const damage = Math.floor(Math.random()*10 + 1) == 1 ? 15 : 10;

    // パーティクル生成
    user.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:counter_shock_particle",partileLoc ?? caretZ(shiftLocation(user.location,0,1,0),user.getRotation(),[0,0,1]));

    // ダメージと速度低下を与える
    const targets = Array.isArray(target) ? target : [target];
    for(const target of targets){
        target.applyDamage(damage,{cause:"override",damagingEntity:user});
        target.addEffect("slowness",30,{amplifier:7,showParticles:false});
    }
}

    setSpCharge(player,"charged_attack");

/**
 * @param {Entity} user 
 * @param {Entity|Entity[]} target 
 * @param {import("@minecraft/server").Vector3} [partileLoc] 
 */
function exe_gamma_knife(user,target,partileLoc=undefined){
    // 1/10でクリティカル
    const damage = Math.floor(Math.random()*10 + 1) == 1 ? 60 : 40;

    // 遅延して発動
    system.runTimeout(()=>{
        // パーティクル生成
        user.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:gamma_knife_particle",partileLoc ?? caretZ(shiftLocation(user.location,0,1,0),user.getRotation(),[0,0,1]));
        // ダメージを与える
        const targets = Array.isArray(target) ? target : [target];
        for(const target of targets){
            target.applyDamage(damage,{cause:"override",damagingEntity:user});
        }
    },3);
}
/**
 * メス
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function mess(player){

    setSpCharge(player,"charged_attack");

    // ターゲットを取得
    const entityRay = player.getEntitiesFromViewDirection({excludeTypes:["item","xp_orb"],excludeFamilies:["waza","opeope"],maxDistance:128,ignoreBlockCollision:true});
    if(entityRay.length>0){
        // ターゲット
        const targetEntity = entityRay[0].entity;
        
        // ターゲットの位置がROOM外なら終了
        if(!isInRoom(player,targetEntity.location)) return;

        // ターゲットまでの距離(3ブロック以上離れているなら終了)
        const targetDistance = entityRay[0].distance;
        if(targetDistance>4) return;

        // ターゲットがすでに心臓をとられているなら終了
        if(targetEntity.hasTag("in_mess")) return;
        
        // 覇気チェック
        if(isPlayer(targetEntity) || checkOpeLevel(targetEntity)){
            system.runTimeout(()=>{
                targetEntity.applyDamage(0.00001,{cause:"selfDestruct",damagingEntity:player});
                targetEntity.addTag("in_mess");
                
                // インベントリに空きがある場合入手、いっぱいの場合落とす
                const inventoryComp = player.getComponent("inventory");
                const giveItemStack = new ItemStack("op_asa:heart",1);
                if(inventoryComp.container.emptySlotsCount > 0){
                    inventoryComp.container.addItem(giveItemStack);
                }else{
                    player.dimension.spawnItem(giveItemStack,player.location);
                }
            },1);
        }else{
            player.sendMessage({rawtext:[{translate:"rawtext.notification.failedStrawdoll"}]});
        }
        
    }
    
    // クールダウン
    player.startItemCooldown("mess",140);
}
/**
 * シャンブルズ１
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function shambles1(player){
    const akumaType = player.getProperty("op_asa:akumanomi_type");
    if(akumaType!=1 && akumaType!=3) return;
    
    // ターゲットを取得
    const entityRay = player.getEntitiesFromViewDirection({excludeTypes:["item","xp_orb"],excludeFamilies:["waza"],maxDistance:128,ignoreBlockCollision:true});
    if(entityRay.length>0){
        // ターゲット
        const targetEntity = entityRay[0].entity;

        // ターゲットの位置
        const targetLoc = targetEntity.location;
        
        // ターゲットの位置がROOM外なら終了
        if(!isInRoom(player,targetLoc)) return;

        // プレイヤーの位置
        const playerLoc = player.location;

        // 覇気チェック
        if(isPlayer(targetEntity) || checkOpeLevel(targetEntity)){
            // プレイヤーをターゲットの位置へテレポート
            player.teleport(targetLoc);
            // ターゲットをプレイヤーの位置へテレポート
            targetEntity.teleport(playerLoc);
        }else{
            player.sendMessage({rawtext:[{translate:"rawtext.notification.failedStrawdoll"}]});
        }
        
    }
    // ターゲットなしの場合ブロック取得
    else{
        const blockRay = player.getBlockFromViewDirection({maxDistance:128});
        if(blockRay!=undefined){
            // ターゲット
            const target = blockRay.block;
            const targetPerm = target.permutation;

            // ターゲットの位置
            const targetLoc = target.location;
            
            // ターゲットの位置がROOM外なら終了
            if(!isInRoom(player,targetLoc)) return;
        
            // プレイヤーの位置
            const playerLoc = player.location;

            // ターゲットを空気に置き換える
            player.dimension.setBlockPermutation(targetLoc,BlockPermutation.resolve("air"));
    
            // プレイヤーをターゲットの位置へテレポート
            player.teleport(targetLoc);
    
            // プレイヤーの位置にターゲットを設置
            player.dimension.setBlockPermutation(playerLoc,targetPerm);
            
        }
    }

    // クールダウン
    player.startItemCooldown("shambles",20);
}

/**
 * シャンブルズ２-発動
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function shambles2(player){
    
    // ターゲットを取得
    const target = player.dimension.getEntities({type:"op_asa:shambles2_p",maxDistance:128,location:player.location})[0];
    if(target!=undefined){

        // ターゲットの位置
        const targetLoc = target.location;
        // プレイヤーの位置
        const playerLoc = player.location;
        
        // ターゲットの位置がROOM外なら終了
        if(!isInRoom(player,targetLoc)){
            target.remove();
            return;
        }

        // プレイヤーをターゲットの位置へテレポート
        player.teleport(targetLoc);

        // ターゲットをプレイヤーの位置へテレポート
        target.teleport(playerLoc);
        // ターゲットを時間差でデスポーンさせる
        system.runTimeout(()=>{
            target.remove();
        },20);
        
    }
    
    // クールダウン
    player.startItemCooldown("shambles",20);
}

/**
 * タクト１
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function tact1(player){
    const akumaType = player.getProperty("op_asa:akumanomi_type");
    if(akumaType!=1 && akumaType!=3) return;

    // 視線の先のエンティティがいるなら浮かせる(四皇、大将、海賊王には効かない)
    const entityRay = player.getEntitiesFromViewDirection({maxDistance:128});
    if(entityRay.length){
        const targetEntity = entityRay[0].entity;
        
        // ターゲットの位置がROOM外なら終了
        if(!isInRoom(player,targetEntity.location)) return;

        // 覇気チェック
        if(isPlayer(targetEntity) || checkOpeLevel(targetEntity)){
            targetEntity.addEffect("levitation",10,{amplifier:20,showParticles:false});
        }else{
            player.sendMessage({rawtext:[{translate:"rawtext.notification.failedStrawdoll"}]});
        }
    }
    // ブロックがあるならタクトエンティティ召喚して浮かせる
    else{
        const blockRay = player.getBlockFromViewDirection({maxDistance:128});
        if(blockRay!=undefined){
            const targetBlock = blockRay.block;
            
            // ターゲットの位置がROOM外なら終了
            if(!isInRoom(player,targetBlock.location)) return;

            const tactEntity = spawnTamedEntity("op_asa:tact_e",shiftLocation(targetBlock.location,0.5,0,0.5),player);

            system.runTimeout(()=>{
                tactEntity.teleport(shiftLocation(tactEntity.location,0,3,0));
            },2);
            
        }
    }

    // クールダウン
    player.startItemCooldown("tact",10);
}
/**
 * タクトエンティティに乗って移動する
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function move_tact_e(player){

    const tactEntity = player.getComponent("riding").entityRidingOn;

    // タクト以外に乗ってる場合は終了(他の乗り物とproperty共有してる)
    if(tactEntity.typeId != "op_asa:tact_e") return;

    // ROOM外なら終了
    if(!isInRoom(player,tactEntity.location)) return;

    const playerRotX = player.getRotation().x;

    const horizontalStrength = 2*Math.cos(playerRotX * (Math.PI/180));
    const verticalStrength = (playerRotX < 0 ? 2 : 1) * -Math.sin(playerRotX * (Math.PI/180));

    applyVarious({
        target:tactEntity,
        damaging:player,
        knockback:{horizontalStrength,verticalStrength}
    });

    // tactEntity.tryTeleport(caret(player.location,player.getRotation(),[0,0,2]),{checkForBlocks:true});
}
/**
 * タクト２
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function tact2(player){
    const akumaType = player.getProperty("op_asa:akumanomi_type");
    if(akumaType!=1 && akumaType!=3) return;

    // 目標の座標
    let goalLocation = caret(player.getHeadLocation(),player.getRotation(),[0,0,8]);

    // ターゲット(エンティティ→ブロック)を取得して目標座標を更新
    const entityRay = player.getEntitiesFromViewDirection({excludeTypes:["item","xp_orb"],excludeFamilies:["waza"],maxDistance:128,ignoreBlockCollision:true});
    if(entityRay.length>0){
        goalLocation = shiftLocation(entityRay[0].entity.location,0,1,0);  
    }
    else{
        const blockRay = player.getBlockFromViewDirection({maxDistance:128});
        if(blockRay!=undefined){
            goalLocation = blockRay.block.location;
        }
    }

    // タクトを取得して、それぞれで実行
    const tactEntities = player.dimension.getEntities({type:"op_asa:tact_e",maxDistance:128,location:player.location});
    for(const tactEntity of tactEntities){
        // 所有している場合だけ実行
        if(isTamedToPlayer(player,tactEntity)){
            // 目標座標をプロパティに保存
            tactEntity.setDynamicProperty("goal_location",goalLocation);
            // タクト２状態に変更
            tactEntity.setProperty("op_asa:state","tact2");
        }
    }
    
    // クールダウン
    player.startItemCooldown("tact",20);
}
/**
 * タクトエンティティ-タクト２状態
 * @param {Entity} entity 
 */
export function tact_e_tact2(entity){

    // 目標の座標
    const goalLocation = entity.getDynamicProperty("goal_location");

    if(goalLocation==undefined){
        entity.remove();
    }else{
        // 所有者がいないか、ROOM外なら終了
        const owner = entity.getComponent("tameable").tamedToPlayer;
        if(owner==undefined || !isInRoom(owner,goalLocation)) return;

        const dim = entity.dimension;
        const loc = entity.location;

        entity.teleport(caret(loc,entity.getRotation(),[0,0,1]),{facingLocation:goalLocation,dimension:dim});
        
        // 到着
        if(getDistance(loc,goalLocation)<2){
            for(const target of getEntitiesInRange(entity,shiftLocation(loc,-2,-1.5,-2),{x:3,y:3,z:3})){
                target.applyDamage(18,{cause:"entityAttack",damagingEntity:owner});
            }
            spawnExplosion(dim,loc,2);
            entity.remove();
        }
    }
}
/**
 * 心臓右クリ
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function heart(player){
    // 自分がターゲットなら心臓を戻す
    if(player.hasTag("in_mess")){
        player.removeTag("in_mess");
        player.getComponent("equippable").setEquipment("Mainhand",undefined);
    }
    // それ以外ならターゲットにダメージと効果を与える
    else{
        const target = player.dimension.getEntities({tags:["in_mess"],closest:1})[0];
    
        // ターゲットいないならアイテム削除
        if(target==undefined){
            player.getComponent("equippable").setEquipment("Mainhand",undefined);
        }
        else{
            target.applyDamage(1,{cause:"selfDestruct",damagingEntity:player});
            target.addEffect("slowness",20,{amplifier:2,showParticles:false});
            target.addEffect("weakness",20,{amplifier:2,showParticles:false});
        }
    }
}

export function radio_knife(player){

    const entityRay = player.getEntitiesFromViewDirection({excludeTypes:["item","xp_orb"],excludeFamilies:["waza"],maxDistance:128,ignoreBlockCollision:true});

}
/**
 * インジェクションショット
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function injection_shot(player){

    const room = player.getProperty("op_asa:akumanomi_type")==1;
    const dim = player.dimension;

    // ROOM
    if(room){

        setScoreUtility(player,"spcharge",0);
        
        spawnExplosion(dim,caret(player.getHeadLocation(),player.getRotation(),[0,0,2]),"op_asa:injection_shot",false);
        
        for(const targetEntity of getEntitiesInFront(player,[3,3],7,true)){
            targetEntity.applyDamage(40,{cause:"entityAttack",damagingEntity:player});
        }
    
        applySelfKnockback(player,3,0.1);
    }
    // RROOM
    else{

        setScoreUtility(player,"spcharge",0);

        // 視線の先のエンティティがいるならダメージ
        const entityRay = player.getEntitiesFromViewDirection({maxDistance:128});
        if(entityRay.length){
            const targetEntity = entityRay[0].entity;
            
            // ターゲットの位置がROOM外なら終了
            if(!isInRoom(player,targetEntity.location)) return;
    
            spawnExplosion(dim,caret(player.getHeadLocation(),player.getRotation(),[0,0,entityRay[0].distance]),"op_asa:injection_shot",false);
            targetEntity.applyDamage(40,{cause:"entityAttack",damagingEntity:player});
        }

    }
    
    // クールダウン
    player.startItemCooldown("kikoku",60);
    
}
/**
 * 切断
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function amputate(player){
    const charge = getScoreUtility(player,"spcharge");

    const playerdim = player.dimension;
    const playerLoc = player.getHeadLocation();
    const playerRot = player.getRotation();
    const playerDir = player.getViewDirection();
    const exeWidth = Math.floor(charge/2);

    /**
     * 
     * @param {Number} width 
     * @param {Number} minDist 
     * @param {Number} maxDist 
     */
    function exe(width,minDist,maxDist){
        for(let dist=minDist; dist<=maxDist,dist<=1+charge*1.6; dist++){
            const blockRay = playerdim.getBlockFromRay(caret(playerLoc,playerRot,[width,0,0]),playerDir,{maxDistance:dist});
            if(blockRay!=undefined){
                const block = blockRay.block;
                if(isInRoom(player,block.location)){
                    destroyBlock(block);
                }else{
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    for(let width=-exeWidth; width<=exeWidth; width++){
        
        // エンティティ切断
        const entityRaycastHits = playerdim.getEntitiesFromRay(caret(playerLoc,playerRot,[width,0,0]),playerDir,{maxDistance:32,excludeFamilies:["waza","opeope"],excludeTags:["opeope"],excludeTypes:["xp_orb","item"],ignoreBlockCollision:true});
        for(const entityRaycastHit of entityRaycastHits){
            const targetEntity = entityRaycastHit.entity;
            if(isPlayer(targetEntity) || checkOpeLevel(targetEntity)){
                targetEntity.addEffect("slowness",20,{amplifier:5,showParticles:false});
                targetEntity.playAnimation("animation.amputate",{stopExpression:"q.any_animation_finished",nextState:"none",blendOutTime:0.5});
            }
        }

        // ブロック切断
        exe(width,0,4);
        system.runTimeout(()=>{
            exe(width,4,8);
        },1);
        system.runTimeout(()=>{
            exe(width,8,12);
        },2);
        system.runTimeout(()=>{
            exe(width,12,16);
        },3);
        system.runTimeout(()=>{
            exe(width,16,20);
        },4);
        system.runTimeout(()=>{
            exe(width,20,24);
        },5);
        system.runTimeout(()=>{
            exe(width,24,28);
        },6);
        system.runTimeout(()=>{
            exe(width,28,32);
        },7);
    }
    
}
/**
 * スキャン
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function scan(player){
    // アイテムエンティティ取得
    const itemEntities = player.dimension.getEntities({type:"item",maxDistance:128,location:player.location});

    // 所有ROOM内ならプレイヤーの位置にテレポート
    for(const itemEntity of itemEntities){
        if(isInRoom(player,itemEntity.location)){
            itemEntity.teleport(player.location);
        }
    }
}
/**
 * ROOM開始
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function room_start(player){
    // R-ROOM
    if(player.getDynamicProperty("room_or_rroom")=="rroom"){
        rroom_start(player);
    }
    // 超過してないならROOM
    else{
        // チャージ
        const spCharge = getScoreUtility(player,"spcharge");
        // パワー消費量
        const startingRoom = getStartingRoom(spCharge);
        const roomScale = startingRoom.scale;
        const powerConsumption = startingRoom.power;
    
        // パワー残量
        const remainingPower = getScoreUtility(player,"sppower");
    
        // パワー残量が消費量を上回っている時だけ発動
        if(remainingPower >= powerConsumption){
            // チャージに応じてサイズ変えて召喚
            spawnTamedEntity(roomScale==3 ? "op_asa:room_l" : roomScale==2 ? "op_asa:room_m" : "op_asa:room_s",shiftLocation(player.location,0,1,0),player);
        
            // チャージに応じてパワー消費(0~9:0, 10~19:10,20:20)
            operationScoreUtility(player,"sppower",-powerConsumption);
    
            // チャージに応じてプロパティ設定
            player.setDynamicProperty("room_scale",roomScale);
        
            // プレイヤーをROOM状態に
            player.setProperty("op_asa:akumanomi_type",1);
        }
        // パワーが足りない
        else{
            player.sendMessage({rawtext:[{translate:"rawtext.notification.enoughSppower"}]});
        }
    
        // チャージ解除
        setScoreUtility(player,"spcharge",0);
    }
}
/**
 * RROOM-開始
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
function rroom_start(player){

    let exeLoc = player.location;

    // 視線の先のエンティティがいるならそこを実行位置に
    const entityRay = player.getEntitiesFromViewDirection({maxDistance:60});
    if(entityRay.length){
        const target = entityRay[0].entity;
        const targetLoc = target.location;
        const headLoc = target.getHeadLocation();

        // world.sendMessage(`head:${headLoc.y}`);
        // world.sendMessage(`loc:${targetLoc.y}`);

        if(headLoc!=undefined){
            exeLoc = shiftLocation(targetLoc,0,(headLoc.y-targetLoc.y)/2,0);
        }else{
            exeLoc = targetLoc;
        }
    }
    // ブロックがあるならそこを実行位置に
    else{
        const blockRay = player.getBlockFromViewDirection({maxDistance:60});
        if(blockRay!=undefined){
            exeLoc = blockRay.block.location;   
        }
    }

    // 実行位置にROOM展開

    // チャージ
    const spCharge = getScoreUtility(player,"spcharge");
    // パワー消費量
    const startingRoom = getStartingRoom(spCharge,true);
    const roomScale = startingRoom.scale;
    const powerConsumption = startingRoom.power;

    // パワー残量
    const remainingPower = getScoreUtility(player,"sppower");

    // パワー残量が消費量を上回っている時だけ発動
    if(remainingPower >= powerConsumption){
        // チャージに応じてサイズ変えて召喚
        spawnTamedEntity(roomScale==3 ? "op_asa:room_m" : roomScale==2 ? "op_asa:room_s" : "op_asa:room_ss",exeLoc,player);
    
        // チャージに応じてパワー消費
        operationScoreUtility(player,"sppower",-powerConsumption);
    
        // プレイヤーをROOM状態に
        player.setProperty("op_asa:akumanomi_type",3);
    }
    // パワーが足りない
    else{
        player.sendMessage({rawtext:[{translate:"rawtext.notification.enoughSppower"}]});
    }

    // チャージ解除
    setScoreUtility(player,"spcharge",0);
}
/**
 * ROOM終了
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function room_end(player){
    // プレイヤーを通常状態に
    player.setProperty("op_asa:akumanomi_type",0);

    // シャンブルズ石を消す
    const roomProjectiles = player.dimension.getEntities({type:"op_asa:shambles2_p",maxDistance:128,location:player.location});
    for(const roomProjectile of roomProjectiles){
        if(isProjectileOwner(player,roomProjectile)){
            roomProjectile.remove();
        }
    }
    // ROOMエンティティを消す
    const roomEntities = player.dimension.getEntities({families:["room"],maxDistance:128,location:player.location});
    for(const roomEntity of roomEntities){
        if(roomEntity.getComponent("tameable").tamedToPlayer==player){
            roomEntity.remove();
        }
    }
    
}
/**
 * その位置がROOM内かどうか
 * @param {Player} player 
 * @param {import("@minecraft/server").Vector3} location 
 */
export function isInRoom(player,location){
    let bool = false;

    // ROOMを取得
    const allRoomL = player.dimension.getEntities({type:"op_asa:room_l",location:location,maxDistance:64});
    const allRoomM = player.dimension.getEntities({type:"op_asa:room_m",location:location,maxDistance:32});
    const allRoomS = player.dimension.getEntities({type:"op_asa:room_s",location:location,maxDistance:16});
    const allRoomSS = player.dimension.getEntities({type:"op_asa:room_ss",location:location,maxDistance:8});

    const allRoom = allRoomL.concat(allRoomM,allRoomS,allRoomSS);

    // 全ROOMについて、一つでもプレイヤーの所有ROOMがあるならtrue
    for(const room of allRoom){
        if(isTamedToPlayer(player,room)){
            bool = true;
            break;
        }
    }

    return bool;
    
}
/**
 * ROOM/RROOM切り替え
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function room_or_rroom(player){
    const room_or_rroom = player.getDynamicProperty("room_or_rroom");

    if(room_or_rroom==undefined || room_or_rroom=="rroom"){

        player.setDynamicProperty("room_or_rroom","room");

        replaceItemInInventoryCombine(player,"op_asa:counter_shock_rroom","op_asa:counter_shock");
        replaceItemInInventoryCombine(player,"op_asa:silent","op_asa:curtain");
        replaceItemInInventoryCombine(player,"op_asa:gamma_knife_rroom","op_asa:gamma_knife");
        replaceItemInInventoryCombine(player,"op_asa:kikoku_rroom_amputate","op_asa:kikoku_amputate");
        replaceItemInInventoryCombine(player,"op_asa:kikoku_rroom_injection","op_asa:kikoku_injection");
        replaceItemInInventoryCombine(player,"op_asa:kikoku_rroom_radio_knife","op_asa:kikoku_radio_knife");
        replaceItemInInventoryCombine(player,"op_asa:kikoku_rroom_scan","op_asa:kikoku_scan");
        replaceItemInInventoryCombine(player,"op_asa:mess_rroom","op_asa:mess");
        replaceItemInInventoryCombine(player,"op_asa:shambles1_rroom","op_asa:shambles1");
        replaceItemInInventoryCombine(player,"op_asa:shambles2_rroom","op_asa:shambles2");
        replaceItemInInventoryCombine(player,"op_asa:tact1_rroom","op_asa:tact1");
        replaceItemInInventoryCombine(player,"op_asa:tact2_rroom","op_asa:tact2");

    }else{

        player.setDynamicProperty("room_or_rroom","rroom");

        replaceItemInInventoryCombine(player,"op_asa:counter_shock","op_asa:counter_shock_rroom");
        replaceItemInInventoryCombine(player,"op_asa:curtain","op_asa:silent");
        replaceItemInInventoryCombine(player,"op_asa:gamma_knife","op_asa:gamma_knife_rroom");
        replaceItemInInventoryCombine(player,"op_asa:kikoku_amputate","op_asa:kikoku_rroom_amputate");
        replaceItemInInventoryCombine(player,"op_asa:kikoku_injection","op_asa:kikoku_rroom_injection");
        replaceItemInInventoryCombine(player,"op_asa:kikoku_radio_knife","op_asa:kikoku_rroom_radio_knife");
        replaceItemInInventoryCombine(player,"op_asa:kikoku_scan","op_asa:kikoku_rroom_scan");
        replaceItemInInventoryCombine(player,"op_asa:mess","op_asa:mess_rroom");
        replaceItemInInventoryCombine(player,"op_asa:shambles1","op_asa:shambles1_rroom");
        replaceItemInInventoryCombine(player,"op_asa:shambles2","op_asa:shambles2_rroom");
        replaceItemInInventoryCombine(player,"op_asa:tact1","op_asa:tact1_rroom");
        replaceItemInInventoryCombine(player,"op_asa:tact2","op_asa:tact2_rroom");

    }
}



/**
 * KROOM-開始
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function kroom_start(player){

    // パワー残量
    const remainingPower = getScoreUtility(player,"sppower");

    // パワー残量が消費量を上回っている時だけ発動
    if(remainingPower >= 30){
    
        // チャージに応じてパワー消費
        operationScoreUtility(player,"sppower",-30);

        // KROOM状態に
        player.setProperty("op_asa:akumanomi_type",2);
        // イベント
        player.triggerEvent("kroom_start");
    }
    // パワーが足りない
    else{
        player.sendMessage({rawtext:[{translate:"rawtext.notification.enoughSppower"}]});
    }
}
/**
 * KROOM-終了
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function kroom_end(player){
    // 通常状態に
    player.setProperty("op_asa:akumanomi_type",0);
    // 鬼哭チャージ解除
    kikoku_kroom_charge_cancel(player);
    // イベント
    player.triggerEvent("kroom_end");
}
/**
 * KROOM-鬼哭チャージ解除
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function kikoku_kroom_charge_cancel(player){
    player.setProperty("op_asa:kroomcharge",0);
    setSpCharge(player,"uncharged");
}
/**
 * KROOM-鬼哭攻撃
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function kikoku_kroom_attack(player){
    // チャージプロパティ
    const kroomCharge = player.getProperty("op_asa:kroomcharge");

    // チャージプロパティ以内の距離でエンティティ取得
    const entityRay = player.getEntitiesFromViewDirection({maxDistance:3+kroomCharge,excludeFamilies:["waza"],excludeTypes:["xp_orb","item"],ignoreBlockCollision:true});
    if(entityRay.length>0){
        entityRay[0].entity.applyDamage(20,{cause:"entityAttack",damagingEntity:player});
    }
}

 * KROOM-鬼哭Rider追加

export function kikoku_kroom_add_rider(player){

    const kroomRider1 = spawnRiderEntity(player,"op_asa:kikoku_kroom_rider_1",player.location);

    // その上に乗せるやつを召喚して乗せる
    spawnRiderEntity(kroomRider1,"op_asa:kikoku_kroom_rider_2",kroomRider1.location);

}

 * KROOM-鬼哭チャージ
 * @param {Player} player

}
/**
 * KROOM-ショックヴィレ
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function shock_wille(player){
    if(isPlayer(player)) setSpCharge(player,"charged_attack");
    // チャージプロパティ
    const kroomCharge = player.getProperty("op_asa:kroomcharge");

    const dim = player.dimension;
    const headLoc = player.getHeadLocation();
    const rot = player.getRotation();
    const viewD = player.getViewDirection();
    const rangeList = [
        [0.5,0.5,0],[0.5,-0.5,0],[0,0,0],[-0.5,0.5,0],[-0.5,-0.5,0]
    ]

    // 2*2の範囲でチャージ+3距離までエンティティを取得して実行
    for(const range of rangeList){
        const targetRayHits = dim.getEntitiesFromRay(
            caret(headLoc,rot,range),
            viewD,
            {excludeFamilies:["waza"],excludeTypes:["xp_orb","item"],maxDistance:3+kroomCharge,ignoreBlockCollision:true}
        );
        for(const targetRayHit of targetRayHits){
            const target = targetRayHit.entity;

            if(target.id==player.id || target.hasTag("shock_wille")) continue;

            target.addTag("shock_wille");

            dim.spawnParticle("op_asa:shock_wille_particle",caret(headLoc,rot,[0,0,targetRayHit.distance]));

            target.applyDamage(20,{cause:"override",damagingEntity:player});
            target.addEffect("slowness",40,{amplifier:20,showParticles:false});
            target.addEffect("blindness",40,{amplifier:20,showParticles:false});
            target.addEffect("weakness",100,{amplifier:20,showParticles:false});
            target.addEffect("nausea",100,{amplifier:20,showParticles:false});
        }
    }

    // 実行済みのエンティティからtagを削除
    for(const tagEntity of dim.getEntities({tags:["shock_wille"],maxDistance:128,location:player.location})){
        tagEntity.removeTag("shock_wille");
    }

    // クールダウン
    if(isPlayer(player)) player.startItemCooldown("kroom",60);

}
/**
 * KROOM-パンクチャーヴィレチャージ開始
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function puncture_wille_charge_start(player){
    setSpCharge(player,"charging");

    player.addEffect("slowness",10000000,{amplifier:1,showParticles:false});
    // 降り制限
    player.inputPermissions.setPermissionCategory(2,false);

    // ターゲットを取得
    const targetRayHits = player.getEntitiesFromViewDirection(
        {
            excludeFamilies:["waza"],excludeTypes:["xp_orb","item"],maxDistance:64,ignoreBlockCollision:true
        }
    );
    // ターゲットがいるならそこに乗り物出してプレイヤーとターゲットを乗せる
    if(targetRayHits.length > 0){
        const target = targetRayHits[0].entity;

        const rideEntity = spawnRideEntity(player,"op_asa:puncture_wille_ride",target.location);
        // ターゲットを乗せる
        rideEntity.getComponent("rideable").addRider(target);
        // ターゲットがプレイヤーなら移動制限
        if(target.typeId == "minecraft:player"){
            target.inputPermissions.setPermissionCategory(2,false);
        }
    }else{
        spawnRideEntity(player,"op_asa:puncture_wille_ride",player.location);
    }

}
/**
 * KROOM-パンクチャーヴィレ
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function puncture_wille(player){
    setSpCharge(player,"charged_attack");

    // チャージプロパティ
    const kroomCharge = player.getProperty("op_asa:kroomcharge");
    
    const playerdim = player.dimension;
    const playerLoc = player.getHeadLocation();
    const rangeList = [
        {x:-1,y:0,z:2},
        {x:0,y:0,z:2},
        {x:1,y:0,z:2},
        
        {x:-2,y:0,z:1},
        {x:-1,y:0,z:1},
        {x:0,y:0,z:1},
        {x:1,y:0,z:1},
        {x:2,y:0,z:1},
        
        {x:-2,y:0,z:0},
        {x:-1,y:0,z:0},
        {x:0,y:0,z:0},
        {x:1,y:0,z:0},
        {x:2,y:0,z:0},
        
        {x:-2,y:0,z:-1},
        {x:-1,y:0,z:-1},
        {x:0,y:0,z:-1},
        {x:1,y:0,z:-1},
        {x:2,y:0,z:-1},

        {x:-1,y:0,z:-2},
        {x:0,y:0,z:-2},
        {x:1,y:0,z:-2}
    ]

    // ダメージ
    for(const target of getEntitiesInRange(player,shiftLocation(playerLoc,-2,-(kroomCharge+3),-2),{x:3,y:kroomCharge+3,z:3})){
        if(target.id != player.id){
            target.applyDamage(20+kroomCharge*2,{cause:"override",damagingEntity:player});
        }
    }

    // 掘削
    function exe(startDist,stopDist){
        for(let dist=startDist; dist<=stopDist; dist++){

            // 3毎にパーティクル
            const center = shiftLocation(playerLoc,0,-dist,0);
            if(dist>1 && dist%3==0){
                playerdim.spawnParticle("op_asa:puncture_wille_spread_particle",center);
                playerdim.spawnParticle("op_asa:puncture_wille_particle",center);
            }

            // 3*3でブロック破壊
            for(const range of rangeList){
                const loc = shiftLocation(playerLoc,range.x,-dist,range.z);

                const block = playerdim.getBlock(loc);
                destroyBlock(block);
            }
        }
    }

    playerdim.spawnParticle("op_asa:puncture_wille_spread_particle",player.location);
    playerdim.spawnParticle("op_asa:puncture_wille_particle",player.location);

    if(kroomCharge<10){
        exe(0,kroomCharge+3);
    }
    else if(kroomCharge<20){
        exe(0,9);
        system.runTimeout(()=>{
            exe(10,kroomCharge+3);
        },1);
    }
    else if(kroomCharge<30){
        exe(0,9);
        system.runTimeout(()=>{
            exe(10,19);
        },1);
        system.runTimeout(()=>{
            exe(20,kroomCharge+3);
        },2);
    }
    else if(kroomCharge<40){
        exe(0,9);
        system.runTimeout(()=>{
            exe(10,19);
        },1);
        system.runTimeout(()=>{
            exe(20,29);
        },2);
        system.runTimeout(()=>{
            exe(30,kroomCharge+3);
        },3);
    }
    else if(kroomCharge<50){
        exe(0,9);
        system.runTimeout(()=>{
            exe(10,19);
        },1);
        system.runTimeout(()=>{
            exe(20,29);
        },2);
        system.runTimeout(()=>{
            exe(30,39);
        },3);
        system.runTimeout(()=>{
            exe(40,kroomCharge+3);
        },4);
    }
    else if(kroomCharge<60){
        exe(0,9);
        system.runTimeout(()=>{
            exe(10,19);
        },1);
        system.runTimeout(()=>{
            exe(20,29);
        },2);
        system.runTimeout(()=>{
            exe(30,39);
        },3);
        system.runTimeout(()=>{
            exe(40,49);
        },4);
        system.runTimeout(()=>{
            exe(50,kroomCharge+3);
        },5);
    }
    else if(true){
        exe(0,9);
        system.runTimeout(()=>{
            exe(10,19);
        },1);
        system.runTimeout(()=>{
            exe(20,29);
        },2);
        system.runTimeout(()=>{
            exe(30,39);
        },3);
        system.runTimeout(()=>{
            exe(40,49);
        },4);
        system.runTimeout(()=>{
            exe(50,kroomCharge+3);
        },5);
    }
}
/**
 * KROOM-パンクチャーヴィレチャージ解除
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function puncture_wille_charge_cancel(player){
    // 発動したかどうか
    const attacked = player.getProperty("op_asa:spcharge")=="charged_attack";

    // クールダウン
    const kroomCharge = player.getProperty("op_asa:kroomcharge");
    const ct = 20 + kroomCharge*2;
    player.startItemCooldown("kroom",ct);

    // kroomサイズ解除
    player.setProperty("op_asa:kroomcharge",0);

    // チャージプロパティ解除
    setSpCharge(player,"uncharged");

    // 鈍化解除
    player.removeEffect("slowness");
    // 降り制限解除
    for(const AnyPlayer of player.dimension.getPlayers({maxDistance:3,location:player.location})){
        AnyPlayer.inputPermissions.setPermissionCategory(2,true);
    }

    // 乗り物削除
    const ridingComp = player.getComponent("riding");
    if(ridingComp!=undefined){
        ridingComp.entityRidingOn.remove();
    }

    // 飛び降り
    if(attacked){
        system.runTimeout(()=>{
            applySelfKnockback(player,-2.5,0.5);
        },1);
    }

}
/**
 * オペの能力対象条件
 * オペ以外とステータスレベル40未満ならtrue
 * @param {Entity} entity 
 */
export function checkOpeLevel(entity){
	return entity.matches({excludeFamilies:["opeope"],excludeTags:["opeope"]}) && getStatusLevel(entity) < 40;
}
/**
 * @param {number} chargeValue 
 * @param {boolean} [isRroom=false] 
 */
function getStartingRoom(chargeValue,isRroom) {
    const scale = chargeValue < 10 ? 1 : chargeValue < 20 ? 2 : 3;
    const power = chargeValue < 10 ? 5 : chargeValue < 20 ? 15 : 30;

    if (!isRroom) {
        return { scale, power }
    } else {
        return { scale, power:power*2 }
    }
}
/**
 * 見ているブロックの座標 (最大距離を超えた場合は、最大距離の座標を返す)
 * @param {Entity} entity 
 * @param {number} maxDistance 
 * @returns {import("@minecraft/server").Vector3}
 */
function getViewBLockLoc(entity,maxDistance) {
    const blockRay = entity.getBlockFromViewDirection({maxDistance});
    if(blockRay) {
        const faceLoc = blockRay.faceLocation;
        return shiftLocation(blockRay.block.location,faceLoc.x,faceLoc.y,faceLoc.z);
    } else {
        return caret(entity.getHeadLocation(),entity.getRotation(),[0,0,maxDistance]);
    }

}

/**
 * ROOM開始 (敵対時に召喚する)
 * @param {Entity} entity 
 */
export function law_room_start(entity) {
    // 召喚
    const room = entity.dimension.spawnEntity("op_asa:law_room",entity.location);
    // // 所有者の種類を保存(law,law2,law3を特定)
    // room.setProperty("op_asa:owner_type",entity.typeId.split(":")[1]);
    // 所有者のIDを保存(個人を特定)
    room.setDynamicProperty("law_room",entity.id);
}
/**
 * ROOM終了 (敵対終了時に所有ROOMを削除)
 * @param {Entity} entity 
 */
export function law_room_end(entity) {
    for (const room of entity.dimension.getEntities({type:"op_asa:law_room"})) {
        if(room.getDynamicProperty("law_room") === entity.id) {
            // world.sendMessage("敵対終了につきROOM削除");
            room.remove();
        }
    }
}
/**
 * 発動中のループ処理
 * @param {Entity} entity 
 * @returns 
 */
export function law_room_loop(entity) {
    const dim = entity.dimension;
    const loc = entity.location;

    if (entity.matches({families:["law"]})) {
        // 64以内に所有ROOMが無い場合召喚
        for (const room of dim.getEntities({type:"op_asa:law_room",location:loc,maxDistance:64})) {
            if(room.getDynamicProperty("law_room") === entity.id) {
                return;
            }
        }
        law_room_start(entity);
        // world.sendMessage("敵対中なのにROOMが無いのでROOM召喚");
    }else {
        // 64以内に所有者がいないなら消える (所有者がいても64超えてるなら消える)
        let dist = undefined;
        for (const law of dim.getEntities({families:["law"],location:loc,maxDistance:128})) {
            if(law.id === entity.getDynamicProperty("law_room")) {
                dist = getDistance(law.location,loc);
                break;
            }
        }
        if (dist === undefined || dist > 64) {
            entity.remove();
            // world.sendMessage("所有者がいないからROOM削除");
        }
    }
}

/**
 * カウンターショック
 * @param {Entity} entity 
 * @returns 
 */
function law2_counter_shock(entity) {

    entity.addEffect("slow_falling",10,{amplifier:0,showParticles:false});

    // ターゲットを取得
    const entityRay = entity.getEntitiesFromViewDirection({excludeTypes:["item","xp_orb"],excludeFamilies:["waza"],maxDistance:128,ignoreBlockCollision:true});

   
    if(entityRay.length>0){
        // ターゲットがいるならテレポートして発動
        const target = entityRay[0].entity;
        const hitLoc = caret(entity.getHeadLocation(),entity.getRotation(),[0,0,entityRay[0].distance]);
        
        entity.teleport(hitLoc);
        exe_counter_shock(entity,target,shiftLocation(hitLoc,0,1,0));
    }else{
        // ターゲットがいないなら最大64までテレポート
        const target = getEntitiesInFront(entity,[1,1],2,true);
        const hitLoc = getViewBLockLoc(entity,64);
        entity.teleport(hitLoc);
        exe_counter_shock(entity,target);
    }

    entity.playAnimation("animation.player.counter_shock",{stopExpression:"q.any_animation_finished",nextState:"default",controller:`controller.animation.${entity.typeId.split(":")[1]}.root`,blendOutTime:0.3});
}

import { Entity, Player, system } from "@minecraft/server";
import { caret, getDistance, shiftLocation } from "../function";
import { getEntitiesInRange, getEntitiesDistance, spawnExplosion } from "../function/entityFunction";
import { applySelfKnockback, applyVarious, damageByEffectStrength } from "../function/combatFunction";



/**
 * 
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function amanoiwato(player){
    const dim = player.dimension;

    // 最大距離
    let targetDist = 58;
    // 始点
    const headLocation = player.getHeadLocation();
    // 視線の先にエンティティがいるなら距離を取得
    const entityRaycastHits = player.getEntitiesFromViewDirection({maxDistance:64,excludeFamilies:["waza"],excludeTypes:["item","xp_orb"]});
    if(entityRaycastHits.length > 0){
        targetDist = Math.min(entityRaycastHits[0].distance,targetDist);
    }
    // いないなら視線の先のブロックのヒット位置を取得
    else{
        const blockHit = player.getBlockFromViewDirection({maxDistance:128});
        if(blockHit != undefined){
            const blockLocation = blockHit.block.location;
            targetDist = Math.min(getDistance(blockLocation,headLocation),targetDist);
        }
    }

    
    // その距離まで0.1間隔でパーティクルを生成、最大距離(ターゲットの位置)で爆発
    for(let num = 0; num <= targetDist; num=num+0.1){
        const exeLocation = caret(headLocation,player.getRotation(),[0,0,num]);
        dim.spawnParticle("op_asa:amanoiwato_p_particle",exeLocation);
        if(targetDist - num < 0.1){
            system.runTimeout(()=>{
                for(const targetEntity of getEntitiesInRange(player,shiftLocation(exeLocation,-3.5,-3,-3.5),{x:6,y:6,z:6})){
                    applyVarious({
                        target:targetEntity,
                        damaging:player,
                        damage:{amount:100,cause:"none"}
                    });
                }
    
                spawnExplosion(dim,exeLocation,"op_asa:amanoiwato");
    
                dim.spawnParticle("op_asa:amanoiwato_particle",exeLocation);
            },4);

            break;
        }
    }
}

export function amaterasu(entity){
    const exeLoc = entity.location;

    let particleId = "op_asa:amaterasu_particle3";
    let targets = getEntitiesDistance(entity,exeLoc,32);

    // ボルサリーノの時だけ変更加える
    if(entity.typeId == "op_asa:borsalino") {
	    entity.addEffect("slowness",20,{amplifier:20,showParticles:false});
        particleId = "op_asa:borsalino_amaterasu_particle";
	    targets = getEntitiesDistance(entity,exeLoc,64);
    }
    
    entity.dimension.spawnParticle(particleId,exeLoc);
    
    system.runTimeout(()=>{
		for(const target of targets){
			if(target.isValid && target.matches({excludeFamilies:["pikapika"],excludeTags:["pikapika"]})){
				target.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:amaterasu_particle2",target.getHeadLocation());
				applyVarious({
					target,

					effect:[
						{typeId:"slowness",duration:60,amplifier:10},
						{typeId:"blindness",duration:60,amplifier:0}
					]
				});
			}
		}
	},10);

}

/**
 * 
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function yatanokagami(player){
    // 最大距離
    let targetDist = 58;
    // 始点
    const startLocation = {
        x:player.getHeadLocation().x,
        y:player.getHeadLocation().y-0.5,
        z:player.getHeadLocation().z
    };
    // 終点
    let stopLocation = caret(startLocation,player.getRotation(),[0,0,58]);
    // 視線の先にエンティティがいるなら距離を取得して終点を設定
    const entityRaycastHits = player.getEntitiesFromViewDirection({maxDistance:64,excludeFamilies:["waza"],excludeTypes:["item","xp_orb"]});
    if(entityRaycastHits.length > 0){
        targetDist = Math.min(entityRaycastHits[0].distance,targetDist);
        stopLocation = entityRaycastHits[0].entity.location;
    }
    // いないなら視線の先のブロックのヒット位置を取得して終点を設定
    else{
        const blockHit = player.getBlockFromViewDirection({maxDistance:128});
        if(blockHit != undefined){
            stopLocation = shiftLocation(blockHit.block.location,blockHit.faceLocation.x,blockHit.faceLocation.y,blockHit.faceLocation.z);
        }
    }
    // その距離まで0.2間隔でパーティクルを生成
    for(let num = 0; num <= targetDist; num=num+0.2){
        const exeLocation = caret(startLocation,player.getRotation(),[0,0,num]);
        player.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:yatanokagami_particle",exeLocation);
    }
    // 終点にテレポート
    system.runTimeout(()=>{
        player.teleport(stopLocation);
        player.addEffect("slow_falling",20,{amplifier:0,showParticles:false});
    },5);
}

/**
 * ラディカルビーム(天岩戸の威力を下げた感じ)
 * @param {Entity} entity 
 */
export function radical_beam(entity){

	// 最大距離
	let targetDist = 58;

	// 始点
    const dim = entity.dimension;
    const rot = entity.getRotation();
    const startLoc = shiftLocation(entity.getHeadLocation(),0,-0.75,0);

	// 発射パーティクル
	dim.spawnParticle("op_asa:radical_beam_particle",caret(startLoc,entity.getRotation(),[0,0,1.5]));

    // ===== ダメージ ======
	// 視線の先にエンティティがいるならダメージ(エンティティ貫通)
	const entityRaycastHits = entity.getEntitiesFromViewDirection({maxDistance:64,excludeFamilies:["waza"],excludeTypes:["item","xp_orb"]});
    for(const entityHit of entityRaycastHits){
        const target = entityHit.entity;
        applyVarious({
            target,
            damaging:entity,
            damage:{amount:20,cause:"none"}
        });
    }

    // ===== パーティクルと爆発 =====

	// 最大距離まで0.2間隔でパーティクルを生成
	for(let num = 1.5; num <= targetDist; num=num+0.2){
		const exeLocation = caret(startLoc,rot,[0,0,num]);
		dim.spawnParticle("op_asa:radical_beam_p_particle",exeLocation);

        // ブロックにヒットしたら爆発
        const inBLock = dim.getBlock(exeLocation);
        if(inBLock && !inBLock.isAir){
            system.runTimeout(()=>{
                for(const targetEntity of getEntitiesInRange(entity,shiftLocation(exeLocation,-3.5,-3,-3.5),{x:6,y:6,z:6})){
                    applyVarious({
                        target:targetEntity,
                        damaging:entity,
                        damage:{amount:20,cause:"none"}
                    });
                }
                spawnExplosion(dim,exeLocation,3);
            },4);
            break;
        }
	}

}

import { Player, Entity, BlockPermutation } from "@minecraft/server";

/**
 * 
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function rakiraki_on_use(player){
	if (getScoreUtility(player,"sppower") > 0) {
		const EntityRaycastHitList = player.getEntitiesFromViewDirection();
		for(const EntityRaycastHit of EntityRaycastHitList){
			const targetEntity = EntityRaycastHit.entity;

			operationScoreUtility(player,"sppower",-1);
			targetEntity.removeTag("unraki");
			for(const badEffect of badEffects){
				player.removeEffect(badEffect.id);
			}
			const goodEffect = goodEffects[Math.floor(Math.random() * goodEffects.length)];
			targetEntity.addEffect(goodEffect.id,goodEffect.duration,{amplifier:goodEffect.amplifier,showParticles:true});
			break;
		}
	}
}
const badEffects = [
	{id:"slowness",duration:600,amplifier:3},
	{id:"mining_fatigue",duration:600,amplifier:3},

/**
 * コイン-projectile
 * @param {Entity} entity 
 */
export function raki_coin_p(entity){
	if (!entity) return;
	
    const player = entity.getComponent("projectile").owner;
	if(!player){
		entity.remove();
		return;
	}

    const unrakiTarget = entity.dimension.getEntities({excludeFamilies:["waza"],excludeTypes:["item","xp_orb"],tags:["unraki"],location:entity.location,maxDistance:64})[0];
    if(unrakiTarget != undefined){
        rakiCoin(player,unrakiTarget);
        unrakiTarget.removeTag("unraki");
    }else{
        const target = entity.dimension.getEntities({excludeFamilies:["waza"],excludeTags:["rakiraki"],excludeTypes:["item","xp_orb"],location:entity.location,maxDistance:64})[0];
        if(target == undefined) return;
        rakiCoin(player,target);
    }
    entity.remove();
}
/**
 * ラキコインイベント 1:小ダメージ　2:小爆発　3:火　4:水　5:中ダメージ　6:大爆発　7:小コインの雨　8:大コイン　9:大穴　10:大ダメージ
 * @param {Entity} player
 * @param {Entity} target
 */
function rakiCoin(player,target){
	const rakiScore = getScoreUtility(player,"sppower");
	if(rakiScore==0){
		player.sendMessage(`0`);
		return;
	}
	
	const luck = rakiScore >= 10 ? 10 : rakiScore;
	const random = Math.floor(Math.random()*luck) + 1;
	player.sendMessage(`${random}`);

	if(random == 1){
		target.applyDamage(4,{cause:"entityAttack",damagingEntity:player});
		operationScoreUtility(player,"sppower",-1);
	}
	else if(random == 2){
		exePseudoExplode(
			player,
			target.location,
			{power:2,damageAmount:true,damageCause:"none",breaksBlocks:true,causesFire:false}
		);
		operationScoreUtility(player,"sppower",-2);
	}
	else if(random == 3){
		fillCommandReplaceAir(target,target.location,[-1,0,-1],[1,2,1],BlockPermutation.resolve("fire"));
		operationScoreUtility(player,"sppower",-3);
	}
	else if(random == 4){
		fillCommandReplaceAir(target,target.location,[-1,3,-1],[1,3,1],BlockPermutation.resolve("water"));
		operationScoreUtility(player,"sppower",-4);
	}
	else if(random == 5){
		target.applyDamage(19,{cause:"entityAttack",damagingEntity:player});
		operationScoreUtility(player,"sppower",-5);
	}
	else if(random == 6){
		exePseudoExplode(
			player,
			target.location,
			{power:4,damageAmount:true,damageCause:"none",breaksBlocks:true,causesFire:false}
		);
		operationScoreUtility(player,"sppower",-6);
	}
	else if(random == 7){
		const { x, y, z } = target.location;

		for (let dx = -3; dx <= 3; dx++) {
			for (let dz = -3; dz <= 3; dz++) {
				target.dimension.spawnEntity("op_asa:raki_coin_small_place", {
					x: x + dx,
					y: y,
					z: z + dz
				});
			}
		}
		operationScoreUtility(player,"sppower",-7);
	}
	else if(random == 8){
		spawnProjectileEntity("op_asa:raki_coin_big",shiftLocation(target.location,0,10,0),player);
		operationScoreUtility(player,"sppower",-8);
	}
	else if(random == 9){
		fillCommand(target,target.location,[-3,-5,-3],[3,0,3],BlockPermutation.resolve("air"));
		operationScoreUtility(player,"sppower",-9);
	}
	else if(random == 10){
		target.applyDamage(40,{cause:"override",damagingEntity:player});
		operationScoreUtility(player,"sppower",-10);
	}
}

/**
 * パワー消費して不利効果解除
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function removeBadEffectsConsumePower(player){
	let spPower = getScoreUtility(player,SCOREBOARD.spPower);
	for (const effect of badEffects) {
		const id = effect.id;
		if (spPower > 0 && player.getEffect(id)) {
			player.removeEffect(id);
			spPower -= 1;
		}
	}
	setScoreUtility(player,SCOREBOARD.spPower,spPower);
}

/**
 * 岩投げ-チャージ中
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function riki_rockthrow_charge(player){

    const scale = Math.max(1,getAkumaExpLevel(getAkumaExp(player,39))); // 1~5
    const rikiBlock = getRikiBLock(player);

/**

export function riki_block_p_hit(entity){

    if (owner) {
