    // 消す
    entity.remove();
}

/**
 * ラリアット
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function riki_lariat(player){
    const dim = player.dimension;
    const loc = player.getHeadLocation();
    const rot = player.getRotation();
    const scale = getAkumaExpLevel(getAkumaExp(player,39)); // 0~5
    const dist_by_scale = 4 + 4*scale;
    const range_by_scale = 3 + 3*scale;

    // サウンド
    dim.playSound("riki_lariat",loc);

    // 前方近距離ダメージ
    dim.spawnParticle("op_asa:riki_lariat_impact",caret(loc,rot,[0,0,1]));
    rangedAttackForward({
        damaging:player,
        range:[range_by_scale,2],
        distance:dist_by_scale,
        damage:{amount:damageByEffectStrength(player,11+scale),cause:"entityAttack"},
        knockback:{type:"front",verticalStrength:1,horizontalStrength:5}
    });

    // 前方遠距離爆発
    if (scale < 1) return;

    const dir = player.getViewDirection();

    function exe(offset_x) {
        const blockHit = dim.getBlockFromRay(shiftLocation(loc,offset_x,0,0),dir,{maxDistance:64});
        const hitDist = blockHit ? Math.min(dist_by_scale,getDistance(blockHit.block.location,loc)) : 64;
        for(let num=1; num<=dist_by_scale; num++) {
            const thisLoc = caret(loc,rot,[offset_x,0,num]);
            if (num == hitDist) {
                dim.spawnParticle("op_asa:riki_lariat_explode",thisLoc);
                destroySphere(dim,thisLoc,3);
            } else {
                dim.spawnParticle("op_asa:riki_lariat_shoot",thisLoc);
            }
        }
    }

    if (scale >= 5) {
        exe(7.5);
        exe(-7.5);
    }
    if (scale >= 4) {
        exe(6.0);
        exe(-6.0);
    }
    if (scale >= 3) {
        exe(4.5);
        exe(-4.5);
    }
    if (scale >= 2) {
        exe(3.0);
        exe(-3.0);
    }
    exe(1.5);
    exe(0.0);
    exe(-1.5);

    // クールダウン
    player.startItemCooldown("akumanomi",60);
}
/**
 * 球体状のブロックを破壊する
 * @param {Dimension} dimension
 * @param {import("@minecraft/server").Vector3} location
 * @param {number} radius
 */
export function destroySphere(dimension, location, radius) {
    const radiusSq = radius * radius;

    const minX = Math.floor(location.x - radius);
    const maxX = Math.floor(location.x + radius);
    const minY = Math.floor(location.y - radius);
    const maxY = Math.floor(location.y + radius);
    const minZ = Math.floor(location.z - radius);
    const maxZ = Math.floor(location.z + radius);

    for (let x = minX; x <= maxX; x++) {
        const dx = x + 0.5 - location.x;
        const dxSq = dx * dx;

        for (let y = minY; y <= maxY; y++) {
            const dy = y + 0.5 - location.y;
            const dySq = dy * dy;

            for (let z = minZ; z <= maxZ; z++) {
                const dz = z + 0.5 - location.z;
                const distanceSq = dxSq + dySq + dz * dz;

                // 球の外
                if (distanceSq > radiusSq) continue;

                const block = dimension.getBlock({ x, y, z });
                if (!block || block.isAir) continue;

                // 中心100%、外周0%
                const chance = 1 - Math.sqrt(distanceSq) / radius;

                if (Math.random() > chance) continue;

                // block.setType("minecraft:air");
                destroyBlock(block,false,"explode");
            }
        }
    }
}

/**
 * 岩投げの岩を取得
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
function getRikiBLock(player){
    let target = undefined;

    // 岩を取得
    const allRikiBlock = player.dimension.getEntities({type:"op_asa:riki_block",location:player.location,maxDistance:64});

    // 全岩から所有物を特定して返す
    for(const rikiBlock of allRikiBlock){
        if(isTamedToPlayer(player,rikiBlock)){
            target = rikiBlock;
            break;
        }
    }

    return target;
    
}

import { Player, world } from "@minecraft/server";
import { caret, decrementStack, giveCommand, replaceAir, shiftLocation } from "../function";
import { getEntitiesDistance } from "../function/entityFunction";
import { getScoreUtility, operationScoreUtility, setScoreUtility } from "../scoreboard";
import { getStatusLevel } from "../status";

/**
 * 
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function soul_pocus(player){
    /**
     * 
     * @param {Number} maxDistance 対象範囲
     * @param {Number} statusLevelExp levelExp閾値
     * @param {String} message メッセージ
     */
    function exe(maxDistance,statusLevelExp,message){
        // 自分にメッセージ
        player.sendMessage(message);

        const level = getStatusLevel(player,statusLevelExp); // 最大60
        const amount = 5 + Math.floor(level/2); // 最大35

        // 指定範囲内のエンティティを取得
        for(const targetEntity of getEntitiesDistance(player,player.location,maxDistance)){
            if(targetEntity.matches({excludeFamilies:["sorusoru"],excludeTags:["sorusoru"]})){

                // ターゲットがプレイヤーならメッセージ
                if(targetEntity.typeId == "minecraft:player"){
                    targetEntity.sendMessage(message);
                }

                // 閾値未満なら実行
                if(targetEntity.getProperty("op_asa:status_level_exp") < statusLevelExp){
                    targetEntity.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:soul_pocus_particle",targetEntity.location);
                    targetEntity.addEffect("slowness",40,{amplifier:5,showParticles:false});
                    targetEntity.applyDamage(amount,{cause:"selfDestruct",damagingEntity:player});
                    giveCommand(player,"op_asa:soul",amount,false,"none");
                }
            }
        }
    }

    const statusLevelExp = player.getProperty("op_asa:status_level_exp");
    if(statusLevelExp < 45){
        player.sendMessage({rawtext:[{translate:"rawtext.notification.soul_pocus"}]});
    }
    else if(statusLevelExp < 190){
        exe(8,45,"§l§5LEAVE OR LIFE !!!§r");
    }
    else if(statusLevelExp < 435){
        exe(12,190,"§l§5STAY OR LIFE !!!§r");
    }
    else if(statusLevelExp < 780){
        exe(16,435,"§l§5LIFE OR WEDDING CAKE !!!§r");
    }
    else if(statusLevelExp < 1225){
        exe(20,780,"§l§5LIFE OR TREAT !!!§r");
    }
    else if(statusLevelExp < 1770){
        exe(24,1225,"§l§5LIFE or SLAVE !!!§r");
    }
    else {
        exe(28,1770,"§l§5LIFE or DEAD !!!§r");
    }
}
/**
 * ホーミーズ生成
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function soul(player){
    const playerBlockRaycastHit = player.getBlockFromViewDirection({maxDistance:8});

    // 視線の先にブロックがある
    if(playerBlockRaycastHit != undefined){
        const targetBlock = playerBlockRaycastHit.block;

        /**@param {Number} number */
        function spawnHomies(number){
            replaceAir(targetBlock);

            const spawnedHomies = targetBlock.dimension.spawnEntity("op_asa:soru_homies",shiftLocation(targetBlock.location,0.5,0,0.5));
            if(number==null){
                spawnedHomies.triggerEvent("op_asa:treeman");
            }else{
                spawnedHomies.triggerEvent(`op_asa:flower.${number}`);
            }
            spawnedHomies.getComponent("tameable").tame(player);
            spawnedHomies.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:tamed_particle",shiftLocation(spawnedHomies.location,0,1,0));

            decrementStack(player,1);
        }

        // 花と木
        if(targetBlock.permutation.matches("minecraft:yellow_flower")) spawnHomies(0);
        else if(targetBlock.permutation.matches("minecraft:poppy")) spawnHomies(1);
        else if(targetBlock.permutation.matches("minecraft:blue_orchid")) spawnHomies(2);
        else if(targetBlock.permutation.matches("minecraft:allium")) spawnHomies(3);
        else if(targetBlock.permutation.matches("minecraft:azure_bluet")) spawnHomies(4);
        else if(targetBlock.permutation.matches("minecraft:red_tulip")) spawnHomies(5);
        else if(targetBlock.permutation.matches("minecraft:orange_tulip")) spawnHomies(6);
        else if(targetBlock.permutation.matches("minecraft:white_tulip")) spawnHomies(7);
        else if(targetBlock.permutation.matches("minecraft:pink_tulip")) spawnHomies(8);
        else if(targetBlock.permutation.matches("minecraft:oxeye_daisy")) spawnHomies(9);
        else if(targetBlock.permutation.matches("minecraft:cornflower")) spawnHomies(10);
        else if(targetBlock.permutation.matches("minecraft:lily_of_the_valley")) spawnHomies(11);
        else if(targetBlock.permutation.matches("minecraft:double_plant",{double_plant_type:"sunflower"})) spawnHomies(12);
        else if(targetBlock.permutation.matches("minecraft:double_plant",{double_plant_type:"syringa"})) spawnHomies(13);
        else if(targetBlock.permutation.matches("minecraft:double_plant",{double_plant_type:"rose"})) spawnHomies(14);
        else if(targetBlock.permutation.matches("minecraft:double_plant",{double_plant_type:"paeonia"})) spawnHomies(15);
        else if(targetBlock.typeId.includes("_sapling") && !targetBlock.typeId.includes("bamboo")) spawnHomies();
        else if(true){
            const targetEntities = player.dimension.getEntities({type:"item",maxDistance:4,location:player.location});
            for(const targetEntity of targetEntities){
    
                const targetItemId = targetEntity.getComponent("item").itemStack.typeId;
    
                let exe  = false;
    
                /**@param {String} type */
                function spawnHomies2(type){
    
                    const spawnedHomies = targetEntity.dimension.spawnEntity("op_asa:soru_homies",targetEntity.location);
                    spawnedHomies.triggerEvent(`op_asa:${type}`);
                    spawnedHomies.getComponent("tameable").tame(player);
                    spawnedHomies.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:tamed_particle",shiftLocation(spawnedHomies.location,0,1,0));
    
                    const targetItemStack = targetEntity.getComponent("item").itemStack;
    
                    if(targetItemStack.amount != 1){
                        const dropItemStack = targetItemStack;
                        dropItemStack["amount"] = targetItemStack.amount - 1;
    
                        targetEntity.dimension.spawnItem(dropItemStack,targetEntity.location);
                    }
                    targetEntity.remove();
                    decrementStack(player,1);
                    exe = true;
                }
    
                if(targetItemId == "minecraft:armor_stand") spawnHomies2("armor_stand");
                else if(targetItemId == "minecraft:bookshelf") spawnHomies2("bookshelf");
                else if(targetItemId == "minecraft:cake") spawnHomies2("cake");
                else if(targetItemId == "minecraft:chest") spawnHomies2("chestbox");
                else if(targetItemId == "minecraft:cookie") spawnHomies2("cookie");
                else if(targetItemId == "minecraft:furnace") spawnHomies2("furnace");
                else if(targetItemId == "minecraft:torch") spawnHomies2("torch");
                
                if(exe == true) break;
    
            }
        }
    }
    // 視線の先にブロックがない
    else{
        const targetEntities = player.dimension.getEntities({type:"item",maxDistance:4,location:player.location});
        for(const targetEntity of targetEntities){

            const targetItemId = targetEntity.getComponent("item").itemStack.typeId;

            let exe  = false;

            /**@param {String} type */
            function spawnHomies(type){
    
                const spawnedHomies = targetEntity.dimension.spawnEntity("op_asa:soru_homies",targetEntity.location);
                spawnedHomies.triggerEvent(`op_asa:${type}`);
                spawnedHomies.getComponent("tameable").tame(player);
                spawnedHomies.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:tamed_particle",shiftLocation(spawnedHomies.location,0,1,0));

                const targetItemStack = targetEntity.getComponent("item").itemStack;

                if(targetItemStack.amount != 1){
                    const dropItemStack = targetItemStack;
                    dropItemStack["amount"] = targetItemStack.amount - 1;

                    targetEntity.dimension.spawnItem(dropItemStack,targetEntity.location);
                }
                targetEntity.remove();
                decrementStack(player,1);
                exe = true;
            }

            if(targetItemId == "minecraft:armor_stand") spawnHomies("armor_stand");
            else if(targetItemId == "minecraft:bookshelf") spawnHomies("bookshelf");
            else if(targetItemId == "minecraft:cake") spawnHomies("cake");
            else if(targetItemId == "minecraft:chest") spawnHomies("chestbox");
            else if(targetItemId == "minecraft:cookie") spawnHomies("cookie");
            else if(targetItemId == "minecraft:furnace") spawnHomies("furnace");
            else if(targetItemId == "minecraft:torch") spawnHomies("torch");
            
            if(exe == true) break;

        }
    }
}

/**
 * ソウル消費
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
function consumeSoul(player){

    // スコア消費
    operationScoreUtility(player,"sppower",-10);

    // スコアが0になった場合
    if(getScoreUtility(player,"sppower")<=0){
        // 死亡回数を1追加
        operationScoreUtility(player,"deadcount",1);
        // 現在の死亡回数に応じてスコア設定
        const deadCount = getScoreUtility(player,"sppower");
        const maxSppower = deadCount>=4 ? 20 : deadCount>=3 ? 40 : deadCount>=2 ? 60 : 80;
        setScoreUtility(player,"sppower",maxSppower);
        // 死亡
        player.kill();
    }
}

/**
 * 
 * @param {Entity} entity 
 */
export function sables_p(entity){
    // 存在しないなら終了
    const projectileComp = entity.getComponent("projectile");
    if(projectileComp==undefined) return;

    // 浮遊とダメージ
    const owner = projectileComp.owner;
    const targets = entity.dimension.getEntities({excludeFamilies:["waza","sunasuna"],excludeTypes:["item","xp_orb"],excludeTags:["sunasuna"],location:shiftLocation(entity.location,-3,-1,-3),volume:{x:6,y:11,z:6}});
    for(const target of targets){
        target.addEffect("levitation",20,{amplifier:14,showParticles:false});
        target.applyDamage(4,{cause:"none",damagingEntity:owner});
    }
}
/**
 * グラウンドセッコ
 * @param {Player} player 
 * @param {Number} eventNum 0 ~ 10
 */
export function groundsecco(player,eventNum){
	const excludeTypes = [
		"sand",
        "water",
        "flowing_water"
	];
	const replaceableBLockTypes = REPLACEABLE_BLOCKS.filter(function(type){
		return !excludeTypes.includes(type);
	});
	const list = [
		{start:[-1,-1,-1],stop:[1,1,1],dist:1,particle:1,damageDist:1},

		{start:[-4,-5,-4],stop:[4,-1,4],dist:4,particle:1,damageDist:4},
		{start:[-4,0,-4],stop:[4,5,4],dist:4,particle:1,damageDist:4},

		{start:[-8,-5,-8],stop:[8,-1,8],dist:8,particle:2,damageDist:8},
		{start:[-8,0,-8],stop:[8,5,8],dist:8,particle:2,damageDist:8},

		{start:[-16,-5,-16],stop:[16,-1,16],dist:16,particle:2,damageDist:16},
		{start:[-16,0,-16],stop:[16,5,16],dist:16,particle:2,damageDist:16},

		{start:[-24,-5,-24],stop:[24,-1,24],dist:24,particle:2,damageDist:16},
		{start:[-24,0,-24],stop:[24,5,24],dist:24,particle:2,damageDist:16},

		{start:[-32,-5,-32],stop:[32,-1,32],dist:32,particle:2,damageDist:16},
		{start:[-32,0,-32],stop:[32,5,32],dist:32,particle:2,damageDist:16},
	]
	const data = list[eventNum];
	const loc = player.location;

	// 地面砂に変換して衰弱付与
	fillCommand(player,loc,data.start,data.stop,BlockPermutation.resolve("minecraft:sand"),replaceableBLockTypes);
	addWitherEffect(player,data.dist);

	// ダメージと衰弱付与
	for (const target of getEntitiesDistance(player,loc,data.damageDist,true)) {
		applyVarious({
			target,
			damaging:player,
			damage:{amount:20,cause:"none"},
			effect:{typeId:"wither",duration:400,amplifier:1,showParticles:true}
		});
	}

	// ダメージ範囲にパーティクル
	player.dimension.spawnParticle(`op_asa:groundsecco_particle_${data.particle}`,loc);

	// クールダウン
	if (isPlayer(player)) player.startItemCooldown("akumanomi4",140);

}
/**
 * グラウンドセッコ(クロコダイル)
 * @param {Entity} entity 
 */
export function groundsecco_crocodile(entity){

	groundsecco(entity,3);

	system.runTimeout(()=>{
		groundsecco(entity,4);
	},6);

}
/**
 * 一定範囲内の砂の上にいるエンティティに衰弱を付与
 * @param {Entity} user 
 * @param {Number} dist 
 */
function addWitherEffect(user,dist){
	for(const target of getEntitiesDistance(user,user.location,dist,true)){
		if(target.matches({excludeTags:["sunasuna"],excludeFamilies:["sunasuna"]})){
			if(target.getBlockStandingOn()?.typeId == "minecraft:sand"){
				target.addEffect("wither",400,{amplifier:1,showParticles:true});
			}
		}
	}
}

import { Dimension, Entity, EntityDamageCause, Player, system, world } from "@minecraft/server";
import { caret, replaceItemInInventoryCombine, shiftLocation, spawnParticlesBetween } from "../function";
import { getScoreUtility } from "../scoreboard";

import { COOLDOWN_CATEGORY_FIGHT, COOLDOWN_CATEGORY_KATANA, COOLDOWN_CATEGORY_ROKUSHIKI } from "../index/item_cooldown_index";

/**
 * cooldown
 * 1: ongle - 一般技
 * 2:  - 射撃技
 * 3:  - 移動技
 * 4: perfect_phoenix, phoenix_flame, blue_bird, hououin - 必殺技
 * 5:  - フィールド技
 * 6: perfect_phoenix_end - 特殊技
 */


/**
 * 不死鳥の炎
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function phoenix_flame(player){
    player.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:phoenix_flame_particle",player.location);

    const entities = player.dimension.getEntities({excludeTypes:["item","xp_orb"],excludeFamilies:["waza"],location:player.location,maxDistance:3});
    for(const entity of entities){
        const healthComp = entity.getComponent("health");
        if(healthComp!=undefined){
            if(entity == player){
                healthComp.setCurrentValue(Math.min(healthComp.effectiveMax,healthComp.currentValue + 3));
                entity.addEffect("regeneration",600,{showParticles:false,amplifier:1});
            }else{
                healthComp.setCurrentValue(Math.min(healthComp.effectiveMax,healthComp.currentValue + 3));
                entity.addEffect("regeneration",600,{showParticles:false,amplifier:0});
            }
        }
    }
}
/**
 * 鳳凰印
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function hououin(player){
	const currentSpExp = Math.min(getAkumaExp(player,11),30);
	const convertSpLevel = currentSpExp < 10 ? 0 : currentSpExp < 30 ? 1 : 2;
    shootProjectile(player,"op_asa:hououin_p",{power:4,spawnEvent:`op_asa:lv${convertSpLevel}`});

    player.startItemCooldown("akumanomi4",60);
}
/**
 * 鳳凰印-ヒット時
 * @param {Entity} projectile 
 */
export function hououin_p(projectile){
    if (!projectile?.isValid) return;

    const owner = projectile.getComponent("projectile")?.owner;
    const dim = projectile.dimension;
    const loc = projectile.location;
    projectile.remove();

    if (owner) exe_hououin(owner,dim,loc);
}
/**
 * 鳳凰印-ダメージ実行
 * @param {Entity} damaging 
 * @param {Dimension} dim 
 * @param {import("@minecraft/server").Vector3} loc 
 */
function exe_hououin(damaging,dim,loc){

    // パーティクル
    dim.spawnParticle("op_asa:hououin_particle",loc);
    dim.spawnParticle("op_asa:hououin_hit_particle",loc);
    dim.spawnParticle("op_asa:toritori_particle1",loc);
    dim.spawnParticle("op_asa:toritori_particle2",loc);

    // ダメージ
    const exp = damaging.typeId === "op_asa:marco" ? 30 : Math.min(getAkumaExp(damaging,11),30);
    const amount = exp < 10 ? 20 : exp < 30 ? 40 : 80;
    for (const target of getEntitiesInRange(damaging,shiftLocation(loc,-2.5,-2,-2.5),{x:4,y:4,z:4})) {
        applyVarious({
            target,
            damaging,
            damage:{
                amount
            },
            knockback:{
                type:"sphere",horizontalStrength:7,verticalStrength:1
            }
        });
    }
}

export function blue_bird(player){

    shootProjectile(player,"op_asa:blue_bird_p",{power:1.5});
}
/**
 * 鶴爪
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function ongle(player){
    
    // 他の技すぐ発動できないように
    player.startItemCooldown("akumanomi4",20);

    player.addEffect("slow_falling",30,{showParticles:false});

    // 開始地点
    const startLocation = player.location;
    
    // テレポート地点
    let hitLoc = startLocation;
    
    // ターゲットを取得
    const entityRay = player.getEntitiesFromViewDirection({excludeTypes:["item","xp_orb"],excludeFamilies:["waza"],maxDistance:16});
    // ターゲットがいるならテレポートして発動
    if(entityRay.length>0){
        hitLoc = caret(player.getHeadLocation(),player.getRotation(),[0,0,entityRay[0].distance]);
    }
    // ブロックがあるならテレポート、なにもないなら8ブロック先にテレポート
    else{
        const blockRay = player.getBlockFromViewDirection({maxDistance:16});
        if(blockRay!=undefined){
            hitLoc = shiftLocation(blockRay.block.location,blockRay.faceLocation.x,blockRay.faceLocation.y,blockRay.faceLocation.z);
        }else{
            hitLoc = caret(player.getHeadLocation(),player.getRotation(),[0,0,8]);
        }
    }

    // テレポートする
    player.teleport(hitLoc);
    
    const stopLocation = player.location;

    // 攻撃音
    // player.dimension.playSound("sword.togenshirataki",stopLocation,{volume:1.1});

    // 攻撃パーティクルとダメージ
    player.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:ongle_particle",caret(player.location,player.getRotation(),[0,0.5,2]));
    rushAttack({
        damaging:player,
        startLocation,
        stopLocation,
        volume:{x:4,y:4,z:4},
        damage:{amount:damageByEffectStrength(player,11,1.3),cause:"entityAttack",katanawaza:true},
        knockback:{type:"front",horizontalStrength:14,verticalStrength:1}
    });
    player.playAnimation("animation.player.phoenix.ongle",{blendOutTime:0.3,stopExpression:"q.any_animation_finished",controller:"controller.animation.player.root",nextState:"third_person"});
}
/**
 * 
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function perfect_phoenix_start(player){
    const akuma = player.getProperty("op_asa:akumanomi");
    const akumaType = player.getProperty("op_asa:akumanomi_type");

    if(akuma==11 && akumaType!=2){
        player.setProperty("op_asa:akumanomi_type",2);
        player.triggerEvent("tori.perfect_phoenix_start");

        // "終了"にクールダウンを与える
        player.startItemCooldown("akumanomi5",20);
        // "獣型"を"終了"に変える
        replaceItemInInventoryCombine(player,"op_asa:perfect_phoenix","op_asa:perfect_phoenix_end");
    }
}
/**
 * 
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function perfect_phoenix_end(player){
    player.setProperty("op_asa:akumanomi_type",0);
    player.triggerEvent("tori.perfect_phoenix_end");
    
    // 全クールダウン解除
    for(const category of perfect_phoenix_ct_categories){
        player.startItemCooldown(category,0);
    }

    // "獣型"にクールダウンを与える
    player.startItemCooldown("akumanomi4",20);
    // "終了"を"獣型"に変える
    replaceItemInInventoryCombine(player,"op_asa:perfect_phoenix_end","op_asa:perfect_phoenix");
}
/**
 * 不死鳥時のアイテムクールダウン
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function perfect_phoenix_ct(player){

    // アイテムクールダウン開始
    for(const category of perfect_phoenix_ct_categories){
        player.startItemCooldown(category,10000);
    }
}
const perfect_phoenix_ct_categories = [
    "akumanomi",
    "akumanomi4",
    ...COOLDOWN_CATEGORY_KATANA,
    ...COOLDOWN_CATEGORY_FIGHT,
    ...COOLDOWN_CATEGORY_ROKUSHIKI,
]



/**
 * マルコ-鳳凰印
 * @param {Entity} entity 
 */
export function marco_hououin(entity){
    const rot = entity.getRotation();
    const start = entity.location;

    let target;
    target = entity.getEntitiesFromViewDirection({maxDistance:64})[0]?.entity;
    if (!target) target = entity.getBlockFromViewDirection({maxDistance:64,includePassableBlocks:false})?.block;
    
    const dim = entity.dimension;
    const end = target ? target.location : caret(start,rot,[0,0,64]);

    spawnParticlesBetween(dim,"op_asa:hououin_p_particle",start,end,2);
    entity.teleport(end,{rotation:rot});

    // ダメージ実行 鳳凰印ダメージの前に1ダメージ与える(回避消費)
    system.runTimeout(()=>{
        if (entity?.isValid) {
            for (const t of getEntitiesInRange(entity,shiftLocation(end,-2.5,-2,-2.5),{x:4,y:4,z:4})) {
                t.applyDamage(1,{cause:EntityDamageCause.entityAttack,damagingEntity:entity});
            }
        }
    },1);
    system.runTimeout(()=>{
        if (entity?.isValid) exe_hououin(entity,dim,end);
    },2);
}

/**
 * 龍巻-チャージ中
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function tatsumaki_charge(player){
    const spcharge = getScoreUtility(player,"spcharge");

    const loc = player.location;

    /**
     * 
     * @param {import("@minecraft/server").Vector3} loc 
     * @param {import("@minecraft/server").Vector3} volume 
     */
    function exe(loc,volume){
        const targets = player.dimension.getEntities({...baseEntityQuery,location:loc,volume:volume});
        for(const target of targets){
            if(target != player){
                applyVarious({
                    target,
                    damaging:player,
                    damage:{amount:14,cause:"none"},
                    knockback:{type:"up",verticalStrength:1}
                });
            }
        }
    }

    if(spcharge==0){
        exe(shiftLocation(loc,-5,0,-5),{x:9,y:5,z:9});
    }
    else if(spcharge==4){
        exe(shiftLocation(loc,-6,0,-6),{x:11,y:11,z:11});
        spawnProjectileEntity("op_asa:uo_tatsumaki_e",shiftLocation(loc,10,0,10),player,{spawnEvent:"op_asa:entity_summoned"});
    }
    else if(spcharge==7){
        exe(shiftLocation(loc,-6,0,-6),{x:11,y:11,z:11});
        spawnProjectileEntity("op_asa:uo_tatsumaki_e",shiftLocation(loc,10,0,-10),player,{spawnEvent:"op_asa:entity_summoned"});
    }
    else if(spcharge==10){
        exe(shiftLocation(loc,-6,0,-6),{x:11,y:11,z:11});
        spawnProjectileEntity("op_asa:uo_tatsumaki_e",shiftLocation(loc,-10,0,-10),player,{spawnEvent:"op_asa:entity_summoned"});
    }
    else if(spcharge==13){
        exe(shiftLocation(loc,-6,0,-6),{x:11,y:11,z:11});
        spawnProjectileEntity("op_asa:uo_tatsumaki_e",shiftLocation(loc,-10,0,10),player,{spawnEvent:"op_asa:entity_summoned"});
    }
    else if(spcharge==17){
        exe(shiftLocation(loc,-6,0,-6),{x:11,y:11,z:11});
        spawnProjectileEntity("op_asa:uo_tatsumaki_e",shiftLocation(loc,20,0,0),player,{spawnEvent:"op_asa:entity_summoned"});
        spawnProjectileEntity("op_asa:uo_tatsumaki_e",shiftLocation(loc,-20,0,0),player,{spawnEvent:"op_asa:entity_summoned"});
        spawnProjectileEntity("op_asa:uo_tatsumaki_e",shiftLocation(loc,0,0,20),player,{spawnEvent:"op_asa:entity_summoned"});
        spawnProjectileEntity("op_asa:uo_tatsumaki_e",shiftLocation(loc,0,0,-20),player,{spawnEvent:"op_asa:entity_summoned"});
    }

    stopComboMove(player,spcharge>=20,[{cooldownCategory:"akumanomi3",tickDuration:400}]);
}
/**
 * 龍巻-エンティティ
 * @param {Entity} entity 
 */
export function tatsumaki_e(entity){
    const owner = entity.getComponent("projectile").owner;
    if(owner==undefined) return;

    const state = entity.getComponent("mark_variant").value;
    const entityLoc = entity.location;

    /**
     * 
     * @param {import("@minecraft/server").Vector3} loc 
     * @param {import("@minecraft/server").Vector3} volume 
     */
    function exe(loc,volume){
        const targets = entity.dimension.getEntities({excludeTypes:["item","xp_orb"],excludeFamilies:["waza"],location:loc,volume:volume});
        for(const target of targets){
            if(target != owner){
                applyVarious({
                    target,
                    damaging:owner,
                    damage:{amount:14,cause:"none"},
                    knockback:{type:"up",verticalStrength:1}
                });
            }
        }
    }

    if(state==0){
        exe(shiftLocation(entityLoc,-2.5,0,-2.5),{x:4,y:5,z:4});
    }
    else if(state==1){
        exe(shiftLocation(entityLoc,-2.5,0,-2.5),{x:4,y:5,z:4});
        exe(shiftLocation(entityLoc,-3.5,6,-3.5),{x:6,y:4,z:6});
        exe(shiftLocation(entityLoc,-5,11,-5),{x:9,y:10,z:9});
    }
}
/**
 * 龍巻-終了
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function tatsumaki_end(player){
    // クールダウン開始
    startItemCooldownDependingOnSpcharge(player,"akumanomi3",400,40);
    // プレイヤーを降ろして、龍巻エンティティを消す
    const ridingComp = player.getComponent("riding");
    if(ridingComp!=undefined){
        const tatsumakiEntity = ridingComp.entityRidingOn;
        tatsumakiEntity.getComponent("rideable").ejectRiders();
        tatsumakiEntity.triggerEvent("op_asa:end");
    }
    // 降制限解除
    player.inputPermissions.setPermissionCategory(8,true);
    // カメラ解除
    system.runTimeout(()=>{
        player.camera.clear();
    },5);
}

/**
 * 火龍大炬-チャージ中
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function kaendaiko_charge(player){
    const charge = getScoreUtility(player,"spcharge")-1;
    
    for(const target of getEntitiesInRange(player,shiftLocation(player.location,-charge,0,-charge),{x:charge*2,y:charge*2,z:charge*2})){
        target.applyDamage(40,{cause:"fire",damagingEntity:player});
        target.setOnFire(3,true);
    }

    // マグマ設置
    fillCommand(player,player.location,[-charge,-2,-charge],[charge,charge-1,charge],BlockPermutation.resolve("magma"));
    fillCommand(player,player.location,[-charge,charge,-charge],[charge,charge*2,charge],BlockPermutation.resolve("magma"));
    
    // 1ブロック内側のマグマと空気を火に変換
    fillCommand(player,player.location,[-charge+1,-1,-charge+1],[charge-1,charge-1,charge-1],BlockPermutation.resolve("fire"),["magma","air"]);
    fillCommand(player,player.location,[-charge+1,charge,-charge+1],[charge-1,charge*2,charge-1],BlockPermutation.resolve("fire"),["magma","air"]);
}

import { Direction, Entity, MolangVariableMap, Player, system, world } from "@minecraft/server";
import { caret, getHitLoc, getSpcharge, shiftLocation } from "../function";
import { getEntitiesDistance } from "../function/entityFunction";
import { getScoreUtility, operationScoreUtility, setScoreUtility } from "../scoreboard";

/**
 * ワープ-チャージ中にパーティクル生成
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function wapu_warp_charge(player){
    const item = player.getComponent("equippable").getEquipment("Mainhand");
    const isRifle = item?.typeId == "op_asa:wapu_rifle";
    const isMulti = item?.typeId == "op_asa:wapu_warp2";

    // テレポート先パーティクル
    const warpInfo = getWarpTargetInfo(player,isRifle);
    const particleLoc = warpInfo.particleLoc;
    if (particleLoc && player.dimension.isChunkLoaded(particleLoc)) {
        player.spawnParticle(
            warpInfo.isBlock ? "op_asa:warp_target_block_particle" : "op_asa:warp_taget_entity_particle",
            particleLoc
        );
    }

    // エリアパーティクル (こっちはdimで全員に見えるように)
    if (isMulti) {
        const molang = new MolangVariableMap();
        molang.setFloat("size",2);
        player.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:warp_area_particle",player.location,molang);
    }
}
/**
 * ライフル-チャージ
 *  ワープかオーガーか
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function augur_rifle_charge(player){
    // スコア加算
    if (getScoreUtility(player,"spcharge") < 20) operationScoreUtility(player,"spcharge",1);

    // ワープならパーティクル
    const item = player.getComponent("equippable").getEquipment("Mainhand");
    if (item?.typeId == "op_asa:wapu_rifle") wapu_warp_charge(player);
}




/**
 * ワープ-実行
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function wapu_warp(player){
    const item = player.getComponent("equippable").getEquipment("Mainhand");
    const isMulti = item?.typeId == "op_asa:wapu_warp2";

    const warpInfo = getWarpTargetInfo(player,false);
    const warpLoc = warpInfo.warpLoc;
    if (warpLoc == undefined) return;

    // テレポート
    let count = 0;
    if (isMulti) {
        const targets = getEntitiesDistance(player,player.location,2,false);
        count = targets.length - 1;
        system.runTimeout(()=>{
            warp(targets,warpLoc);
        },2);
    } else {
        system.runTimeout(()=>{
            warp(player,warpLoc);
        },2);
    }

    // 飛ばした人数分クールダウン伸びる
    player.startItemCooldown("akumanomi",20 + 80*count);

}
/**
 * オーガーライフル
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function augur_rifle(player){
    player.dimension.playSound("augur_rifle_charged_attack",player.location,{volume:0.3});
    const lv = getSpcharge(player).lv;
    const projectile = shootProjectile(player,"op_asa:augur_rifle_p",{power:7,offset:[0,0,1],spawnEvent:`op_asa:lv${lv}`});
    setScoreUtility(player,"spcharge",0);
    player.startItemCooldown("weapon",20);

    // ワープならクールダウン、テレポート追加
    if (player.getComponent("equippable").getEquipment("Mainhand")?.typeId == "op_asa:wapu_rifle") {
        player.startItemCooldown("akumanomi",20);
        const warpLoc = getWarpTargetInfo(player,true).warpLoc;
        if (warpLoc) {
            system.runTimeout(()=>{
                warp(player,warpLoc);
                if (projectile.isValid) projectile.remove();
            },7);
        }
    }
}


/**
 * ワープ先を取得
 * @param {Player} player 
 * @param {boolean} isRifle 銃かどうか
 */
function getWarpTargetInfo(player,isRifle=false){
    let particleLoc;
    let warpLoc;
    let isBlock = false;

    const entityRayHit = player.getEntitiesFromViewDirection({maxDistance:64})[0];
    if (!isRifle && entityRayHit) {
        // エンティティの場合
        // 距離取得してテレポートとパーティクル
        particleLoc = caret(player.getHeadLocation(),player.getRotation(),[0,0,entityRayHit.distance]);
        warpLoc = particleLoc;
    } else {
        const blockRayHit = player.getBlockFromViewDirection({maxDistance:128});
        if (blockRayHit) {
            isBlock = true;
            // ブロックの場合
            // ブロックに触れるようにテレポート
            // ブロックを覆うようにパーティクル
            const dim = player.dimension;
            const block = blockRayHit.block;

            particleLoc = block.center();

            // ブロックの上に空間があるならブロックの上に、それ以外は設置面
            if (dim.getBlock(shiftLocation(block.location,0,1,0))?.isAir && dim.getBlock(shiftLocation(block.location,0,2,0))?.isAir) {
                warpLoc = shiftLocation(block.center(),0,0.6,0);
            } else {
                warpLoc = getHitLoc(blockRayHit);
            }
        } else {
            // それ以外
            // 銃なら32、ワープなら64にテレポートとパーティクル
            warpLoc = caret(player.getHeadLocation(),player.getRotation(),[0,0,64]);
            particleLoc = warpLoc;
        }
    }

    return {particleLoc,warpLoc,isBlock};
}
/**
 * ワープそのもの
 * @param {Entity|Entity[]} entities 
 * @param {import("@minecraft/server").Vector3} warpLoc 
 */
function warp(entities,warpLoc){
    const entityList = Array.isArray(entities)
        ? entities
        : [entities];

    for (const entity of entityList) {
        entity.teleport(warpLoc,{rotation:entity.getRotation()});
    }

    const user = entityList[0];
    if (user) {
        const dim = user.dimension;
        system.runTimeout(()=>{
            dim.spawnParticle("op_asa:warp_complete_particle",warpLoc);
            dim.playSound("mob.shulker.teleport",user.location);
        },1); // テレポート先が離れていると音が聞こえないから遅延
    }
}

/**
 * カード
 * @param {Entity} entity 
 */
export function strawmans_card(entity){
    // 効果削除
    for(const effect of ALL_EFFECT_IDS){
        entity.removeEffect(effect);
    }
    // プレイヤーかどうか
    const isPlayerEntity = isPlayer(entity);
    // 0 ~ 7
    const random = Math.floor(Math.random() * 8);
    
    if(random == 0){
        if(isPlayerEntity){
            entity.addEffect("strength",1200,{amplifier:1,showParticles:true});
            entity.addEffect("haste",1200,{amplifier:1,showParticles:true});
        }else{
            entity.addEffect("strength",1200,{amplifier:1,showParticles:true});
            entity.addEffect("speed",1200,{amplifier:1,showParticles:true});
        }
    }
    else if(random == 1){
        if(isPlayerEntity){
            entity.addEffect("speed",1200,{amplifier:2,showParticles:true});
            entity.addEffect("jump_boost",1200,{amplifier:3,showParticles:true});
        }else{
            entity.addEffect("resistance",1200,{amplifier:1,showParticles:true});
        }
    }
    else if(random == 2){
        if(isPlayerEntity){
            entity.addEffect("strength",1200,{amplifier:3,showParticles:true});
            entity.addEffect("haste",1200,{amplifier:3,showParticles:true});
        }else{
            entity.addEffect("strength",1200,{amplifier:3,showParticles:true});
            entity.addEffect("speed",1200,{amplifier:3,showParticles:true});
        }
    }
    else if(random == 3){
        if(isPlayerEntity){
            entity.addLevels(20);
        }else{
            entity.addEffect("resistance",1200,{amplifier:4,showParticles:true});
        }
    }
    else if(random == 4){
        if(isPlayerEntity){
            entity.addEffect("bad_omen",1200,{amplifier:0,showParticles:true});
        }else{
            entity.addEffect("wither",1200,{amplifier:0,showParticles:true});
        }
    }
    else if(random == 5){
        if(isPlayerEntity){
            entity.addEffect("weakness",1200,{amplifier:1,showParticles:true});
            entity.addEffect("nausea",1200,{amplifier:0,showParticles:true});
        }else{
            entity.addEffect("weakness",1200,{amplifier:1,showParticles:true});
        }
    }
    else if(random == 6){
        if(isPlayerEntity){
            entity.addEffect("mining_fatigue",1200,{amplifier:3,showParticles:true});
            entity.addEffect("slowness",1200,{amplifier:3,showParticles:true});
            entity.addEffect("wither",1200,{amplifier:0,showParticles:true});
        }else{
            entity.addEffect("slowness",1200,{amplifier:3,showParticles:true});
        }
    }
    else if(random == 7){
        entity.kill();
    }

    entity.dimension.spawnEntity("op_asa:strawmans_card_e",entity.getHeadLocation());
}

import { BlockPermutation, Entity, MolangVariableMap, Player, system } from "@minecraft/server";

/**
 * cooldown
 * 1: gura_shake, yamiyami - 一般技

/**
 * 闇水
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function kurouzu(player){
    const exeLoc = caret(player.getHeadLocation(),player.getRotation(),[0,0,2]);
    
    const targetPlayers = player.dimension.getPlayers({tags:["devil"],excludeTags:["yamiyami"],maxDistance:64,location:exeLoc});
    const targetMobs = player.dimension.getEntities({families:["devil"],excludeFamilies:["yamiyami"],maxDistance:64,location:exeLoc});
    const targets = targetPlayers.concat(targetMobs);
    
    // ターゲットを引き寄せる
    for(const target of targets){
    
        const targetLoc = target.location;
    
        const distanceXZ = Math.sqrt(Math.pow((targetLoc.x - exeLoc.x),2) + Math.pow((targetLoc.z - exeLoc.z),2));
        const distanceXYZ = Math.sqrt(Math.pow((targetLoc.x - exeLoc.x),2) + Math.pow((targetLoc.y - exeLoc.y),2) + Math.pow((targetLoc.z - exeLoc.z),2));
        const directionY = 1 * (targetLoc.y - exeLoc.y)/distanceXYZ;
    
        const horizontalStrength = Math.min(3,distanceXZ);
        const verticalStrength = Math.abs(targetLoc.y - exeLoc.y) < 2 ? 0 : -directionY;

        applyVarious({
            target,
            damaging:player,
            knockback:{type:"sphere",horizontalStrength:-horizontalStrength,verticalStrength,knockbackLocation:exeLoc}
        });

    }
    
    // 2ブロック先から半径2ブロック以内の能力者を闇水状態にする
    const volumeLoc = {
        x:exeLoc.x - 1,
        y:exeLoc.y - 1,
        z:exeLoc.z- 1,
    }
    const kurouzuTargetPlayers = player.dimension.getPlayers({tags:["devil"],excludeTags:["yamiyami"],volume:{x:2,y:2,z:2},location:volumeLoc});
    for(const kurouzuTargetPlayer of kurouzuTargetPlayers){
        clearAllSkill(kurouzuTargetPlayer);
        // player.sendMessage("闇水に触れた" + kurouzuTargetPlayer.nameTag);
    }
    const kurouzuTargetMobs = player.dimension.getEntities({families:["devil"],excludeFamilies:["yamiyami"],volume:{x:2,y:2,z:2},location:volumeLoc});
    for(const kurouzuTargetMob of kurouzuTargetMobs){
        if(kurouzuTargetMob.getProperty("op_asa:kurouzu")==false){
            kurouzuTargetMob.triggerEvent("op_asa:kurouzu");
            // player.sendMessage("闇水に触れた" + kurouzuTargetMob.typeId);
        }
    }
}

/**
 * 闇穴道
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function blackhole(player){
    const loc = player.location;

    // スコア取得
    const spcharge = getScoreUtility(player,"spcharge");

    // 0の時は召喚
    if(spcharge==0){
        // すでに存在してる場合は削除
        getTamedEntity(player,loc,32,"op_asa:blackhole_e")?.triggerEvent("op_asa:despawn");
        // 生成
        const entity = player.dimension.spawnEntity("op_asa:blackhole_e",shiftLocation(loc,0,0.6,0));
        entity.getComponent("tameable").tame(player);
        entity.setProperty("op_asa:is_player_summoned",true);
    }
    // それ以外はプロパティを更新
    else{
        getTamedEntity(player,loc,32,"op_asa:blackhole_e")?.setProperty("op_asa:charge",spcharge);
    }

    // スコア追加
    if(spcharge<20) {
        operationScoreUtility(player,"spcharge",1);
    }
}
/**
 * 闇穴道エンティティ
 * @param {Entity} entity 
 */
export function blackhole_e(entity){

    // プレイヤーに発動されていてオーナーが不在なら消して終了
    if(entity.getProperty("op_asa:is_player_summoned")==true){
        // オーナー
        const player = entity?.getComponent("tameable").tamedToPlayer;
        if(player==undefined){
            entity?.remove();
            return;
        }
    }

    // チャージ 0~20
    const charge = entity.getProperty("op_asa:charge");

    // 中心からの距離 0~30
    const dist = charge*1.5;

    // 中心の座標
    const loc = entity.location;

    // パーティクル生成
    const molang = new MolangVariableMap();
    molang.setFloat("variable.charge",dist);
    entity.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:blackhole_particle",loc,molang);
    entity.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:blackhole_particle",shiftLocation(loc,0,-0.3,0),molang);
    entity.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:blackhole_particle2",loc,molang);
    
    // 火消し
    if(system.currentTick%10===0){
        const fillDist = Math.floor(Math.sqrt(2) * dist);
        fillCommand(entity,entity.location,[-fillDist,-1,-fillDist],[fillDist,1,fillDist],BlockPermutation.resolve("air"),["fire","lava","flowing_lava"]);
    }

    // 効果付与
    for(const target of getEntitiesDistance(entity,loc,32)){
        const test = inBlackhole(target,entity);
        if(test.effect){
            target.addEffect("slowness",20,{amplifier:5});
            target.addEffect("mining_fatigue",20,{amplifier:5});
        }
        if(test.knockback){
            applySelfKnockback(target,0,-5);
        }
        if(test.all){
            target.removeEffect("poison");
            target.removeEffect("fatal_poison");
            target.removeEffect("wither");
            target.extinguishFire(true);
        }
    }
}
/**
 * 開放
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function revelation(player){

    // プレイヤー座標
    const loc = player.location;

    // 
    const teleportLoc = caretZ(loc,player.getRotation(),[0,0,-0.2]);

    // ブラックホールエンティティ
    const blackholeEntity = getTamedEntity(player,loc,32,"op_asa:blackhole_e");
    
    // ブラックホール内じゃないなら発動不可
    if(blackholeEntity==undefined || inBlackhole(player,blackholeEntity).all==false){
        player.sendMessage({translate:"rawtext.notification.revelation"})
        return;
    }

    // ブラックホール座標
    const blackholeLoc = blackholeEntity.location;

    // パーティクル
    player.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:blackhole_revelation_particle",teleportLoc);
    
    // 効果対象
    const targets = getEntitiesDistance(player,blackholeLoc,32);
    const inEffectTargets = targets.filter(entity => {
        const result = inBlackhole(entity, blackholeEntity);
            return result?.effect;
        }
    );
    
    // ブラックホール削除
    blackholeEntity.remove();

    // テレポート
    for(const target of inEffectTargets){
        target.addEffect("invisibility",6,{amplifier:0,showParticles:false});
        target.removeEffect("slowness");
        target.teleport(shiftLocation(teleportLoc,0,5,0));
    }

    // ダメージ付与
    system.runTimeout(()=>{
        for(const target of inEffectTargets){
            target.applyDamage(200,{cause:"piston",damagingEntity:player});
        }
    },2);
}
/**
 * エンティティがブラックホールの中にいるかどうか
 * @param {Entity} entity 
 * @param {Entity} blackholeEntity 
 * @returns {{ effect: boolean, knockback: boolean, all: boolean } | null}
 */
function inBlackhole(entity, blackholeEntity) {
    if (!blackholeEntity) return null;

    const pos = entity.location;
    const center = blackholeEntity.location;
    
    // チャージ取得 0~20
    const charge = blackholeEntity.getProperty("op_asa:charge") ?? 0;

    // 中心からの水平距離（XZ）
    const dx = pos.x - center.x;
    const dz = pos.z - center.z;
    const distanceXZ = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz);
    const dist = Math.max(1,charge * 1.5); // 半径

    // ---------- 高さの範囲 ----------
    // エフェクト範囲
    const effectMinY = center.y - 2;
    const effectMaxY = center.y;

    // ノックバック範囲
    const knockbackMinY = center.y - 1;
    const knockbackMaxY = center.y + 5;

    return {
        effect: entity.matches({excludeFamilies:["yamiyami"],excludeTags:["yamiyami"]}) && !isPlayerInCreative(entity) && (distanceXZ <= dist) &&
                (pos.y >= effectMinY && pos.y <= effectMaxY),

        knockback: entity.matches({excludeFamilies:["yamiyami"],excludeTags:["yamiyami"]}) && !isPlayerInCreative(entity) && (distanceXZ <= dist) &&
                   (pos.y >= knockbackMinY && pos.y <= knockbackMaxY),
        all: (distanceXZ <= dist) &&
                (pos.y >= effectMinY && pos.y <= effectMaxY)
    };
}
/**
 * エンティティが指定したボリューム内にあるかどうかを判定する
 * @param {Entity} entity - 判定対象のエンティティ
 * @param {Vector3} min - ボリュームの最小座標（x,y,z）
 * @param {Vector3} max - ボリュームの最大座標（x,y,z）
 * @returns {boolean}
 */
function isEntityInVolume(entity, min, max) {
    const pos = entity.location;

    return (
        pos.x >= Math.min(min.x, max.x) &&
        pos.x <= Math.max(min.x, max.x) &&
        pos.y >= Math.min(min.y, max.y) &&
        pos.y <= Math.max(min.y, max.y) &&
        pos.z >= Math.min(min.z, max.z) &&
        pos.z <= Math.max(min.z, max.z)
    );
}

export function soulking(player){

    player.dimension.playSound("soulking.sound",exeLoc,{volume:0.75});
    const targets = getEntitiesDistance(player,exeLoc,32,true);

    system.runTimeout(()=>{

/**
 * 
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function astral_projection(player){
    // 変身済みなら終了
    if(player.getProperty("op_asa:akumanomi_type")==2) return;
    // 変身
    player.triggerEvent("yomi_astral_projection");
    // id
    const playerId = player.id;
    // 名前
    const playerName = player.nameTag;
    // 体召喚
    const yomiPlayer = player.dimension.spawnEntity("op_asa:yomi_player",player.location);
    yomiPlayer.nameTag = playerName;
    yomiPlayer.addTag(`id${playerId}`);

    player.startItemCooldown("akumanomi2",40);
}

import { Block, BlockPermutation, BlockVolume, Dimension, Entity, MolangVariableMap, Player, system, world } from "@minecraft/server";
import { caret, caretZ, fillCommand, isPlayer, shiftLocation } from "../function";
import { getEntitiesInRange, getEntitiesDistance, baseEntityQuery, spawnEntityEx, spawnTamedEntity, getEntitiesInFront } from "../function/entityFunction";
import { applySelfKnockback, applyVarious } from "../function/combatFunction";
import { getAkumaExp, getAkumaExpLevel } from "../status_akumanomi";



/**@type {import("@minecraft/server").EntityQueryOptions} */
const excludeZushi = {excludeFamilies:["zushizushi"],excludeTags:["zushizushi"]};

/**
 * 
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function gurabito(player){

    const loc = player.location;
    const rot = player.getRotation();
    const center = caretZ(loc,rot,[0,0,8]);

    const akumaLevel = getAkumaExpLevel(getAkumaExp(player,6));
    const damageAmount = 8 + 8*akumaLevel;

    const rotY = rot.y * Math.PI / 180;
    const molang = new MolangVariableMap();
    molang.setFloat("direction_x",-Math.sin(rotY));
    molang.setFloat("direction_z",Math.cos(rotY));
    player.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:zushi_horizon_particle",loc,molang);
    player.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:zushi_horizon_particle2",loc,molang);

    // ダメージとノックバック
    function exe(){
        for(const target of getEntitiesInRange(player,shiftLocation(center,-8,-8,-8),{x:15,y:15,z:15})){
            if(target.matches(excludeZushi)){
                applyVarious({
                    target,
                    damaging:player,
                    damage:{amount:damageAmount,cause:"piston"},
                    effect:[
                        {typeId:"slowness",duration:200,amplifier:1},
                        {typeId:"mining_fatigue",duration:200,amplifier:4}
                    ],
                    knockback:{type:"front",horizontalStrength:4,verticalStrength:0.3}
                });
            }
        }
    }

    // 連続発動
    for (let num=0; num<20; num++) {
        system.runTimeout(()=>{
            exe();
        },num);
    }
}

export function fujitora_gurabito(entity){

/**
 * 隕石
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function meteo(player){
    let target;
    
    const entityHits = player.getEntitiesFromViewDirection({...baseEntityQuery,maxDistance:32});
    if(entityHits.length > 0){
        target = entityHits[0].entity;
    }else{
        const blockRaycastHit = player.getBlockFromViewDirection({maxDistance:32});
        if(blockRaycastHit){
            target = blockRaycastHit.block;
        }else{
            player.sendMessage({translate:"rawtext.notification.outOfRange"});
            player.startItemCooldown("akumanomi2",0);
            return;
        }
    }

    const exeLoc = target.location;
    const dim = target.dimension;

    dim.spawnParticle("op_asa:meteo_particle",exeLoc);

    spawnMeteo(dim,shiftLocation(exeLoc,0,200,0),player,true);

    for(const target of getEntitiesDistance(player,exeLoc,16,true)){
        if(target.matches(excludeZushi)){
            target.addEffect("slowness",200,{amplifier:4,showParticles:true});
            target.applyImpulse({x:0,y:-10,z:0});
        }
    }
}
/**
 * 隕石群発動
 * @param {Entity} entity 
 */
export function meteor_shower(entity){
    
    // ===== 落下位置決定 =====

    const isPlayerEntity = isPlayer(entity);
    const maxDistance = isPlayerEntity ? 32 : 64;
    let location;

    const entityHits = entity.getEntitiesFromViewDirection({...baseEntityQuery,maxDistance});
    if(entityHits.length > 0){
        location = entityHits[0].entity.location;
    }else{
        const blockRaycastHit = entity.getBlockFromViewDirection({maxDistance});
        if(blockRaycastHit){
            location = blockRaycastHit.block.center();
        }else{
            if(isPlayerEntity){
                entity.sendMessage({translate:"rawtext.notification.outOfRange"});
                entity.startItemCooldown("akumanomi2",0);
            }
            return;
        }
    }

    // ===== 隕石落下 =====

    const dimension = entity.dimension;

    dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:meteor_shower_particle",location);

    spawnMeteo(dimension,shiftLocation(location,0,100,0),entity,false);
    spawnMeteo(dimension,shiftLocation(location,0,125,0),entity,false);
    spawnMeteo(dimension,shiftLocation(location,0,150,0),entity,false);

    for(const targetEntity of getEntitiesInRange(entity,shiftLocation(location,-5,-2,-5),{x:9,y:52,z:9},true)){
        if(targetEntity.matches(excludeZushi)){
            targetEntity.addEffect("slowness",60,{amplifier:4,showParticles:true});
            targetEntity.applyImpulse({x:0,y:-10,z:0});
        }
    }
}
/**
 * 隕石召喚

    const entityId = isLarge ? "op_asa:meteo_e" : "op_asa:meteor_shower_e";
    const meteo = dimension.spawnEntity(entityId,location);
    meteo.getComponent("projectile").owner = owner;
    meteo.setOnFire(1000,true);
}

/**
 * 重力エリア
 * @param {Entity} entity
 */
export function zushi_area_e(entity){

    if (!entity?.isValid) return;

    const type = entity.getProperty("op_asa:type");

    // 強める
    if (type == 0) {
        const owner = entity.getComponent("tameable").tamedToPlayer;
        if (!owner) return;

        for (const target of getEntitiesDistance(entity,entity.location,6)) {
            if(target.matches(excludeZushi)){
                target.addEffect("slowness",20,{amplifier:1,showParticles:true});
                target.addEffect("mining_fatigue",20,{amplifier:4,showParticles:true});
                applySelfKnockback(target,0,-5);
                applyVarious({
                    target,
                    damaging:owner,
                    damage:{amount:2,cause:"piston"}
                });
            }
        }
    }
    // 弱める
    else {
        const loc = entity.location;
        const dim = entity.dimension;
        // 能力者には速度上昇と跳躍、それ以外には浮遊
        for (const target of getEntitiesDistance(entity,loc,6)) {
            if(target.matches(excludeZushi)){
                target.addEffect("levitation",200,{amplifier:2,showParticles:false});
            } else {
                target.addEffect("speed",1200,{amplifier:3,showParticles:false});
                target.addEffect("jump_boost",1200,{amplifier:3,showParticles:false});
            }
        }
        // ブロックをエンティティにする
        for (const block of getBlocks(dim,shiftLocation(loc,-2,-1,-2),shiftLocation(loc,2,3,2))) {
            if (block?.typeId == "minecraft:grass_block") {
                block.setType("air");
                dim.spawnEntity("op_asa:zushi_grass",shiftLocation(block.location,0,1,0));
            }
            else if (block?.typeId == "minecraft:dirt") {
                block.setType("air");
                dim.spawnEntity("op_asa:zushi_dirt",shiftLocation(block.location,0,1,0));
            }
            else if (block?.typeId == "minecraft:stone") {
                block.setType("air");
                dim.spawnEntity("op_asa:zushi_stone",shiftLocation(block.location,0,1,0));
            }
        }
        
    }
}
/**
 * @param {Dimension} dimension
 * @param {import("@minecraft/server").Vector3} start
 * @param {import("@minecraft/server").Vector3} end
 * @returns {Block[]}
 */
function getBlocks(dimension, start, end) {
    const blocks = [];

    const minX = Math.min(start.x, end.x);
    const maxX = Math.max(start.x, end.x);
    const minY = Math.min(start.y, end.y);
    const maxY = Math.max(start.y, end.y);
    const minZ = Math.min(start.z, end.z);
    const maxZ = Math.max(start.z, end.z);

    for (let x = minX; x <= maxX; x++) {
        for (let y = minY; y <= maxY; y++) {
            for (let z = minZ; z <= maxZ; z++) {
                const block = dimension.getBlock({ x, y, z });
                if (block) {
                    blocks.push(block);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    return blocks;
}

        .button({rawtext:[{translate:`${akuma35!=0 ? "akumanomi.goru" : "?"}`},{text:amountText(akuma35)}]}, "textures/items/akumanomi/akumanomi_gorugoru")
        .button({rawtext:[{translate:`${akuma36!=0 ? "akumanomi.numa" : "?"}`},{text:amountText(akuma36)}]}, "textures/items/akumanomi/akumanomi_numanuma")
        .button({rawtext:[{translate:`${akuma37!=0 ? "akumanomi.bomu" : "?"}`},{text:amountText(akuma37)}]}, "textures/items/akumanomi/akumanomi_bomubomu")
        .button({rawtext:[{translate:`${akuma38!=0 ? "akumanomi.kiro" : "?"}`},{text:amountText(akuma38)}]}, "textures/items/akumanomi/akumanomi_kirokiro")
        .button({rawtext:[{translate:`${akuma39!=0 ? "akumanomi.riki" : "?"}`},{text:amountText(akuma39)}]}, "textures/items/akumanomi/akumanomi_rikiriki")
        .button({rawtext:[{translate:`${akuma40!=0 ? "akumanomi.wapu" : "?"}`},{text:amountText(akuma40)}]}, "textures/items/akumanomi/akumanomi_wapuwapu")
        .show(player).then(res => {
            if(!res.canceled){
                // 選んだボタン番号のデータが0以下ならメッセージ
                if(zukanDataParce[res.selection]<=0){
                    player.sendMessage({translate:"rawtext.akumanomizukan_custom.error.1"});
                }
                // 0じゃない
                else{
                    // インベントリ内からnametagとdpropが一致する図鑑を探し出してそれのdpropを更新して、実を一つ与える
                    const inventoryComp = player.getComponent("minecraft:inventory");
                    let bool = false;// 実行したかどうか
                    for(let slotNumber=0; slotNumber<=35 && bool==false; slotNumber++ ){
                        const itemStack1 = inventoryComp.container.getItem(slotNumber);
                        if(itemStack1!=undefined){
                            if(itemStack1.getDynamicProperty("zukan_data") == itemStack.getDynamicProperty("zukan_data") && itemStack1.nameTag == itemStack.nameTag){
                                bool = true;
                                
                                zukanDataParce[res.selection] = zukanDataParce[res.selection] - 1;
                                itemStack.setDynamicProperty("zukan_data",JSON.stringify(zukanDataParce));
                                inventoryComp.container.setItem(slotNumber,itemStack);
                                
                                // 実を一つ与える
                                giveCommand(player,`op_asa:akumanomi_${getAkumanomiData({num:res.selection+1}).itemId}`,1,false,"none");
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    if(bool == false){
                        player.sendMessage({translate:"rawtext.akumanomizukan_custom.error.2"});
                    }
                }
            }
        });
    }
    // しゃがんでいない場合、ブロックにエンティティ召喚
    else{      
        const blockRay = player.getBlockFromViewDirection({maxDistance:64});

        const block = blockRay?.block;
        if (!block) return;

        const pos = block.location;

        // 当たった面名（"up" | "down" | "north" | "south" | "east" | "west"）
        const face = blockRay.face;

        // プレイヤーのヨー角
        const yaw = player.getRotation().y * (Math.PI / 180);

        // Bedrock 用の右方向ベクトル
        const rightX = Math.sin(yaw);
        const rightZ = -Math.cos(yaw);

        let spawnPos;

        // --- 上面 or 下面の場合 ---
        if (face === "Up") {
            // 真上
            spawnPos = {
                x: pos.x,
                y: pos.y + 1,
                z: pos.z
            };
        }
        else if (face === "Down") {
            // 真下
            spawnPos = {
                x: pos.x,
                y: pos.y - 1,
                z: pos.z
            };
        }
        // --- 側面の場合（右側にずらす） ---
        else {
            spawnPos = {
                x: pos.x + Math.round(rightX),
                y: pos.y,
                z: pos.z + Math.round(rightZ),
            };
        }

        // 最後に中央に補正
        const finalPos = shiftLocation(spawnPos, 0.5, 0, 0.5);

        const zukanEntity = block.dimension.spawnEntity("op_asa:akumanomizukan_custom", finalPos);

        zukanEntity.getComponent("inventory").container.setItem(0,itemStack);

        decrementStack(player,1);
    }
}

]

                else{
                    zukanDataParce[res.selection] = zukanDataParce[res.selection] - 1;
                    itemStack.setDynamicProperty("zukan_data",JSON.stringify(zukanDataParce));
                    inventoryComp.container.setItem(0,itemStack);
                    
                    giveCommand(player,`op_asa:akumanomi_${getAkumanomiData({num:res.selection+1}).itemId}`,1,false,"none");
    
                }
            }
        });
    }

        // プレイヤーの持っている実

        // プレイヤーの持っている実のデータを追加

        inventoryComp.container.setItem(0,itemStack);
    
        // プレイヤーから実を取る
        decrementStack(player,1);
    }
}

import { Block, BlockPermutation, Dimension, Entity, ItemStack, Player, system, world } from "@minecraft/server";
import { replaceAir, decrementStack, fillCommand, shiftLocation } from "./function";
import { getEntitiesDistance } from "./function/entityFunction";

/**
 * スポーンブロック(設置した時にエンティティを召喚)
 * @param {Block} block 
 */
export function spawn_block(block){
    const name = block.typeId.split("_spawn_block")[0];
    block.dimension.spawnEntity(name,block.location);

    replaceAir(block);
}
/**
 * 四皇海賊旗(インタラクトして四皇召喚イベント)
 * @param {Block} block 
 */
export function pirate_flag(block){
    // 直下の固体ブロックに召喚、最大距離32、ブロックが無い場合は空中に召喚

    // 直下の固体ブロック(最大距離32)
    const targetBlockRaycastHit = block.dimension.getBlockFromRay(block.location,{x:0,y:-100,z:0},{includeLiquidBlocks:false,includePassableBlocks:false,maxDistance:32});

    // type
    const name = block.typeId.split("pirate_flag_")[1];

    // ブロックがある
    if(targetBlockRaycastHit != undefined){
        const targetBlock = targetBlockRaycastHit.block;
        targetBlock.dimension.spawnEntity(
            "op_asa:yonko_summoned",
            {
                x:targetBlock.location.x + 0.5,
                y:targetBlock.y,
                z:targetBlock.location.z + 0.5
            }
        ).setProperty("op_asa:type",name);
    }
    // ブロックがない
    else{
        block.dimension.spawnEntity(
            "op_asa:yonko_summoned",
            {
                x:block.location.x + 0.5,
                y:block.y - 32,
                z:block.location.z + 0.5
            }
        ).setProperty("op_asa:type",name);
    }

    fillCommand(block.dimension.getPlayers()[0],block.location,[-8,-23,0],[8,6,0],BlockPermutation.resolve("air"),["oak_fence"],true);
    fillCommand(block.dimension.getPlayers()[0],block.location,[-7,-6,0],[7,6,0],BlockPermutation.resolve("air"),[`op_asa:pirate_flag_${name}`],true);
}
/**
 * ルートブロック(インタラクトして戦利品ドロップ)
 * @param {Block} block 
 */
export function loot_block(block){
    const blockId = block.typeId;
    const dim = block.dimension;
    const loc = block.location;

    let type = "";
    if(blockId == "op_asa:mugiwarabou_block"){
        type = "mugiwarabou"
    }
    else if(blockId == "op_asa:roger_loot_block"){
        type = "roger"
        dim.playSound("akumanomi_block.sound",loc,{volume:0.5});
    }
    else if(blockId == "op_asa:newgate_loot_block"){
        type = "newgate"
        dim.playSound("akumanomi_block.sound",loc,{volume:0.5});
    }
    else if(true){
        type = block.permutation.getState("op_asa:type");
        dim.playSound("akumanomi_block.sound",loc,{volume:0.5});
    }

    const x = loc.x;
    const y = loc.y;
    const z = loc.z;
    dim.runCommand(`execute positioned ${x} ${y} ${z} run loot spawn ~~~ loot "blocks/loot_block/${type}"`);
    
    replaceAir(block);
}
/**
 * 宝箱(インタラクトしてイベント)
 * @param {Player} player 
 * @param {Block} block 
 */
export function akumanomi_block_on_interact(player,block){

    const itemStack = player.getComponent("equippable").getEquipment("Mainhand");

    // 鍵以外でインタラクト
    if(itemStack == undefined || itemStack.typeId != "op_asa:key_akumanomi") return;

    const dim = block.dimension;
    const loc = block.location;
    const rank = block.permutation.getState("op_asa:rank");

    if(rank == "bronze"){
        // 銅は鍵で開けれない
        player.sendMessage({rawtext:[{translate:"rawtext.notification.brokenKeyhole"}]});
    } else {
        // 銀/金は実ドロップ
        decrementStack(player,1);
        dim.playSound("akumanomi_block.sound",loc,{volume:0.5});
        spawnLootAkumanomiBlock(dim,loc,rank);
        replaceAir(block);
    }
}
/**
 * 宝箱(破壊してイベント)
 * @param {Block} block 破壊後のブロック
 * @param {BlockPermutation} blockPermutation 破壊されたブロック
 */
export function akumanomi_block_on_destroy(block,blockPermutation){
    const dim = block.dimension;
    const loc = block.location;
    const rank = blockPermutation.getState("op_asa:rank");
    const type = blockPermutation.getState("op_asa:type");
    const isPirates = type === "pirate" || (type !== "marine" && Math.random() < 0.5);

    function summonPirates(){// 海賊6体
        for (let count=0; count<6; count++) {
            dim.spawnEntity("op_asa:kaizoku",loc).triggerEvent("op_asa:akumanomi_block_summoned");
        }
    }
    function summonMarines(){// 海兵6体
        for (let count=0; count<6; count++) {
            dim.spawnEntity("op_asa:kaigun",loc).triggerEvent("op_asa:akumanomi_block_summoned");
        }
    }
    
    // 25%で悪魔の実
    if(Math.random() < 0.25){
        spawnLootAkumanomiBlock(dim,loc,rank);
    } else{
        if (isPirates) {
            if (rank === "bronze") {
                summonPirates();
                dim.spawnEntity("op_asa:kaizoku2",loc);
            } else {
                summonPirates();
                dim.spawnEntity("op_asa:kaizoku5",loc);
            }
        } else {
            if (rank === "bronze") {  
                summonMarines();
            } else {
                summonMarines();
                dim.spawnEntity("op_asa:kaigun2",loc).triggerEvent("op_asa:akumanomi_block_summoned");
            }
        }
    }
}
/**
 * 宝箱からの実ドロップ
 * @param {Dimension} dim 
 * @param {import("@minecraft/server").Vector3} loc 
 * @param {"bronze"|"silver"|"gold"} rank 
 */
function spawnLootAkumanomiBlock(dim,loc,rank) {
    const itemId = rank === "gold" ? getRandomLootId(3,[1,2,3]) : rank === "silver" ? getRandomLootId(3,[1,2]) : getRandomLootId(3,1);
    const item = new ItemStack(`op_asa:${itemId}`,1);
    dim.spawnItem(item,loc);
}
/**
 * バリアボール
 * @param {Block} block 
 */
export function barrier_ball_block_on_tick(block){
    // 48以内のtag=baribariのプレイヤーを取得
    const players = block.dimension.getPlayers({maxDistance:48,location:block.location,tags:["baribari"]});
    // 16以内のbarrier_ball_eを取得
    const barrierBallEntities = block.dimension.getEntities({maxDistance:16,location:block.location,type:"op_asa:barrier_ball_e"});
    // 取得できないなら空気変換
    if(players.length < 0 || barrierBallEntities.length < 0){
        replaceAir(block);
        return;
    }
    // 取得できた場合、そのプレイヤーすべてで右手の持ち物を検索、一人でも指定アイテム持っていればok
    let count = 0;
    for(const player of players){
        const itemStack = player.getComponent("equippable").getEquipment("Mainhand");
        if(itemStack == undefined){
            continue;
        }
        if(itemStack.typeId == "op_asa:barrier_ball"){
            count = 1;
        }
    }
    if(count==0){
        replaceAir(block);
    }
}
/**
 * バリアビリティ
 * @param {Block} block 
 */
export function barrierbility_block_on_tick(block){
    // 48以内のtag=baribariのプレイヤーを取得
    const players = block.dimension.getPlayers({maxDistance:48,location:block.location,tags:["baribari"]});
    // 取得できないなら空気変換
    if(players.length < 0){
        replaceAir(block);
        return;
    }
    // 取得できた場合、そのプレイヤーすべてで右手の持ち物を検索、一人でも指定アイテム持っていればok
    let count = 0;
    for(const player of players){
        const itemStack = player.getComponent("equippable").getEquipment("Mainhand");
        if(itemStack == undefined){
            continue;
        }
        if(itemStack.typeId == "op_asa:barrierbility"){
            count = 1;
        }
    }
    if(count==0){
        replaceAir(block);
    }
    // まわり１ブロックに同ブロックが一つも無いなら空気変換
    const block_1 = block.dimension.getBlockFromRay(block.location,{x:1,y:0,z:0},{includeTypes:["op_asa:barrierbility_block"]})?.block;
    const block_2 = block.dimension.getBlockFromRay(block.location,{x:-1,y:0,z:0},{includeTypes:["op_asa:barrierbility_block"]})?.block;
    const block_3 = block.dimension.getBlockFromRay(block.location,{x:0,y:1,z:0},{includeTypes:["op_asa:barrierbility_block"]})?.block;
    const block_4 = block.dimension.getBlockFromRay(block.location,{x:0,y:-1,z:0},{includeTypes:["op_asa:barrierbility_block"]})?.block;
    const block_5 = block.dimension.getBlockFromRay(block.location,{x:0,y:0,z:1},{includeTypes:["op_asa:barrierbility_block"]})?.block;
    const block_6 = block.dimension.getBlockFromRay(block.location,{x:0,y:0,z:-1},{includeTypes:["op_asa:barrierbility_block"]})?.block;
    if(block_1 == undefined && block_2 == undefined && block_3 == undefined && block_4 == undefined && block_5 == undefined && block_6 == undefined){
        replaceAir(block);
    }
}

        }
    }

/**
 * カイドウ部下スポナー
 * @param {Block} block 
 */
export function kaido_buka_spawner(block){
    const dimension = block.dimension;
    const blockLoc = block.location;
    let exeLocation = {
        x:blockLoc.x,
        y:blockLoc.y,
        z:blockLoc.z
    }

    const random =  Math.floor(Math.random()*4);

    if(random == 0){
        exeLocation.x = exeLocation.x + 1;
    }
    else if(random == 1){
        exeLocation.x = exeLocation.x - 1;
    }
    else if(random == 2){
        exeLocation.z = exeLocation.z + 1;
    }
    else if(random == 3){
        exeLocation.z = exeLocation.z - 1;
    }
    
    if(dimension.getBlock(exeLocation).isAir){
        const num = Math.random()*4 >= 3 ? "4" : "3"; 

        dimension.spawnParticle(`op_asa:kaido_buka_spawner_particle`,exeLocation);
        dimension.spawnEntity(`op_asa:kaizoku${num}`,exeLocation);
    }
}
/**
 * ルーシーブロック
 * @param {Block} block 
 */
export function luccy_block(block) {
    const dim = block.dimension;
    const { x, y, z } = block.location;
    const center = { x, y, z };

    // 爆発パーティクルを出す位置オフセット
    const offsets = [
        { x: 1, y: -0.5, z: 0 },
        { x: -1, y: -0.5, z: 0 },
        { x: 0, y: -0.5, z: 0 },
        { x: 0, y: -0.5, z: 1 },
        { x: 0, y: -0.5, z: -1 },
    ];

    // パーティクル発生
    for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        for (const off of offsets) {
            const pos = {
                x: center.x + off.x,
                y: center.y + off.y,
                z: center.z + off.z,
            };
            dim.spawnParticle("minecraft:huge_explosion_emitter", pos);
        }
    }

    // ノックバック
    for(const targetEntity of getEntitiesDistance(world.getPlayers()[0],center,6,false)){
        applyVarious({
            target:targetEntity,
            damaging:targetEntity,
            knockback:{type:"sphere",knockbackLocation:center,horizontalStrength:3,verticalStrength:0.25},
            ignoreCreative:false
        });
    }

    // ランダムでエンティティ召喚
    const num = Math.floor(Math.random() * 2 + 1);
    dim.spawnEntity(`op_asa:luccy${num}`, center);
}

/**
 * 衣類修繕キット
 * @param {Block} block 
 * @@param {Player} player 
 */
export function mending_kit(block,player){

	const itemStack = player.getComponent("equippable").getEquipment("Mainhand");
    if(itemStack == undefined) return;

	const durabilityComp = itemStack.getComponent("durability");
	if(durabilityComp == undefined) return;
	
	const blockId = block.typeId;
	if(!blockId.startsWith("op_asa:mending_kit_")) return;

	const itemId = itemStack.typeId;
	if(!itemId.includes("op_asa:")) return;

	const damage = durabilityComp.damage;
	if(damage!=0){
		// アイテムの耐久値回復
		if(damage <= 100){
			durabilityComp.damage = 0;
		}else{
			if(damage - 100 > durabilityComp.maxDurability){
				durabilityComp.damage = durabilityComp.maxDurability - 100;
			}else{
				durabilityComp.damage = damage - 100;
			}
			
		}
		player.getComponent("equippable").setEquipment("Mainhand",itemStack);

		// 0~2のランダムで0の場合のみブロックの耐久値減少
		const blockDamage = Math.floor(Math.random() * 3);
		if(blockDamage!=0){
			// 使用音
			block.dimension.playSound("random.anvil_use",block.location);
		}else{
			const blockDurabiloty = blockId.split("op_asa:mending_kit_")[1];
			if(blockDurabiloty == 0){
				block.setPermutation(BlockPermutation.resolve("op_asa:mending_kit_1"));
				block.dimension.playSound("random.anvil_use",block.location);
			}
			else if(blockDurabiloty == 1){
				block.setPermutation(BlockPermutation.resolve("op_asa:mending_kit_2"));
				block.dimension.playSound("random.anvil_use",block.location);
			}
			else if(blockDurabiloty == 2){
				replaceAir(block);
				block.dimension.playSound("random.anvil_break",block.location);
			}
		}
	}
}
/**
 * 商人ブロック
 * @param {Block} block 
 */
export function shop_block(block){
    const number = block.permutation.getState("op_asa:number");
    const type = block.permutation.getState("op_asa:type");

    // 通常
    if(type=="default"){
        // 商人１
        if(number==1){
            block.dimension.spawnEntity("op_asa:shop_clerk",shiftLocation(block.location,0,-1,1));
        }
        // 商人２
        else if(number==2){
            if(Math.random() > 0.9){
                block.dimension.spawnEntity("op_asa:shop_broker",shiftLocation(block.location,0,-1,1));
            }
            else{
                block.dimension.spawnEntity("op_asa:shop_clerk",shiftLocation(block.location,0,-1,1)).triggerEvent("trade.2.default");
            }
        }
    }
    // ワノ国
    else if(type=="wanokuni"){
        // 商人１
        if(number==1){
            block.dimension.spawnEntity("op_asa:shop_clerk",shiftLocation(block.location,0,-1,1)).triggerEvent("trade.1.wanokuni");
        }
        // 商人２
        else if(number==2){
            if(Math.random() > 0.9){
                block.dimension.spawnEntity("op_asa:shop_swordsmith",shiftLocation(block.location,0,-1,1));
            }
            else{
                block.dimension.spawnEntity("op_asa:shop_clerk",shiftLocation(block.location,0,-1,1)).triggerEvent("trade.2.wanokuni");
            }
        }
    }
    // 空島
    else if(type=="skypiea"){
        // 商人１
        if(number==1){
            block.dimension.spawnEntity("op_asa:shop_clerk",shiftLocation(block.location,0,-1,1)).triggerEvent("trade.1.skypiea");
        }
        // 商人２
        else if(number==2){
            block.dimension.spawnEntity("op_asa:shop_clerk",shiftLocation(block.location,0,-1,1)).triggerEvent("trade.2.skypiea");
        }
    }

    replaceAir(block);
}
/**
 * 緑星ブロック
 * @param {Block} block 
 */
export function midoriboshi1_block(block){
    const type = block.permutation.getState("op_asa:user");

    if(type == "player"){
        const damagingEntity = block.dimension.getPlayers({maxDistance:64,location:block.location})[0];
        const targets = block.dimension.getEntities({maxDistance:1,location:block.location,excludeFamilies:["waza"],excludeTypes:["item","xp_orb"]});
        for(const target of targets){
            if(target.getComponent("equippable")?.getEquipment("Mainhand")?.typeId != "op_asa:kurokabuto"){
                target.applyDamage(10,{cause:"entityAttack",damagingEntity:damagingEntity});
            }
        }
    }else{
        const damagingEntity = block.dimension.getEntities({maxDistance:64,location:block.location,type:"op_asa:usopp"})[0];
        const targets = block.dimension.getEntities({maxDistance:1,location:block.location,excludeFamilies:["waza"],excludeTypes:["item","xp_orb","op_asa:usopp"]});
        for(const target of targets){
            target.applyDamage(10,{cause:"entityAttack",damagingEntity:damagingEntity});
        }
    }
}

/**
 * 
 * @param {CustomCommandRegistry} ccReg 
 */
export function customCommand(ccReg){
	ccReg.registerCommand(openStatusMenuCommand,openStatusMenu);
	// ccReg.registerCommand(haoshokuCommand,activateHaoshoku);
}



/**
 * ステータスメニュー
 *  コマンド設定
 * @type {import("@minecraft/server").CustomCommand}
 */
const openStatusMenuCommand = {
	cheatsRequired:false,
	description:"Open Status Menu",
	mandatoryParameters:[],
	name:"asa:status",
	optionalParameters:[],
	permissionLevel:0 // 誰でも
}
/**
 * ステータスメニュー
 *  実行内容
 * @param {CustomCommandOrigin} origin 
 * @returns {import("@minecraft/server").CustomCommandResult}
 */
function openStatusMenu(origin) {

	// 1tick遅らせる コマンド画面から開けないっぽい
	system.runTimeout(()=>{
		operationStatus(origin.sourceEntity);
	},1);

	return {
		status: CustomCommandStatus.Success,
		message: undefined,
	}
}

import { BlockComponentRegistry } from "@minecraft/server";
import { replaceAir } from "../function";
import * as blockFunc from "../blocks";
import { training_site_on_interact } from "../training";


/**
 * 
 * @param {BlockComponentRegistry} blockCompReg 
 */
export function customCompBlock(blockCompReg){

	blockCompReg.registerCustomComponent("op_asa:spawn_block",{onPlace: arg => {blockFunc.spawn_block(arg.block);}});
