    decrementStack(player);
}
/**
 * コーラ
 * @param {ItemStack} itemStack 
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function cola(itemStack,player){
    const isSuper = itemStack.typeId.includes("super");
    const random = Math.random();
    if(isSuper){
        if(random < 0.25){
            heal(player,4);
        }
        else if(random < 0.65){
            heal(player,8);
        }
        else if(random < 0.85){
            heal(player,16);
        }
        else if(random < 0.95){
            heal(player,32);
        }
        else if(true){
            heal(player,64);
        }
    }else{
        if(random < 0.625){
            heal(player,4);
        }
        else if(random < 0.825){
            heal(player,8);
        }
        else if(random < 0.925){
            heal(player,16);
        }
        else if(random < 0.975){
            heal(player,32);
        }
        else if(true){
            heal(player,64);
        }
    }
}

/**
 * 悪魔の実
 * @param {ItemStack} itemStack 
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function akumanomi(itemStack,player){

    // 元々の能力に応じて実行

    const akuma = player.getProperty("op_asa:akumanomi");
    // ズシ
    if (akuma==6){
        // 重力ブロック変換
        const zushiBlocks = player.dimension.getEntities({families:["zushi_block"]});
        for(const zushiBlock of zushiBlocks){
            zushiBlock.triggerEvent("op_asa:to_block");
        }
    }
    // オペ
    else if (akuma==7){
        // シャンブルズ石を消す
        const roomProjectiles = player.dimension.getEntities({type:"op_asa:shambles2_p",maxDistance:128,location:player.location});
        for(const roomProjectile of roomProjectiles){
            world.sendMessage(`${roomProjectile.getComponent("projectile").owner.typeId}`)
            if(isProjectileOwner(player,roomProjectile)){
                roomProjectile.remove();
            }
        }
        // ROOMエンティティを消す
        const roomEntities = player.dimension.getEntities({families:["room"],maxDistance:128,location:player.location});
        for(const roomEntity of roomEntities){
            if(roomEntity.getComponent("tameable").tamedToPlayer==player){
                roomEntity.remove();
            }
        }
    }
    // イト
    else if (akuma==12){
        ito_end(player);
    }
    // ホビ
    else if (akuma==16){
        hobi_end(player);
    }
    // ワラ
    else if (akuma==18){
        // 身代わりエンティティ解除
        const sacrificeEntities = player.dimension.getEntities({tags:["sacrifice"]});
        for(const sacrificeEntity of sacrificeEntities){
            sacrificeEntity.removeTag("sacrifice");
        }
    }
    // ハナ
    else if (akuma==23){
        // 分身を消す
        player.dimension.getEntities({type:"op_asa:cuerpofleur_e"})[0]?.remove();
    }
    // バラ
    else if (akuma==28){
        // 足を消す
        getMyFeet(player)?.remove();
    }

    // 共通

    // 全tag取り除く
    for(const removeTag of akumanomiTags){
        player.removeTag(removeTag);
    }
    // 全技アイテムclear
    clearAllSkill(player);

    // 全能力クールダウン解除
    const cooldownEntries = COOLDOWN_CATEGORY_AKUMANOMI.map(category => ({
        category,
        tickDuration: 0
    }));
    startCooldownEntries(player,cooldownEntries);


    // 食べた実に応じて実行

    const type = itemStack.typeId.split("op_asa:akumanomi_")[1];
    // リセット
    if(type == "reset"){
        // リセットメッセージ
        player.sendMessage({rawtext:[{translate:"rawtext.akumanomi_reset"}]});
        // 悪魔の実カウントを0にする
        setScoreUtility(player,"akumanomi_eat_count",0);
        // 能力者tag取り除く
        player.removeTag("devil");
        // 全エフェクト取り除く
        for(const effect of player.getEffects()){
            player.removeEffect(effect.typeId);
        }
        // イベント実行
        player.triggerEvent("reset");
    }
    // それ以外
    else{
        updateAkumanomi(player,type);
    }
}

/**
 * 悪魔の実を更新
 * @param {Player} player 
 * @param {String} type 
 */
function updateAkumanomi(player,type){
    // 能力者tag付与
    player.addTag("devil");

    // 酔い付与
    player.addEffect("nausea",200,{amplifier:1,showParticles:false});

    // tag付与
    if(type == "yamigura"){
        player.addTag("yamiyami");
        player.addTag("guragura");
    }else{
        player.addTag(type);
    }

    // お気に入りをリセット
    player.setDynamicProperty("favorite_skills",undefined);

    // イベント実行
    player.triggerEvent("akumanomi");

    // スコア設定
    function setPowerScores(current=0,max=0) {
        setScoreUtility(player,"sppower_max",max);
        setScoreUtility(player,"sppower",current);
    }
    if(type=="opeope"){
        setPowerScores(100,100);
    }
    else if(type=="rakiraki"){
        setPowerScores(0,100);
    }
    else if(type=="sorusoru"){
        setPowerScores(100,100);
        setScoreUtility(player,SCOREBOARD.deadCount,0);
    }
    else if(type=="bomubomu"){
        setPowerScores(0,5);
    }
    else if(type=="warawara"){
        setPowerScores();
        setScoreUtility(player,SCOREBOARD.strawman,0);
    }
    else{
        setPowerScores();
    }

    // メッセージ表示
    if(type!="yomiyomi"){
        player.sendMessage(
            {
                rawtext:[
                    {text:type=="yamigura" ? "§5" : "§b"},
                    {translate:getAkumanomiData({itemId:type}).langId},
                    {text:type=="gomgom" ? "..§r" : "§r"}
                ]
            }
        );
    }

    // 2つ目の時死ぬ(クリエイティブ以外) -3tick遅延
    const deathSystem = world.getDynamicProperty("akumanomi_death") ?? true;
    if(world.getDifficulty()!="Creative" && deathSystem) {
        system.runTimeout(()=>{
            operationScoreUtility(player,"akumanomi_eat_count",1);
            if(getScoreUtility(player,"akumanomi_eat_count")>=2){
                player.kill();
                player.sendMessage({rawtext:[{translate:"rawtext.akumanomi_dead1"},{text:"\n"},{translate:"rawtext.akumanomi_dead2"}]});
                setScoreUtility(player,"akumanomi_eat_count",1);
            }
        },3);
    }

    // HP更新 -2tick遅延(1tickでいいけど念のため)
    system.runTimeout(()=>{
        updateHp(player);
    },2);
}
/**
 * ヒトヒトの実
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function akumanomi_hitohito(player){
    const entityRaycastHit = player.getEntitiesFromViewDirection({excludeTypes:["item","xp_orb"],excludeFamilies:["waza"],maxDistance:4})[0];
    if(entityRaycastHit == undefined) return;

    const target = entityRaycastHit.entity;
    if(target.typeId == "minecraft:cow"){
        new MessageFormData()
        .title("akumanomi.hito")
        .body({rawtext:[{translate:"rawtext.hitohito_cow"}]})
        .button1("gui.ok")
        .button2("gui.no")
        .show(player).then(res => {
            if(res.selection == 0){
                decrementStack(player,1);
                player.dimension.spawnEntity("op_asa:cow_hitohito",target.location).getComponent("tameable").tame(player);
                player.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:tamed_particle",{x:target.location.x,y:target.location.y+1,z:target.location.z});
                target.remove();
            }
        });
    }
    else if(target.typeId == "minecraft:chicken"){
        new MessageFormData()
        .title("akumanomi.hito")
        .body({rawtext:[{translate:"rawtext.hitohito_chicken"}]})
        .button1("gui.ok")
        .button2("gui.no")
        .show(player).then(res => {
            if(res.selection == 0){
                decrementStack(player,1);
                player.dimension.spawnEntity("op_asa:chicken_hitohito",target.location).getComponent("tameable").tame(player);
                player.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:tamed_particle",{x:target.location.x,y:target.location.y+1,z:target.location.z});
                target.remove();
            }
        });
    }
    else if(target.typeId == "minecraft:salmon"){
        new MessageFormData()
        .title("akumanomi.hito")
        .body({rawtext:[{translate:"rawtext.hitohito_salmon"}]})
        .button1("gui.ok")
        .button2("gui.no")
        .show(player).then(res => {
            if(res.selection == 0){
                decrementStack(player,1);
                player.dimension.spawnEntity("op_asa:salmon_hitohito",target.location).getComponent("tameable").tame(player);
                player.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:tamed_particle",{x:target.location.x,y:target.location.y+1,z:target.location.z});
                target.remove();
            }
        });
    }
}
/**
 * 金の悪魔の実
 * @param {ItemStack} itemStack 
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function golden_akumanomi(itemStack,player){
    const itemId = itemStack.typeId;
    const isEnchanted = itemId.includes("enchanted");
    let duration = 6000;
    let amplifier = 50;

    if(!isEnchanted){
        duration = 3600;
        amplifier = Number(itemId.split("op_asa:golden_akumanomi_")[1]) * 5;
    }

	player.addEffect("health_boost",duration,{amplifier:amplifier});

    const healthComp = player.getComponent("health");
    healthComp.setCurrentValue(healthComp.effectiveMax);
    
    const hungerConp = player.getComponent("player.hunger");
    hungerConp.setCurrentValue(hungerConp.effectiveMax);
}

/**
 * 手配書右クリ-懸賞金スコア追加、所属ステータス更新
 * @param {ItemStack} itemStack 
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function on_use_bounty(itemStack,player){
    const itemId = itemStack.typeId;
    const entityId = itemId.split("op_asa:bounty_")[1];
    const entityData = allEntityData.find(e => e.id === entityId);
    if (entityData==undefined) return;

    const jobType = Math.floor(player.getProperty("op_asa:status_job")/10);

    // 海賊
    if(jobType == 1){
        // 懸賞金スコア追加
        addBountyScore(player,entityData);
        // 所属ステータス更新
        updateJobExp(player,entityData.rewardExp);
        // アイテム消費
        decrementStack(player,1);
    }
    // 海軍
    else if(jobType == 2){
        // 換金可能なやつだけしか使えない
        if(entityData.canExchange==false){
            showSubtitle(player,"rawtext.tellraw.bounty.cannotUse",15);
        }else{
            // 所属ステータス更新
            updateJobExp(player,entityData.rewardExp);
            // アイテム消費
            decrementStack(player,1);
        }
    }
    // 賞金稼ぎ
    else if(jobType == 3){
        showSubtitle(player,"rawtext.tellraw.bounty.bountyhunter",15);
    }
    // 市民
    else{
        showSubtitle(player,"rawtext.tellraw.bounty.citizen",15);
    }
}
/**
 * 懸賞金スコアを追加-懸賞金の半分
 * @param {Player} player
 * @param {import("./index/entity_index").EntityData} entityData 
 */
function addBountyScore(player,entityData){
    // スコア補正
    if(getScoreUtility(player,"bounty1")>=100000000){
        operationScoreUtility(player,"bounty2",1);
        operationScoreUtility(player,"bounty1",-100000000);
    }
    // スコア追加
    const halfBountyData = getHalfBounty(entityData);
    const halfBounty1 = halfBountyData.halfBounty1;
    const halfBounty2 = halfBountyData.halfBounty2;
    const halfBounty = halfBounty2*100000000 + halfBounty1;
    operationScoreUtility(player,"bounty1",halfBounty1);
    operationScoreUtility(player,"bounty2",halfBounty2);
	player.sendMessage({rawtext:[{text:`§a`},{translate:"form.status.bounty"},{text:`§f+${halfBounty}`}]});
}
/**
 * カスタム舶刀
 * @param {ItemStack} itemStack 
 * @param {Player} player
 */
export function custom_cutlass(itemStack,player){
    const type = itemStack.typeId.split("op_asa:cutlass_")[1];
    if(type == "goro"){
        const entityRaycastHit = player.getEntitiesFromViewDirection({maxDistance:32,excludeFamilies:["waza","inanimate"],excludeTypes:["item","xp_orb"]});
        if(entityRaycastHit.length > 0){
            const targetEntity = entityRaycastHit[0].entity;
            const projectile = player.dimension.spawnEntity("op_asa:cutlass_goro_p",targetEntity.location);
            const projectileComp = projectile.getComponent("projectile");
            projectileComp.owner = player;
        }
        else{
            const blockRaycastHit = player.getBlockFromViewDirection({maxDistance:32,includeLiquidBlocks:false,includePassableBlocks:false});
            if(blockRaycastHit != undefined){
                const block = blockRaycastHit.block;
                const projectile = player.dimension.spawnEntity("op_asa:cutlass_goro_p",block.location);
                const projectileComp = projectile.getComponent("projectile");
                projectileComp.owner = player;
            }
        }
    }
    else if(type == "hie"){
        shootProjectile(player,"op_asa:cutlass_hie_p");
    }
    else if(type == "mag"){
        shootProjectile(player,"op_asa:cutlass_mag_p");
    }
    else if(type == "mera"){
        shootProjectile(player,"op_asa:cutlass_mera_p");
    }
    else if(type == "moku"){
        for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            system.runTimeout(() => {
                player.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:cutlass_moku_particle", player.location);
                applySelfKnockback(player,1.75,0.5);
            }, i);
        }
    }
    else if(type == "numa"){
        if(player.getComponent("riding") == undefined){
            spawnRideEntity(player,"op_asa:cutlass_numa_e",player.location);
            decrementStack(player,1);
        }
    }
    else if(type == "pika"){
        pika_beam(player);
    }
    else if(type == "suna"){
        desert_spada(player);
    }
    else if(type == "yami"){
        yamiyami_cutlass(player);
    }
}
/**
 * ホットバー8
 * @param {ItemStack} itemStack 
 * @param {Player} player
 */
export function hotbar_8(itemStack,player){
    const itemId = itemStack.typeId;

    if(itemId.startsWith("op_asa:hotbar_8_status")){
        const entityHit = player.getEntitiesFromViewDirection({maxDistance:8})[0];
        if (entityHit == undefined){
            operationStatus(player);
        } else{
            const hitEntity = entityHit.entity;

            // プレイヤーを見ているときは他プレイヤー用のステータス表示
            if (isPlayer(hitEntity)){
                showPlayerStatus(player,hitEntity);
            }
            // 船員を見ているときは船員用のステータス表示 (船員が自分に乗っているときは自分のステータスを表示)
            else if (hitEntity.typeId == "op_asa:kaizoku_neo"){
                if (hitEntity.getComponent("riding")?.entityRidingOn == player) {
                    operationStatus(player);
                } else {
                    showKaizokuNeoStatus(player,hitEntity);
                }
            }
            // それ以外は自分のステータスを表示
            else {
                operationStatus(player);
            }
        }
    }
    else if(itemId.startsWith("op_asa:hotbar_8_haoshoku")){
        haoshoku(player);
    }
    else if(itemId.startsWith("op_asa:hotbar_8_kenbunshoku")){
        k_haki_observe(player);
    }
}
/**
 * 銃
 * @param {Player} player
 */
export function ju(player){
    shootProjectile(player,"op_asa:ju_p",{power:2.5});
    player.dimension.playSound("ju_shoot.sound",player.location,{volume:0.4});

    const equipComp = player.getComponent("equippable");
    const mainhandItemStack = equipComp.getEquipment("Mainhand");
    const durability = mainhandItemStack.getComponent("durability");

    // 最大耐久値
    const maxDurability = durability.maxDurability;
    // 減少値
    const damagedDurability = durability.damage;
    // 残り耐久値
    const remainingDurability = maxDurability - damagedDurability;

    // 残り耐久値1以上なら耐久値減少
    if(remainingDurability > 0){

        const updateItemStack = new ItemStack(mainhandItemStack.typeId,1);
        const updateItemDurability = updateItemStack.getComponent("minecraft:durability");
        updateItemDurability.damage = damagedDurability + 1;

        equipComp.setEquipment("Mainhand",updateItemStack);
    }else{
        equipComp.setEquipment("Mainhand",undefined);
    }
}
/**
 * サンダーボルトテンポ
 * @param {Entity} entity 
 */
export function thunder_bolt_tempo(entity){
    const dim = entity.dimension;
    let targetLoc;

    // ===== 目標座標を決定(エンティティの場合はダメージも発生) =====
    const entityHit = entity.getEntitiesFromViewDirection({maxDistance:64,excludeFamilies:["waza"],excludeTypes:["item","xp_orb"]})[0];
    if(entityHit){
        const target = entityHit.entity;
        applyVarious({
            target,
            damaging:entity,
            damage:{
                amount:damageByEffectStrength(entity,8)
            }
        });
        targetLoc = target.location;
    }else{
        const blockHit = entity.getBlockFromViewDirection({maxDistance:64,includeLiquidBlocks:true,includePassableBlocks:false});
        if(blockHit){
            targetLoc = blockHit.block.center();
        }
    }

    // ====== 落雷 ======
    if(targetLoc){
        spawnRandomLightningBolt(dim,targetLoc,"minecraft:lightning_bolt");
    }
}
/**
 * 落雷
 ** 中心座標から半径5ブロック以内にランダムで3回召喚
 * @param {import("@minecraft/server").Dimension} dimension
 * @param {{x:number, y:number, z:number}} center
 * @param {string} entityId 
 */
function spawnRandomLightningBolt(dimension, center, entityId) {
    const RADIUS = 5;
    const COUNT = 3;
	const INTERVAL = 3;
	
	function spawnOnce() {
		const x = center.x + (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * RADIUS;
		const z = center.z + (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * RADIUS;

		dimension.spawnEntity(entityId, {
			x,
			y: center.y,
			z
		});
	}

    for (let i = 0; i < COUNT; i++) {
        if (i === 0) {
            // 1回目：即時
            spawnOnce();
        } else {
            // 2回目以降：遅延
            system.runTimeout(() => {
                spawnOnce();
            }, INTERVAL * i);
        }
    }
}

/**
 * 飛ぶ斬撃
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function slash(player){
    const { CDC, CDD } = KATANAWAZA_INFO.slash;

    const strength = player.getEffect("strength");
    const spawnEvent = strength == undefined ? undefined : `op_asa:strength_${Math.min(strength.amplifier,5)}`;

    // 中央
    shootProjectile(
        player,"op_asa:slash_p",
        {
            offset:[0,-0.2,0.25],
            spawnEvent,
            properties:{"op_asa:visible":true}
        }
    );
    // 横
    shootProjectile(player,"op_asa:slash_p",{offset:[2,-0.2,0.25],spawnEvent});
    shootProjectile(player,"op_asa:slash_p",{offset:[1,-0.2,0.25],spawnEvent});
    shootProjectile(player,"op_asa:slash_p",{offset:[-1,-0.2,0.25],spawnEvent});
    shootProjectile(player,"op_asa:slash_p",{offset:[-2,-0.2,0.25],spawnEvent});

    // サウンド
    player.dimension.playSound("sword.slash",player.location);

    // ct
    katanawazaCoolDown(player,CDC,CDD);
}

/**
 * 獅子歌々
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function shishisonson(player){
    const { DMG, DMGM, CDC, CDD } = KATANAWAZA_INFO.shishisonson;

    // 移動
    const startLocation = player.location;
    const cos0 = Math.cos(player.getRotation().x * (Math.PI/180));
    const sin0 = Math.sin(player.getRotation().x * (Math.PI/180));
    const horizontalStrength = player.getRotation().x < 0 ? 35 * cos0 : 35;
    const verticalStrength = Math.max(0,-3 * sin0);
    applySelfKnockback(player,horizontalStrength,verticalStrength);
    
    // 音
    player.dimension.playSound("sword.shishisonson",player.location);

    // クールダウン
    katanawazaCoolDown(player,CDC,CDD);
    
    // 静止、ダメージ発生
    system.runTimeout(()=>{
        player.clearVelocity();
        const stopLocation = player.location;
        rushAttack({
            damaging:player,
            startLocation,
            stopLocation,
            volume:{x:4,y:4,z:4},
            damage:{amount:damageByEffectStrength(player,DMG,DMGM),cause:"entityAttack",katanawaza:true}
        });
    },3);

    // 納刀音
    system.runTimeout(()=>{
        player.dimension.playSound("sword.shishisonson_finish",player.location,{volume:1});
    },15);
}

/**
 * 大辰撼-発射物
 * @param {Entity} entity 
 */
export function daishinkan_p(entity){
    const { DMG, DMGM } = KATANAWAZA_INFO.daishinkan;

    // バリバリブロック内なら消す
    if(removeProjectileInBLock(entity,["op_asa:barrier_ball_block","op_asa:barrierbility_block"])) return;

    const dim = entity.dimension;
    const loc = entity.location;

    // ブロック内なら爆発起こして消す
    const targetBLock = dim.getBlock(loc);
    if(entity!=undefined && !targetBLock.isAir && !targetBLock.typeId.includes("_grass")){
        spawnExplosion(dim,loc,2);
        entity.remove();
    }
    else{
        // 存在しないなら終了
        const projectileComp = entity.getComponent("projectile");
        if(projectileComp==undefined) return;

        // ブロック破壊
        fillCommandDestroy(entity,loc,[-1,-1,0],[1,-1,0]);
        fillCommandDestroy(entity,loc,[0,-1,-1],[0,-1,1]);
        fillCommandDestroy(entity,loc,[0,0,0],[0,0,0]);
        fillCommandDestroy(entity,loc,[0,-2,0],[0,-2,0]);

        // パーティクル
        dim.spawnParticle("op_asa:daishinkan_p_particle",loc);

        // ダメージ
        const owner = projectileComp.owner;
        for(const targetEntity of getEntitiesDistance(owner,loc,3)){
            applyVarious({
                target:targetEntity,
                damaging:owner,
                damage:{amount:damageByEffectStrength(owner,DMG,DMGM),cause:"entityAttack",katanawaza:true}
            });
        }
    }
}
/**
 * 三千世界
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function sanzensekai(player){
    const { DMG, DMGM, CDC, CDD } = KATANAWAZA_INFO.sanzensekai;
    const damageAmount = damageByEffectStrength(player,DMG,DMGM);


    // 三千世界
    if(isBuso(player)){
        const startLocation = player.location;

        if(player.isOnGround){
            applySelfKnockback(player,20,0);
        }else{
            applySelfKnockback(player,7,0.2);
        }

        // ダメージ(4連続)
        system.runTimeout(()=>{
            rushAttack({
                damaging:player,
                startLocation,
                stopLocation:player.location,
                volume:{x:4,y:4,z:4},
                damage:{amount:damageAmount,cause:"entityAttack",katanawaza:true}
            });
        },1);
        system.runTimeout(()=>{
            rushAttack({
                damaging:player,
                startLocation,
                stopLocation:player.location,
                volume:{x:4,y:4,z:4},
                damage:{amount:damageAmount,cause:"entityAttack",katanawaza:true}
            });
        },2);
        system.runTimeout(()=>{
            rushAttack({
                damaging:player,
                startLocation,
                stopLocation:player.location,
                volume:{x:4,y:4,z:4},
                damage:{amount:damageAmount,cause:"entityAttack",katanawaza:true}
            });
        },3);
        system.runTimeout(()=>{
            rushAttack({
                damaging:player,
                startLocation,
                stopLocation:player.location,
                volume:{x:4,y:4,z:4},
                damage:{amount:damageAmount,cause:"entityAttack",katanawaza:true}
            });
        },4);
    }
    // 一大三千大千世界
    else{

        const cos0 = Math.cos(player.getRotation().x * (Math.PI/180));
        const sin0 = Math.sin(player.getRotation().x * (Math.PI/180));
        const horizontalStrength = player.getRotation().x < 0 ? 16 * cos0 : 36;
        const verticalStrength = Math.max(0,-3 * sin0);
        applySelfKnockback(player,horizontalStrength,verticalStrength);

        // パーティクル生成(4回に分けて実行)、ダメージ(4連続)
        const initialLoc = player.location;
        let startLocation = player.location;
        /**@param {Number} n  */
        function runTimeout(n){
            system.runTimeout(()=>{
                const stopLocation = player.location;

                rushAttack({
                    damaging:player,
                    startLocation,
                    stopLocation,
                    volume:{x:5,y:5,z:5},
                    particle:{trailParticleId:"op_asa:sanzensekai_particle"}
                });
                rushAttack({
                    damaging:player,
                    startLocation:initialLoc,
                    stopLocation,
                    volume:{x:5,y:5,z:5},
                    damage:{amount:damageAmount,cause:"entityAttack",katanawaza:true}
                });

                if(n != 0){
                    startLocation = player.location;
                    runTimeout(n-1);
                }
            },1);
        }
        runTimeout(4);
    }
    
    // プレイヤーの場合はアイテムクールダウン、それ以外はイベント実行
    if(isPlayer(player)){
        katanawazaCoolDown(player,CDC,CDD);
    }else{
        player.triggerEvent("op_asa:cooldown");
    }
    
}
/**
 * 鬼斬り
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function onigiri(player){
    const { DMG, DMGM, CDC, CDD } = KATANAWAZA_INFO.onigiri;
    const damageAmount = damageByEffectStrength(player,DMG,DMGM);

    // 3:覇王、2:武装、1:なし
    const hakiInfusion = getHakiInfusion(player);
    const type = hakiInfusion.includes("hao") ? 3 : 
                (hakiInfusion.includes("buso") || hakiInfusion.includes("ryuo")) ? 2 : 1;

    // 移動
    const startLocation = player.location;
    const cos0 = Math.cos(player.getRotation().x * (Math.PI/180));
    const sin0 = Math.sin(player.getRotation().x * (Math.PI/180));
    const horizontalStrength = player.getRotation().x < 0 ? 35 * cos0 : 35;
    const verticalStrength = Math.max(0,-3 * sin0);
    applySelfKnockback(player,horizontalStrength,verticalStrength);
    
    // 音
    player.dimension.playSound("sword.hiryujigoku",player.location,{volume:2});

    // 静止、ダメージ発生
    system.runTimeout(()=>{
        player.clearVelocity();
        const stopLocation = caretZ(player.location,player.getRotation(),[0,0,2]);
        if(type==3){
            rushAttack({
                damaging:player,
                startLocation,
                stopLocation,
                volume:{x:6,y:6,z:6},
                damage:{amount:DMG,cause:"void",katanawaza:true},
                particle:{trailParticleId:`op_asa:onigiri_particle_${type}`}
            });
        }else{
            rushAttack({
                damaging:player,
                startLocation,
                stopLocation,
                volume:{x:6,y:6,z:6},
                damage:{amount:damageAmount,cause:"entityAttack",katanawaza:true},
                particle:{trailParticleId:`op_asa:onigiri_particle_${type}`}
            });
        }
    },3);
    
    // クールダウン
    if(player.typeId=="minecraft:player"){
        katanawazaCoolDown(player,CDC,CDD);
    }else{
        player.triggerEvent("op_asa:cooldown");
    }
}

/**
 * 銃擬鬼-連続物理ダメージ＋押し出し
 * @param {Player} player 
//  */
export function ganmodoki(player){
    const loc = player.location;
    const viewD = player.getViewDirection();
    const vector = {x:viewD.x*0.4,y:0,z:viewD.z*0.4};
    const damageAmount = damageByEffectStrength(player,1,1.3);

    for(const targetEntity of getEntitiesInRange(player,shiftLocation(player.location,-3,-2.5,-3),{x:5,y:5,z:5})){
        if(targetEntity != player){
            targetEntity.applyImpulse(vector);
            applyVarious({
                target:targetEntity,
                damaging:player,
                damage:{amount:damageAmount,cause:"entityAttack"}
            });
        }
    }

}

/**
 * 桃源白滝
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function togenshirataki(player){
    const { DMG, DMGM, CDC, CDD } = KATANAWAZA_INFO.togenshirataki;
    const damageAmount = damageByEffectStrength(player,DMG,DMGM);

    setScoreUtility(player,"spcharge",0);
    setSpCharge(player,"charged_attack");
    katanawazaCoolDown(player,CDC,CDD);
    player.addEffect("slow_falling",30,{showParticles:false});

    system.runTimeout(()=>{
        // 開始地点
        const startLocation = player.location;
        
        // ジャンプパーティクル生成
        player.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:togenshirataki_start_particle",startLocation);
        
        // テレポート地点
        let hitLoc = startLocation;
        
        // ターゲットを取得
        const entityRay = player.getEntitiesFromViewDirection({excludeTypes:["item","xp_orb"],excludeFamilies:["waza"],maxDistance:16});
        // ターゲットがいるならテレポートして発動
        if(entityRay.length>0){
            hitLoc = caret(player.getHeadLocation(),player.getRotation(),[0,0,entityRay[0].distance]);
        }
        // ターゲットがいないなら最大16ブロック先にテレポートして発動
        else{
            const blockRay = player.getBlockFromViewDirection({maxDistance:16});
            if(blockRay!=undefined){
                hitLoc = shiftLocation(blockRay.block.location,blockRay.faceLocation.x,blockRay.faceLocation.y,blockRay.faceLocation.z);
            }else{
                hitLoc = caret(player.getHeadLocation(),player.getRotation(),[0,0,16]);
            }
        }
    
        // テレポートする
        player.teleport(hitLoc);
        
        const stopLocation = player.location;

        // 攻撃音
        player.dimension.playSound("sword.togenshirataki",stopLocation,{volume:1.1});

        // 攻撃パーティクルとダメージ
        if(getHakiInfusion(player).includes("ryuo")){
            player.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:togenshirataki_ryuo_particle",{x:stopLocation.x,y:stopLocation.y+1,z:stopLocation.z});
        }else{
            player.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:togenshirataki_particle",{x:stopLocation.x,y:stopLocation.y+1,z:stopLocation.z});
        }
        rushAttack({
            damaging:player,
            startLocation,
            stopLocation,
            volume:{x:5,y:5,z:5},
            damage:{amount:damageAmount,cause:"entityAttack",katanawaza:true}
        });
    },10);

}
/**
 * 桃源十拳
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function togentotuka(player){
    const { DMG, DMGM, CDC, CDD } = KATANAWAZA_INFO.togentotuka;
    const damageAmount = damageByEffectStrength(player,DMG,DMGM);

    setScoreUtility(player,"spcharge",0);
    setSpCharge(player,"charged_attack");
    katanawazaCoolDown(player,CDC,CDD);

    // 真上にジャンプ
    player.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:togenshirataki_start_particle",player.location);
    applySelfKnockback(player,1,1);
    player.addEffect("slow_falling",40,{showParticles:false});

    // 移動
    system.runTimeout(()=>{
        const startLocation = player.location;
    
        const cos0 = Math.cos(player.getRotation().x * (Math.PI/180));
        const sin0 = Math.sin(player.getRotation().x * (Math.PI/180));
        const horizontalStrength = player.getRotation().x < 0 ? 35 * cos0 : 35;
        const verticalStrength = Math.max(0,-3 * sin0);
        applySelfKnockback(player,horizontalStrength,verticalStrength);
    
        // 音
        system.runTimeout(()=>{
            player.dimension.playSound("sword.togenshirataki",player.location,{volume:2,pitch:0.75});
        },2);

        // 静止、ダメージ発生
        system.runTimeout(()=>{
            player.clearVelocity();
            const stopLocation = caretZ(player.location,player.getRotation(),[0,0,3]);

            player.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:togentotuka_particle1",stopLocation);

            rushAttack({
                damaging:player,
                startLocation,
                stopLocation,
                volume:{x:4,y:4,z:4},
                damage:{amount:damageAmount,cause:"void",katanawaza:true},
                knockback:{type:"front",horizontalStrength:7,verticalStrength:1},
                particle:{trailParticleId:"op_asa:togentotuka_rush_particle",hitParticleId:"op_asa:togentotuka_hit_particle"}
            });
        },4);
    },5);

}
/**
 * 神避
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function kamusari(player){
    const { DMG, CDC, CDD } = KATANAWAZA_INFO.kamusari;

    // 前方小範囲にダメージとノックバック
    const knockbackTargets = getEntitiesInFront(player,[5,5],5);
    for(const targetEntity of knockbackTargets){
        applyVarious({
            target:targetEntity,
            damaging:player,
            damage:{amount:DMG,cause:"void",katanawaza:true},
            knockback:{type:"front",horizontalStrength:10,verticalStrength:1}
        });
        // 盾防御してるなら破壊
        if(targetEntity.isSneaking){
            const equipComp = targetEntity.getComponent("equippable");
            if(equipComp?.getEquipment("Mainhand")?.typeId == "shield"){
                equipComp.setEquipment("Mainhand",undefined);
            }
            if(equipComp?.getEquipment("Offhand")?.typeId == "shield"){
                equipComp.setEquipment("Offhand",undefined);
            }
        }
    }

    // 射撃
    if(player.getComponent("equippable").getEquipment("Mainhand")?.typeId == "op_asa:gryphon_kamusari"){
        shootProjectile(player,"op_asa:kamusari_p",{spawnEvent:"op_asa:gryphon"});
    }
    else{
        shootProjectile(player,"op_asa:kamusari_p");
    }

    player.dimension.playSound("sword.kamusari",player.location);

    // ct
    katanawazaCoolDown(player,CDC,CDD);
}
/**
 * 神避-発射物
 * @param {Entity} entity 
 */
export function kamusari_p(entity){
    const { DMG } = KATANAWAZA_INFO.kamusari;

    if(removeProjectileInBLock(entity)) return;

    const projectileComp = entity.getComponent("projectile");

    if(projectileComp==undefined) return;
    const owner = projectileComp.owner;

    const damageAmount = owner.typeId == "op_asa:roger" ? 60 : DMG;
    const targets = getEntitiesInRange(owner,shiftLocation(entity.location,-3,-1.5,-3),{x:5,y:3,z:5});
    for(const targetEntity of targets){
        // ダメージ
        applyVarious({
            target:targetEntity,
            damaging:owner,
            damage:{amount:damageAmount,cause:"void",katanawaza:true}
        });
        // 盾防御してるなら破壊
        if(targetEntity.isSneaking){
            const equipComp = targetEntity.getComponent("equippable");
            if(equipComp?.getEquipment("Mainhand")?.typeId == "shield"){
                equipComp.setEquipment("Mainhand",undefined);
            }
            if(equipComp?.getEquipment("Offhand")?.typeId == "shield"){
                equipComp.setEquipment("Offhand",undefined);
            }
        }
    }
}
/**
 * 赤髪の神避-発動
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function akagami_kamusari(player){
    const { CDC, CDD } = KATANAWAZA_INFO.akagami_kamusari;

    katanawazaCoolDown(player,CDC,CDD);

    // 目標までの距離
    let targetDist = 12;
    // 遅延
    let delay = 4;

    // エンティティ→ブロックの順にターゲットを選定し、目標までの距離、遅延を更新
    const entityRay = player.getEntitiesFromViewDirection({maxDistance:64});
    if(entityRay.length){
        targetDist = entityRay[0].distance;
        delay = Math.min(6,Math.floor(targetDist/4));
    }else{
        const blockRay = player.getBlockFromViewDirection({maxDistance:128,includePassableBlocks:false});
        if(blockRay!=undefined){
            targetDist = getDistance(player.location,blockRay.block.location);
            delay = Math.min(6,Math.floor(targetDist/4));
        }
    }
    // player.sendMessage(`距離: ${targetDist}\n遅延: ${delay}`);

    // 突撃
    if(delay<2){
        // 近いときはダメージの前に遅延して即撃ち
        setSpCharge(player,"charging");

        system.runTimeout(()=>{
            const horizontalStrength = (targetDist * Math.cos(player.getRotation().x * (Math.PI/180)));
            const verticalStrength = -5 * Math.sin(player.getRotation().x * (Math.PI/180));
            applySelfKnockback(player,horizontalStrength,verticalStrength);
            
            akagami_kamusari_exe(player);
        },2);
    }
    else if(true){
        // ちょっと上に上がって突撃して遅延して急停止して撃つ
        applySelfKnockback(player,0,1);

        system.runTimeout(()=>{
            const horizontalStrength = ((targetDist/2) * Math.cos(player.getRotation().x * (Math.PI/180)));
            const verticalStrength = -5 * Math.sin(player.getRotation().x * (Math.PI/180));
            applySelfKnockback(player,horizontalStrength,verticalStrength);

            setSpCharge(player,"charging");

            system.runTimeout(()=>{
                akagami_kamusari_exe(player);
            },delay);

        },1);
    }
}
/**
 * 赤髪の神避-攻撃実行
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
function akagami_kamusari_exe(player){

    setSpCharge(player,"uncharged");
    player.addEffect("slow_falling",40,{showParticles:false});

    // アイテム入れ替えてたら実行しない
    if(player.getComponent("equippable").getEquipment("Mainhand")==undefined || player.getComponent("equippable").getEquipment("Mainhand").typeId!="op_asa:gryphon_akagami_kamusari") return;

    // 静止、ダメージ発生
    system.runTimeout(()=>{
        player.clearVelocity();
        akagami_kamusari_attack(player,caretZ(shiftLocation(player.location,0,1,0),player.getRotation(),[0,0,2]),haoHakiEffects);
    },1);
}
/**
 * 赤髪の神避-攻撃内容
 * @param {Entity} entity 
 * @param {import("@minecraft/server").Vector3} location 
 * @param {Object} effects 
 */
export function akagami_kamusari_attack(entity,location,effects){
    const { DMG } = KATANAWAZA_INFO.akagami_kamusari;

    // サウンド
    entity.dimension.playSound("sword.kamusari",location);

    // パーティクル
    entity.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:shanks_kamusari_particle1",location);
    entity.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:shanks_kamusari_particle2",location);

    // 覇気効果
    for(const effectTarget of getEntitiesDistance(entity,location,30)){
    
        // クリエイティブプレイヤーは除く
        if(isPlayer(effectTarget) && effectTarget.getGameMode()=="Creative") continue;

        // ステータスレベルが使用者未満ならエフェクト与える
        if(getStatusLevel(effectTarget) < getStatusLevel(entity)){
            for(const effect of effects){
                effectTarget.addEffect(effect.type,effect.duration,{amplifier:effect.amplifier,showParticles:false});
            }
        }

        // 雑魚に瀕死ダメージ
        if(effectTarget.getProperty("op_asa:status_level_exp") < 45){
            effectTarget.applyDamage(18,{cause:"selfDestruct",damagingEntity:entity});
        }
        else if(effectTarget.matches({families:["homies"]})){
            effectTarget.applyDamage(100,{cause:"selfDestruct",damagingEntity:entity});
        }
    }

    // 前方中範囲にダメージとノックバック
    for(const targetEntity of getEntitiesInRange(entity,shiftLocation(location,-5.5,-5,-5.5),{x:10,y:10,z:10})){
        if(targetEntity.matches({propertyOptions:[{propertyId:"op_asa:akumanomi",value:{equals:28}}]})){
            onDamagedBaraBara(targetEntity);
            applyVarious({
                target:targetEntity,
                damaging:entity,
                damage:{amount:DMG/2,cause:"void"},
                knockback:{type:"front",horizontalStrength:9,verticalStrength:1.5}
            });
        }
        else{
            applyVarious({
                target:targetEntity,
                damaging:entity,
                damage:{amount:DMG,cause:"void"},
                knockback:{type:"front",horizontalStrength:9,verticalStrength:1.5}
            });
        }
    }
}
const haoHakiEffects = [
	{type:"weakness",duration:200,amplifier:4},
	{type:"slowness",duration:200,amplifier:4},
	{type:"mining_fatigue",duration:200,amplifier:7}
]
/**
 * 覇王の一撃(ロジャー版)
 * @param {Entity} entity 
 */
export function hao_strike(entity){
    const { CDC, CDD } = KATANAWAZA_INFO.hao_strike;

    const dim = entity.dimension;
    const isPlayerEntity = isPlayer(entity);
    const dist = isPlayerEntity ? 2 : 4;
    const loc = caretZ(entity.getHeadLocation(),entity.getRotation(),[0,0,dist]);// 頭から少し前
    const user = isPlayerEntity ? "player" : "roger"

    // ダメージ
    hao_strike_damage(entity,dim,loc,user);

    // クールタイム
    if(isPlayerEntity) katanawazaCoolDown(entity,CDC,CDD);
}
/**
 * 薙刀連撃
 * @param {Entity} entity 
 * @param {Number} combo 
 */
export function murakumokiri_combo(entity,combo){
    const { DMG, DMGM } = KATANAWAZA_INFO.murakumokiri_combo;
    const damageAmount = damageByEffectStrength(entity,DMG,DMGM);

	const dim = entity.dimension;
	const isPlayerEntity = isPlayer(entity);
    const spCharge = combo ?? getScoreUtility(entity,"spcharge");
    const idGura = entity.getProperty("op_asa:akumanomi")==5 && (isPlayerEntity || (entity.getProperty("op_asa:kairouseki") == false && entity.getProperty("op_asa:kurouzu") == false));

    // グラの時だけ射撃
    if(idGura){
        const num = spCharge>= 20 ? 4 : spCharge>=10 ? 3 : spCharge>=5 ? 2 : 1;
        shootProjectile(entity,"op_asa:murakumokiri_p",{ignorePitch:true,properties:{"op_asa:num":num}});
        dim.playSound("sword.slash",entity.location,{volume:0.75});
    }
    else{
        dim.playSound("sword.swing",entity.location,{volume:0.75});
    }

    // 前方小範囲にダメージ(最終段のみノックバック)
    const targets = isPlayerEntity ? getEntitiesInRange(entity,shiftLocation(caretZ(entity.getHeadLocation(),entity.getRotation(),[0,0,2]),-2.5,-2,-2.5),{x:4,y:4,z:4})
	: getEntitiesInRange(entity,shiftLocation(caretZ(entity.location,entity.getRotation(),[0,0,4]),-4.5,-4,-4.5),{x:8,y:8,z:8});
    for(const targetEntity of targets){
        if(spCharge>=20){
            applyVarious({
                target:targetEntity,
                damaging:entity,
                damage:{amount:damageAmount,cause:"entityAttack",katanawaza:true},
                knockback:{type:"front",horizontalStrength:isPlayerEntity ? 5 : 15,verticalStrength:isPlayerEntity ? 0.75 : 2}
            });
        }else{
            applyVarious({
                target:targetEntity,
                damaging:entity,
                damage:{amount:damageAmount,cause:"entityAttack",katanawaza:true}
            });
        }
    }
}
/**
 * 薙ぎ払い
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function murakumokiri_sweep(player){
    const { DMG, DMGM, CDC, CDD } = KATANAWAZA_INFO.murakumokiri_sweep;
    const damageAmount = damageByEffectStrength(player,DMG,DMGM);

    katanawazaCoolDown(player,CDC,CDD);

    const dim = player.dimension;

    // グラの時だけ射撃
    if(player.getProperty("op_asa:akumanomi")==5){
        shootProjectile(player,"op_asa:murakumokiri_p",{offset:[0,0,3],ignorePitch:true,properties:{"op_asa:num":5}});
        dim.playSound("sword.slash",player.location,{volume:0.75});
        system.runTimeout(()=>{
            dim.playSound("sword.slash",player.location,{volume:0.75});
        },1);
        system.runTimeout(()=>{
            dim.playSound("sword.slash",player.location,{volume:0.75});
        },2);
    }
    else{
        dim.playSound("sword.swing",player.location,{volume:0.75});
        system.runTimeout(()=>{
            dim.playSound("sword.swing",player.location,{volume:0.75});
        },1);
        system.runTimeout(()=>{
            dim.playSound("sword.swing",player.location,{volume:0.75});
        },2);
    }

    // 前方中範囲にダメージとノックバック
    for(const targetEntity of getEntitiesInRange(player,shiftLocation(caretZ(player.getHeadLocation(),player.getRotation(),[0,0,5]),-5.5,-3,-5.5),{x:10,y:6,z:10})){
        applyVarious({
            target:targetEntity,
            damaging:player,
            damage:{amount:damageAmount,cause:"entityAttack",katanawaza:true},
            knockback:{type:"front",horizontalStrength:7,verticalStrength:1.5}
        });
    }

    // パーティクル
    dim.spawnParticle("op_asa:murakumokiri_sweep_particle",caretZ(player.getHeadLocation(),player.getRotation(),[-4.5,-1,1.5]));
    dim.spawnParticle("op_asa:murakumokiri_sweep_particle",caretZ(player.getHeadLocation(),player.getRotation(),[-3.0,-0.5,2]));
    system.runTimeout(()=>{
        dim.spawnParticle("op_asa:murakumokiri_sweep_particle",caretZ(player.getHeadLocation(),player.getRotation(),[-1.5,0,3]));
        dim.spawnParticle("op_asa:murakumokiri_sweep_particle",caretZ(player.getHeadLocation(),player.getRotation(),[0.0,0,3.5]));
        dim.spawnParticle("op_asa:murakumokiri_sweep_particle",caretZ(player.getHeadLocation(),player.getRotation(),[1.5,0,3]));
    },1);
    system.runTimeout(()=>{
        dim.spawnParticle("op_asa:murakumokiri_sweep_particle",caretZ(player.getHeadLocation(),player.getRotation(),[3.0,0.5,2]));
        dim.spawnParticle("op_asa:murakumokiri_sweep_particle",caretZ(player.getHeadLocation(),player.getRotation(),[4.5,1,1.5]));
    },2);
}
/**
 * 覇王の一撃(白ひげ版)-開始
 * @param {Entity} entity 
 */
export function murakumokiri_hao_strike_start(entity){
    const isNewgate = entity.typeId == "op_asa:newgate";

    // 視線の先にエンティティがいるならそこへ目掛けて飛ぶ
    const entityRay = entity.getEntitiesFromViewDirection({maxDistance:64});
    if(entityRay.length){
        const targetDist = entityRay[0].distance;
        const distY = entityRay[0].entity.location.y - entity.location.y;

        if(isNewgate){
            const horizontalStrength = targetDist > 24 ? targetDist : targetDist > 8 ? targetDist/1.2 : targetDist/1.7;
            const verticalStrength = 2.5 + distY/3;
            applySelfKnockback(entity,horizontalStrength,verticalStrength);
        }else{
            const horizontalStrength = targetDist > 32 ? targetDist/2 : targetDist > 24 ? targetDist/3 : targetDist/4;
            const verticalStrength = 1 + distY/6;
            system.runTimeout(()=>{
                applySelfKnockback(entity,horizontalStrength,verticalStrength);
            },1);
        }
    }
}
/**
 * 覇王の一撃(白ひげ版)
 * @param {Entity} entity 
 */
export function murakumokiri_hao_strike(entity){
    const { CDC, CDD } = KATANAWAZA_INFO.murakumokiri_hao_strike;

    const dim = entity.dimension;
    const isPlayerEntity = isPlayer(entity);
    const dist = isPlayerEntity ? 4 : 8;
    const loc = caretZ(entity.location,entity.getRotation(),[0,0,dist]);// 足元から少し前
    const user = isPlayerEntity ? "player" : "newgate"
    
    // 静止
    entity.clearVelocity();
    entity.addEffect("slow_falling",40,{showParticles:false});

    // ダメージ
    hao_strike_damage(entity,dim,loc,user);

    // クールタイム
    if(isPlayerEntity) katanawazaCoolDown(entity,CDC,CDD);
}
/**
 * 覇王の一撃によるダメージ
 ** ノックバック、パーティクル、サウンド含む 
 * @param {Entity} damaging 発動者
 * @param {Dimension} dim ディメンション
 * @param {import("@minecraft/server").Vector3} loc 実行位置
 * @param {"roger"|"newgate"|"player"} user 発動者が誰か
 */
function hao_strike_damage(damaging,dim,loc,user="player"){
    const { DMG, DMGM } = KATANAWAZA_INFO.hao_strike;
    const damageAmount = damageByEffectStrength(damaging,DMG,DMGM);
    
    const damageTargets = getEntitiesInRange(damaging,shiftLocation(loc,-10.5,-10,-10.5),{x:20,y:20,z:20});
    
    // ロジャーで発動中の白ひげがいるなら、ダメージ消して周囲吹き飛ばし
    // 白ひげで発動中ロジャーがいるなら、ダメージとパーティクル消す
    const rogerCancel = user === "roger" && damageTargets.some(target => target.typeId == "op_asa:newgate" && target.getProperty("op_asa:hao_strike_state")===true);
    const newgateCancel = user === "newgate" && damageTargets.some(target => target.typeId == "op_asa:roger" && target.getProperty("op_asa:hao_strike_state")===true);

    // ダメージ
    if(!rogerCancel && !newgateCancel){
        for(const target of damageTargets){
            applyVarious({
                target,
                damaging,
                damage:{amount:damageAmount,cause:"void"},
                knockback:{type:"front",horizontalStrength:14,verticalStrength:1.5}
            });
        }
    }

    // 吹き飛ばしと衝突パーティクル (ダメージ範囲より大きい、連続で与える)
    if(rogerCancel){
        dim.spawnParticle("op_asa:hao_strike_crash_particle",loc);
        const knockbackTargets = getEntitiesInRange(damaging,shiftLocation(loc,-32.5,-32,-32.5),{x:64,y:64,z:64}).filter(e => {
            const id = e.typeId;
            if((id == "op_asa:roger" || id == "op_asa:newgate") && e.getProperty("op_asa:hao_strike_state")===true) return false;
            return true;
        });
        const delays = [0, 2, 4, 6];
        for (const delay of delays) {
            system.runTimeout(() => {
                for (const target of knockbackTargets) {
                    applyVarious({
                        target,
                        damaging,
                        knockback: {
                            type: "sphere",
                            horizontalStrength: 5,
                            verticalStrength: 1
                        }
                    });
                }
            }, delay);
        }
    }

    // パーティクル
    if(!newgateCancel) dim.spawnParticle("op_asa:hao_strike_particle",loc);

    // サウンド
    dim.playSound("raimeihakke",loc,{volume:1.25,pitch:1.5});
}
/**
 * 焔裂き
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function homurasaki(player){
    const { CDC, CDD } = KATANAWAZA_INFO.homurasaki;

    katanawazaCoolDown(player,CDC,CDD);

    const loc = player.location;
    
    player.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:homurasaki_particle",loc);

    const targets = player.dimension.getEntities({location:loc,maxDistance:7,families:["waza","fire"]});
    for(const target of targets){
        target.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:meramera_arm_particle",shiftLocation(target.location,0,0.5,0));
        target.remove();
    }

    player.extinguishFire(true);
    
    player.dimension.playSound("sword.swing",player.location);

    fillCommand(player,loc,[-6,-1,-6],[6,6,6],BlockPermutation.resolve("air"),["fire"]);
}
/**
 * 雷鳴八卦
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function raimeihakke(player){
    const { DMG, DMGM, CDC, CDD } = KATANAWAZA_INFO.raimeihakke;
    const damageAmount = damageByEffectStrength(player,DMG,DMGM);

    const startLocation = player.location;

    const cos0 = Math.cos(player.getRotation().x * (Math.PI/180));
    const sin0 = Math.sin(player.getRotation().x * (Math.PI/180));
    const horizontalStrength = player.getRotation().x < 0 ? 35 * cos0 : 35;
    const verticalStrength = Math.max(0,-3 * sin0);
    applySelfKnockback(player,horizontalStrength,verticalStrength);

    player.addEffect("slow_falling",40,{showParticles:false});

    player.dimension.playSound("raimeihakke",player.location,{volume:1,pitch:1.5});
    
    katanawazaCoolDown(player,CDC,CDD);

    // 静止、ダメージ発生
    system.runTimeout(()=>{
        player.clearVelocity();
        const stopLocation = shiftLocation(player.location,convertRotYtoPosXZ(player).x*2,0,convertRotYtoPosXZ(player).z*2);
        rushAttack({
            damaging:player,
            startLocation,
            stopLocation,
            volume:{x:4,y:4,z:4},
            damage:{amount:damageAmount,cause:"entityAttack"},
            knockback:{type:"front",horizontalStrength:7,verticalStrength:1},
            particle:{trailParticleId:"op_asa:raimeihakke_rush_particle"}
        });
    },3);
}

/**
 * 金剛鏑-発射物
 * @param {Entity} entity 
 */
export function kongokabura_p(entity){
    if(removeProjectileInBLock(entity)) return;

    const projectileComp = entity.getComponent("projectile");

    if(projectileComp==undefined) return;
    const owner = projectileComp.owner;
    
    const { DMG, DMGM } = KATANAWAZA_INFO.kongokabura;
    const damageAmount = owner.typeId == "op_asa:kaido" ? 80 : damageByEffectStrength(owner,DMG,DMGM);
    
    const dim = entity.dimension;
    dim.spawnParticle("op_asa:kongokabura_p_particle1",entity.location);
    dim.spawnParticle("op_asa:kongokabura_p_particle2",entity.location);

    for(const targetEntity of getEntitiesInRange(owner,shiftLocation(entity.location,-3,-2.5,-3),{x:5,y:5,z:5})){
        if(targetEntity != owner){
            applyVarious({
                target:targetEntity,
                damaging:owner,
                damage:{amount:damageAmount,cause:"entityAttack"}
            });
        }
    }
}
/**
 * 引奈落-開始
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function ragunaraku_start(player){

    // プレイヤーの座標
    const playerLoc = player.location;

    // ターゲットの座標
    let targetLoc = playerLoc;

    // エンティティ→ブロックの順にターゲットを選定
    const entityRay = player.getEntitiesFromViewDirection({maxDistance:64});
    if(entityRay.length){
        targetLoc = entityRay[0].entity.location;
    }else{
        const blockRay = player.getBlockFromViewDirection({maxDistance:128});
        if(blockRay!=undefined){
            targetLoc = blockRay.block.location;
        }
    }

    // ターゲットの座標をプロパティに保存
    player.setDynamicProperty("target_location",targetLoc);

    // ターゲットの座標の真上になるように移動する
    // ターゲットとのy座標距離
    const distY = targetLoc.y - playerLoc.y;

    // ターゲットとの距離
    const targetDist = getDistance(playerLoc,targetLoc);
    const horizontalStrength = player.isOnGround ? targetDist/3 : targetDist/4;
    const verticalStrength = 2.5 + distY/10;
    applySelfKnockback(player,horizontalStrength,verticalStrength);
    // 

    player.addEffect("slow_falling",100,{showParticles:false});
}
/**
 * 引奈落-落下開始
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function ragunaraku_falling_start(player){
    system.runTimeout(()=>{
        player.addEffect("slow_falling",40,{showParticles:false});
        applySelfKnockback(player,0,-15);
    },10);
}
/**
 * 引奈落-落下中
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function ragunaraku_falling(player){
    // ターゲットの座標
    const targetLoc = player.getDynamicProperty("target_location");

    // 地面にいるか、ターゲットの座標のy座標以下なら発動
    if(player.isOnGround || (targetLoc!=undefined && player.location.y <= targetLoc.y+1)){
        ragunaraku(player);
    }
}
/**
 * 引奈落
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function ragunaraku(player){
    const { DMG, DMGM, CDC, CDD } = KATANAWAZA_INFO.ragunaraku;
    const damageAmount = damageByEffectStrength(player,DMG,DMGM);

    const dim = player.dimension;
    const loc0 = convertRotYtoPosXZ(player);
    const loc = shiftLocation(player.location,loc0.x*1.75,0.5,loc0.z*1.75);

    for(const targetEntity of getEntitiesInRange(player,shiftLocation(player.location,-4,-3.5,-4),{x:7,y:7,z:7})){
        if(targetEntity != player){
            applyVarious({
                target:targetEntity,
                damaging:player,
                damage:{amount:damageAmount,cause:"entityAttack"},
                knockback:{type:"front",horizontalStrength:5,verticalStrength:1.5}
            });
        }
    }

    // 爆発召喚
    spawnExplosion(dim,loc,4,false);
    spawnExplosion(dim,shiftLocation(loc,0,-3,0),4,false);

    // 演出
    dim.playSound("raimeihakke",player.location,{pitch:1.5});
    dim.spawnParticle("op_asa:ragunaraku_particle1",loc);
    dim.spawnParticle("op_asa:ragunaraku_particle2",loc);
    dim.spawnParticle("op_asa:ragunaraku_particle4",loc);

    setSpCharge(player,"uncharged");
    setScoreUtility(player,"spcharge",0);
    katanawazaCoolDown(player,CDC,CDD);
}
/**
 * 冥王の一閃
 * @param {Entity} entity 
 */
export function rayleighsword_flash_slash(entity){
    const { DMG, DMGM, CDC, CDD } = KATANAWAZA_INFO.flash_slash;
    const damageAmount = damageByEffectStrength(entity,DMG,DMGM);

    const maxDistance = 64;
    const loc = entity.getHeadLocation();

    let teleportLoc;

    // 幅でターゲットとって、その目の前にテレポート
    const targets = getEntitiesInFront(entity,[5,5],64);
    if (targets.length > 0) {
        const target = targets[0];
        const targetLoc = target.location;
        const dir = getDirectionVector3(targetLoc,loc);

        teleportLoc =  {
            x: targetLoc.x + dir.x,
            y: targetLoc.y + dir.y,
            z: targetLoc.z + dir.z
        };
        
    } else {
        const blockHit = entity.getBlockFromViewDirection({maxDistance});
        if (blockHit) {
            // ブロックがあるならその少し前
            teleportLoc = caret(loc,entity.getRotation(),[0,0,Math.min(16,getDistance(blockHit.block.center(),loc) - 1.5)]);
        } else {
            teleportLoc = caret(loc,entity.getRotation(),[0,0,24]);
        }
    }
    
    // テレポート
    system.runTimeout(()=>{
        entity.teleport(teleportLoc);
        rushAttack({
            damaging:entity,
            startLocation:loc,
            stopLocation:teleportLoc,
            volume:{x:5,y:5,z:5},
            damage:{
                amount:damageAmount,cause:"entityAttack",katanawaza:true
            },
            knockback:{
                verticalStrength:1,horizontalStrength:5
            },
            particle:{
                trailParticleId:"op_asa:rayleighsword_flash_slash_particle"
            }
        });
        // サウンド
        entity.dimension.playSound("rayleighkatana_flash_slash",loc,{pitch:1.5});
        system.runTimeout(()=>{
            entity.dimension.playSound("rayleighkatana_flash_slash",teleportLoc,{pitch:1.5});
        },1);
    },1);

    if (isPlayer(entity)) {
        katanawazaCoolDown(entity,CDC,CDD);
    }
}
/**
 * 冥王の威圧-開始
 * @param {Entity} entity 
 */
export function rayleighkatana_dread_start(entity){
    const dim = entity.dimension;
    const loc = entity.location;
    const viewD = entity.getViewDirection();
    const rot = entity.getRotation();

    for (let x = -4; x < 5; x++) {
        const exeLoc = caretZ(loc,rot,[x,0,4]);
        destroyBlock(dim.getBlock(shiftLocation(exeLoc,0,-1,0)),false,"destroy");
        dim.spawnParticle("op_asa:riki_lariat_explode",exeLoc);
    }

    for (const target of getEntitiesInRange(entity,shiftLocation(loc,-8,-8,-8),{x:15,y:15,z:15})) {
        target.applyImpulse({x:viewD.x,y:0.2,z:viewD.z});
        target.applyDamage(1,{cause:"piston",damagingEntity:entity});
    }
}
/**
 * 冥王の威圧-ノックバック
 * @param {Player} entity 
 */
export function rayleighkatana_dread(entity){
    const { CDC, CDD } = KATANAWAZA_INFO.dread;

    const dim = entity.dimension;
    const loc = entity.location;
    const viewD = entity.getViewDirection();
    const horizontalStrength = isPlayer(entity) ? 3 : 7;
    const verticalStrength = isPlayer(entity) ? 0.75 : 1.25;
    const dist = isPlayer(entity) ? 5 : 32;
    const damageAmount = getStatusLevel(entity)*2;

    dim.spawnParticle("op_asa:haoshoku_particle_lv1",caret(entity.getHeadLocation(),entity.getRotation(),[0,0,1]));
    dim.spawnParticle("op_asa:riki_block_cloud_1",loc);
    dim.playSound("dread_shockwave",loc);

    for (const target of getEntitiesInRange(entity,shiftLocation(loc,-dist,-dist,-dist),{x:dist*2-1,y:dist*2-1,z:dist*2-1})) {
        target.applyImpulse({x:viewD.x*horizontalStrength,y:verticalStrength,z:viewD.z*horizontalStrength});
        target.addEffect("slowness",200,{amplifier:0,showParticles:true});
        target.addEffect("mining_fatigue",200,{amplifier:0,showParticles:true});
        target.applyDamage(damageAmount,{cause:"piston",damagingEntity:entity});
    }

    if (isPlayer(entity)) {
        setSpCharge(entity,"charged_attack");
        katanawazaCoolDown(entity,CDC,CDD);
        entity.inputPermissions.setPermissionCategory(2,false);
        system.runTimeout(()=>{
            entity.inputPermissions.setPermissionCategory(2,true);
        },15);
    }
}

export function rayleighkatana_hao_release(entity){
    const { CDC, CDD } = KATANAWAZA_INFO.hao_release;

        entity.addEffect("slowness",25,{amplifier:20,showParticles:false});
    }
}
/**
 * 冥王の看破
 * @param {Player} entity 
 * @param {Entity} [target] 
 */
export function rayleighsaber_counter(entity,target=undefined){

    // ガード　　→　カウンター
    // 押し出しダメージ　→　テレポートからダメージとノックバック

    const dim = entity.dimension;
    const loc = entity.location;
    const viewD = entity.getViewDirection();

    // ガードして押し出し
    entity.clearVelocity();
    dim.spawnParticle(`op_asa:just_guard_particle`,caretZ(entity.getHeadLocation(),entity.getRotation(),[0,0.1,1]));
    dim.playSound("guard_counter_sword",loc);
    for(const impluseTarget of getEntitiesDistance(entity,loc,4,true)){
        impluseTarget.applyDamage(0.00001,{cause:"entityAttack",damagingEntity:entity});
        impluseTarget.applyImpulse({x:viewD.x,y:0.75,z:viewD.z});
    }

    // クールダウン
    if (isPlayer(entity)) {
        katanawazaCoolDown(entity,"2",25); // 突進だけ実質短縮
    }


    // ターゲットがいる場合はカウンター実行
    const targetEntity = target ? target : entity.dimension.getEntities({tags:["rayleighsaber_counter_target"],maxDistance:64,location:loc})[0];
    if (targetEntity) {

        // テレポートしてダメージとノックバック
        system.runTimeout(() => {
            // プレイヤーの場合は、アイテム持ってるならアニメーション開始させる、持ってないならテレポート自体実行しない
            if (isPlayer(entity)) {
                if (entity.getComponent("equippable").getEquipment("Mainhand")?.typeId == "op_asa:rayleighsaber_counter") {
                    entity.setProperty("op_asa:spcharge","charged_attack");
                }else{
                    return;
                }
            }

            const targetLoc = targetEntity.location;
            const dir = getDirectionVector3(targetLoc,loc);
            const teleportLoc =  {
                x: targetLoc.x + dir.x,
                y: targetLoc.y + dir.y,
                z: targetLoc.z + dir.z
            };
            entity.teleport(teleportLoc,{rotation:entity.getRotation()});
            
            system.runTimeout(()=>{
                dim.spawnParticle("op_asa:rayleighsaber_counter_particle",teleportLoc);
                dim.playSound("rayleighsaber_counter",teleportLoc);
            },1);
            system.runTimeout(()=>{
                for (const damageTarget of getEntitiesInRange(entity,shiftLocation(teleportLoc,-3,-1,-3),{x:5,y:5,z:5})) {
                    const damage = damageByPct(damageTarget,5,"max");
                    applyVarious({
                        target:damageTarget,
                        damaging:entity,
                        knockback:{type:"front",horizontalStrength:7,verticalStrength:1},
                        damage:{amount:damage,katanawaza:true,cause:"override"}
                    });
                }
            },3);

            // // クールダウン
            // if (isPlayer(entity)) {
            //     katanawazaCoolDown(entity,"2",15); // 突進だけ実質短縮
            //     // for (const category of COOLDOWN_CATEGORY_KATANA) {
            //     //     player.startItemCooldown(category,15);
            //     // }
            // }

        },10);

        targetEntity.removeTag("rayleighsaber_counter_target");
    }
}


/**
 * 指定したtypeに任意のTickのクールダウンを与え、
 * それ以外の剣術に15Tickのクールダウンを与える(15tick以上クールダウンが残っているなら実行しない)
 * @param {Player} player 
 * @param {string} type 
 * @param {number} tickDuration 
 */
function katanawazaCoolDown(player,type,tickDuration) {
    const targetCategory = `katanawaza${type}`;
    for (const category of COOLDOWN_CATEGORY_KATANA) {
        if (category === targetCategory) {
            player.startItemCooldown(category,tickDuration);
        } else {
            const currentCT = player.getItemCooldown(category);
            if (currentCT < 15) player.startItemCooldown(category,15);
        }
    }
}

/**

 * @param {Entity} entity 
 */
export function ikoku_p(entity){
    const projectileComp = entity.getComponent("projectile");

    if(projectileComp==undefined) return;
    const owner = projectileComp.owner;

    const targets = getEntitiesInRange(owner,shiftLocation(entity.location,-4,-3.5,-4),{x:7,y:7,z:7});
    for(const targetEntity of targets){
        applyVarious({
            target:targetEntity,
            damaging:owner,
            damage:{amount:damageByEffectStrength(owner,40,1.1),cause:"entityAttack"},
            knockback:{type:"front",horizontalStrength:7,verticalStrength:0.75,knockbackLocation:entity.location}
        });
    }

    entity.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:ikoku_particle1",entity.location);
    entity.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:ikoku_particle2",entity.location);

    fillCommand(entity,entity.location,[-2,-2,-2],[2,2,2],BlockPermutation.resolve("air"));
    fillCommand(entity,entity.location,[-3,-1,-3],[3,1,3],BlockPermutation.resolve("air"));
    fillCommand(entity,entity.location,[-1,-1,-3],[1,1,3],BlockPermutation.resolve("air"));
    fillCommand(entity,entity.location,[-1,-3,-1],[1,3,1],BlockPermutation.resolve("air"));
}
/**
 * モーガン斧-振り下ろし 16 1.2
 * @param {Entity} entity 
 */
export function morganaxe_attack(entity){
	const dim = entity.dimension;

	const loc = entity.location;
	const locX = loc.x;
	const locY = loc.y;
	const locZ = loc.z;
	const pos = convertRotYtoPosXZ(entity);
	const posX = pos.x;
	const posZ = pos.z;
	
	function exe(count = 1) {
		if (count >= 15) return;

		const exeLoc = {x:locX + posX*count, y:locY, z:locZ + posZ*count};

		// ブロック破壊
		fillCommandDestroy(entity,exeLoc,[-1,-1,0],[1,1,0]);
		fillCommandDestroy(entity,exeLoc,[0,-1,-1],[0,1,1]);

		// パーティクル
		dim.spawnParticle("op_asa:morgan_attack_particle",exeLoc);
		
        // ダメージ
        for(const targetEntity of getEntitiesInRange(entity,shiftLocation(exeLoc,-1.5,-1,-1.5),{x:2,y:5,z:2})){
            applyVarious({
                target:targetEntity,
                damaging:entity,
                damage:{amount:damageByEffectStrength(entity,16,1.2),cause:"entityAttack",katanawaza:true}
            });
        }

		// ループ
		system.runTimeout(() => {
			exe(count + 2);
		}, 1);
	}

	exe();

    if (isPlayer(entity)) entity.startItemCooldown(COOLDOWN_CATEGORY_KATANA[0],100);

}

 * ヒグマの刀

world.afterEvents.worldLoad.subscribe(() => {
	// ダイナミックプロパティ初期設定
	for(const worldDynamicPropId of worldDynamicPropList){
		const worldDynamicProp = world.getDynamicProperty(worldDynamicPropId);
		if(worldDynamicProp==undefined){
			world.setDynamicProperty(worldDynamicPropId,true);
		}
	}
	// スコアボード初期設定
	ensureRequiredScoreboards();
});
const worldDynamicPropList = [
	"akumanomi_exp","akumanomi_death","block_breakable","block_replaceable","healthbar_visible"
]

});

	entityDie(ev);
});


// プレイヤーがスポーンした時
world.afterEvents.playerSpawn.subscribe(ev => {
	const player = ev.player;
	// リスポーンは除外
	if (!ev.initialSpawn) return;

	// 最大体力が20の場合は初期設定を行う(後からアドオン入れた時に修正するため)
	const healthComp = player.getComponent("health");
	if (healthComp.defaultValue == 20) {
		// world.sendMessage("fix");
		player.triggerEvent("minecraft:entity_spawned");
	}
});
// ジャンプとスニーク
world.afterEvents.playerButtonInput.subscribe(ev => {

	const player = ev.player;
	const input = ev.button;
	const newButtonState = ev.newButtonState;

	// スペクテイターは実行しない
	if(player.getGameMode()=="spectator") return;

	// スニーク
	if(input == "Sneak"){
		if(newButtonState == "Pressed"){
			pressedSneak(player);
		}else{
			releasedSneak(player);
		}
	}
	// ジャンプ
	else{
		if(newButtonState != "Pressed") return;

		const akuma = player.getProperty("op_asa:akumanomi");
		if(akuma!=14) return;

		const flyProp = player.getProperty("op_asa:test_prop");
		
		// クリエイティブ飛行中は飛行モードを終わらせる
		if(player.isFlying){
			if(flyProp!=0){
				player.setProperty("op_asa:test_prop",0);
				showSubtitle(player,"rawtext.boundman.fly.creative",15);
			}
			return;
		}

		const akumaType = player.getProperty("op_asa:akumanomi_type");

		if(akumaType==41){
			// 飛行モードでないなら２回ジャンプで飛行モード１に変更
			if(flyProp==0){
				// 入れ替え準備中
				if(player.hasTag("test_prop")){
					player.setProperty("op_asa:test_prop",1);
					showSubtitle(player,"rawtext.boundman.fly.1",15);
				}
				// 入れ替え準備開始
				else{
					player.addTag("test_prop");
					// 入れ替え準備解除
					system.runTimeout(()=>{
						player.removeTag("test_prop");
					},4);
				}
			}
			// 飛行モードなら１回ジャンプで飛行モード１と２を切り替え、２回ジャンプで飛行モード終了
			else{
				// 入れ替え準備中
				if(player.hasTag("test_prop")){
					player.setProperty("op_asa:test_prop",0);
					showSubtitle(player,"rawtext.boundman.fly.0",15);
				}
				// 入れ替え準備開始
				else{
					const newProp = (flyProp % 2) + 1;
					player.setProperty("op_asa:test_prop",newProp);
					showSubtitle(player,`rawtext.boundman.fly.${newProp}`,15);

					player.addTag("test_prop");
					// 入れ替え準備解除
					system.runTimeout(()=>{
						player.removeTag("test_prop");
					},4);
				}
			}
		}
		else if(akumaType==5){
			// ２回ジャンプで飛行モード開始と終了
			// 入れ替え準備中
			if(player.hasTag("test_prop")){
				const newProp = 1 - flyProp;
				player.setProperty("op_asa:test_prop",newProp);
				showSubtitle(player,`rawtext.boundman.fly.${newProp}`,15);
			}
			// 入れ替え準備開始
			else{
				player.addTag("test_prop");
				// 入れ替え準備解除
				system.runTimeout(()=>{
					player.removeTag("test_prop");
				},4);
			}
		}
	}
});
// エンティティインタラクト
world.afterEvents.playerInteractWithEntity.subscribe(ev => {

	const target = ev.target;
	const player = ev.player;
	const itemStack = ev.itemStack;

	// カスタム図鑑
	if(target.typeId == "op_asa:akumanomizukan_custom"){
		akumanomizukan_custom_entity(target,player,itemStack);
	}
	// 船員１リスポーン
	else if(target.typeId == "op_asa:kaizoku_neo_respawner"){
		kaizoku_neo_respawn_start(target,player);
	}
	// 同盟フォーム
	else if(itemStack?.typeId == "op_asa:pirate_alliance_item"){
		showAllianceOnInteract(player,target);
	}
});
