// tick
system.runInterval(() => {

	const players = world.getAllPlayers();
	for(const player of players){

		const akuma = player.getProperty("op_asa:akumanomi");
		const akumaType = player.getProperty("op_asa:akumanomi_type");

		const bootsProp = player.getProperty("op_asa:boots");

		const healthComp = player.getComponent("health");
		const currentHealth = healthComp.currentValue;
		const effectiveMaxHealth = healthComp.effectiveMax;

		const equippableComp = player.getComponent("equippable");
		
		// // アクションバー
		showActionbar(player,akuma,akumaType,currentHealth,effectiveMaxHealth);

		// 剃有効-移動速度上昇
		if(player.isSprinting && bootsProp.includes("soru")){
			if((!player.getEffect("speed") || player.getEffect("speed").duration<=2)){
				player.addEffect("speed",20,{amplifier:2,showParticles:false});
			}
		}

		// 水中効果
		waterEffect(player,equippableComp,akuma);

		// 能力者関連のTickイベント
		if(akuma != 0) akumaTickEvent(player,akuma,akumaType,equippableComp,bootsProp);
		
		// 20tickごとに実行
		if(system.currentTick%20 === 0){
			// 覇気エフェクト
			hakiEffect(player);
			// 自然回復
			naturalRegeneration(player,healthComp,currentHealth);
		}
	}
});

/**
 * 自然回復
 * @param {Player} player 
 * @param {EntityHealthComponent} healthComp 
 * @param {Number} currentHealth 
 */
function naturalRegeneration(player,healthComp,currentHealth){

	// ===== 体力 =====
	const defaultHealth = healthComp.defaultValue;
	// player.sendMessage(`体力: ${currentHealth} / ${defaultHealth}`);
	if(currentHealth>=defaultHealth) return; // 体力が最大以上なら実行しない

    // ===== 満腹度 =====
    const hungerComp = player.getComponent("player.hunger");
	const hungerCurrent = hungerComp.currentValue;
	if(hungerCurrent!=20) return; // 満腹度が最大ではないなら実行しない

    // ===== 隠し満腹度 =====
    const saturationComp = player.getComponent("player.saturation");
    const saturationCurrent = saturationComp.currentValue;
	// player.sendMessage(`隠し満腹度: ${saturationCurrent}`);


	// ===== 満腹度消費して体力回復 =====
	const healValue = saturationCurrent>=2 ? 2 : 1;
    if(saturationCurrent>=1){
		// 隠し満腹度が1以上なら1減らす
        saturationComp.setCurrentValue(saturationCurrent-healValue);
    }else{
		// それ以外は満腹度を1減らす
        hungerComp.setCurrentValue(Math.max(0,hungerComp.currentValue-healValue));
    }
	healthComp.setCurrentValue(Math.min(defaultHealth,currentHealth+healValue));
}
/**
 * 水中効果(バフ、デバフなど)
 * @param {Player} player 
 * @param {Number} akuma 
 * @param {EntityEquippableComponent} equippableComp 
 */
function waterEffect(player,equippableComp,akuma){
	const perm = player.inputPermissions;

	// シャボン
	if(equippableComp.getEquipment(EquipmentSlot.Offhand)?.typeId == "op_asa:soap_bubbles") {
		maintainEffect(player,"water_breathing",0,4);
		if (perm.isPermissionCategoryEnabled(6) == false) perm.setPermissionCategory(6,true);
		return;
	}

	// 水中ではない
	if(player.getProperty("op_asa:is_underwater") == false) {
		if (perm.isPermissionCategoryEnabled(6) == false) perm.setPermissionCategory(6,true);
		return;
	}

	// クリエイティブモードか非能力者
	if(player.getGameMode() == GameMode.Creative || akuma == 0) {
		if (perm.isPermissionCategoryEnabled(6) == false) perm.setPermissionCategory(6,true);
		return;
	}

	// デバフ
	maintainEffect(player,"slowness",10,4);
	maintainEffect(player,"weakness",10,4);
	maintainEffect(player,"mining_fatigue",10,4);
	clearAllSkill(player);
	if (perm.isPermissionCategoryEnabled(6) == true) perm.setPermissionCategory(6,false);
}
/**
 * 覇気エフェクト
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
function hakiEffect(player){
	const hakiInfusion = player.getProperty("op_asa:haki_infusion");
	const isHaki = hakiInfusion.includes("buso") || hakiInfusion.includes("ryuo");
	const isHao = hakiInfusion.includes("hao");
	const b_haki_exp = player.getProperty("op_asa:b_haki_exp");
	// 覇王色武装色
	if(isHaki && isHao){
		const strAmp = getStatusLevel(player) < 50 ? 3 : 4;
		const resAmp = b_haki_exp < 10 ? 0 : b_haki_exp < 30 ? 1 : b_haki_exp < 50 ? 2 : 3;
		player.addEffect("strength",30,{amplifier:strAmp,showParticles:false});
		player.addEffect("resistance",30,{amplifier:resAmp,showParticles:false});
	}
	// 武装色だけ
	else if(isHaki){
		const strAmp = b_haki_exp < 20 ? 0 : b_haki_exp < 40 ? 1 : b_haki_exp < 50 ? 2 : 3;
		const resAmp = b_haki_exp < 10 ? 0 : b_haki_exp < 30 ? 1 : b_haki_exp < 50 ? 2 : 3;
		player.addEffect("strength",30,{amplifier:strAmp,showParticles:false});
		player.addEffect("resistance",30,{amplifier:resAmp,showParticles:false});
	}
	// 覇王色だけ
	else if(isHao){
		const strAmp = getStatusLevel(player) < 50 ? 2 : 3;
		player.addEffect("strength",30,{amplifier:strAmp,showParticles:false});
	}
}
/**
 * 能力者関連のTickイベント
 * @param {Player} player 
 * @param {Number} akuma 
 * @param {Number} akumaType 
 * @param {EntityEquippableComponent} equippableComp 
 * @param {String} bootsProp 
 */
function akumaTickEvent(player,akuma,akumaType,equippableComp,bootsProp){
	// world.sendMessage(`hunger: ${player.getComponent("player.hunger").currentValue} | satration:${player.getComponent("player.saturation").currentValue}`)

	if(akuma == 1){// hie
		// 足元氷設置と速度上昇
		if(!player.isInWater && bootsProp.includes("logia")){
			const headRot = player.getRotation().x;

			if(headRot <= 30){
				fillCommandReplaceAir(player,player.location,[1,0,1],[-1,0,-1],BlockPermutation.resolve("op_asa:hiehie_block").withState("op_asa:type","ice_walk"));
			}
			else if(headRot <= 60){
				fillCommandReplaceAir(player,player.location,[1,-1,1],[-1,-1,-1],BlockPermutation.resolve("op_asa:hiehie_block").withState("op_asa:type","ice_walk"));
			}
			else if(headRot <= 80){
				fillCommandReplaceAir(player,player.location,[1,-2,1],[-1,-2,-1],BlockPermutation.resolve("op_asa:hiehie_block").withState("op_asa:type","ice_walk"));
			}
			else if(true){
				fillCommandReplaceAir(player,player.location,[1,-3,1],[-1,-3,-1],BlockPermutation.resolve("op_asa:hiehie_block").withState("op_asa:type","ice_walk"));
			}

			player.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:partisan_particle",player.location);

			// 直下のブロックが氷なら速度上昇
            const belowBLockRay = player.dimension.getBlockFromRay(player.location,{x:0,y:-100,z:0});
			if(belowBLockRay!=undefined){
				const belowBLock = belowBLockRay.block;
				if(belowBLock.typeId == "ice" || belowBLock.typeId == "packed_ice" || belowBLock.typeId == "blue_ice" || belowBLock.typeId == "hiehie_block"){
					if((!player.getEffect("speed") || player.getEffect("speed").duration<=2)){
						player.addEffect("speed",20,{amplifier:2,showParticles:false});
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else if(akuma == 4){// suna
		// 飛行
		if(!player.isInWater && bootsProp.includes("logia")){
			if(player.isJumping){
				// ジャンプ長押しが10未満
				if (getScoreUtility(player,"jumping_time")<5){
					operationScoreUtility(player,"jumping_time",1);
				}
				// ジャンプ長押しが10以上
				else{
					applySelfKnockback(player,1,0.2);
					if(!player.getEffect("slow_falling") || player.getEffect("slow_falling").duration<=2){
						player.addEffect("slow_falling",20,{amplifier:1,showParticles:false});
					}
				}
			}else{
				setScoreUtility(player,"jumping_time",0);
			}
		}
	}
	else if(akuma == 8){// mera
		// 飛行
		if(!player.isInWater && bootsProp.includes("logia")){
			if(player.isJumping){
				// ジャンプ長押しが10未満
				if (getScoreUtility(player,"jumping_time")<5){
					operationScoreUtility(player,"jumping_time",1);
				}
				// ジャンプ長押しが10以上
				else{
					applySelfKnockback(player,1,0.2);
					if(!player.getEffect("slow_falling") || player.getEffect("slow_falling").duration<=2){
						player.addEffect("slow_falling",20,{amplifier:1,showParticles:false});
					}
				}
			}else{
				setScoreUtility(player,"jumping_time",0);
			}
		}
	}
	else if((akuma == 9 || akuma == 15) && akumaType==2){// yami
		// パーティクル
		player.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:yamiyami_particle",player.location);

		// 毒、衰弱、やけど解除
		player.removeEffect("poison");
		player.removeEffect("fatal_poison");
		player.removeEffect("wither");
		player.extinguishFire(true);
		
		// 火炎耐性
		const effect = player.getEffect("fire_resistance");
		if(!effect || effect.duration<=2) player.addEffect("fire_resistance",20,{amplifier:3,showParticles:false});

		// 状態変化
		if(system.currentTick%20===0){
			if(getScoreUtility(player,"sppower")<=0){
				player.setProperty("op_asa:akumanomi_type",1);
			}else{
				operationScoreUtility(player,"sppower",-1);
			}
		}

	}
	else if(akuma == 13){// soru
		// ゼウス,プロメテウスに乗ってる時、火炎耐性
		const ridingComp = player.getComponent("riding");
		if(ridingComp){
			if(ridingComp.entityRidingOn.matches({families:["soru_rider"]})){
				if(!player.getEffect("fire_resistance") || player.getEffect("fire_resistance").duration<=2){
					player.addEffect("fire_resistance",20,{amplifier:0,showParticles:false});
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else if(akuma == 29){// moku
		// 飛行
		if(!player.isInWater && bootsProp.includes("logia")){
			if(player.isJumping){
				// ジャンプ長押しが10未満
				if (getScoreUtility(player,"jumping_time")<5){
					operationScoreUtility(player,"jumping_time",1);
				}
				// ジャンプ長押しが10以上
				else{
					applySelfKnockback(player,1,0.2);
					if(!player.getEffect("slow_falling") || player.getEffect("slow_falling").duration<=2){
						player.addEffect("slow_falling",20,{amplifier:1,showParticles:false});
					}
				}
			}else{
				setScoreUtility(player,"jumping_time",0);
			}
		}
	}
	else if(akuma==11){// tori
		zoonHealing(player);
		// 再生エフェクトを持っているならパーティクル
		if(player.getEffect("regeneration")) player.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:phoenix_regeneration_particle",player.location);

		// 人獣
		if(akumaType==1){
			// エフェクト
			ensureEffect(player,"speed",20,{amplifier:2,showParticles:false});
			ensureEffect(player,"jump_boost",20,{amplifier:2,showParticles:false});

			// 空中で移動権限があるなら
			if(!player.isOnGround && player.inputPermissions.isPermissionCategoryEnabled(2)){
				// 滞空：移動キー操作なしまたは鳳凰印チャージ中
				if(isInputIdle(player) || player.getTags().includes("hououin_charge")){
					player.setDynamicProperty("accelCharge",undefined);
					exeStayInAir(player);
				}
				// 飛行
				else{
					exeFlying(player,0.75,true);
				}
			}
		}
		// 獣
		else if(akumaType==2){
			// 再生
			ensureEffect(player,"regeneration",20,{amplifier:3,showParticles:false});
			
			// 移動権限があるなら
			if(player.inputPermissions.isPermissionCategoryEnabled(2)){
				// 滞空：移動キー操作なし
				if(isInputIdle(player) || player.getTags().includes("hououin_charge")){
					player.setDynamicProperty("accelCharge",undefined);
					exeStayInAir(player);
				}
				// 飛行
				else{
					exeFlying(player,1,true);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else if(akuma==14){// gom

		// ギア５、ギア５CT以外なら動物系回復
		if(akumaType!=5 && akumaType!=50){
			zoonHealing(player);
		}

		// バウンドマン
		if(akumaType==41){
			// エフェクト
			ensureEffect(player,"jump_boost",20,{amplifier:3,showParticles:false});

			// 飛行モードで移動権限があるなら以下実行
			const flyProp = player.getProperty("op_asa:test_prop");
			if(flyProp==0 || player.inputPermissions.isPermissionCategoryEnabled(2)==false) return;

			// 滞空：移動キー操作なし
			if(isInputIdle(player)){
				player.setDynamicProperty("accelCharge",undefined);
				exeStayInAir(player,true);
			}
			// 飛行
			else{
				if(flyProp==1){
					exeFlying(player,0.6,true);
				}else{
					exeFlying(player,1,true);
				}
			}
		}
		// スネイクマン
		else if(akumaType==43){
			// しゃがんでるとき0、通常時3、ダッシュ時7、クリエで飛んでるとき3
			if(player.isFlying){
				player.addEffect("jump_boost",20,{amplifier:3,showParticles:false});
				player.addEffect("speed",20,{amplifier:3,showParticles:false});
			}else{
				if(player.isSneaking){
					player.removeEffect("jump_boost");
					player.removeEffect("speed");
				}else{
					if(player.isSprinting){
						player.addEffect("jump_boost",20,{amplifier:7,showParticles:false});
						player.addEffect("speed",20,{amplifier:7,showParticles:false});
					}else{
						player.addEffect("jump_boost",20,{amplifier:3,showParticles:false});
						player.addEffect("speed",20,{amplifier:3,showParticles:false});
					}
				}
			}
		}
		// ギア５
		else if(akumaType==5){
			// 再生
			ensureEffect(player,"regeneration",20,{amplifier:3,showParticles:false});
			
			// 通常
			if(player.getProperty("op_asa:gear5_gigant")==0){
				// 跳躍上昇
				if(player.isSprinting){
					ensureEffect(player,"jump_boost",20,{amplifier:9,showParticles:false});
				}else{
					ensureEffect(player,"jump_boost",20,{amplifier:3,showParticles:false});
				}
	
				// 飛行モードで移動権限があるなら以下実行
				const flyProp = player.getProperty("op_asa:test_prop");
				if(flyProp==0 || player.inputPermissions.isPermissionCategoryEnabled(2)==false) return;

				// 移動キー操作ありで飛行
				if(!isInputIdle(player)){
					exeFlying(player,0.5,true);
				}
			}
			// 巨人
			else{
				// 跳躍上昇
				ensureEffect(player,"jump_boost",10,{amplifier:10,showParticles:false});
				// 跳躍上昇削除
				if(!player.isOnGround){
					player.removeEffect("jump_boost");
				}
				// 弱体化
				ensureEffect(player,"weakness",10,{amplifier:100,showParticles:false});
			}

		}
		// ギア５CT
		else if(akumaType==50){
			// エフェクト
			ensureEffect(player,"hunger",20,{amplifier:255,showParticles:false});
			ensureEffect(player,"weakness",20,{amplifier:255,showParticles:false});
			ensureEffect(player,"mining_fatigue",20,{amplifier:255,showParticles:false});
			ensureEffect(player,"slowness",20,{amplifier:2,showParticles:false});
		}
	}
	else if(akuma==20){// uo
		zoonHealing(player);

		// 獣/かえんだいこ
		if(akumaType==1 || akumaType==2){
			// エフェクト
			ensureEffect(player,"slow_falling",10,{amplifier:0,showParticles:false});

			// 空中で移動権限があるなら
			if(!player.isOnGround && player.inputPermissions.isPermissionCategoryEnabled(2)){
				// 滞空：移動キー操作なしまたは鳳凰印チャージ中
				if(isInputIdle(player) || player.getTags().includes("hououin_charge")){
					player.setDynamicProperty("accelCharge",undefined);
					exeStayInAir(player);
				}
				// 飛行
				else{
					exeFlying(player,0.75,true);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else if(akuma==7){// ope

		// ROOM
		if(akumaType==1){
			// 発動サイズダイプロ取得
			const roomScale = player.getDynamicProperty("room_scale");
	
			const playerLoc = player.location;
	
			// Sサイズ
			if(roomScale == 1){
				const allRoom = player.dimension.getEntities({type:"op_asa:room_s",location:playerLoc,maxDistance:16});
				// プレイヤーの所有ROOMを取得
				let num = 0;
				for(const room of allRoom){
					if(room.getComponent("tameable").tamedToPlayer==player){
						num++;
					}
				}
				// 一つもないなら終了
				if(num==0) ope.room_end(player);
			}
			// Mサイズ
			else if(roomScale == 2){
				const allRoom = player.dimension.getEntities({type:"op_asa:room_m",location:playerLoc,maxDistance:32});
				// プレイヤーの所有ROOMを取得
				let num = 0;
				for(const room of allRoom){
					if(room.getComponent("tameable").tamedToPlayer==player){
						num++;
					}
				}
				// 一つもないなら終了
				if(num==0) ope.room_end(player);
			}
			// Lサイズ
			else if(roomScale == 3){
				const allRoom = player.dimension.getEntities({type:"op_asa:room_l",location:playerLoc,maxDistance:64});
				// プレイヤーの所有ROOMを取得
				let num = 0;
				for(const room of allRoom){
					if(room.getComponent("tameable").tamedToPlayer==player){
						num++;
					}
				}
				// 一つもないなら終了
				if(num==0) ope.room_end(player);
			}
		}
		// RROOM
		else if(akumaType==3){
			const allRoom = player.dimension.getEntities({families:["rroom"],location:player.location,maxDistance:96});
			// プレイヤーの所有ROOMを取得
			let num = 0;
			for(const room of allRoom){
				if(room.getComponent("tameable").tamedToPlayer==player){
					num++;
				}
			}
			// 一つもないなら終了
			if(num==0) ope.room_end(player);
		}

	}
	else if(akuma == 23){// hana
		// ウィング持ってるとき低速落下
		if(equippableComp.getEquipment("Mainhand")?.typeId == "op_asa:hanahana_wing"){
			if(!player.getEffect("slow_falling") || player.getEffect("slow_falling").duration<=2){
				player.addEffect("slow_falling",20,{amplifier:0,showParticles:false});
			}
		}
	}
	else if(akuma == 20 || akuma == 22 || akuma == 31){// uo, hito, hito2
		zoonHealing(player);
	}
	else if(akuma==12){// ito
		
		// 空中移動持ってるとき低速落下
		if(equippableComp.getEquipment("Mainhand")?.typeId == "op_asa:itoito_move"){
			if(!player.getEffect("slow_falling") || player.getEffect("slow_falling").duration<=2){
				player.addEffect("slow_falling",20,{amplifier:0,showParticles:false});
			}
		}
	}
	else if(akuma == 36){// numa
		// 乗っているエンティティに透明化、ridePopないエンティティはアニメーション再生
		const rideableComp = player.getComponent("rideable");
		if(rideableComp==undefined) return;

		for(const rider of rideableComp.getRiders()){
			// 透明化
			if(!rider.getEffect("invisibility") || rider.getEffect("invisibility").duration<=2){
				rider.addEffect("invisibility",5,{amplifier:0,showParticles:false});
			}
			// プロパティ持ってないならアニメーション
			if(rider.getProperty("op_asa:ride")==undefined){
				// world.sendMessage(`${rider.typeId}`);
				rider.playAnimation("animation.numa_scale",{nextState:"none",blendOutTime:0,stopExpression:"!q.is_riding"});
			}
		}
	}
	else if(akuma==28){// bara
		// 通常
		if(akumaType==0){
			// 自分の足が存在するなら消す
			const myFeet = bara.getMyFeet(player);
			if(myFeet!=undefined){
				// player.sendMessage("§b[main.js]§f飛行じゃないのに足が存在するから消す");
				myFeet.remove();
			}
		}
		// 飛行
		if(akumaType==1){

			const myFeet = bara.getMyFeet(player);

			if(myFeet==undefined){
				// player.sendMessage("§b[main.js]§fそもそも足が存在しないまたは自分の足が存在しないから終了");
				bara.barabara_fly_end(player,0);
			}else{
				if(getDistance(player.location,myFeet.location)>64){
					// player.sendMessage("§b[main.js]§f自分の足が存在するが64以上離れてるから終了");
					bara.barabara_fly_end(player,1);
				}else{
					// 足が水中
					if(myFeet.isInWater){
						// player.sendMessage("§b[main.js]§f自分の足が存在するが水中だから酔い付与");
						if(player.getEffect("nausea")==undefined || player.getEffect("nausea").duration < 1){
							player.addEffect("nausea",200,{amplifier:1,showParticles:false});
						}
					}
					// ジャンプ
					if(player.isJumping){
						const horizontalStrength = 2 * Math.cos(player.getRotation().x * (Math.PI/180));
						const verticalStrength = (player.getRotation().x < 0 ? 2 : 1) * -Math.sin(player.getRotation().x * (Math.PI/180));
						applySelfKnockback(player,horizontalStrength/1.5,verticalStrength/3);
					}
					// 滞空
					else{
						player.addEffect("slow_falling",10,{amplifier:0,showParticles:false});
						if(system.currentTick%20 === 0){
							player.addEffect("levitation",16,{amplifier:0,showParticles:false});
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else if(akuma==34){// raki
		if(system.currentTick%10 === 0){
			removeBadEffectsConsumePower(player);
		}
	}
}
/**
 * 動物系再生
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
function zoonHealing(player){
	const hpComp = player.getComponent("minecraft:health");
	const currentHp = hpComp.currentValue;
	const defaultHp = hpComp.defaultValue;
	if(currentHp/defaultHp <= 0.25 && currentHp != 0 && (!player.getEffect("regeneration") || player.getEffect("regeneration").duration<=2)){
		player.addEffect("regeneration",30,{amplifier:1,showParticles:false});
	}
}
/**
 * パーセント表示(0~100,5ごと)
 * @param {Number} pctValue
 */
function pct5(pctValue){

	if(pctValue){
		if (pctValue>=1) return 100;

		// 小数第三位で四捨五入
		const pctRoundValue = Math.round(pctValue*100);
		
		// 十の位
		const tens = Math.floor(pctRoundValue/10);
		// 一の位
		const ones = pctRoundValue%10;
		const ones0or5 = tens == 0 ? (ones == 0 ? 0 : 5) : (ones < 5 ? 0 : 5);

		return tens*10 + ones0or5;
	}

	return 0;
}
/**
 * アクションバーチャージゲージ
 * @param {Player} player
 * @param {Number} akumanomi 
 * @param {Number} akumanomiType 
 */
function actionbarCharge(player,akumanomi,akumanomiType){
	const kroom = akumanomi==7 && akumanomiType==2;

	const chargePct = pct5(
		kroom ? player.getProperty("op_asa:kroomcharge")/60 : 
		Math.max(0,getScoreUtility(player,"spcharge"))/20
	);
	if(chargePct==0){
		return "";
	}else{
		return `charge_${chargePct}pct`;
	}
}
/**
 * アクションバーパワースコア
 * @param {Player} player
 */
function actionbarPower(player,akuma,akumaType){

	if(akuma==7){// オペ
			return `${akumaType==1 ? "\ue130 " : akumaType==2 ? "\ue131 " : akumaType==3 ? "\ue132 " : "\ue183"}${Math.max(0,getScoreUtility(player,"sppower"))}/${Math.max(0,getScoreUtility(player,"sppower_max"))}`;
	}
	else if((akuma==9 || akuma==15) && akumaType==2){// ヤミ-闇状態
		return `\ue188${Math.max(0,getScoreUtility(player,"sppower"))}/${Math.max(0,getScoreUtility(player,"sppower_max"))}`;
	}
	else if(akuma==14 && akumaType==40){// ゴム-CT
		return `\ue184${Math.max(0,getScoreUtility(player,"cooltime"))}/120`;
	}
	else if(akuma==14 && akumaType==50){// ゴム-CT
		return `\ue184${Math.max(0,getScoreUtility(player,"cooltime"))}/180`;
	}
	else if(akuma==18){// ワラ,藁人形,降魔の相
		if(akumaType==1){
			return `\ue185${Math.max(0,getScoreUtility(player,"strawman"))}/7`;
		}
		else if(akumaType==2){
			return `\ue186`;
		}
		else if(true){
			return `\ue183${Math.max(0,getScoreUtility(player,"strawman"))}/7`;
		}
	}
	// ゴロ(雷神)、ゴム(ギア４/ギア５)、ドク(毒の巨兵)、ラキ(運)
	else if((akuma==2 && akumaType==1) || (akuma==14 && (akumaType==41 || akumaType==43 || akumaType==5)) || (akuma==30 && akumaType==1) || akuma==34){
		return `\ue183${Math.max(0,getScoreUtility(player,"sppower"))}/${Math.max(0,getScoreUtility(player,"sppower_max"))}`;
	}
	else if(akuma==28 && akumaType==1){// バラ-足距離
		return bara.getMyFeet(player)==undefined ? "\ue187-/64" : `\ue187${Math.floor(getDistance(player.location,bara.getMyFeet(player).location))}/64`;
	}

	return "";
}
/**
 * アクションバーを表示する
 * @param {Player} player 
 * @param {Number} akuma 
 * @param {Number} akumaType 
 * @param {Number} currentHealth 
 * @param {Number} effectiveMaxHealth 
 */
function showActionbar(player,akuma,akumaType,currentHealth,effectiveMaxHealth){
	let current = currentHealth;
	let max = effectiveMaxHealth;
	
	// ===== 体力補正(幽体離脱中) =====
	if(akuma==21 && akumaType==2){
		if(player.dimension.getEntities({tags:[`id${player.id}`]}).length){
			const healthComp = player.dimension.getEntities({tags:[`id${player.id}`]})[0].getComponent("minecraft:health");
			current = healthComp.currentValue;
			max = healthComp.effectiveMax;
		}
	}

	// ===== スニークガード =====
	const guardScore = getScoreUtility(player,"guard_time");
	const guardText = guardScore ? guardScore >= 90 ? `\ue181§b${guardScore}§f` : `\ue181${guardScore}` : "\ue181";

	// ===== オート回避 =====
	const dodgeTxt = player.getProperty("op_asa:auto_dodge") == true ? "\ue182 " : `\ue192${getScoreUtility(player,"auto_dodge_ct")}`;
					 
	// ===== 月歩 =====
	const geppouTxt = !player.isOnGround && player.getProperty("op_asa:boots").includes("geppou") && player.getProperty("op_asa:rokushiki_exp") >= 4 ? `geppou_${Math.max(0,getGeppouCountMax(player) - getGeppouCount(player))}c` : "";

	// 表示する
	player.onScreenDisplay.setActionBar(
		{
			rawtext:[
				{
					text:
					guardText+dodgeTxt+actionbarPower(player,akuma,akumaType)
					+`\n ${Math.ceil(current)}/${max}\n\n\n\n\n`
					+actionbarCharge(player,akuma,akumaType)+`hp_${pct5(current/max)}pct`+geppouTxt
				}
			]
		}
	);
}
/**
 * エフェクトを維持する（切れそうなら再付与）
 * @param {Entity} entity
 * @param {string} effectId
 * @param {number} amplifier 強さ(0~) default: 0
 * @param {number} duration 付与時間（tick）default: 1
 * @param {number} refreshThreshold 残り何tick未満で更新するか default: duration
 */
function maintainEffect(entity,effectId,amplifier=0,duration=1,refreshThreshold=duration){
	const effect = entity.getEffect(effectId);

	if(!effect || effect.duration < refreshThreshold){
		entity.addEffect(effectId,duration,{amplifier,showParticles:false});
	}
}

import { PlayerSwingStartAfterEvent } from "@minecraft/server";
import { dial_charge } from "./dial";
import { replaceEquipment } from "./function";
import { gear5_gigant_attack } from "./akumanomi/gom";
import { kikoku_kroom_attack } from "./akumanomi/ope";
import { goumanosou_attack } from "./akumanomi/wara";

/**
 * 
 * @param {PlayerSwingStartAfterEvent} ev 
 * @returns 
 */
export function playerSwing(ev){
	const source = ev.swingSource;

	// 攻撃と採掘だけ(採掘も入れないとブロック攻撃が取れない)
	if(source == "Attack" || source == "Mine") {
		const player = ev.player;
		const heldItem = ev.heldItemStack;
		const akuma = player.getProperty("op_asa:akumanomi");
		const akumaType = player.getProperty("op_asa:akumanomi_type");


		// ====== 能力関連 ======

		// 巨人攻撃(アイテム関係なし)
		if(akuma == 14 && akumaType == 5 && player.getProperty("op_asa:gear5_gigant")==true){
			gear5_gigant_attack(player);
		}
		// 藁釘(素手)
		else if(akuma == 18 && akumaType == 2 && heldItem==undefined){
			goumanosou_attack(player);
		}


		// ====== アイテム ======

		if(!heldItem) return;
		const itemId = heldItem.typeId;
		const id = itemId.split(":")[1];

		// ダイアルチャージ
		if(['breath_dial','jet_dial','flame_dial','water_dial'].includes(id)){
			dial_charge(player);
		}else if(id == "lamp_dial"){
			player.triggerEvent("lamp_dial_charge");
		}
		// クリマタクト
		else if(id == "sorcery_clima_tact_new"){
			replaceEquipment(player,"Mainhand","op_asa:sorcery_clima_tact_new_long",1,false,"none");
		}else if(id == "sorcery_clima_tact_new_long"){
			replaceEquipment(player,"Mainhand","op_asa:sorcery_clima_tact_new",1,false,"none");
		}


		// ====== 能力アイテム ======

		// kroom攻撃
		if(id == "kikoku_kroom" && akuma == 7 && akumaType == 2){
			kikoku_kroom_attack(player);
		}
	}

};

import { Entity, Player, system } from "@minecraft/server";
import { convertRotYtoPosXZ, removeProjectileInBLock, fillCommandDestroy, stopComboMove, shiftLocation, caretZ, decrementStack } from "./function";
import { getEntitiesInRange, getEntitiesInFront } from "./function/entityFunction";

import { getLevelForExp, updateHakiExp } from "./status";
import { applySelfKnockback, applyVarious, setSpCharge, shootProjectile } from "./function/combatFunction";



/**
 * 六式基礎を使用したとき
 * @param {Player} player
 */
export function rokushiki_base(player){
    const exp = player.getProperty("op_asa:rokushiki_exp");
    updateRokushikiExp(player,exp,exp+1,"base");
}
/**
 * 六式EXP更新
 * @param {Player} player 
 * @param {Number} currentExp 更新前のEXP
 * @param {Number} newExp 更新後のEXP
 * @param {string} [cause="base"] 更新理由(default:base 基礎使用)
 */
function updateRokushikiExp(player,currentExp,newExp,cause="base"){
    // exp最大
    if(currentExp == 50){
        player.sendMessage({rawtext:[{translate:"rawtext.rokushiki.levelmax"}]});
        return;
    }
    
    // exp追加
    player.setProperty("op_asa:rokushiki_exp",newExp);

    // 基礎使用ならスタック減らす
    if(cause=="base") decrementStack(player,1);

    // レベルアップ通知ポイント
    const levelUps = [4, 7, 9, 10, 12, 13, 16];

    // 習得
    if (newExp === 1) {
        player.playSound("random.levelup");
        player.sendMessage({ rawtext: [{ translate: "rawtext.rokushiki.acquired" }] });
    }
    // 六式追加
    else if (levelUps.includes(newExp)) {
        player.playSound("random.levelup");
        player.sendMessage({ rawtext: [{ translate: "rawtext.rokushiki.levelup" }] });
    }
    // 六王銃
    else if (newExp === 19) {
        player.playSound("random.levelup");
        player.sendMessage({ rawtext: [{ translate: "rawtext.rokushiki.levelup.19" }] });
        // すべての六式を習得したとき武装色を自動的に習得
        if (player.getProperty("op_asa:b_haki")==0) updateHakiExp(player,"b_haki",0,1,"set");
    }
    // その他のEXP上昇
    else {
        player.playSound("random.orb");
        player.sendMessage({ rawtext: [{ translate: "rawtext.rokushiki.exp" }] });
    }
}
/**
 * 所属レベルに応じて、六式EXPを補正する
 * @param {Player} player
 * @param {Number} jobExp 所属EXP
 */
export function adjustRokushikiExp(player, jobExp) {
    const jobLevel = getLevelForExp(jobExp);
    const currentExp = player.getProperty("op_asa:rokushiki_exp");

    // レベル2ごとにEXP1上がる（最大50）
    const minExp = Math.min(Math.floor(jobLevel / 2), 50);

    if (currentExp < minExp) {
        updateRokushikiExp(player, currentExp, minExp);
    }
}
/**
 * 指銃
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function shigan(player){

    const damageAmount = 8 + getRokushikiLevel(player)*8;

    for(const target of getEntitiesInFront(player,[2,2],5,true)){
        applyVarious({
            target,
            damaging:player,
            damage:{amount:damageAmount},
            knockback:{horizontalStrength:2,verticalStrength:0.5}
        });
    }

    applySelfKnockback(player,5,0);
}

const geppouCount = new Map();
/**
 * @param {Player} player 
 * @returns {number}
 */
export function getGeppouCountMax(player) {
    return 5 + getRokushikiLevel(player);
}
/**

 * @returns {number}
 */

    return geppouCount.get(player.id) ?? 0;

    geppouCount.delete(player.id);
}
/**
 * 月歩
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function rokushiki_geppou(player){
    // 鉄塊の時は使えない
    if(player.hasTag("rokushiki_tekkai")) return;

    // 回数制限
    const count = getGeppouCount(player);
    if (count >= getGeppouCountMax(player)) {
        return;
    }
    geppouCount.set(player.id, count + 1);

    // 実行
    player.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:rokushiki_geppou_particle",player.location);
    knockbackByViewAndInput(player,1.5,0.75);
    player.addEffect("slow_falling",10,{showParticles:false});
}
/**
 * 入力と視線を考慮してノックバックを与える
 * @param {Player} player - 対象プレイヤー
 * @param {number} strength - ノックバックの強さ（水平）
 * @param {number} vertical - 上方向の強さ
 */
function knockbackByViewAndInput(player, strength = 1, vertical = 1) {
    if (!player?.inputInfo) return;

    const moveVec = player.inputInfo.getMovementVector();
    if (!moveVec) return;

    const inputForward = moveVec.y ?? 0; // W/S
    const inputSide = moveVec.x ?? 0;    // A/D

    const yaw = -(player.getRotation().y ?? 0) * Math.PI / 180;

    // 入力を視線方向に変換
    let dirX = inputForward * Math.sin(yaw) + inputSide * Math.cos(yaw);
    let dirZ = inputForward * Math.cos(yaw) - inputSide * Math.sin(yaw);

    const len = Math.hypot(dirX, dirZ);
    if (len > 0.0001) {
        dirX /= len;
        dirZ /= len;
    } else {
        // 入力なし → 真上に飛ばす場合は水平ゼロ
        dirX = 0;
        dirZ = 0;
    }

    // world.sendMessage(`${player.getRotation().y} | dirX:${dirX} | dirZ:${dirZ}`);
    player.applyKnockback(
        { x: dirX * strength, z: dirZ * strength },
        vertical
    );
}
/**
 * 嵐脚-射撃エンティティ
 * @param {Entity} entity 
 */
export function rokushiki_rankyaku_p(entity){
    if(removeProjectileInBLock(entity,["op_asa:barrier_ball_block","op_asa:barrierbility_block"])) return;

    fillCommandDestroy(entity,entity.location,[-1,0,0],[1,0,0]);
    fillCommandDestroy(entity,entity.location,[0,0,-1],[0,0,1]);
    fillCommandDestroy(entity,entity.location,[0,1,0],[0,1,0]);
    fillCommandDestroy(entity,entity.location,[0,-1,0],[0,-1,0]);
}
/**
 * 六王銃
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function rokuogan(player){

    setSpCharge(player,"uncharged");
    setScoreUtility(player,"spcharge",0);
    player.startItemCooldown("rokushiki",140);
    player.addEffect("slowness",14,{amplifier:2,showParticles:false});

    // プレイヤーのx回転を考慮しない実行座標
    /**@param {Number} num  */
    function exeLoc(num){
        return {
            x:player.getHeadLocation().x + convertRotYtoPosXZ(player).x*num,
            y:player.getHeadLocation().y,
            z:player.getHeadLocation().z + convertRotYtoPosXZ(player).z*num
        }
    }
    const loc1 = exeLoc(1);
    const loc15 = exeLoc(1.5);
    const loc2 = exeLoc(2);
    const loc25 = exeLoc(2.5);
    const loc3 = exeLoc(3);
    const loc35 = exeLoc(3.5);
    const loc4 = exeLoc(4);
    const loc45 = exeLoc(4.5);
    const loc5 = exeLoc(5);
    const loc55 = exeLoc(5.5);
    const loc6 = exeLoc(6);
    
    // ダメージ量
    const damageAmount = 8 + getRokushikiLevel(player)*8;

    // ダメージを与える
    for(const target of getEntitiesInFront(player,[3,3],6,true)){
        applyVarious({
            target,
            damaging:player,
            damage:{amount:damageAmount,cause:"void"},
            knockback:{horizontalStrength:5,verticalStrength:0.75}
        });
    }
    
    // パーティクルを生成する
    player.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:rokuogan_particle1",loc1);
    player.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:rokuogan_particle1",loc15);
    player.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:rokuogan_particle1",loc2);
    player.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:rokuogan_particle1",loc25);
    player.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:rokuogan_particle2",loc1);
    player.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:rokuogan_particle2",loc2);
    system.runTimeout(()=>{
        player.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:rokuogan_particle1",loc3);
        player.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:rokuogan_particle1",loc35);
        player.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:rokuogan_particle1",loc4);
        player.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:rokuogan_particle1",loc45);
        player.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:rokuogan_particle2",loc3);
        player.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:rokuogan_particle2",loc4);
        system.runTimeout(()=>{
            player.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:rokuogan_particle1",loc5);
            player.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:rokuogan_particle1",loc55);
            player.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:rokuogan_particle1",loc6);
            player.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:rokuogan_particle2",loc5);
            player.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:rokuogan_particle2",loc6);
        },1);
    },1);
}
/**
 * 紙絵"残身"
 * @param {Entity} entity 
 */
export function rokushiki_kamie_zanshin(entity){
    const target = entity.dimension.getEntities({tags:["rokushiki_kamie_zanshin_target"],maxDistance:128,location:entity.location})[0];

    if(target==undefined) return;
    
    // 強制終了
    stopComboMove(entity,true,[{cooldownCategory:"rokushiki2",tickDuration:60}]);
    
    // ターゲットに鈍化と酔い、tag取る
    target.addEffect("slowness",40,{amplifier:4});
    target.addEffect("nausea",40,{amplifier:1});
    target.removeTag("rokushiki_kamie_zanshin_target");

    // 残像召喚してテレポート
    entity.dimension.spawnEntity("op_asa:kamie_zanshin_e",entity.location).setRotation(entity.getRotation());
    entity.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:rokushiki_kamie_zanshin_particle",entity.location);
    entity.teleport(caretZ(target.location,target.getRotation(),[0,0,-2]),{rotation:{x:entity.getRotation().x,y:target.getRotation().y}});

}

/**
 * 六式レベルを取得
 ** EXP: 0 ~ 50
 ** LEVEL: 1 ~ 5
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function getRokushikiLevel(player){
    
	const rokushikiExp = player.getProperty("op_asa:rokushiki_exp");
	return rokushikiExp < 20 ? 1 : Math.floor(rokushikiExp/10);
}

import { world, Entity, Player } from "@minecraft/server";
import { SCOREBOARD_DEFINITIONS, SCOREBOARD_REQUIRED } from "./index/scoreboard_index";



/**
 * @param {string} id
 */
function getScoreboardDefinition(id) {
    return Object.values(SCOREBOARD_DEFINITIONS).find(scoreboard => scoreboard.id === id);
}
/**
 * スコアボードを追加(スコアボードが存在してないなら、スコアボードを作成する)
 * @param {string} objId
 */
function addScoreboard(objId){
	if(!world.scoreboard.getObjective(objId)){
		world.scoreboard.addObjective(objId,"");
	}
};
/**
 * スコアを取得(スコアボードが存在している前提で、スコアを取得/スコアがないなら初期値設定)
 * @param {Entity} entity
 * @param {string} objId
 * @returns {number}
 */
function getScore0(entity,objId){
	const scoreboardObjective = world.scoreboard.getObjective(objId);

	// スコアを持ってるなら取得して返す
	if(scoreboardObjective.hasParticipant(entity)){
		return scoreboardObjective.getScore(entity);
	}

	// スコアを持ってないなら初期設定して返す
	const defaultScore = getScoreboardDefinition(objId)?.default ?? 0;
	scoreboardObjective.setScore(entity, defaultScore);

	return defaultScore;
};
/**
 * スコアを取得(スコアボードが存在してないなら追加してから、スコアを取得/スコアがないなら初期値設定)
 * @param {Entity} entity
 * @param {string} objId
 */
export function getScoreUtility(entity,objId){

	addScoreboard(objId);

	return getScore0(entity,objId);
};
/**
 * スコアを設定(スコアボードが存在してないなら追加してから、スコアを設定)
 * @param {Entity} entity
 * @param {string} objId
 * @param {number} score
 */
export function setScoreUtility(entity,objId,score){

	addScoreboard(objId);

	world.scoreboard.getObjective(objId).setScore(entity,score);
};
/**
 * スコアを計算して設定(スコアボードが存在してないなら追加してから、スコアを取得/スコアがないなら初期値設定、スコアを計算して設定)
 * @param {Entity} entity
 * @param {string} objId
 * @param {number} score
 */
export function operationScoreUtility(entity,objId,score){

	addScoreboard(objId);
	
	world.scoreboard.getObjective(objId).setScore(entity,getScore0(entity,objId)+score);
};
/**
 * スコアボード初期設定 (必須のスコアボードが存在しない場合に作成する)
 */
export function ensureRequiredScoreboards() {
	for (const id of Object.values(SCOREBOARD_REQUIRED)) {
		if(!world.scoreboard.getObjective(id)){
			world.scoreboard.addObjective(id,"");
		}
	}
}

			for (const target of getEntitiesInRange(eventEntity,shiftLocation(evLoc,-2,-1,-2),{x:3,y:2,z:3},true)) {
				applyVarious({
					target,
					damaging:eventEntity,
					damage:{amount:4,cause:"none"}
				});
				target.setOnFire(4,true);
			}

			const movementVec = eventEntity.inputInfo.getMovementVector();
			if(movementVec.x!=0 || movementVec.y!=0){
				const evRot = eventEntity.getRotation();

				const block0 = evDim.getBlock(caretZ(evLoc,evRot,[0,0,1]));
				const block1 = evDim.getBlock(caretZ(evLoc,evRot,[0,1,1]));
				if (block0.isLiquidBlocking("Water") || block1.isLiquidBlocking("Water")) {
					eventEntity.applyImpulse({x:0,y:0.2,z:0});
				}
			}

		// 例: scriptevent aa:explodeOnHit_1_true_entityAttack_true_true_0
		
		const owner = eventEntity.getComponent("projectile")?.owner;
		if(!owner) return;

		const loc = eventEntity.location;
		const parts = eventId.split("_");
		if (parts.length < 5) return;

		const power = Number(parts[1]);
		if (!Number.isFinite(power)) return;

		let damageAmount;
    	const damageToken = parts[2];
		const damageNum = Number(damageToken);
		if (Number.isFinite(damageNum)) {
			damageAmount = damageNum;
		} else if (damageToken == "true") {
			damageAmount = true;
		} else if (damageToken == "false") {
			damageAmount = false;
		} else {
			return;
		}
		const damageCause = parts[3];

		if (parts[4] !== "true" && parts[4] !== "false") return;
		const breaksBlocks = parts[4] === "true";

		if (parts[5] !== "true" && parts[5] !== "false") return;
		const causesFire = parts[5] === "true";

		const akumanomi = parts[6] == "" ? undefined : Number(parts[6]);

		exePseudoExplode(
			owner,
			loc,
			{power,damageAmount,breaksBlocks,causesFire,damageCause,akumanomi}
		);

		const x = Math.floor(pos.x + fx);
		const y = Math.floor(pos.y);
		const z = Math.floor(pos.z + fz);

		const frontBlock = dim.getBlock({ x, y, z });

		// 足元前が固体なら上に少しだけ移動
		if (frontBlock==undefined || frontBlock.isAir==false) {
			eventEntity.applyKnockback({x:0,z:0}, 1.5);

				// CT開始 念のため2tick遅延
				system.runTimeout(()=>{
					eventEntity.setProperty("op_asa:boeufburst_state",2);
				},2);

				// CT終了
				system.runTimeout(()=>{
					eventEntity.setProperty("op_asa:boeufburst_state",0);
				},40);
			}else if(type == "morgan"){
				katanawaza.morganaxe_attack(eventEntity);
			}else if(type == "law2"){
				ope.law2_shoot(eventEntity);
			}else if(type == "marco"){
				tori.marco_hououin(eventEntity);
			}
		}
		// 船降り
		else if(eventId == "addon_mob_get_off"){
			const ridingComp = eventEntity.getComponent("riding");
			if(ridingComp==undefined) return;

			const rideEntity = ridingComp.entityRidingOn;
			const rideEntityId = rideEntity.typeId;
			const breakableEntitis = ["minecraft:boat","minecraft:chest_boat","minecraft:minecart"];

			// ボート系なら壊す
			if(breakableEntitis.includes(rideEntityId)){
				rideEntity.applyDamage(1000);
			}
			// それ以外なら降ろすだけ
			else{
				rideEntity.getComponent("rideable").ejectRiders();
			}
		}
		// 武装ガード
		else if(eventId == "addon_mob_guard"){
			// ノックバックキャンセル
			cancelKnockback(eventEntity);
			
			let controller = "controller.animation.addon_mob.root";
			let animationName = "animation.addon_mob.guard";
			let slow = true;

			// キャラによって変更
			if (eventEntity.typeId == "op_asa:kaigun2") controller = "controller.animation.kaigun2.root";
			else if (eventEntity.typeId == "op_asa:kaigun3") controller = "controller.animation.kaigun3.root";
			else if (eventEntity.typeId == "op_asa:morgan") {
				controller = "controller.animation.morgan.root";
				animationName = "animation.morgan.guard";
				slow = false;
			}

			// 速度低下
			if (slow) eventEntity.addEffect("slowness",10,{amplifier:200,showParticles:false});
			// アニメーション
			eventEntity.playAnimation(animationName,{controller,nextState:"default",blendOutTime:0.2,stopExpression:"q.any_animation_finished"});
		}
	}
	// 天竜人の大将召喚イベント
	else if(eventId == "tenryuubito_summon_taisyo"){
		const random = Math.floor(Math.random() * 6);

		// 青雉
		if(random==0){
			eventEntity.dimension.spawnEntity("op_asa:aokizi",eventEntity.location).setProperty("op_asa:tenryuubito_summoned",true);
			hie.ice_world(eventEntity);
		}
		// 赤犬
		else if(random==1){
			eventEntity.dimension.spawnEntity("op_asa:akainu",eventEntity.location).setProperty("op_asa:tenryuubito_summoned",true);
			fillCommand(eventEntity,eventEntity.location,[-32,-5,-32],[32,-1,32],BlockPermutation.resolve("minecraft:magma"));
			fillCommand(eventEntity,eventEntity.location,[-32,0,-32],[32,5,32],BlockPermutation.resolve("minecraft:magma"));
			fillCommand(eventEntity,eventEntity.location,[-32,0,-32],[32,5,32],BlockPermutation.resolve("minecraft:magma"));
		}
		// 黄猿
		else if(random==2){
			const dim = eventEntity.dimension;
			const loc = eventEntity.location;

			const kizaru = dim.spawnEntity("op_asa:kizaru",loc);
			kizaru.setProperty("op_asa:tenryuubito_summoned",true);
			
			const targetEntities = dim.getPlayers({location:loc,maxDistance:64});
			for(const targetEntity of targetEntities){
				applyVarious({
					target:targetEntity,
					damaging:kizaru,
					damage:{amount:100,cause:"none"}
				});
				const targetLoc = targetEntity.location;
				spawnExplosion(dim,targetLoc,"op_asa:amanoiwato");
	
				dim.spawnParticle("op_asa:amanoiwato_particle",targetLoc);
			}

			kizaru.teleport(targetEntities[0].location);
		}
		// 藤虎
		else if(random==3){
			eventEntity.dimension.spawnEntity("op_asa:fujitora",eventEntity.location).setProperty("op_asa:tenryuubito_summoned",true);

			const targetEntities = eventEntity.dimension.getEntities({location:eventEntity.location,maxDistance:32,excludeTags:["zushizushi"],excludeFamilies:["zushizushi"]});
			for(const targetEntity of targetEntities){
				// targetEntity.addEffect("slowness",60,{amplifier:10});
				if(targetEntity.typeId == "minecraft:player"){
					fillCommandDestroy(targetEntity,targetEntity.location,[-2,-5,-2],[2,-1,2]);
				}
			}
		}
		// ボルサリーノ
		else if(random==4){
			const borsalino = eventEntity.dimension.spawnEntity("op_asa:borsalino",eventEntity.location);

			borsalino.setProperty("op_asa:tenryuubito_summoned",true);
			pika.amaterasu(eventEntity);

		}
		// サカズキ
		else if(random==5){
			eventEntity.dimension.spawnParticle("op_asa:sakazuki_summoned_particle",eventEntity.location);

			eventEntity.dimension.spawnEntity("op_asa:sakazuki",eventEntity.location).setProperty("op_asa:tenryuubito_summoned",true);
			
		}
	}
	// カスタム図鑑
	else if(eventId == "akumanomizukan_custom"){
		const itemStack = eventEntity.getComponent("inventory").container.getItem(0);
		if(itemStack!=undefined){
			eventEntity.dimension.spawnItem(itemStack,eventEntity.location);
		}
		eventEntity.remove();
	}
	// 右手のアイテム1個減らす
	else if(eventId == "decrement_stack"){
		decrementStack(eventEntity,1);
	}
	// スキルアイテム全削除
	else if(eventId == "clear_all_skill"){
		clearAllSkill(eventEntity);
	}
	// ショップ店員切り替え
	else if(eventId == "shop_clerk"){
		entities.shop_clerk(eventEntity);
	}
	// ノックバック打消し
	else if(eventId == "knockback_cancel"){
		cancelKnockback(eventEntity);
	}
	// 六式
	else if(eventId.startsWith("rokushiki_")){
		if(eventId == "rokushiki_soru"){
			rokushiki.rokushiki_soru(eventEntity);
		}else if(eventId == "rokushiki_geppou"){
			rokushiki.rokushiki_geppou(eventEntity);
		}else if(eventId == "rokushiki_geppou_reset"){
			rokushiki.resetGeppouCount(eventEntity);
		}else if(eventId == "rokushiki_rankyaku_p"){
			rokushiki.rokushiki_rankyaku_p(eventEntity);
		}else if(eventId == "rokushiki_rokuogan"){
			rokushiki.rokuogan(eventEntity);
		}else if(eventId == "rokushiki_kamie_zanshin"){
			rokushiki.rokushiki_kamie_zanshin(eventEntity);
		}else if(eventId == "rokushiki_tekkai_rin"){
			rokushiki.rokushiki_tekkai_rin(eventEntity);
		}else if(eventId == "rokushiki_tekkai_rin_attack"){
			rokushiki.rokushiki_tekkai_rin_attack(eventEntity);
		}
	}
	// クールダウン
	else if(eventId.startsWith("cooldown_")){
		eventEntity.startItemCooldown(eventId.split("_")[1],Number(eventId.split("_")[2])*20);
	}
	// daily
	else if(eventId == "daily_supply"){
		// スコアを1に設定
		setScoreUtility(eventEntity,"daily_supply",1);
		setScoreUtility(eventEntity,"daily_alliance",1);
	}
	// アイテム入れ替え
	else if(eventId.startsWith("replaceItemInInventoryCombine_")){
		replaceItemInInventoryCombine(eventEntity,`op_asa:${eventId.split("_")[1]}`,`op_asa:${eventId.split("_")[2]}`);
	}
	// インベントリに配置する
	else if(eventId.startsWith("setItemInInventory")){
		const array = eventId.split(".");
		setItemInInventory(eventEntity,Number(array[1]),`op_asa:${array[2]}`,Number(array[3]),array[4]=="true",array[5]);
	}
    // 強制的に降ろす
    else if(eventId == "eject_riders"){
		eventEntity.getComponent("rideable").ejectRiders();
    }
	// サブタイトル表示
	else if(eventId.startsWith("showSubtitle")){
		const [_, text, duration] = eventId.split("_");
		const stayDuration = duration ? Number(duration) : null;
		showSubtitle(eventEntity,text,stayDuration);
	}
};

FILE: Pirate's_Breath_BP.zip :: Pirate's_Breath_BP/scripts/sneak.js

import { Player, world } from "@minecraft/server";
import { replaceEquipment, setItemInInventory } from "./function";
import { getAkumaExp, isAwakened } from "./status_akumanomi";
import { replaceKatanawaza } from "./status_katanawaza";


/**
 * スニークボタン押した時
 * @param {Player} player
 */
export function pressedSneak(player){
	// player.sendMessage("pressedSneak");

	// ボタンタップでスニークの場合、１回のタップでpressからreleaseまで行われて
	// スニーク解除するときにも同じことが起こる
	// これだと１回のスニーク時に２回実行される
	// 解除のタップでは実行されないようにisSneaking判定入れている
	if(!player.isSneaking) return;

	const mainhandItemStack = player.getComponent("equippable").getEquipment("Mainhand");
	const offhandItemStack = player.getComponent("equippable").getEquipment("Offhand");
	const akuma = player.getProperty("op_asa:akumanomi");
	const akumaType = player.getProperty("op_asa:akumanomi_type");

	// 右手にアイテムを持っている
	if(mainhandItemStack!=undefined){

		const itemId = mainhandItemStack.typeId;
		if(!itemId.includes("op_asa:")) return;

		const id = itemId.split("op_asa:")[1];

		// ホットバー8入れ替え
		if(id == "hotbar_8_status_all"){
			setItemInInventory(player,8,"op_asa:hotbar_8_haoshoku_all",1,true,"slot");
		}
		else if(id == "hotbar_8_haoshoku_all"){
			setItemInInventory(player,8,"op_asa:hotbar_8_kenbunshoku_all",1,true,"slot");
		}
		else if(id == "hotbar_8_kenbunshoku_all"){
			setItemInInventory(player,8,"op_asa:hotbar_8_status_all",1,true,"slot");
		}
		else if(id == "hotbar_8_status_h"){
			setItemInInventory(player,8,"op_asa:hotbar_8_haoshoku",1,true,"slot");
		}
		else if(id == "hotbar_8_haoshoku"){
			setItemInInventory(player,8,"op_asa:hotbar_8_status_h",1,true,"slot");
		}
		else if(id == "hotbar_8_status_k"){
			setItemInInventory(player,8,"op_asa:hotbar_8_kenbunshoku",1,true,"slot");
		}
		else if(id == "hotbar_8_kenbunshoku"){
			setItemInInventory(player,8,"op_asa:hotbar_8_status_k",1,true,"slot");
		}
		// 剣術入れ替え
		else if(mainhandItemStack.hasTag("op_asa:katanawaza")){
			replaceKatanawaza(player,id);
		}
		// オペ入れ替え
		else if(mainhandItemStack.hasTag("op_asa:opeope") && mainhandItemStack.hasTag("op_asa:sneaking_change")){
			ope(player,id);
		}
		// ゴム入れ替え
		else if(mainhandItemStack.hasTag("op_asa:gomgom") && mainhandItemStack.hasTag("op_asa:sneaking_change")){
			gom(player,id);
		}
		// ヨミ入れ替え
		else if(mainhandItemStack.hasTag("op_asa:yomiyomi") && mainhandItemStack.hasTag("op_asa:sneaking_change")){
			yomi(player,id);
		}
		// ヨミ入れ替え
		else if(mainhandItemStack.hasTag("op_asa:yomiyomi") && mainhandItemStack.hasTag("op_asa:sneaking_change")){
			yomi(player,id);
		}
		// キロ入れ替え
		else if(mainhandItemStack.hasTag("op_asa:kirokiro") && mainhandItemStack.hasTag("op_asa:sneaking_change")){
			kiro(player,id,"Mainhand");
		}
	}

	// 左手にアイテムを持っている
	if(offhandItemStack!=undefined){

		const itemId = offhandItemStack.typeId;
		if(!itemId.includes("op_asa:")) return;

		const id = itemId.split("op_asa:")[1];

		// キロ入れ替え
		if(offhandItemStack.hasTag("op_asa:kirokiro") && offhandItemStack.hasTag("op_asa:sneaking_change")){
			kiro(player,id,"Offhand");
		}
	}

	// ソルソル乗れないようにする
	if(akuma == 13){
		player.triggerEvent("rideable.default");
	}
	// ギア５巨人捕まえてるやつ降ろす
	else if(akuma == 14 && akumaType == 5 && player.getProperty("op_asa:gear5_gigant") != 0){
		player.getComponent("rideable").ejectRiders();
	}

}
/**
 * スニークボタン離した時
 * @param {Player} player
 */
export function releasedSneak(player){
	const akuma = player.getProperty("op_asa:akumanomi");

	// ソルソル乗れるようにする
	if(akuma == 13){
		player.triggerEvent("rideable.sorusoru");
	}

}


/**
 * 鬼哭/シャンブルズ/タクト入れ替え
 * @param {Player} player 
 * @param {String} id 
 */
function ope(player,id){
	const akumanomiType = player.getProperty("op_asa:akumanomi_type");

	const rroom = player.getDynamicProperty("room_or_rroom")=="rroom";

	// tact
	if(id.includes("tact1")){
		replaceEquipment(player,"Mainhand","op_asa:tact2",1,true,"inventory");
	}
	else if(id.includes("tact2")){
		replaceEquipment(player,"Mainhand","op_asa:tact1",1,true,"inventory");
	}
	// shambles
	else if(id.includes("shambles1")){
		replaceEquipment(player,"Mainhand","op_asa:shambles2",1,true,"inventory");
	}
	else if(id.includes("shambles2")){
		replaceEquipment(player,"Mainhand","op_asa:shambles1",1,true,"inventory");
	}
	// kikoku-room
	else if(id == "kikoku_off_ope" && !rroom){
		replaceEquipment(player,"Mainhand","op_asa:kikoku_amputate",1,true,"inventory");
	}
	else if(id == "kikoku_amputate"){
		replaceEquipment(player,"Mainhand","op_asa:kikoku_scan",1,true,"inventory");
	}
	else if(id == "kikoku_scan"){
		replaceEquipment(player,"Mainhand","op_asa:kikoku_injection",1,true,"inventory");
	}
	else if(id == "kikoku_injection"){
		replaceEquipment(player,"Mainhand","op_asa:kikoku_radio_knife",1,true,"inventory");
	}
	else if(id == "kikoku_radio_knife"){
		if(akumanomiType==0){
			replaceEquipment(player,"Mainhand","op_asa:kikoku_off_ope",1,true,"inventory");
		}else{
			replaceEquipment(player,"Mainhand","op_asa:kikoku_amputate",1,true,"inventory");
		}
	}
	// kikoku-kroom
	else if(id == "kikoku_kroom"){
		replaceEquipment(player,"Mainhand","op_asa:kikoku_kroom_shock_wille",1,true,"inventory");
	}
	else if(id == "kikoku_kroom_shock_wille"){
		replaceEquipment(player,"Mainhand","op_asa:kikoku_kroom_puncture_wille",1,true,"inventory");
	}
	else if(id == "kikoku_kroom_puncture_wille"){
		replaceEquipment(player,"Mainhand","op_asa:kikoku_kroom",1,true,"inventory");
	}
	// kikoku-rroom
	else if(id == "kikoku_off_ope"){
		replaceEquipment(player,"Mainhand","op_asa:kikoku_rroom_amputate",1,true,"inventory");
	}
	else if(id == "kikoku_rroom_amputate"){
		replaceEquipment(player,"Mainhand","op_asa:kikoku_rroom_scan",1,true,"inventory");
	}
	else if(id == "kikoku_rroom_scan"){
		replaceEquipment(player,"Mainhand","op_asa:kikoku_rroom_injection",1,true,"inventory");
	}
	else if(id == "kikoku_rroom_injection"){
		replaceEquipment(player,"Mainhand","op_asa:kikoku_rroom_radio_knife",1,true,"inventory");
	}
	else if(id == "kikoku_rroom_radio_knife"){
		if(akumanomiType==0){
			replaceEquipment(player,"Mainhand","op_asa:kikoku_off_ope",1,true,"inventory");
		}else{
			replaceEquipment(player,"Mainhand","op_asa:kikoku_rroom_amputate",1,true,"inventory");
		}
	}
}
/**
 * ギア入れ替え
 * @param {Player} player 
 * @param {String} id 
 */
function gom(player,id){
	const akumaExp = getAkumaExp(player,14);

	// ギア５状態以外でギア２
	if(id == "gear"){
		if(player.getProperty("op_asa:akumanomi_type")!=5){
			replaceEquipment(player,"Mainhand","op_asa:gear2",1,true,"inventory");
		}
	}
	// 経験値100未満でギア、100以上でギア４
	else if(id== "gear2"){
		if(akumaExp < 100){
			replaceEquipment(player,"Mainhand","op_asa:gear",1,true,"inventory");
		}
		else{
			replaceEquipment(player,"Mainhand","op_asa:gear4_1",1,true,"inventory");
		}
	}
	else if(id== "gear4_1"){
		replaceEquipment(player,"Mainhand","op_asa:gear4_3",1,true,"inventory");
	}
	// 経験値200以上で、ギアN状態ならギア５、それ以外はギア
	else if(id== "gear4_3"){
		if(isAwakened(player,14,akumaExp) && player.getProperty("op_asa:akumanomi_type")==0){
			replaceEquipment(player,"Mainhand","op_asa:gear5",1,true,"inventory");
		}
		else{
			replaceEquipment(player,"Mainhand","op_asa:gear",1,true,"inventory");
		}
	}
	else if(id== "gear5"){
		replaceEquipment(player,"Mainhand","op_asa:gear",1,true,"inventory");
	}
}
/**
 * 魂の喪剣入れ替え
 * @param {Player} player
 * @param {String} id 
 */
function yomi(player,id){
	if(id == "soul_solid"){
		replaceEquipment(player,"Mainhand","op_asa:soul_solid_on",1,true,"inventory");
	}
	else if(id== "soul_solid_on"){
		replaceEquipment(player,"Mainhand","op_asa:soul_solid_off",1,true,"inventory");
	}
	else if(id== "soul_solid_off"){
		replaceEquipment(player,"Mainhand","op_asa:soul_solid",1,true,"inventory");
	}
}
/**
 * キロ傘入れ替え
 * @param {Player} player
 * @param {String} id 
 * @param {String} equipmentSlot
 */
function kiro(player,id,equipmentSlot){
	if(id == "kiro_1kg"){
		replaceEquipment(player,equipmentSlot,"op_asa:kiro_10000kg",1,true,"inventory");
	}
	else if(id == "kiro_10000kg"){
		replaceEquipment(player,equipmentSlot,"op_asa:kiro_1kg",1,true,"inventory");
	}
}

import { ItemStack, Player, Entity, EquipmentSlot, world } from "@minecraft/server";
import { ActionFormData, ModalFormData } from "@minecraft/server-ui";
import { getScoreUtility, setScoreUtility, operationScoreUtility } from "./scoreboard";
import { decrementStack, giveCommand, showSubtitle } from "./function";
import { getAkumaExp, updateAkumaExp, trySendAwakenedMessage, statusAkumanomi } from "./status_akumanomi";
import { statusHakiInfusion } from "./status_haki";
import { statusButtonKatanawaza } from "./status_katanawaza";
import { getRokushikiLevel } from "./rokushiki";
import { statusButtonFighting } from "./status_fighting";
import { getJobExp, statusButtonJob, updateJobExp } from "./status_job";
import { statusButtonHelp } from "./status_help";
import { disableHealthBar } from "./entities";
import { addMyMoney, getMyMoney, statusButtonMoney } from "./status_money";

// -----------------------------------------------------
// 
// ステータス
// EXP: 0 ~ 4950 [0, 1, 3, 6, 10, 15, ...4950] (1:0, 10:45, 20:190, 30:435, 40:780, 50:1225)
// Lv.: 1 ~ 100
// 倒すごとに+n、リスト外なら一律+1
// 
// -----------------------------------------------------
export const MAX_STATUS_EXP = 4950;
/**
 * ステータス総合
 * @param {Player} player
 */
export function operationStatus(player) {

	// ステータスEXP
	const statusExp = player.getProperty("op_asa:status_level_exp");
	const statusLevel = getStatusLevel(player,statusExp);
	// 所属プロパティ
    const playerJobProperty = player.getProperty("op_asa:status_job");
	// 能力者
    const akuma = player.getProperty("op_asa:akumanomi");
	// E-S
    const ESuser = player.getProperty("op_asa:energy_steroid")!=0;
    const ESoverdose = player.getProperty("op_asa:energy_steroid")>100;
	// CT (纏う覇気使用不可)
	const isCT = akuma==14 && (player.getProperty("op_asa:akumanomi_type")==40 || player.getProperty("op_asa:akumanomi_type")==50);

    // body 配列
    const bodyLines = [
		{translate:"form.status.body.0"},{text:`${statusLevel} / 100\n`},
		{translate:"form.status.body.1"},{text:`${statusExp} / 4950`}
	]

    // ES情報
    if(ESuser){
        bodyLines.push({text:"\n--------------------------------"});
        bodyLines.push({translate:"energy_steroid"});
        bodyLines.push({text:`\ntime : ${getScoreUtility(player,"es_time")}  |  dosage : ${player.getProperty("op_asa:energy_steroid")}`});
        if(ESoverdose){
            bodyLines.push({text:"overdose"});
        }
    }

	// ボタンとアクションの配列
	const buttons = [];
	const actions = [];
	const icons = []; // アイコンも別配列で管理

	// 所属
	buttons.push({
		rawtext:[{translate:playerJobProperty==0 ? "form.status.selectJob" : (playerJobProperty<20 ? "status_job.pirate" : playerJobProperty<30 ? "status_job.marine" : "status_job.bountyhunter")}]
	});
	icons.push(playerJobProperty==0 ? "textures/form/status/citizen" : (playerJobProperty<20 ? "textures/form/status/kaizoku" : playerJobProperty<30 ? "textures/form/status/kaigun" : "textures/form/status/bountyhunter"));
	actions.push(() => statusButtonJob(player,playerJobProperty));

	// 能力者
	buttons.push({rawtext:[{text:akuma==0 ? "§7" : ""},{translate:"form.status.akumanomi"}]});
	icons.push("textures/form/status/akumanomi");
	actions.push(() => statusAkumanomi(player));

	// 纏う覇気
	if(isCT){
		buttons.push({rawtext:[{text:"§7"},{translate:"form.status.haki_infusion"}]});
		icons.push("textures/form/status/haki_infusion");
		actions.push(() => showSubtitle(player,"form.hakiInfusion.body.ct",15));
	}else{ 
		buttons.push({translate:"form.status.haki_infusion"});
		icons.push("textures/form/status/haki_infusion");
		actions.push(() => statusHakiInfusion(player));
	}

	// 格闘術・剣術・六式・お金・習得済みの覇気、ヘルプ
	buttons.push({translate:"form.status.fighting"});   icons.push("textures/form/status/fighting");     actions.push(() => statusButtonFighting(player));
	buttons.push({translate:"form.status.katanawaza"}); icons.push("textures/form/status/katanawaza");   actions.push(() => statusButtonKatanawaza(player));
	buttons.push({translate:"form.status.rokushiki"});  icons.push("textures/form/status/rokushiki");    actions.push(() => statusButtonRokushiki(player));
	buttons.push({translate:"form.status.money"});      icons.push("textures/form/status/money");        actions.push(() => statusButtonMoney(player));
	buttons.push({translate:"form.status.abilities"});  icons.push("textures/form/abilities/acquired/guard"); actions.push(() => statusButtonHaki(player));
	buttons.push({translate:"form.status.help"});       icons.push("textures/form/status/help");         actions.push(() => statusButtonHelp(player));

	// オペレーター
	if(player.playerPermissionLevel==2){
		buttons.push({translate:"form.status.operator"}); icons.push("textures/form/status/op"); actions.push(() => statusButtonOperator(player));
	}

	// クリエイティブ
	if(player.getGameMode()=="Creative"){
		buttons.push({rawtext:[{text:"§g§l"},{translate:"form.status.cheatMenu"},{text:"§f"}]}); 
		icons.push(""); 
		actions.push(() => statusButtonCheat(player,akuma));
	}

    // フォーム作成
    const statusMenu = new ActionFormData().title({rawtext:[{text:"\ue180"},{text:` ${player.nameTag}\ue180`}]});

	// body があれば追加
	statusMenu.body({rawtext: bodyLines});

	// ボタンを登録
	for(let i=0; i<buttons.length; i++){
		statusMenu.button(buttons[i], icons[i]);
	}

    // 表示
    statusMenu.show(player).then(response => {
        const idx = response.selection;
        if(idx>=0 && idx<actions.length){
            actions[idx](); // 選択されたボタンに対応する処理を呼ぶ
        }
    });
}
/**
 * 他のプレイヤーのステータスを表示
 * @param {Player} player
 * @param {Entity} targetEntity 
 */
export function showPlayerStatus(player,targetEntity) {
	// 所属プロパティ
    const jobNumber = targetEntity.getProperty("op_asa:status_job");
	// 懸賞金
	const bountyScore = getScoreUtility(targetEntity,"bounty1") + getScoreUtility(targetEntity,"bounty2") * 100000000;
	const bountyScoreStr = String(bountyScore).replace(/(\d)(?=(\d\d\d)+(?!\d))/g, '$1,');

    // フォーム表示
    const form = new ActionFormData()
	.title("")
	.button("gui.close");

	if(Math.floor(jobNumber/10) == 1){
		form.body({rawtext:[
			{text:`${targetEntity.nameTag}`},{text:`\n\n`},
			{translate:`status_job.${jobNumber}`},{text:`\n\n`},
			{translate:"form.status.bounty"},{text:`${bountyScoreStr}\ue121`},{text:`\n\n`},
		]});
	}else{
		form.body({rawtext:[
			{text:`${targetEntity.nameTag}`},{text:`\n\n`},
			{translate:`status_job.${jobNumber}`},{text:`\n\n`},
		]});
	}

	form.show(player);
}
/**
 * ステータスレベルを取得（上限100）
 * プロパティ未所持なら0を返す
 * 三角数列ベース: 必要経験値 = n(n-1)/2
 * @param {Player} player 
 * @param {Number} [currentExp] 省略可
 * @returns {Number}
 */
export function getStatusLevel(player,currentExp) {
    const exp = currentExp ?? player.getProperty("op_asa:status_level_exp") ?? 0;
    return getLevelForExp(exp);
}
/**
 * EXPからレベルを取得
 * @param {Number} exp 
 */
export function getLevelForExp(exp) {
    if (exp <= 0) return 1; // レベル1スタート
    const n = (1 + Math.sqrt(1 + 8 * exp)) / 2;
    return Math.min(100, Math.floor(n)); // レベル1以上、100以下
}
/**
 * ステータスレベルを設定(レベルに合わせてexpを設定する)
 * 三角数列ベース: 必要経験値 = n(n-1)/2
 * @param {Player} player 
 * @param {Number} level - 設定するレベル（0〜100）
 * @param {"status"|"job"} type 
 */
function setStatusLevel(player, level,type="status") {
	
    const lv = Math.min(100, Math.max(1, Math.floor(level))); // 1〜100に制限
    const exp = (lv * (lv - 1)) / 2;

    if (type=="status") {
		player.setProperty("op_asa:status_level_exp", exp);
	}
	else {
		updateJobExp(player,exp,"set","update");
	}
}
/**
 * ステータスEXPを加算して、ステータスレベルの変化を返す
 * タイミング-エンティティを倒した時
 * @param {Player} player 
 * @param {Number} value - 追加する値
 * @returns {{newExp:Number,currentLevel:Number,newLevel:Number}} 計算後のEXP, 現在のレベル, 計算後のレベル
 */
export function operationStatusLevel(player, value) {
    const currentExp = player.getProperty("op_asa:status_level_exp");
	const currentLevel = getStatusLevel(player,currentExp);

	const newExp = Math.min(MAX_STATUS_EXP,currentExp+value);
	player.setProperty("op_asa:status_level_exp",newExp);
	const newLevel = getStatusLevel(player,newExp);

	return {currentLevel, newLevel};
}
/**
 * HPを更新
 * タイミング-エンティティを倒した時、能力変更時、チート
 * @param {Player} player 
 * @param {number} level ステータスレベル(指定する場合以外省略)
 */
export function updateHp(player,level){
	const akuma = player.getProperty("op_asa:akumanomi");

	// HP設定
	const statusLevel = level ?? getStatusLevel(player);
	const hpComp = player.getComponent("health");
	const defaultHp = hpComp.defaultValue;

	// レベル帯ごとのHPテーブル
	const hpTable = [
		{ min: 0,   max: 4,  hp: 40 },
		{ min: 5,   max: 9,  hp: 48 },
		{ min: 10,  max: 14, hp: 56 },
		{ min: 15,  max: 19, hp: 64 },
		{ min: 20,  max: 24, hp: 72 },
		{ min: 25,  max: 29, hp: 80 },
		{ min: 30,  max: 34, hp: 88 },
		{ min: 35,  max: 39, hp: 96 },
		{ min: 40,  max: 44, hp: 104 },
		{ min: 45,  max: 49, hp: 112 },
		{ min: 50,  max: 54, hp: 120 },
		// --- ここから+4ずつ ---
		{ min: 55,  max: 59, hp: 124 },
		{ min: 60,  max: 64, hp: 128 },
		{ min: 65,  max: 69, hp: 132 },
		{ min: 70,  max: 74, hp: 136 },
		{ min: 75,  max: 79, hp: 140 },
		{ min: 80,  max: 84, hp: 144 },
		{ min: 85,  max: 89, hp: 148 },
		{ min: 90,  max: 94, hp: 152 },
		{ min: 95,  max: 99, hp: 156 },
		// 100以上
		{ min: 100, max: Infinity, hp: 160 },
	];

	// レベルに対応するHPを取得
	const entry = hpTable.find(e => statusLevel >= e.min && statusLevel <= e.max);
	if (!entry) return;
	const newHp = entry.hp;

	// --------------更新--------------
	if (akuma == 16){
		// 現在HP > 56 なら56にする
		if (defaultHp > 56) player.triggerEvent("health.56");
		// 現在HP <= 56 の場合
		else if (newHp <= 56 && defaultHp !== newHp) {
			// 56以下のときだけ更新
			player.triggerEvent(`health.${newHp}`);
		}
	}
	else {
		if (defaultHp !== newHp) {
			player.triggerEvent(`health.${newHp}`);
		}
	}
}
/**
 * 覇王色を更新
 * タイミング-エンティティを倒した時、チート
 * @param {Player} player 
 * @param {number} level ステータスレベル(省略可)
 */
export function updateHhaki(player,level){
	const h_haki = player.getProperty("op_asa:h_haki");
	const statusLevel = level ?? getStatusLevel(player);

	// 50 ~ :3
	if (statusLevel >= 50) {
		if (h_haki != 3) {
			player.setProperty("op_asa:h_haki",3);
			player.sendMessage({rawtext:[{translate:"rawtext.acquired_h_haki_3_1"},{text:"\n"},{translate:"rawtext.acquired_h_haki_3_2"}]});
		}
	}
	// 40 ~ 49 :2
	else if (statusLevel >= 40) {
		if (h_haki != 2) {
			player.setProperty("op_asa:h_haki",2);

			if (h_haki > 2) {
				player.sendMessage({translate:"rawtext.weakened_h_haki"});
			}
			else {
				player.sendMessage({rawtext:[{translate:"rawtext.acquired_h_haki_2_1"},{text:"\n"},{translate:"rawtext.acquired_h_haki_2_2"}]});
			}
		}
	}
	// 20 ~ 39 :1
	else if (statusLevel >= 20) {
		if (h_haki != 1) {
			player.setProperty("op_asa:h_haki",1);

			if (h_haki > 1) {
				player.sendMessage({translate:"rawtext.weakened_h_haki"});
				player.triggerEvent("haki_off");
			}
			else {
				player.sendMessage({translate:"rawtext.acquired_h_haki_1"});
			}
		}
	}
	// ~ 19 :0
	else {
		if (h_haki != 0) {
			player.setProperty("op_asa:h_haki",0);
			player.sendMessage({translate:"rawtext.lost_h_haki"});
			player.triggerEvent("haki_off");
		}
	}
}

/**
 * 覇気基礎(流桜含む)右クリック
 * @param {ItemStack} itemStack 
 * @param {Player} player
 */
export function haki_base_on_use(itemStack,player){
	const itemId = itemStack.typeId;
	// 流桜
	if(itemId == "op_asa:haki_acquire_ryuo"){
		// 未習得時のみ
		if(player.getProperty("op_asa:b_haki") != 2){
			decrementStack(player,1);
			player.setProperty("op_asa:b_haki",2);
			player.playSound("random.levelup");
			player.sendMessage({rawtext:[{translate:"rawtext.ryuo.acquired"}]});
		}
	}
	// 武装/見聞
	else {
		const hakiType = itemId == "op_asa:haki_base_busoshoku" ? "b_haki" : "k_haki";

		const hakiExp = player.getProperty(`op_asa:${hakiType}_exp`);

		// EXPがすでに最大
		if(hakiExp == 50){
			player.sendMessage({rawtext:[{translate:`rawtext.${hakiType}.levelmax`}]});
		}
		// EXP更新、アイテム消費
		else{
			const newExp = updateHakiExp(player,hakiType,hakiExp,1);

			if (hakiType == "b_haki") trySendAwakenedMessage(player,{currentState:{b_haki_exp:newExp}});
			else trySendAwakenedMessage(player,{currentState:{k_haki_exp:newExp}});

			decrementStack(player,1);
		}
	}
}
/**
 * 覇気EXPを更新
 * @param {Player} player 
 * @param {"b_haki"|"k_haki"} hakiType 覇気の種類
 * @param {number} exp 現在のExp
 * @param {Number} value 加算/設定する値
 * @param {"set"|"add"} type - 更新方法
 * @returns {Number} 更新後の値
 */
export function updateHakiExp(player,hakiType="b_haki",exp,value,type="add"){
	const currentExp = exp ?? player.getProperty(`op_asa:${hakiType}_exp`);
	const newExp = type=="add" ? currentExp + value : value;
	
	// EXPプロパティ更新
	player.setProperty(`op_asa:${hakiType}_exp`,newExp);

	// 加算
	if (type=="add") {
		// 未習得だった場合
		if(currentExp == 0){
			// 習得
			if (hakiType == "b_haki") player.setProperty("op_asa:b_haki",1);
			else player.setProperty("op_asa:k_haki",true);
			// 
			player.playSound("random.levelup");
			player.sendMessage({rawtext:[{translate:`rawtext.${hakiType}.acquired`}]});
		}
		// レベルアップ(一の位が9のとき)
		else if(currentExp%10 == 9){
			player.playSound("random.levelup");
			player.sendMessage({rawtext:[{translate:`rawtext.${hakiType}.levelup`}]});
		}
		// その他
		else if(true){
			player.playSound("random.orb");
			player.sendMessage({rawtext:[{translate:`rawtext.${hakiType}.exp`}]});
		}
	}
	// 設定
	else {
		// 未習得で0以外を選択しているなら習得
		if(currentExp == 0 && value != 0){
			// 習得
			if (hakiType == "b_haki") player.setProperty("op_asa:b_haki",1);
			else player.setProperty("op_asa:k_haki",true);
			// 
			player.playSound("random.levelup");
			player.sendMessage({rawtext:[{translate:`rawtext.${hakiType}.acquired`}]});
		}
		// 習得済みで0を選択しているなら覇気を失う
		else if(currentExp != 0 && value == 0){
			// 習得
			if (hakiType == "b_haki") player.setProperty("op_asa:b_haki",0);
			else player.setProperty("op_asa:k_haki",false);
		}
	}

	return newExp;
}
/**
 * 覇気の情報を取得：現在の経験値、レベル(＋文字表示)。次のレベルまでの経験値。
 * @param {Player} player 
 * @param {"b_haki"|"k_haki"} hakiType 覇気の種類
 */
export function getHakiInfo(player,hakiType="b_haki"){
	// 現在の経験値
	const currentExp = player.getProperty(`op_asa:${hakiType}_exp`);
	// 現在のレベル
	const currentLevel = Math.floor(currentExp/10);
	// 次のレベルに必要な経験値
	const requiredExp = currentExp==50 ? " - " : (10 - currentExp%10).toString();
	// 現在のレベル文字表示
	const currentlevelString = currentLevel === 0 ? "" : "HakiLevel_" + currentLevel.toString();

	return { currentExp, currentLevel, requiredExp, currentlevelString }
}

/**

	const button0 = rokushikiExp >=1;
	const button1 = rokushikiExp >=4;
	const button2 = rokushikiExp >=7;
	const button3 = rokushikiExp >=9;
	const button4 = rokushikiExp >=10;
	const button5 = rokushikiExp >=12;
	const button6 = rokushikiExp >=13;
	const button7 = rokushikiExp >=16;
	const button8 = rokushikiExp >=19;

	// フォーム作成
	const formRokushikiMenu = new ActionFormData()
	.title({rawtext:[{text:"\ue180"},{translate:"form.status.rokushiki"},{text:"\ue180"}]})
	.body(
		{
			rawtext:[

		const rokushikiId = rokushikiList[rokushikiNumber];

				);

							{text:hasRokushikiInventory(player,`op_asa:rokushiki_${rokushikiId}`) ? "§1" : ""},

					`textures/items/rokushiki/${rokushikiId}`

			}
			// それ以外: 持っているかどうか＋レベル表記
			else if(true){
				formRokushikiMenu.button(
					{
						rawtext:[
							{text:hasRokushikiInventory(player,`op_asa:rokushiki_${rokushikiId}`) ? "§1" : ""},
							{translate:`form.rokushiki.${rokushikiList[rokushikiNumber]}`},{translate:`HakiLevel_${rokushikiLevel}`}

			}

	}
	// ボタン追加
	addButton(button0,0);
	addButton(button1,1);
	addButton(button2,2);
	addButton(button3,3);
	addButton(button4,4);
	addButton(button5,5);
	addButton(button6,6);
	addButton(button7,7);
	addButton(button8,8);

						{translate:"form.rokushiki.info.1"},{text:"\n"},

						{translate:"form.rokushiki.info.4"},{text:"\n\n"},

		else if(selectNum==1){

			if(bootsProp=="soru"){

				player.sendMessage({rawtext:[{translate:"rawtext.prop_boots.inactivate.soru"}]});
			}
			else if(bootsProp=="soru_geppou_logia"){
				player.setProperty("op_asa:boots","geppou_logia");
				player.sendMessage({rawtext:[{translate:"rawtext.prop_boots.inactivate.soru"}]});
			}
			else if(bootsProp=="geppou"){
				player.setProperty("op_asa:boots","soru_geppou");
				player.sendMessage({rawtext:[{translate:"rawtext.prop_boots.activate.soru"}]});
			}
			else if(bootsProp=="geppou_logia"){
				player.setProperty("op_asa:boots","soru_geppou_logia");
				player.sendMessage({rawtext:[{translate:"rawtext.prop_boots.activate.soru"}]});
			}
			else if(bootsProp=="logia"){
				player.setProperty("op_asa:boots","soru_logia");
				player.sendMessage({rawtext:[{translate:"rawtext.prop_boots.activate.soru"}]});
			}
			else if(bootsProp=="default"){
				player.setProperty("op_asa:boots","soru");
				player.sendMessage({rawtext:[{translate:"rawtext.prop_boots.activate.soru"}]});

		}
		// 月歩: 切り替え
		else if(selectNum==2){

			const bootsProp = player.getProperty("op_asa:boots");
			
			if(bootsProp=="soru"){
				player.setProperty("op_asa:boots","soru_geppou");
				player.sendMessage({rawtext:[{translate:"rawtext.prop_boots.activate.geppou"}]});

				player.setProperty("op_asa:boots","logia");
				player.sendMessage({rawtext:[{translate:"rawtext.prop_boots.inactivate.geppou"}]});

/**
 * 指定の六式が有効かどうか
 * @param {Player} player
 * @param {Number} rokushikiNumber 0:soru,1:geppou
 */
function isActiveRokushiki(player,rokushikiNumber){
	/**@type {String} */
	const bootsProp = player.getProperty("op_asa:boots");

	// 剃
	if(rokushikiNumber==0){
		return bootsProp.includes("soru");
	}
	// 月歩
	else if(rokushikiNumber==1){
		return bootsProp.includes("geppou");
	}
}
/**
 * 指定の六式がインベントリ内にあるかどうか
 * @param {Player} player
 * @param {String} rokushikiItemId
 */
function hasRokushikiInventory(player,rokushikiItemId){
    const inventoryComp = player.getComponent("minecraft:inventory");
	
	let count = 0;

    for(let slotNumber=0; slotNumber<=35; slotNumber++ ){
        const itemStack = inventoryComp.container.getItem(slotNumber);
        if(itemStack!=undefined){
			if(itemStack.typeId == rokushikiItemId){
				count = 1;
			}
        }
    }
	const equippableComp = player.getComponent("minecraft:equippable");
	for(const equipmentSlot of Object.values(EquipmentSlot)){
		if(equippableComp.getEquipment(equipmentSlot)!=undefined){
			if(equippableComp.getEquipment(equipmentSlot).typeId == rokushikiItemId){
				count = 1;
			}
        }
	}
	return count == 1 ? true : false;
}
/**
 * 指定の六式を消す
 * @param {Player} player
 * @param {String} itemId
 * @param {Number} amount
 */
function clearRokushiki(player,itemId){
	// 全スロットから削除
	const inventoryComp = player.getComponent("minecraft:inventory");
	for(let slotNumber=0; slotNumber<=35; slotNumber++){
		const itemStack = inventoryComp.container.getItem(slotNumber);
		if(itemStack != undefined){
			if(itemStack.typeId==itemId){
				inventoryComp.container.setItem(slotNumber,undefined);
			}
		}
	}
	// 全装備スロットから削除
	const equippableComp = player.getComponent("minecraft:equippable");
	for(const equipmentSlot of Object.values(EquipmentSlot)){
		const itemStack = equippableComp.getEquipment(equipmentSlot);
		if(itemStack != undefined){
			if(itemStack.typeId == itemId){
				equippableComp.setEquipment(equipmentSlot,undefined);
			}
		}
	}
}

/**
 * オペレーター限定の設定
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
function statusButtonOperator(player){
	const toggle0 = world.getDynamicProperty("akumanomi_exp") ?? true;
	const toggle1 = world.getDynamicProperty("akumanomi_death") ?? true;
	const toggle2 = world.gameRules.doTileDrops;
	const toggle3 = world.gameRules.mobGriefing;
	const toggle4 = world.getDynamicProperty("block_breakable") ?? true;
	const toggle5 = world.getDynamicProperty("block_replaceable") ?? true;
	const toggle6 = world.getDynamicProperty("healthbar_visible") ?? true;

	// フォーム作成
	new ModalFormData()
		.title("form.status.operator")
		.toggle({rawtext:[{translate:"form.operator.akumanomi_exp"}]},{defaultValue:toggle0,tooltip:{translate:"form.operator.akumanomi_exp.tooltip"}})
		.toggle({rawtext:[{translate:"form.operator.akumanomi_death"}]},{defaultValue:toggle1,tooltip:{translate:"form.operator.akumanomi_death.tooltip"}})
		.divider()
		.toggle({rawtext:[{translate:"createWorldScreen.tileDrops"}]},{defaultValue:toggle2,tooltip:{translate:"form.operator.tileDrops.tooltip"}})
		.toggle({rawtext:[{translate:"createWorldScreen.mobgriefing"}]},{defaultValue:toggle3,tooltip:{translate:"form.operator.mobgriefing.tooltip"}})
		.toggle({rawtext:[{translate:"form.operator.block_breakable"}]},{defaultValue:toggle4,tooltip:{translate:"form.operator.block_breakable.tooltip"}})
		.toggle({rawtext:[{translate:"form.operator.block_replaceable"}]},{defaultValue:toggle5,tooltip:{translate:"form.operator.block_replaceable.tooltip"}})
		.toggle({rawtext:[{translate:"form.operator.healthbar_visible"}]},{defaultValue:toggle6,tooltip:{translate:"form.operator.healthbar_visible.tooltip"}})
		.show(player).then(result => {
			if (result.canceled) return;

			world.setDynamicProperty("akumanomi_exp",result.formValues[0]);
			world.setDynamicProperty("akumanomi_death",result.formValues[1]);
			world.gameRules.doTileDrops = result.formValues[3];
			world.gameRules.mobGriefing = result.formValues[4];
			world.setDynamicProperty("block_breakable",result.formValues[5]);
			world.setDynamicProperty("block_replaceable",result.formValues[6]);
			world.setDynamicProperty("healthbar_visible",result.formValues[7]);
			if (result.formValues[7] === false) {
				disableHealthBar(player);
			}
			
			// 通知
			world.sendMessage(
				{
					rawtext:[
						{text:"§g§l["},{translate:"form.status.operator"},{text:"]§r\n"},
						{translate:"form.operator.akumanomi_exp"},{text:`: §b${result.formValues[0]}§f\n`},
						{translate:"form.operator.akumanomi_death"},{text:`: §b${result.formValues[1]}§f\n`},
						{translate:"createWorldScreen.tileDrops"},{text:`: §b${result.formValues[3]}§f\n`},
						{translate:"createWorldScreen.mobgriefing"},{text:`: §b${result.formValues[4]}§f\n`},
						{translate:"form.operator.block_breakable"},{text:`: §b${result.formValues[5]}§f\n`},
						{translate:"form.operator.block_replaceable"},{text:`: §b${result.formValues[6]}§f\n`},
						{translate:"form.operator.healthbar_visible"},{text:`: §b${result.formValues[7]}§f`}
					]
				}
			);
	});
}
/**

 * @param {Player} player 
 * @param {Number} akuma 
 */

	/**
	 * ステータスレベル
	 * 所属レベル
	 * 武装経験値
	 * 見聞経験値
	 * 六式経験値
	 * 能力者経験値
	 * 能力パワー

	 * お金
	 */
	const statusLevel = getStatusLevel(player);
	const statusJobLevel = getStatusLevel(player,getJobExp(player));
	const b_haki_exp = player.getProperty("op_asa:b_haki_exp");
	const k_haki_exp = player.getProperty("op_asa:k_haki_exp");
	const rokushiki_exp = player.getProperty("op_asa:rokushiki_exp");
	const akumaExp = getAkumaExp(player,akuma,true);// ワールド設定を無視するので本来のexpを表示

	.slider({rawtext:[{translate:"form.cheatMenu.statusLevel"}]}, 1, 100, {valueStep:1,defaultValue:statusLevel})
	.slider({rawtext:[{translate:"form.cheatMenu.statusJobLevel"}]}, 1, 100, {valueStep:1,defaultValue:statusJobLevel})
