const KATANAWAZA_REPLACE_DEFAULT_LIST = [-1, -1, -1, -1];
/**
 * 入れ替えリストを取得 (parse済み)
 * @param {Player} player 
 * @returns {number[]}
 */
function getKatanawazaReplaceList(player) {
    const dprop = player.getDynamicProperty("katanawaza_replace_list");
    return dprop ? JSON.parse(dprop) : KATANAWAZA_REPLACE_DEFAULT_LIST;
}
/**
 * 入れ替えリストを設定
 * @param {Player} player 
 * @param {number[]} list 
 */
function setKatanawazaReplaceList(player,list) {
    player.setDynamicProperty("katanawaza_replace_list",JSON.stringify(list));
}
/**
 * 剣術アイテムを置き換える
 * @param {Player} player 
 * @param {string} id (namespace含まない)
 */
export function replaceKatanawaza(player,id) {
	// idから剣術番号を取得
	const wazaNum = KATANAWAZA_ID_LIST.indexOf(id);
	// world.sendMessage(`現在の剣術番号: ${wazaNum}`);

	// 剣術番号がとれないなら処理を終了
	if (wazaNum < 0) return;

	// 入れ替えデータ
	const replaceList = getKatanawazaReplaceList(player);
	// world.sendMessage(`入れ替えリスト: ${replaceList}`);

	// 入れ替えデータ設定なしなら処理を終了
	if (!replaceList) return;

	// 剣術番号が入れ替えデータの何番目か
	const listNum = replaceList.indexOf(wazaNum);

	// 入れ替えデータに含まれていないなら処理を終了
	if (listNum < 0) return;

	// 入れ替えデータの次の番号を取得(-1以外になるまで最大3回繰り返す、空スロットならその次のスロットにするため)
	let nextWazaNum = -1;
	for (let count = 1; count <= 3; count++) {
		const index = (listNum + count) % replaceList.length;
		const value = replaceList[index];

		if (value >= 0) {
			nextWazaNum = value;
			break;
		}
	}

	// 入れ替え先がないなら処理を終了
	if (nextWazaNum == -1) return;

	// 入れ替える
	const nextData = KATANAWAZA_ID_LIST[nextWazaNum];
	if (nextData) {
		replaceEquipment(player,"Mainhand",`op_asa:${nextData}`,1,true,"inventory");
	}
}

import { Player, world } from "@minecraft/server";
import { ModalFormData } from "@minecraft/server-ui";
import { getScoreUtility } from "./scoreboard";
import { decrementStack, formatNumber, giveCommand } from "./function";


// -----------------------------------------------------
// 
// 所持金
// 
// -----------------------------------------------------
/**
 * ボタン-所持金
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function statusButtonMoney(player){
	const myMoney = getMyMoney(player);

	new ModalFormData()
		.title("form.status.money")
		.label({rawtext:[{translate:"form.status.money"},{text:`: §g${formatNumber(myMoney)}\ue121`}]})
		.divider()
		.slider("10", 0, 90, {valueStep:10})
		.slider("100", 0, 900, {valueStep:100})
		.slider("1000", 0, 9000, {valueStep:1000})
		.slider("10000", 0, 90000, {valueStep:10000})
		.slider("100000", 0, 900000, {valueStep:100000})
		.slider("1000000", 0, 9000000, {valueStep:1000000})
		.slider("10000000", 0, 90000000, {valueStep:10000000})
		.slider("100000000", 0, 900000000, {valueStep:100000000})
		.submitButton("form.money.submitButton")
		.show(player)
		.then(result => {
			if (result.canceled) return;
			
			const withdrawMoney = result.formValues[2] + result.formValues[3] + result.formValues[4] + result.formValues[5] + result.formValues[6] + result.formValues[7] + result.formValues[8] + result.formValues[9];

			if (addMyMoney(player,myMoney,-withdrawMoney)) {
				for(let num = 2; num <= 9; ++num){
					const money = result.formValues[num];
					const digit = 10**(num-1);
					const moneyQuantity = money / digit;
					if(money > 0){
						giveCommand(player,`op_asa:money${digit}`,moneyQuantity,false,"none");
					}
				}
			}
	});
}
/**
 * 所持金を取得(DynamicProperty:my_money)
 * @param {Player} player 
 * @returns {number} 
 */
export function getMyMoney(player) {
	const myMoney = player.getDynamicProperty("my_money");

	if (myMoney === undefined) {

		// v75まではスコアに保存していたのでdpropに書き換える
		const score = getScoreUtility(player,"money1") + getScoreUtility(player,"money2") * 100000000;
		world.scoreboard.getObjective("money1").removeParticipant(player);
		world.scoreboard.getObjective("money2").removeParticipant(player);
		world.sendMessage("Money System Updated !");

		player.setDynamicProperty("my_money",score);
		return score;
	} else {
		return myMoney;
	}
}
/**
 * 所持金を追加/減少
 * @param {Player} player 
 * @param {number} myMoney 
 * @param {number} value 
 * @returns {number|false} 更新後の所持金。所持金が不足する場合はfalse
 */
export function addMyMoney(player,myMoney,value) {
	const newMoney = myMoney + value;

	if (newMoney < 0) {
		player.sendMessage({rawtext:[{translate:"rawtext.noMoney"}]});
		return false;
	}

	player.setDynamicProperty("my_money",newMoney);
	return newMoney;
}
/**
 * お金アイテム-使用して所持金に変換する
 * @param {ItemStack} itemStack 
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function on_use_money(itemStack,player){
	const itemAmount = itemStack.amount;
	const itemId = itemStack.typeId;
	const money = itemAmount*itemId.split("money")[1];

	addMyMoney(player,getMyMoney(player),money);
	
	decrementStack(player,itemAmount,true);
}

FILE: Pirate's_Breath_BP.zip :: Pirate's_Breath_BP/scripts/training.js
==========================================================================================

import { Block, BlockPermutation, Entity, EntityDamageCause, Player, system, world } from "@minecraft/server";
import { MessageFormData } from "@minecraft/server-ui";
import { formatNumber, shiftLocation } from "./function";
import { addMyMoney, getMyMoney } from "./status_money";



const LEVEL = "op_asa:level"; // エンティティプロパティ、ブロックプロパティ
const TRAINING_SITE_ENTITY = "op_asa:training_site_entity"; 
const TRAINING_START_LOC = "training_start_location"; // トレーニング開始位置のダイナミックプロパティ(これで対応するブロックを取得する)

/**
 * トレーニングブロック-インタラクト
 * @param {Block} block 
 * @param {Player} player 
 */
export function training_site_on_interact(block,player){
	const dim = block.dimension;
	const loc = block.location;
	const perm = block.permutation;

	// 発動中で対応するエンティティがいるなら開始しない、発動中でも対応するエンティティがいないなら開始する
	const isActive = perm.getState("op_asa:is_active");
	if (isActive) {
		for (const target of dim.getEntities({type:TRAINING_SITE_ENTITY,location:loc,maxDistance:64})) {
			const dporp = target.getDynamicProperty(TRAINING_START_LOC);
			if (loc.x === dporp.x && loc.y === dporp.y && loc.z === dporp.z) {
				player.sendMessage({translate:"form.training.isActive"});
				return;
			}
		}
	}

	// 開始
	const level = perm.getState(LEVEL);

	// レベルに応じて必要な金額
	const cost = Math.pow(level-1,4) * 1000;
	const myMoney = getMyMoney(player);

	// フォーム
	const form = new MessageFormData().title("form.training.title").button1("gui.yes").button2("gui.no")
	if (cost === 0) {
		form.body({rawtext:[
			{translate:"form.training.body.level"},{text:`${level}\n\n`},
			{translate:"form.training.body.start"},
		]});
	} else {
		form.body({rawtext:[
			{translate:"form.training.body.level"},{text:`: ${level}\n\n`},
			{translate:"form.training.body.requiredMoney"},{text:`: ${formatNumber(cost)}\ue121\n`},
			{translate:"form.status.money"},{text:`: ${formatNumber(myMoney)}\ue121\n`},
			{translate:"form.training.body.start"},
		]})
	}
	form.show(player).then(res => {
		if (res.selection === 0) {
			if (addMyMoney(player,myMoney,-cost)) {
				// 開始
				for (const player of dim.getPlayers({maxDistance:32,location:loc})) {
					player.onScreenDisplay.setTitle({translate:"form.training.start"},{fadeInDuration:0,fadeOutDuration:10,stayDuration:40});
					player.playSound("training_start");
				}
				block.setPermutation(BlockPermutation.resolve(block.typeId,{"op_asa:is_active":true,"op_asa:level":level}));
				const entity = dim.spawnEntity(TRAINING_SITE_ENTITY,loc);
				entity.setProperty(LEVEL,level);
				entity.setDynamicProperty(TRAINING_START_LOC,loc);// 自分のブロックの座標を保存
				system.runTimeout(()=>{training_site_loop(entity);},1); // ここで最初の一回を実行、以降はエンティティのtimer (遅延するのはpropertyの変更を待つため)
			}
		}
	});
}
/**
 * トレーニングエンティティ-ループ
 * @param {Entity} entity 
 */
export function training_site_loop(entity){
	const level = entity.getProperty(LEVEL);

	// Mobをランダムな位置に召喚
	const dim = entity.dimension;
	const loc = entity.location;
	// 召喚数決定(レベル数、召喚制限16)
	const max = level;
	const currentCount = dim.getEntities({location:loc,maxDistance:64,propertyOptions:[{propertyId:"op_asa:is_spawned_by_training",value:true}]}).length;
	const spawnableCount = Math.min(Math.max(16 - currentCount),max);
	if (spawnableCount <= 0) return;
	// world.sendMessage(`§b召喚!: ${spawnableCount}`);

	for (let count=1; count<=spawnableCount; count++) {
		// 4~16のランダムな位置
		const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
		const distance = 4 + Math.random() * 12;
		let spawnLoc = {
			x: loc.x + Math.cos(angle) * distance,
			y: loc.y,
			z: loc.z + Math.sin(angle) * distance,
		};
		// 空気以外なら上に1ブロック上げる
		let height = 0;
		while (!dim.getBlock(spawnLoc).isAir && height < 20) {
			spawnLoc = shiftLocation(spawnLoc, 0, 1, 0);
			height++;
		}
		if (dim.getBlock(spawnLoc).isAir) {
			dim.spawnParticle("op_asa:kaido_buka_spawner_particle",spawnLoc);
			dim.spawnEntity(randomMob(level),spawnLoc,{spawnEvent:"op_asa:spawned_by_training"});
		}
	}
}
/**
 * スポーンさせる敵をレベルに応じて決定
 * @param {number} level 
 */
function randomMob(level) {
	const weights = [
		[10, 0,  0],
		[9,  1,  0],
		[8,  2,  0],
		[7,  3,  0],
		[6,  4,  0],
		[5,  5,  0],
		[4,  5,  1],
		[3,  5,  2],
		[2,  5,  3],
		[1,  5,  4],
		[0,  5,  5],
		[0,  4,  6],
		[0,  3,  7],
		[0,  2,  8],
		[0,  1,  9],
		[0,  0, 10]
	];

	const [weightA, weightB] = weights[level - 1];
	const random = Math.random() * 10;

	if (random < weightA) {
		return "op_asa:kaizoku";
	} else if (random < weightA + weightB) {
		return "op_asa:kaizoku2";
	} else {
		return "op_asa:kaizoku5";
	}
}
/**
 * 敵死亡時にトレーニングエンティティにダメージ与える
 * MAX:1000
 * @param {Entity} entity 
 */
export function training_site_progress(entity){
	// world.sendMessage("§b1体倒した!");

	for (const target of entity.dimension.getEntities({type:TRAINING_SITE_ENTITY,closest:1,location:entity.location,maxDistance:64})) {
		target.applyDamage(100/target.getProperty(LEVEL),{cause:EntityDamageCause.selfDestruct});
		// target.applyDamage(1000,{cause:EntityDamageCause.selfDestruct});
	}
}
/**
 * トレーニングエンティティ-エンティティ死亡時にトレーニング完了
 * @param {Entity} entity 
 */
export function training_site_complete(entity){
	const dim = entity.dimension;
	const loc = entity.location;
	const dprop = entity.getDynamicProperty(TRAINING_START_LOC);
	
	// 完了
	const players = dim.getPlayers({maxDistance:32,location:loc});
	for (const player of players) {
		player.onScreenDisplay.setTitle({translate:"form.training.complete"},{fadeInDuration:0,fadeOutDuration:10,stayDuration:40});
		// player.playSound("random.levelup");
		player.playSound("training_complete");
	}

	// -16~16の範囲で対応するブロックを探す
	let block;
	for (let x = -16; x <= 16; x++) {
		for (let y = -16; y <= 16; y++) {
			for (let z = -16; z <= 16; z++) {
				const serchLoc = {
					x: loc.x + x,
					y: loc.y + y,
					z: loc.z + z
				};
				const targetBlock = dim.getBlock(serchLoc);
				if (targetBlock?.typeId !== "op_asa:training_site") continue;

				const targetBlockLoc = targetBlock.location;
				if (targetBlockLoc.x === dprop.x && targetBlockLoc.y === dprop.y && targetBlockLoc.z === dprop.z) {
					block = targetBlock;
					break;
				}
			}
		}
	}

	// ブロックが存在するならレベルを上げる
	if (block) {
		const currentLevel = block.permutation.getState(LEVEL);

		// 16未満ならレベルアップ
		if (currentLevel < 16) {
			// world.sendMessage("§bトレーニングレベルアップ!");
			for (const player of players) {
				player.onScreenDisplay.updateSubtitle({translate:"form.training.levelUp"});
			}
			block.setPermutation(BlockPermutation.resolve(block.typeId,{[LEVEL]:currentLevel+1}));
		}

		// 戦利品ルーレットを召喚
		dim.spawnEntity("op_asa:loot_roulette",shiftLocation(block.location,0.5,0,-0.5),{initialRotation:180});
	}

	// エンティティ削除
	entity.remove();
}
